papers.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
papers.abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. First, such learned capabilities solve a recurring task on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases across every model, significantly reducing solution non-determinism and improving reliability. Second, Phronix turns an agent's own execution into 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task without user instruction, and creation falls below two once the needed capability exists. Third, warm-start runs consume only 0.38-0.40 million tokens per task, which is three to four times less than a single baseline attempt, while a cold-start costs no more than the baseline. On the 1000 Genome Pegasus workflow, instrumenting a production application for I/O performance analysis, Phronix passes all 11 correctness checks against six for the baseline harness, and also lifts the task solving rates of two cheaper models from 29% and 27% of SWE-bench tasks solved to 91% and 87%, respectively, matching the performance of the most expensive evaluated model.

translation.title: Phronix：面向智能体的以能力为中心的学习范式
translation.abstract: 科学计算日益依赖基于大语言模型的智能体来完成性能工程任务，如插桩、分析和工作流移植。然而，智能体的效果在很大程度上取决于其周围的harness，而harness通常依赖人工编写的技能和精心整理的记忆。这限制了自主学习，迫使智能体反复重新发现解决方案，而不是保留和复用先前执行中获得的知识。我们提出Phronix，一种以能力为中心的学习范式，使agentic harness能够从自身执行中获取、验证和精炼可复用的能力。Phronix通过预测器-验证器-纠正器循环运作：MCP工具及相关技能提出解决方案，工具执行对其进行验证，观察到的结果再精炼存储的能力。它将每次观察到的交互蒸馏到能力库中，并对失败的任务进行研究而非放弃。首先，这样学到的能力使每个模型在93-95%的情况下首次尝试即可解决重复出现的任务，显著降低了求解的非确定性并提高了可靠性。其次，Phronix在无用户指令的情况下，将智能体自身的执行转化为每任务7.6-30.8个持久能力，而当所需能力已存在时，能力创建数降至两个以下。第三，warm-start运行每任务仅消耗0.38-0.40百万token，比单次基线尝试少三到四倍，而cold-start的成本不超过基线。在1000 Genome Pegasus工作流（为生产应用插桩以进行I/O性能分析）上，Phronix通过了全部11项正确性检查，而基线harness仅通过六项；同时将两个较便宜模型在SWE-bench任务上的求解率从29%和27%分别提升至91%和87%，与所评估的最昂贵模型的性能相当。
translation.brief: 针对智能体依赖人工技能、无法复用历史执行知识的问题，提出Phronix范式，通过预测器-验证器-纠正器循环从自身执行中自动获取、验证并精炼可复用能力。

papers.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
papers.abstract: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. The output is an annotated and revised version of the paper, a report of the changes, and Lean code in which each declaration is linked to the statement it formalizes. The author's toolkit grows as more papers are formalized, and authors can share their verified papers so that researchers who build on them can reuse their Lean code. By making verified papers practical to produce, PaperFormalizer aims to make research that rests on mathematical proofs more robust. PaperFormalizer runs inside a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and is available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer. Papers with Lean code shared by users are available at https://paperformalizer.org.

translation.title: PaperFormalizer：作者在环的研究论文Lean自动形式化
translation.abstract: 即使经过仔细校对的论文，其证明或所陈述的假设中也可能存在小的缺口。我们提出PaperFormalizer，一个基于Lean的agentic流水线，帮助作者发现并弥合自己论文中的此类缺口，并将每篇论文转化为经Lean验证的版本。从LaTeX源码出发，PaperFormalizer将论文转录为命题的依赖图，用自然语言审计每个命题的忠实性、歧义性和正确性，然后基于Mathlib、可选领域库和作者的个人工具箱在Lean中形式化并证明这些命题。只有作者知道一个命题的本意以及如何最好地修复结果中的形式化缺口。因此，每当一个命题存在多种解读时，流水线会停下来询问作者，以自然语言和TeX符号呈现每个修复方案作为提案，供作者接受、拒绝或调整，并将任何可能改变论文主张的决策留给作者。输出是论文的带注释修订版、变更报告以及Lean代码，其中每个声明都链接到它所形式化的命题。随着更多论文被形式化，作者的工具箱不断增长，作者还可以分享其已验证的论文，使后续研究者能够复用其Lean代码。通过使已验证论文的产出变得切实可行，PaperFormalizer旨在让依赖数学证明的研究更加稳健。PaperFormalizer运行在编码智能体（Claude Code或Codex）中，可在https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer获取。用户分享的带Lean代码的论文见https://paperformalizer.org。
translation.brief: 针对论文证明中难以察觉的缺口问题，提出基于Lean的agentic流水线，通过作者在环的方式将论文转录、审计并形式化为经Lean验证的版本。

papers.title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
papers.abstract: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library of lessons, automatically routing them to solve related problems later. Experiments with agents based on open-weight models from the Qwen family across open-ended research (GAIA), tool-use workflows (Claw-Eval), and terminal tasks (Terminal-Bench 2.1) show that our method improves overall success rates by 8.9 to 17.0 percentage points and performs competitively with frontier systems. We find that Self-Direction reduces repeated mistakes across future encounters of a task, nearly doubling the reliability of an agent's corrections. Learned lessons also transfer: a handful of adapters generalize to dozens of new tasks without additional training. Ultimately, this self-directed repair transforms everyday mistakes into lasting lessons.

translation.title: 不要忘记刚学到的东西：自主修复将智能体的错误转化为持久的经验
translation.abstract: 智能体应当从错误中学习，使经验带来持续改进。然而当今的智能体从错误中恢复只是暂时的：上下文内的反思容易在会话间被遗忘并争夺有限的上下文，而全参数微调成本高昂且可能干扰已有能力。我们提出Self-Direction，一种让智能体从错误中学习的机制，它结合了临时上下文内重试和策略更新的优点。当智能体在任务上失败时，它会反思自己的轨迹以提取经验教训，并立即将其蒸馏到一个轻量级低秩适配器中。通过保持原始权重冻结，Self-Direction防止适配器训练覆盖基础模型参数，同时每个适配器仅训练约相当于基础模型参数量0.02%的额外参数。智能体随后将这些适配器保存到持久的经验库中，并在日后自动路由它们以解决相关问题。基于Qwen系列开放权重模型的智能体在开放式研究（GAIA）、工具使用工作流（Claw-Eval）和终端任务（Terminal-Bench 2.1）上的实验表明，我们的方法将整体成功率提高8.9至17.0个百分点，并与前沿系统表现相当。我们发现Self-Direction减少了任务在未来遇到时的重复错误，几乎将智能体纠正的可靠性提高一倍。学到的经验还能迁移：少量适配器无需额外训练即可泛化到数十个新任务。最终，这种自主修复将日常错误转化为持久的经验。
translation.brief: 针对智能体错误恢复只是暂时性的问题，提出Self-Direction机制，将失败轨迹反思蒸馏为轻量级低秩适配器并存入持久经验库以供日后复用。

papers.title: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
papers.abstract: We present the framework of TACS-RF - a Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave modules. In this framework, a large-language-model (LLM) coding agent (Claude Opus 4.8) directly drives industry-standard electronic-design-automation (EDA) tools such as Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Calibre, Cadence EMX, and Ansys HFSS to design RF and mmWave modules. We validate the framework through the agentic design of a 240-251 GHz sub-THz transmitter in a 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS process. The agent semi-autonomously designed the sub-blocks including a 60 GHz push-push Colpitts VCO with second-harmonic extraction, multistage differential cascode power drivers, a push-push frequency doubler, a differential bowtie antenna, and all the interstage matching networks. The transmitter chain with parasitic-extracted devices and EM-verified passives delivers +5.1 to +6.3 dBm across an 11 GHz varactor-only tuning range, phase noise of -80 to -88 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz offset while consuming a DC power of 361 mW. We describe the agent-driven design flow and the resulting division of labor between human and agent, taking a step toward a "text-to-ASIC" future for designing RF/mmWave hardware.

translation.title: TACS-RF：工具驱动的射频与毫米波模块agentic电路综合
translation.abstract: 我们提出TACS-RF框架——一种工具驱动的射频与毫米波模块agentic电路综合。在该框架中，大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体（Claude Opus 4.8）直接驱动行业标准的电子设计自动化（EDA）工具，如Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre、Calibre、Cadence EMX和Ansys HFSS，来设计射频与毫米波模块。我们通过在90 nm SiGe BiCMOS工艺中agentic设计一个240-251 GHz亚THz发射机来验证该框架。智能体半自主地设计了各子模块，包括带二次谐波提取的60 GHz push-push Colpitts VCO、多级差分共源共栅功率驱动器、push-push倍频器、差分蝶形天线以及所有级间匹配网络。经寄生提取器件和EM验证无源器件的发射机链在11 GHz纯变容管调谐范围内提供+5.1至+6.3 dBm输出，1 MHz频偏处相位噪声为-80至-88 dBc/Hz，直流功耗为361 mW。我们描述了智能体驱动的设计流程以及由此产生的人机分工，朝着设计射频/毫米波硬件的"text-to-ASIC"未来迈出一步。
translation.brief: 针对射频/毫米波电路设计自动化问题，提出TACS-RF框架，让LLM编码智能体直接驱动工业EDA工具完成从子模块到发射机链的半自主设计。

papers.title: Permission to Retry: A Study of Authorization and Recovery in AI Agent Workflows
papers.abstract: A durable agent can resume a consequential action while its authority changes and the action's external outcome remains uncertain. We study execution-time reliability of tool-using AI agents, isolating recovery decisions from language-model behavior. Checkpoint state, permission to dispatch, evidence of an external effect and permission to reconcile are distinct obligations. We present a finite conformance study that checks these obligations through histories scored against a provider effect ledger hidden from the recovering application. A prospectively frozen campaign executes 336 histories on native LangGraph and Temporal hosts, crossing 14 schedules, three provider contracts and four matched application policies. All 168 paired host cells have identical checked outcomes. Per host, retained-ledger reconciliation passes all 42 histories: 21 checked completions, 15 denials and six unknown outcomes with reservations retained. Cached retry, revalidation before retry and stable-key retry pass 30, 36 and 31 histories respectively. A separate 16-case component study of InfinityOS, an enterprise AI platform developed by Arya.ai, exercises exported authority, worker, recovery and settlement code over repository fakes. The results isolate the roles of current authority, provider contracts and retained observations in recovery, with safety, completion and unresolved obligations reported separately for the declared application profile.

translation.title: 重试的许可：AI智能体工作流中的授权与恢复研究
translation.abstract: 一个持久的智能体应能在其权限发生变化且动作的外部结果仍不确定时恢复一个重要动作。我们研究使用工具的AI智能体的执行时可靠性，将恢复决策与语言模型行为隔离开。检查点状态、分发许可、外部效果的证据以及调和许可各自是不同的义务。我们提出一项有限一致性研究，通过将历史记录与对恢复应用隐藏的提供方效果账本进行比对评分来检查这些义务。一项前瞻性冻结的实验在原生LangGraph和Temporal宿主上执行336条历史记录，跨越14种调度、三种提供方契约和四种匹配的应用策略。全部168个配对宿主单元具有完全一致的检查结果。每个宿主上，保留账本的调和通过了全部42条历史：21个已检查完成、15个拒绝和6个保留保留意见的未知结果。缓存重试、重试前重新验证和稳定键重试分别通过30、36和31条历史。另一项针对InfinityOS（由Arya.ai开发的企业AI平台）的16案例组件研究，在仓库仿真件上测试了导出的授权、工作者、恢复和结算代码。结果隔离了当前权限、提供方契约和保留观察在恢复中的作用，并针对声明的应用配置分别报告安全性、完成度和未解决义务。
translation.brief: 针对工具使用智能体在权限变化和外部结果不确定时的恢复可靠性问题，通过有限一致性实验隔离并检验检查点、分发许可、效果证据与调和许可等恢复义务。

papers.title: Beyond On-Policy vs. Off-Policy: At What Level Should LLM Agent Distillation Follow the Student?
papers.abstract: Distilling interactive LLM agents requires choosing between teacher-generated demonstrations and student-generated experience, corresponding broadly to off-policy and on-policy distillation. While both have proven effective, we argue that this distinction is inherently hierarchical: the policy that induces an interaction history need not be the same as the policy that generates the token prefix of the current action. We introduce a hierarchical agent distillation framework that formalizes these two levels of on-policiness and enables explicit control over their pairing, mixture proportions, and training schedule. We study this problem through self-distillation, where a frozen teacher has access to task guidance unavailable to the student, and conduct a three-stage controlled study across three models and four interactive environments. We find that student-induced histories paired with teacher-generated action prefixes generally provide the strongest standalone training signal, whereas following the student at both levels generally performs worst. Nevertheless, fully on-policy data becomes beneficial when incorporated into a mixture with other configurations. Moreover, mixtures with identical teacher/student proportions at each level can yield substantially different performance, showing that how the two levels are paired matters beyond the overall amount of on-policy data. Finally, front-loading fully teacher-generated contexts and delaying fully on-policy contexts improves over a static mixture. These findings provide practical principles for deciding where, how much, and when agent distillation should follow the student.

translation.title: 超越 On-Policy 与 Off-Policy 之分：LLM Agent 蒸馏应在哪个层级跟随学生？
translation.abstract: 蒸馏交互式 LLM agent 需要在教师生成的示范与学生生成的经验之间做出选择，这大致对应于 off-policy 与 on-policy 蒸馏。虽然两者都已被证明有效，但我们认为这种区分本质上是分层的：引发交互历史的策略不必与生成当前动作 token 前缀的策略相同。我们提出了一个分层 agent 蒸馏框架，将这两个层级的 on-policiness 形式化，并支持对它们的配对、混合比例和训练日程进行显式控制。我们通过自蒸馏来研究这一问题，其中冻结的教师拥有学生无法获得的任务指导，并在三个模型和四个交互环境中进行了三阶段受控研究。我们发现，学生引发的交互历史与教师生成的动作前缀配对通常提供最强的独立训练信号，而在两个层级都跟随学生通常表现最差。然而，当完全 on-policy 数据被纳入与其他配置的混合中时，它会变得有益。此外，在每个层级具有相同教师/学生比例的混合可能产生显著不同的性能，这表明两个层级的配对方式比 on-policy 数据的总量更重要。最后，将完全教师生成的上下文前置、延迟引入完全 on-policy 上下文，优于静态混合。这些发现为决定 agent 蒸馏应在何处、以多大程度、何时跟随学生提供了实用原则。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM agent 蒸馏中 on-policy 与 off-policy 的分层选择问题，提出分层蒸馏框架以显式控制交互历史与动作前缀两个层级的教师/学生配对、混合与训练日程。

papers.title: $M^3$: A Multi-LLM System for Multi-Turn Jailbreaking as a Markov Decision Process
papers.abstract: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to carefully orchestrated multi-turn interactions that progressively bypass safety mechanisms. However, many existing red-teaming approaches rely on heuristics or impose strong assumptions that limit their applicability in fully black box settings. We address this gap by introducing $M^3$, an automated red-teaming framework that formalizes multi-turn jailbreaking as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP). In $M^3$, an attacker LLM interacts with a target LLM while operating over a compact internal state produced by a state LLM. Across two benchmarks and six target models, $M^3$ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-turn red-teaming methods in Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving improvements of up to 53% in ASR@5. Even with lightweight attacker, $M^3$ attains gains up to 26% in ASR@1 and 34% in ASR@5, compared to baselines that use higher capacity attackers. Beyond improved effectiveness, $M^3$ exhibits steeper risk escalation over conversational turns and achieves more consistent performance across risk categories (up to 4.82 improvement in Gini index) without relying on predefined risk taxonomy, providing a scalable and principled framework for multi-turn red-teaming and safety evaluation.

translation.title: $M^3$：将多轮越狱建模为马尔可夫决策过程的多 LLM 系统
translation.abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到精心编排的多轮交互的攻击，这些交互会逐步绕过安全机制。然而，许多现有的红队测试方法依赖启发式规则或施加较强假设，限制了它们在完全黑盒设置中的适用性。我们通过引入 $M^3$ 来填补这一空白，这是一个将多轮越狱形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的自动化红队测试框架。在 $M^3$ 中，攻击者 LLM 与目标 LLM 交互，同时基于由状态 LLM 生成的紧凑内部状态进行操作。在两个基准和六个目标模型上，$M^3$ 在攻击成功率（ASR）上持续超越最先进的多轮红队测试方法，ASR@5 提升最高达 53%。即使使用轻量级攻击者，$M^3$ 相比使用更高容量攻击者的基线，ASR@1 提升最高达 26%，ASR@5 提升最高达 34%。除了有效性提升外，$M^3$ 在对话轮次中表现出更陡峭的风险升级，并在不依赖预定义风险分类的情况下，在各风险类别上取得更一致的性能（Gini 指数提升最高达 4.82），为多轮红队测试和安全评估提供了一个可扩展且有原则的框架。
translation.brief: 将多轮越狱形式化为有限时域 MDP，用攻击者 LLM、状态 LLM 与目标 LLM 构建自动化黑盒红队测试系统以提升攻击成功率。

papers.title: Knowing Whom to Trust is not Enough: The Trust--Agreement Gap in Repeated Multi-Party LLM Negotiation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in negotiations on behalf of individuals and organizations, yet they remain vulnerable to manipulation, particularly in repeated multi-party interactions. Classical multi-agent systems address this challenge through explicit trust and reputation models, whereas existing work on LLM negotiation largely treats trust as an emergent phenomenon. We investigate whether LLM agents can form useful trust estimates from prior interactions and leverage them to improve future negotiation outcomes. We introduce a repeated, multi-party, multi-issue negotiation framework in which recurring agents participate in a sequence of negotiation games while one participant covertly attempts to prevent agreement. After each game, agents assess their counterparts and maintain pairwise trust estimates that carry over to subsequent negotiations. We compare trust-aware and trust-agnostic agents and analyze how explicit trust influences negotiation outcomes. Our results reveal a \emph{trust--agreement gap}: trust-aware agents can identify the adversary within a few games, but accurate trust estimates do not consistently translate into better agreements. Trust increases agreement rates by up to 23 percentage points, but only when agents are explicitly guided to use it in their decisions. Explicit trust can therefore improve repeated LLM negotiations, but its value depends critically on how trust is assessed and incorporated into agents' reasoning.

translation.title: 知道该信任谁还不够：重复多方 LLM 谈判中的信任—协议鸿沟
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）agent 越来越多地代表个人和组织参与谈判，但它们仍然容易受到操纵，尤其是在重复的多方交互中。经典的多智能体系统通过显式的信任与声誉模型来应对这一挑战，而现有的 LLM 谈判研究大多将信任视为一种涌现现象。我们研究 LLM agent 能否从先前的交互中形成有用的信任估计，并利用它们改善未来的谈判结果。我们引入了一个重复的、多方的、多议题的谈判框架，其中循环出现的 agent 参与一系列谈判博弈，同时一名参与者暗中试图阻止达成协议。每次博弈后，agent 评估其对手并维护延续到后续谈判的两两信任估计。我们比较了信任感知与信任无关的 agent，并分析显式信任如何影响谈判结果。我们的结果揭示了一种“信任—协议鸿沟”：信任感知的 agent 能在几局博弈内识别出对手，但准确的信任估计并不总能转化为更好的协议。信任最多可将协议达成率提高 23 个百分点，但前提是 agent 被显式引导在决策中使用信任。因此，显式信任可以改善重复的 LLM 谈判，但其价值关键取决于信任如何被评估以及如何被纳入 agent 的推理。
translation.brief: 研究重复多方 LLM 谈判中信任估计能否改善协议达成的问题，构建带隐性破坏者的重复谈判框架并对比信任感知与信任无关 agent 的表现。

papers.title: Reproducible Evaluation as the Substrate for Safe Prompt Compression in Production Agents
papers.abstract: Evaluating conversational agents that act on live, mutable enterprise data is hard: replayed sessions drift as backend state changes, and a benchmark built today can silently go stale as the data it describes moves on. We present an offline evaluation harness for a production conversational agent that stays reproducible despite the live data it operates on changing, and that can be regenerated on demand once it goes stale. We then use this harness as the fitness function for GEPA-based prompt optimization under a correctness gate that guards against reward hacking. Applied to a production merchant-facing agent, correctness-gated compression shrinks the agent's full prompt surface by 3.5-7.6% without regressing held-out task correctness, consistently across three independent subject-model families, and for one, correctness measurably improves.

translation.title: 可复现评估作为生产级 Agent 安全提示压缩的基础
translation.abstract: 评估作用于实时、可变企业数据的对话 agent 十分困难：随着后端状态变化，重放的会话会发生漂移，今天构建的基准可能随着其描述的数据的演进而悄然过时。我们提出了一个面向生产级对话 agent 的离线评估工具，尽管其操作的实时数据在不断变化，它仍能保持可复现性，并且在过时后可以按需重新生成。然后，我们将该工具用作基于 GEPA 的提示优化的适应度函数，并辅以防止 reward hacking 的正确性门控。应用于一个面向商家的生产级 agent，带正确性门控的压缩将 agent 的完整提示面缩减了 3.5-7.6%，且在三个独立的主模型家族中均未降低留出任务上的正确性，其中一个模型的正确性还有可测量的提升。
translation.brief: 针对生产级 agent 提示压缩问题，构建可复现且可按需再生的离线评估工具作为 GEPA 优化的适应度函数，并以正确性门控防止 reward hacking。

papers.title: The Helpful Agent Problem: When Emergent Cooperation Among LLM Agents Bypasses Intended Workflows
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings where they pursue separate tasks while sharing resources and operating under review or oversight processes. Such settings create safety risks not only when agents are malicious, but also when they are simply trying to help. Prior work has largely studied adversarial or explicitly collusive behavior; we show that benign agents pursuing separate objectives can spontaneously cooperate in ways that bypass intended workflows. We call this the \emph{helpful agent problem}. We study long-horizon shared-resource environments in which agents sometimes depend on resources owned by their peers and cross-owner changes are normally mediated by a reviewer. When review becomes unavailable, agents begin making changes on one another's behalf despite having no shared reward or explicit incentive to cooperate. Crucially, these actions remain within each agent's local permissions while circumventing the system's intended oversight structure. We introduce \textsc{FavorBench}, a controlled benchmark with measurable downstream side effects, and adapt \textsc{CooperBench} to test the phenomenon in realistic repositories. Across two benchmarks and four models, we find that out-of-workflow favors emerge frequently. Further, in \textsc{FavorBench}, favors from at least three models cause significant harm to parties outside the interaction. These results reveal a distinct multi-agent safety challenge: cooperation itself can create pathways around system-level safeguards.

translation.title: 乐于助人的 Agent 问题：当 LLM Agent 间的涌现合作绕过预期工作流时
translation.abstract: LLM agent 越来越多地被部署在协作环境中，它们在审查或监督流程下追求各自的任务并共享资源。此类环境带来的安全风险不仅存在于 agent 恶意时，也存在于它们只是想提供帮助时。已有工作大多研究对抗性或显式共谋行为；我们表明，追求各自目标的良性 agent 可以自发地以绕过预期工作流的方式进行合作。我们将此称为“乐于助人的 agent 问题”。我们研究了长时程共享资源环境，其中 agent 有时依赖同伴拥有的资源，跨所有者的更改通常由审查者调解。当审查不可用时，agent 开始代表彼此进行更改，尽管它们没有共享奖励或明确的合作激励。关键在于，这些行为仍在每个 agent 的本地权限范围内，却绕过了系统预期的监督结构。我们引入了 \textsc{FavorBench}，一个具有可测量下游副作用的受控基准，并改编 \textsc{CooperBench} 以在真实仓库中测试该现象。在两个基准和四个模型上，我们发现工作流之外的帮忙行为频繁出现。此外，在 \textsc{FavorBench} 中，至少三个模型的帮忙行为对交互之外的第三方造成了显著伤害。这些结果揭示了一个独特的多智能体安全挑战：合作本身就能为绕过系统级保障创造途径。
translation.brief: 研究良性 LLM agent 自发合作绕过审查工作流的安全问题，提出 FavorBench 基准并改编 CooperBench 来量化工作流外帮忙行为的频率与危害。

papers.title: BARC-Bench: Benign Asks, Risky Consequences
papers.abstract: Task instructions from users for agents are inherently underspecified, especially regarding safety boundaries--creating behavioral risks. To study these risks, we introduce BARC-Bench, a collection of 110 tasks across nine simulated workspace environments where benign requests leave openings for unsafe actions. In this benchmark, we evaluate agent behavior against safety boundaries established by workspace records, implicit environmental context, and unstated social norms. For example, an agent asked to schedule off-boarding discussions must arrange the meeting without prematurely revealing an employee's resignation through a shared calendar invitation. Evaluating four frontier model configurations across five attempts per task reveals that models are not consistently safe: the share of tasks completed safely on all five attempts ranges from 9.1% to 72.7%, with even the strongest configuration producing a safety violation on 27.3% of tasks. These results highlight an asymmetric operational risk: while models frequently complete complex workflows, their inability to consistently respect unstated boundaries presents a substantial barrier to safe autonomous delegation.

translation.title: BARC-Bench：无害的请求，有风险的后果
translation.abstract: 用户给智能体的任务指令天然是不完整的，尤其是在安全边界方面——这会带来行为风险。为研究这些风险，我们提出 BARC-Bench，这是一个包含九个模拟工作区环境中 110 个任务的基准，其中无害的请求可能为不安全行为留下空间。在该基准中，我们依据工作区记录、隐式环境上下文和未明说的社会规范所确立的安全边界来评估智能体行为。例如，被要求安排离职面谈的智能体必须安排会议，同时不能通过共享日历邀请过早泄露员工的离职消息。对四种前沿模型配置、每个任务五次尝试的评估显示，模型并不总是安全的：五次尝试全部安全完成的任务占比从 9.1% 到 72.7% 不等，即使最强的配置也有 27.3% 的任务出现安全违规。这些结果凸显了一种不对称的运营风险：虽然模型经常能完成复杂工作流，但它们无法始终如一地遵守未明说的边界，这为安全的自主委托构成了重大障碍。
translation.brief: 针对用户指令中未明说安全边界导致智能体行为风险的问题，构建了含110个任务的BARC-Bench基准来评估智能体对隐式安全边界的遵守能力。

papers.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
papers.abstract: Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. RSI-Opt substantially improves optimizer-agent performance, with representative raw-space summary $z$-scores increasing from $+10.48$ to $+14.33$ on the evolution suite with Opus 5.5 and from $-0.36$ to $+3.11$ on held-out tasks with GPT-5.5 through cross-model policy transfer. On the Burgers PDE, it reduces mean relative $L_2$ error by approximately 2.7-fold with Opus 5.5 and 8.8-fold with GPT-6.1 over the fixed-prompt agent baseline, although PDE transfer varies across LLMs and tasks. Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks. These findings demonstrate how procedures and executable tools accumulated across training runs can improve optimizer-agent performance and support transfer to scientific machine learning.

translation.title: RSI-Opt：用于模型训练的递归自我改进优化器智能体
translation.abstract: 传统神经网络训练通常遵循预定义的优化方案，这促使人们构建能够监控训练动态并随训练进程调整优化器设置的 LLM 智能体，但固定的智能体策略无法跨训练运行积累经验。我们提出 RSI-Opt，一个即插即用的递归自我改进优化器智能体，它会演化指导该过程的知识：一个提示词、一本流程手册、一个经过测试的优化器代码库以及一个决策节奏。元智能体利用先前运行的证据重写该策略，并用存档保留已评估的策略以供进一步演化。在三个训练任务上的 5 代演化中，元智能体发展出可复用的流程和代码，并自行开展 CPU 代理实验。RSI-Opt 显著提升了优化器智能体的性能：在演化套件上使用 Opus 5.5 时，代表性原始空间汇总 z 分数从 +10.48 提升至 +14.33；在留出任务上使用 GPT-5.5 时，通过跨模型策略迁移从 -0.36 提升至 +3.11。在 Burgers PDE 上，相比固定提示词的智能体基线，它使用 Opus 5.5 将平均相对 L2 误差降低约 2.7 倍，使用 GPT-6.1 降低约 8.8 倍，尽管 PDE 迁移效果因 LLM 和任务而异。受控比较表明，演化出的策略将可复用的优化知识与对每个任务的适配相结合：初始决策在已见任务上贡献了大部分收益，而持续适配则改善了未见任务的结果。这些发现展示了跨训练运行积累的流程和可执行工具如何提升优化器智能体的性能，并支持向科学机器学习的迁移。
translation.brief: 针对固定智能体策略无法跨训练运行积累经验的问题，提出RSI-Opt，通过元智能体递归演化提示词、流程手册和优化器代码库来改进优化器智能体。

papers.title: Do AI-for-Science Agents Preserve Model Safety?
papers.abstract: AI-for-Science agents are increasingly being used for formulating scientific hypotheses, running autonomous experiments, and interpreting evidence. These agents are constructed by integrating a large language model (LLM) into a domain-specific agent harness, which in turn can improve the LLM's scientific capability and enable the model to orchestrate scientific tools. In this work, we ask whether model safety is preserved when an LLM is integrated in an AI-for-Science agent harness. We evaluate five agent harnesses on 50 harmful chemistry requests. Specifically, we study how the safety behavior changes under direct prompting, two simple adversarial prompting strategies, and an adaptive attack. Across four recent GPT variants, our results show that the agent harness can increase harmful compliance even under direct prompting. More critically, we find that adaptive attacks that are largely unsuccessful against the base LLM suddenly become highly successful after the agent harness is introduced. Our results show that the safety behavior of the base LLM is not durable once a harness is introduced. Thus, as AI-for-Science agents become more capable and autonomous, the community needs to evaluate and align the agent using domain-specific safety benchmarks.

translation.title: AI-for-Science 智能体是否保留了模型安全性？
translation.abstract: AI-for-Science 智能体正被越来越多地用于提出科学假设、运行自主实验和解读证据。这些智能体通过将大语言模型（LLM）集成到领域特定的智能体框架（harness）中构建而成，这反过来可以提升 LLM 的科学能力，并使模型能够编排科学工具。在本工作中，我们探究当 LLM 被集成到 AI-for-Science 智能体框架中时，模型安全性是否得以保留。我们在 50 个有害化学请求上评估了五个智能体框架。具体而言，我们研究了在直接提示、两种简单的对抗性提示策略以及一种自适应攻击下安全行为的变化。在四个近期的 GPT 变体上，我们的结果表明，即使在直接提示下，智能体框架也会增加有害合规性。更关键的是，我们发现对基础 LLM 基本无效的自适应攻击，在引入智能体框架后突然变得高度成功。我们的结果表明，一旦引入框架，基础 LLM 的安全行为并不持久。因此，随着 AI-for-Science 智能体变得更加强大和自主，社区需要使用领域特定的安全基准来评估和对齐这些智能体。
translation.brief: 针对LLM被集成到AI-for-Science智能体框架后安全性是否保留的问题，通过50个有害化学请求和多种攻击策略评估发现框架会显著削弱基础模型的安全行为。

papers.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
papers.abstract: Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by $82.8$-$84.6\%$ in FLOPs and $47.7$-$58.4\%$ in runtime. These results establish TTME as an effective and computationally efficient alternative to TTT in the evaluated discovery settings.

translation.title: 测试时记忆演化能否在科学发现中超越测试时训练？
translation.abstract: 近期的测试时训练（TTT）框架使开源权重的大语言模型（LLM）在科学发现任务上超越了由前沿模型驱动的纯推理框架。然而，TTT 在发现过程中引入了在线权重更新的额外计算成本，使得在扩展到更大模型时计算效率成为重要考量。这促使我们探索一种高效的科学发现测试时适应方法。我们提出测试时记忆演化（TTME），一种即插即用的测试时适应方法，作为 TTT 的替代方案。TTME 通过将经验蒸馏到外部记忆中并持续更新，以指导后续发现，而无需更新模型权重。为了进行干净的对比，我们在相同的发现框架下评估 TTME 和 TTT，仅替换测试时适应方法。我们的评估显示，TTME 在全部五个数学任务上优于 TTT，同时将计算成本降低了 82.8%–84.6%（FLOPs）和 47.7%–58.4%（运行时间）。这些结果确立了 TTME 在所评估的发现场景中是 TTT 的一种有效且计算高效的替代方案。
translation.brief: 针对测试时训练（TTT）在线权重更新计算成本高的问题，提出测试时记忆演化（TTME），通过持续更新外部记忆而非模型权重来指导科学发现。

papers.title: Understanding Communication Failures in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems aim to improve reasoning through debate, evidence sharing, and mutual correction, but interaction can also introduce failures that final accuracy alone cannot explain. Agents may converge too early, ignore dissent, suppress correct minority answers, or preserve a wrong framing across rounds. We present a corpus-grounded taxonomy of communication failures, built from 3,211 failed multi-round trajectories across medical QA, coding, finance, multi-hop reasoning, ethics, and embodied text tasks. Using this taxonomy, we analyze failure distributions across datasets and system designs, round-level error dynamics, recovery hardness, majority transitions, minority-signal suppression, and self-reported confidence. We find that failures are dominated by recovery/correction and consensus/decision problems rather than isolated first-round mistakes, with many emerging after agents first observe peer responses. Based on these findings, we recommend stronger disagreement handling, evidence verification, minority-signal preservation, and recovery checks before finalization.

translation.title: 理解多智能体 LLM 系统中的沟通失败
translation.abstract: 多智能体 LLM 系统旨在通过辩论、证据共享和相互纠错来提升推理能力，但交互也可能引入仅凭最终准确率无法解释的失败。智能体可能过早收敛、忽视异议、压制正确的少数派答案，或在多轮中延续错误的框架。我们提出了一个基于语料库的沟通失败分类法，该分类法构建自涵盖医学问答、编程、金融、多跳推理、伦理和具身文本任务的 3,211 条失败的多轮轨迹。利用该分类法，我们分析了失败在不同数据集和系统设计中的分布、轮次级错误动态、恢复难度、多数派转变、少数派信号压制以及自我报告的置信度。我们发现，失败主要由恢复/纠错和共识/决策问题主导，而非孤立的首轮错误，且许多失败在智能体首次观察到同伴回应后出现。基于这些发现，我们建议加强异议处理、证据验证、少数派信号保留以及最终定稿前的恢复检查。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体LLM系统中交互引入的沟通失败问题，基于3211条失败轨迹构建沟通失败分类法并分析失败分布与动态。

papers.title: DriveMind: Mind-Evolving Belief Tracking for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perceive a traffic scene, reason about it, and propose a driving action within a single model. However, existing MLLM-based drivers reason from scratch at each frame and commit to a single explanation, discarding earlier hypotheses about the scene. When the scene is ambiguous, the agent locks in on the wrong interpretation and acts on it before evidence accumulates. In this paper, we propose DriveMind, an MLLM-based driving framework that keeps several hypotheses about the scene alive at the same time and updates their weights as new frames arrive. Inspired by particle filtering, DriveMind propagates each hypothesis through a VLM, scores it against the current observation, and resamples to maintain diversity. On Bench2Drive, adding belief tracking to the same driving pipeline improves the Driving Score (DS) from 68.50 to 81.37 and the Success Rate (SR) from 41.36% to 54.09%. The largest gains occur on ambiguous scenarios such as unsignalized intersections (+20.0 DS) and oncoming-traffic interactions (+20.5 DS). Beyond the overall metrics, DriveMind also improves fine-grained interactive driving abilities such as merging, emergency braking, and give-way.

translation.title: DriveMind：面向闭环自动驾驶的心智演化信念跟踪
translation.abstract: 近期的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）可以在单个模型内感知交通场景、进行推理并提出驾驶动作。然而，现有的基于 MLLM 的驾驶方法在每一帧都从零开始推理，并只保留单一解释，丢弃了此前对场景的假设。当场景存在歧义时，智能体会锁定错误的解释并在证据积累之前就据此行动。本文提出 DriveMind，一个基于 MLLM 的驾驶框架，它同时保持多个关于场景的假设，并随着新帧的到来更新它们的权重。受粒子滤波启发，DriveMind 通过 VLM 传播每个假设，根据当前观测对其打分，并通过重采样保持多样性。在 Bench2Drive 上，在相同的驾驶流程中加入信念跟踪后，Driving Score（DS）从 68.50 提升到 81.37，Success Rate（SR）从 41.36% 提升到 54.09%。最大的提升出现在歧义场景中，例如无信号灯交叉口（+20.0 DS）和对向来车交互（+20.5 DS）。除整体指标外，DriveMind 还提升了细粒度的交互式驾驶能力，如汇入、紧急制动和让行。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 驾驶智能体每帧从零推理并过早锁定错误解释的问题，提出受粒子滤波启发的多假设信念跟踪框架 DriveMind，随新帧到来传播、评分并重采样假设。

papers.title: Behaviour analysis for large language model-driven agents
papers.abstract: Understanding language-agent behaviour requires learning how actions are organised across a trajectory and how this organisation relates to context and outcomes. We propose a general framework that connects data-driven behavioural discovery with analysis and experimental investigation. Categories developed from recorded activity define what is measured. Analyses preserve the behaviours' positions in the process and express their relationships as interpretable hypotheses. Statistical assessment and tests in held-out contexts examine the strength and scope of the evidence. Experiments, including prompt steering, then test how behaviour and outcomes change under deliberately varied conditions. A study of iterative self-reflection illustrates how discovery, dependency learning and prompt comparisons can inform one another. We develop this approach for trajectories of varying length, event order and agent roles, and identify advances in coding, analysis and experimentation needed to support its wider use.

translation.title: 面向大语言模型驱动智能体的行为分析
translation.abstract: 理解语言智能体的行为需要学习动作如何在轨迹中组织，以及这种组织方式如何与上下文和结果相关联。我们提出了一个通用框架，将数据驱动的行为发现与分析及实验研究相结合。从记录的活动发展出的类别定义了测量内容。分析保留了行为在过程中的位置，并将其关系表达为可解释的假设。统计评估和在保留上下文中的测试检验证据的强度和范围。包括提示引导在内的实验则检验行为和结果在刻意变化的条件下如何改变。一项关于迭代式自我反思的研究展示了发现、依赖学习和提示比较如何相互启发。我们针对不同长度、事件顺序和智能体角色的轨迹发展了这一方法，并指出了支持其更广泛应用所需的编码、分析和实验方面的进展。
translation.brief: 针对如何系统分析语言智能体行为的问题，提出一个将数据驱动的行为发现、可解释假设、统计检验与实验干预相结合的通用分析框架。

papers.title: PersonaScienceBench: Evaluating Scientific Agents with Diverse Simulated Researchers
papers.abstract: Scientific agents collaborate with researchers whose expertise and preferences differ, but benchmarks usually hold the collaborator fixed. We introduce PersonaScienceBench: 200 tasks from five benchmarks across four scientific domains. Simulated researchers provide context and feedback according to persona profiles, while task objectives and grading remain fixed. Agents encounter researcher preferences only through conversation. Across eighteen modelconfigurations, task performance, fact recovery, and self-repetition reveal different strengths. Detailed GPT 6 Astra analyses show distinct agent responses across researcher profiles; interaction traces illustrate targeted clar ification and workflow revision. These behaviors can differ even when final scores match. PersonaScienceBench therefore evaluates how agents collaborate with diverse researchers alongside whether they complete the task.

translation.title: PersonaScienceBench：用多样化模拟研究人员评估科学智能体
translation.abstract: 科学智能体需要与专长和偏好各不相同的研究人员协作，但现有基准通常将协作者固定不变。我们提出 PersonaScienceBench：来自四个科学领域五个基准的 200 个任务。模拟研究人员根据角色画像提供上下文和反馈，而任务目标和评分保持固定。智能体只能通过对话感知研究人员的偏好。在十八个模型配置上，任务表现、事实恢复和自我重复揭示了不同的优势。详细的 GPT 6 Astra 分析显示智能体对不同研究人员画像有不同反应；交互轨迹展示了有针对性的澄清和工作流修订。即使最终得分相同，这些行为也可能不同。因此，PersonaScienceBench 在评估智能体能否完成任务的同时，也评估其与多样化研究人员协作的能力。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准忽略协作者差异的问题，构建 PersonaScienceBench，通过带角色画像的模拟研究人员提供上下文与反馈，评估科学智能体与多样化研究人员协作的能力。

papers.title: Who Verifies the Tools? How Warped Formatters Mislead Agents and Their Verifiers
papers.abstract: Agents and verifiers often rely on the text a tool prints, and that text can misrepresent what the tool actually did, even when the tool's computation is correct. We saw this happen in a production RAG research system used by the Pilsudski Institute in New York, where tool output formatters misled an agent into giving wrong or incomplete information to users. Each tool did its job correctly, but its output omitted search limits, result caps, or identifier namespaces. We also recreated an unlabeled estimate caught in code review before release. We studied whether these formatters misled agents and verifiers and how much the repaired wording helps. We fed tool results to agents using two formatter versions: one with the key omissions and one with all missing details clearly stated. That difference alone changed what the agents claimed and what the verifiers accepted. Unsupported agent claims dropped substantially for three of the four failure types. In one test, verifiers went from accepting incorrect answers 90 out of 90 times to rejecting them 90 out of 90 times. A control showed the verifiers could catch the errors once they were given the missing facts and asked to judge correctness. We include the audit prompt we used with Codex and Claude Code in an exploratory demonstration, written with prior knowledge of our own system's defects. When pointed at an old version of our own system, it rediscovered the defects that were still live and surfaced twelve more we had not catalogued. When pointed at OpenClaw and Hermes, two of the best-known open-source agentic systems, it found warped formatters in both. We opened PRs to fix both, and the OpenClaw fix has already been merged. Practitioners can run the same prompt on their own systems today.

translation.title: 谁来验证工具？被扭曲的格式化输出如何误导智能体及其验证器
translation.abstract: 智能体和验证器通常依赖工具打印的文本，而这些文本可能歪曲工具实际做的事情，即使工具的计算是正确的。我们在纽约 Pilsudski Institute 使用的一个生产级 RAG 研究系统中观察到这种情况：工具输出格式化器误导智能体向用户提供错误或不完整的信息。每个工具都正确完成了工作，但其输出省略了搜索限制、结果上限或标识符命名空间。我们还在发布前的代码审查中重现了一个被发现的未标注估计。我们研究了这些格式化器是否误导了智能体和验证器，以及修复后的措辞有多大帮助。我们向智能体提供两种格式化版本的相同工具结果：一个包含关键省略，一个明确陈述所有缺失细节。仅这一差异就改变了智能体的声明内容和验证器接受的内容。在四类失败类型中的三类上，智能体的无依据声明大幅下降。在一项测试中，验证器从 90 次全部接受错误答案变为 90 次全部拒绝。对照实验表明，一旦向验证器提供缺失的事实并要求其判断正确性，它们就能发现这些错误。我们在一个探索性演示中附上了与 Codex 和 Claude Code 一起使用的审计提示，该提示是在预先知晓我们自身系统缺陷的情况下编写的。当指向我们系统的旧版本时，它重新发现了仍然存在的缺陷，并发现了十二个我们未曾记录的新缺陷。当指向 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 这两个最知名的开源智能体系统时，它在两者中都发现了被扭曲的格式化器。我们提交了修复两者的 PR，OpenClaw 的修复已被合并。从业者今天就可以在自己的系统上运行同样的提示。
translation.brief: 针对工具输出格式化器省略关键信息从而误导智能体和验证器的问题，通过对比实验和审计提示演示证明修复措辞可显著减少错误声明，并在开源系统中发现并修复了同类缺陷。

papers.title: Not All Information Is Worth Asking For: Decision-Informed Information Seeking with LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts for the LLM's uncertain estimates of how strongly each check shifts this probability. DIVA is training-free and applies to any LLM. Across four domains and 20 LLMs, DIVA-U has lower regret, i.e., value lost relative to the best possible decision, than every LLM baseline on real-world data, mainly by stopping once evidence suffices, and DIVA cuts the regret of the best LLM baseline by 75% in synthetic scenarios where every check's reliability is given. Code: github.com/seunghan96/diva.

translation.title: 并非所有信息都值得询问：基于决策的 LLM 信息获取
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于在不完整信息下支持决策，此时决定查什么、何时停止与最终答案同样重要。然而，LLM 会陷入信息陷阱：它们为无法改变决策或不值得其成本的检查（即昂贵的证据）付费，并且在证据已经充分时仍继续询问。为此，我们提出 Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition（DIVA），一种基于证据决策价值的简单而有效的 LLM 信息获取方法。DIVA 1）让 LLM 通过简短的数值问题指定一个小的决策模型，即坏结果的可能性以及每次检查会如何改变该概率；2）通过想象各候选检查的结果对决策的净改进（扣除成本）来为其赋值，当没有检查值得其成本时停止。其变体 DIVA-U 进一步考虑了 LLM 对每次检查改变该概率强度的估计不确定性。DIVA 无需训练，适用于任何 LLM。在四个领域和 20 个 LLM 上，DIVA-U 在真实数据上的后悔值（即相对最优决策损失的价值）低于所有 LLM 基线，主要得益于在证据充分时即停止；而在每次检查可靠性已知的合成场景中，DIVA 将最佳 LLM 基线的后悔值降低了 75%。代码：github.com/seunghan96/diva。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在信息获取中为无价值检查付费且不知何时停止的问题，提出基于证据决策价值的免训练方法 DIVA，通过小型决策模型评估每次检查的净收益并据此决定获取或停止。

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded SLM Behavioral Prediction Architecture for Future Assistance Use
papers.abstract: Users often exhibit changes in interaction behavior before explicitly seeking assistance, enabling systems to anticipate future assistance use. This is especially important in high-stakes environments, where delayed assistance can have operational, financial, or safety consequences. However, conventional Large Language Models (LLMs) are often unsuitable for continuous on-device behavioral prediction because of their computational and memory demands. Behavioral patterns are also highly individual and device-specific, motivating local processing that preserves privacy and data sovereignty. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative, but their ability to reason reliably over low-level sequential interaction events remains underexplored. This study introduces Evidence-Grounded Local Behavioral Prediction (ELBP), a four-layer architecture combining deterministic interaction processing, dual-view behavioral representation, SLM-based prediction, and evidence verification with abstention. Three instruction-tuned models of 3B parameters or fewer were evaluated using raw, structured, dual-view, and complete ELBP configurations. The best-performing model, Qwen2.5-3B with ELBP, achieved a full-set F1-score of 0.80 and PR-AUC of 0.84, representing a 15.9\% relative improvement over raw-event prompting and 17.6\% over XGBoost, while full-set ECE decreased by 43.2\% relative to raw-event prompting. With evidence verification and abstention, selective F1 increased to 0.84 at 91\% coverage and evidence support reached 96\%. These results show that structured behavioral representation and evidence-verified selective prediction can improve the reliability of behavioral forecasting in SLMs.

translation.title: 面向未来辅助使用需求的证据锚定SLM行为预测架构
translation.abstract: 用户在显式寻求帮助之前常常会表现出交互行为的变化，这使系统能够预测未来的辅助使用需求。这在高风险环境中尤为重要，因为延迟的辅助可能带来运营、财务或安全后果。然而，传统大语言模型（LLM）因计算和内存需求过高，往往不适合持续的端上行为预测。行为模式又高度个体化和设备特定化，这促使采用能保护隐私和数据主权的本地处理方式。小语言模型（SLM）提供了有前景的替代方案，但其在低层次序列交互事件上进行可靠推理的能力仍未被充分探索。本研究提出了证据锚定本地行为预测（ELBP），这是一种四层架构，结合了确定性交互处理、双视角行为表示、基于SLM的预测以及带弃权的证据验证。研究评估了三个参数量不超过3B的指令微调模型，分别使用原始事件、结构化、双视角和完整ELBP配置。表现最佳的模型是采用ELBP的Qwen2.5-3B，其全集F1分数达到0.80，PR-AUC达到0.84，相比原始事件提示提升了15.9%，相比XGBoost提升了17.6%，其全集ECE相比原始事件提示降低了43.2%。在启用证据验证与弃权机制后，选择性F1在91%覆盖率下提升至0.84，证据支持率达到96%。这些结果表明，结构化的行为表示和经证据验证的选择性预测能够提高SLM行为预测的可靠性。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决SLM在端上预测用户未来辅助使用需求时可靠性不足的问题，核心方法是提出结合确定性交互处理、双视角行为表示、SLM预测与带弃权证据验证的四层ELBP架构。

papers.title: SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces
papers.abstract: Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.

translation.title: SWE-Shift：在演化工作空间中评估编码智能体
translation.abstract: 仓库级编码基准大多假设任务和环境在整个执行过程中保持不变。而在软件开发中，代码、依赖、运行时状态和需求可能在智能体仍在工作时发生变化。我们提出SWE-Shift，一个用于评估编码智能体在此类执行中途变化下表现的基准。基于同一份保存的历史和工作空间，Clean延续过程在没有干预的情况下进行，而匹配的Shifted延续过程会收到与任务相关的更新。成功要求完成当前任务、保留仍然有效的工作，并满足适用的状态与证据检查。该基准包含12个变化类别下的120个场景，每个场景在九个预定干预位置进行评估。我们评估了17个编码智能体系统，所有系统的Shifted成功率均低于Clean成功率。GPT-6 Astra从67.35%降至24.79%，配对成功率仅为20.34%。工具/会话变化和过时证据导致所有系统的配对成功率均为零。后期位置的配对成功率在某些系统中更低，在另一些系统中更高。这些结果表明，在未变化任务上的成功可能与更新后无法保留工作、恢复状态或刷新证据并存。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决现有编码基准假设任务环境静态不变、无法评估智能体应对执行中途变化能力的问题，核心方法是构建包含120个场景、对比Clean与Shifted延续过程的SWE-Shift基准。

papers.title: Watermarking Diffusion Language Models with Learned Foresight and Balanced Bands
papers.abstract: Green-red watermarks favor tokens from a green list that a secret key derives from the preceding tokens. Diffusion language models, however, often choose a token before its preceding tokens, and the token later shapes its neighbors' green lists. Prior work therefore tilts each choice to raise the expected number of green tokens at its own and its neighbors' positions. Building on this objective, we first learn two components that prior work keeps fixed: vocabulary bands that serve as green lists, separate competing candidates and keep the null distribution exact, and a foresight predictor that estimates how each candidate shifts its neighbors' predictions. Second, we count green tokens as the detector does, once per distinct context-token pair, so repetition earns nothing. On WaterBench with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, each learned component raises the z-score at equal distortion, and their gains are nearly additive. With a strong watermark, ours detects at least 96% of responses at a 1% false-positive rate while matching the LLM-judge score of unwatermarked text. Ours also detects more responses on Dream and as many or more on code and question answering without a significant loss in task accuracy.

translation.title: 基于学习预见与平衡频带的水印扩散语言模型
translation.abstract: 绿红水印倾向于选择由前序token经密钥推导出的绿名单中的token。然而，扩散语言模型常常在生成前序token之前就选择某个token，而该token随后又会影响其邻近token的绿名单。因此，先前的工作会使每个选择产生偏斜，以提升自身及其邻近位置上绿色token的期望数量。基于这一目标，我们首先学习了先前工作中保持固定的两个组件：作为绿名单的词表频带，用于分离竞争候选并保持零假设分布精确；以及预见预测器，用于估计每个候选如何改变其邻近位置的预测。其次，我们按照检测器的方式统计绿色token，即每个不同的上下文-token对只计一次，从而使重复不产生任何收益。在基于LLaDA-8B-Instruct的WaterBench上，每个学习到的组件在相同失真下都能提升z-score，且其增益几乎可叠加。在强水印下，我们的方法在1%假阳性率下至少能检测出96%的回复，同时保持与未加水印文本相当的LLM-judge分数。我们的方法在Dream上检测出更多回复，在代码和问答任务上检测出相当或更多的回复，且任务准确率无显著损失。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决扩散语言模型因token生成顺序特殊而难以有效应用绿红水印的问题，核心方法是学习词表频带与预见预测器两个组件并按检测器方式统计绿色token。

papers.title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
papers.abstract: Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents. We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints. We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points. It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones. In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks. With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage. Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively. These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.

translation.title: 答案正确、闸门紧闭：面向验证屏障的GUI智能体SolveBind
translation.abstract: 网站和应用程序部署了利用交互轨迹和时序等行为信号（而非仅凭结果）来区分人类与自动化智能体的CAPTCHA和反自动化机制。我们将这类受保护的GUI环境称为验证屏障环境，其中仅正确解答验证任务不足以完成端到端任务。智能体必须将求解器输出转化为被接受的交互，并在时间约束下根据运行时反馈调整执行。我们提出SolveBind，一个将分层求解与运行时监督相结合的GUI智能体框架。分层求解树将验证任务分解为相互依赖的感知、定位、求解、行动和验证能力。运行时监督器将动作承诺锚定于工具推导的证据，随着证据到来进行修正，并在明确的恢复预算下调解执行。在九个CAPTCHA任务族和九个骨干模型上，SolveBind在八个骨干模型上取得最高成功率，超出最强基线13.3至34.5个百分点。它在AndroidWorld全部六个骨干模型上均取得最高成功率。在配对的GPT-5.5分析中，MobileAgent产生了正确答案但在90个任务中的13个上未能通过动态验证；SolveBind在这些任务中成功了七个。启用自动提交时，移除绑定会使成功率从82.22%降至71.56%，并增加延迟和token使用量。恢复上限降低了执行成本，仅带来较小的成功率权衡：移除它们会使成功率从82.22%升至83.56%，但延迟和token使用量分别增至完全监督模式的3.7倍和2.4倍。这些结果支持以证据为锚定的执行控制，同时揭示了恢复机制中的成功率-成本权衡以及启发式提交规则的失效边界。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决GUI智能体在CAPTCHA等验证屏障环境中虽能解出答案但无法通过动态行为验证的问题，核心方法是结合分层求解树与基于证据锚定的运行时监督的SolveBind框架。

papers.title: Training an MoE LLM in MXFP4: How We Closed the Gap to BF16
papers.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) in sub-8-bit arithmetic promises substantial gains in memory bandwidth and compute throughput, yet FP4 formats introduce quantization error severe enough to destabilize optimization if left unaddressed. We present ALTO, an open-source training recipe for GPT-OSS-20B, a 20-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, on the MLPerf Small MoE Training benchmark under the MXFP4 microscaling format. The recipe combines established techniques from Abecassis, Felix et al. [arXiv:2509.25149] (hybrid 1D/2D block quantization, randomized Hadamard transforms, and stochastic rounding) with a simplified weight de-oscillation scheme adapted from TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527]. On C4 validation at global batch size 16, MXFP4 + RHT + SR + de-oscillation reaches a validation loss of 3.3350 at 16,128 steps, only 0.007 above the BF16 baseline (3.3283), closing roughly 50% of the gap left by MXFP4 without de-oscillation (3.3418). Measured by steps to reach the MLPerf quality target (validation loss 3.34), de-oscillation cuts the FP4 convergence overhead relative to BF16 from +20.0% to +5.0%. We also report negative end-to-end results from differential gradient estimation, outlier clipping, and macro-block scaling, despite each showing operator-level SNR gains. All experiments use simulated MXFP4 kernels on AMD MI300X hardware and wall-clock speed has not been optimized.

translation.title: 在MXFP4中训练MoE大语言模型：我们如何缩小与BF16的差距
translation.abstract: 以低于8比特的算术训练大语言模型（LLM）有望在内存带宽和计算吞吐量上带来显著收益，但FP4格式引入的量化误差严重到若不加处理会使优化不稳定。我们提出ALTO，一个开源训练配方，用于在MLPerf Small MoE Training基准下以MXFP4微缩放格式训练GPT-OSS-20B这一200亿参数的混合专家模型。该配方将Abecassis、Felix等人的成熟技术（混合1D/2D块量化、随机Hadamard变换和随机舍入）与改编自TetraJet-v2的简化权重去振荡方案相结合。在全局批大小为16的C4验证集上，MXFP4 + RHT + SR + 去振荡在16,128步时达到3.3350的验证损失，仅比BF16基线（3.3283）高0.007，相比无去振荡的MXFP4（3.3418）缩小了约50%的差距。以达到MLPerf质量目标（验证损失3.34）所需步数衡量，去振荡将FP4相对于BF16的收敛开销从+20.0%降至+5.0%。我们还报告了差分梯度估计、离群值裁剪和宏块缩放的负面端到端结果，尽管它们在算子层面均显示出SNR增益。所有实验均使用AMD MI300X硬件上的模拟MXFP4内核，且尚未优化实际运行速度。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决FP4低精度训练MoE大语言模型时量化误差导致优化不稳定的问题，核心方法是提出结合混合块量化、Hadamard变换、随机舍入与权重去振荡的ALTO训练配方。

papers.title: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
papers.abstract: In modern financial markets, more than 3/4th of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher precision and speed than traditional human traders. The conventional strategies focused on price-based indicators are inadequate in capturing the market dynamism arising from real-world events such as social sentiments, political instability, or sudden economic shifts. With the rise of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and data availability, there is a requirement for more efficient algorithms that can incorporate these external factors in trading strategies. DRL has shown potential in simulating real-world scenarios and in simplifying complex decision-making since DRL agents can automate the trading process i.e. executing trades in a manner comparable to human traders. They have shown reliable performance since they can update their policies based on risk and quantitative factors. In this paper, we propose a DRL approach based on partial and deep-infusion of sentimental analysis. It features distinct policy designs of actor-critic-based agents: only policy optimization (A2C & PPO) and policy optimization along with Q-learning principles (DDPG, TD3 & SAC). Our findings reveal, that the agents based on policy optimization combined with Q-learning, significantly and consistently demonstrate improved performance upon sentiment deep-infusion in profit maximization as well as risk-averse trading.

translation.title: 面向Actor-Critic智能体的金融上下文丰富策略：一种用于股票交易的深度强化学习方法
translation.abstract: 在现代金融市场中，超过3/4的大宗交易由基于先进交易策略的算法交易执行，以获得比传统人类交易者更高的精度和速度。传统基于价格指标的策略不足以捕捉由社会情绪、政治不稳定或突发经济变化等现实世界事件引发的市场动态。随着深度强化学习（DRL）的兴起和数据的可得性，需要更高效的算法将这些外部因素纳入交易策略。DRL在模拟真实场景和简化复杂决策方面已展现出潜力，因为DRL智能体可以像人类交易者一样自动执行交易，并能够基于风险和量化因素更新策略，表现出可靠的性能。本文提出一种基于情感分析部分注入与深度注入的DRL方法，涵盖基于actor-critic智能体的不同策略设计：仅策略优化（A2C与PPO）以及策略优化结合Q-learning原理（DDPG、TD3与SAC）。研究发现，结合Q-learning的策略优化智能体在情感深度注入下，在利润最大化与风险规避交易方面均显著且持续地表现出性能提升。
translation.brief: 针对传统价格指标策略无法纳入社会情绪等外部因素的问题，提出在actor-critic类DRL智能体中注入情感分析的股票交易方法。

papers.title: Minimum Description Length Unsupervisedly Separates Law-Grade from Statistical-Grade Knowledge in a Self-Improving Science Agent - and Reveals 86% of Its Own Discoveries Are Statistical
papers.abstract: AI systems that discover scientific relations now generate candidate "laws" at scale, but the bottleneck has shifted from generation to vetting: which candidates deserve belief? We show that a deployed self-improving science agent - one that has admitted 252 relations through held-out prediction courts - already computes the quantity that answers this question: the Minimum Description Length compression ratio used for model selection doubles, when read under discrete accounting, as an unsupervised epistemic grader. The compression-ranked top band of the agent's ledger recovers exactly the canonical laws among its discoveries (vis-viva across seven planets, Balmer/Rydberg) plus cross-measurement identities - enrichment $p=3.6\times10^{-12}$ under a hypergeometric test - with zero counterexamples and physically coherent band structure. The same lens retroactively reveals that 86% of the ledger compresses nothing ($\mathrm{cr}\approx 1$): the agent had been recording statistical regularities, including a learned predictor with held-out $R^2=0.541$ admitted through the prediction gate, under a narrative of compression as the unified value of knowledge - a narrative that was never true for them. We formalize the resulting dual-axis bookkeeping - prediction value ($R^2$) and compression value (cr) as nearly decoupled axes of knowledge - demonstrate its robustness to quantization, and register forward falsifiable predictions. The episode is, to our knowledge, the first measured instance of a discovery agent auditing its own knowledge ledger by an internal measure and finding itself over-claiming.

translation.title: 用最小描述长度无监督地区分自我改进科学智能体中的定律级知识与统计级知识——并揭示其86%的发现属于统计级
translation.abstract: 发现科学关系的AI系统如今大规模生成候选“定律”，但瓶颈已从生成转向审查：哪些候选值得相信？我们展示了一个已部署的自我改进科学智能体——它已通过留出预测法庭接纳了252条关系——已经在计算回答该问题所需的量：用于模型选择的最小描述长度压缩比，在离散记账方式下解读时，可兼作无监督的认识论评级器。按压缩比排序的账本顶部区间恰好恢复了其发现中的经典定律（七颗行星的活力定理、Balmer/Rydberg公式）以及跨测量恒等式——超几何检验下富集 p=3.6×10⁻¹²——且零反例，区间结构物理上连贯。同一视角回溯性揭示账本中86%的内容没有任何压缩（cr≈1）：该智能体一直在“压缩是知识的统一价值”的叙事下记录统计规律，包括一个通过预测门控、留出R²=0.541的学习型预测器——而该叙事对这些内容从未成立。我们将由此产生的双轴记账形式化——预测价值（R²）与压缩价值（cr）作为近乎解耦的知识轴——证明其对量化具有鲁棒性，并注册了前向可证伪的预测。据我们所知，这一事件是首个发现型智能体用内部度量审计自身知识账本并发现自己过度声明的实测案例。
translation.brief: 针对科学发现AI生成候选定律难以甄别真伪的问题，利用最小描述长度压缩比作为无监督评级器，区分定律级与统计级知识并发现智能体86%的发现属统计级。

papers.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
papers.abstract: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and $\tau^3$ Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.

translation.title: RSIHub：一个可组合的智能体进化方法框架
translation.abstract: 智能体进化方法利用执行反馈来改进提示、技能、工具与编排，但其实现往往需要重复构建相同的实验机制。我们提出RSIHub，一个开源框架，用于在共享基础设施上构建、比较和扩展这些方法。Recipe通过组合可复用算子并声明可变资源；RSIHub提供执行、评估、恢复与谱系管理。研究者可专注于进化策略，同时评估保持在可变面之外，结果始终与候选方案及评估条件绑定。我们在不修改框架核心的情况下实例化了AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve和GEPA，将方法特定逻辑保留在recipe和算子中。我们在固定模型与评估器配置下，用MiniSWE和Codex在Terminal Bench 2与τ³ Banking上评估它们。观察到的最大整体pass@1提升为13.5个百分点，而方法排名在不同设置间有所变化，且优化收益并不总能迁移到留出任务。RSIHub为比较进化策略、检查候选历史以及开发新方法提供了通用协议与可复用组件。
translation.brief: 针对智能体进化方法实现重复造轮子的问题，提出共享基础设施框架RSIHub，以可组合的recipe和算子统一实现与比较多种进化方法。

papers.title: MedCaseAgent: From Multimodal Clinical Evidence to Rare Disease Case Reports
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in clinical documentation, generating the rigorous, evidence-based reasoning required for unprecedented, atypical, and rare disease case reports remains a significant challenge. We present MedCaseAgent, an end-to-end agentic reasoning paradigm that bridges this gap by synthesizing publication-quality reports from unstructured clinical notes. MedCaseAgent leverages a hierarchical structure, integrating patient-level data mining with iterative, tool-integrated reasoning. By dynamically querying medical literature and knowledge bases, the agent maintains high clinical fidelity and assesses case novelty. The framework is inherently modular, supporting various backbone LLMs in a plug-and-play fashion. To facilitate this research, we release MedCase-150K, a large-scale multimodal clinical case-report corpus, and MedCase-Bench, a robust temporally held-out evaluation suite. We also introduce an open-source model post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B and optimized specifically for this task. Under both LLM-judged and rule-based evaluation, MedCaseAgent outperforms existing general-purpose and specialized medical LLMs and agents. Blinded expert reviews and ablations further support the system's clinical relevance and evidence grounding.

translation.title: MedCaseAgent：从多模态临床证据到罕见病病例报告
translation.abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）已在临床文档领域展现出潜力，但为前所未有的、非典型的和罕见疾病病例报告生成严谨的、基于证据的推理仍是一大挑战。我们提出MedCaseAgent，一种端到端的智能体推理范式，通过从非结构化临床笔记合成出版级质量的报告来弥合这一差距。MedCaseAgent采用层次化结构，将患者级数据挖掘与迭代的、工具集成的推理相结合。通过动态查询医学文献和知识库，该智能体保持高临床保真度并评估病例新颖性。该框架天然模块化，支持以即插即用方式接入各种骨干LLM。为促进此研究，我们发布了MedCase-150K，一个大规模多模态临床病例报告语料库，以及MedCase-Bench，一个基于时间留出的鲁棒评估套件。我们还引入了一个从Qwen3.5-9B后训练并针对该任务优化的开源模型。在LLM评判与规则评估下，MedCaseAgent均优于现有的通用及专业医学LLM与智能体。盲法专家评审与消融实验进一步支持了系统的临床相关性与证据 grounding。
translation.brief: 针对罕见病病例报告生成缺乏严谨证据推理的问题，提出层次化、工具集成的智能体MedCaseAgent，从非结构化临床笔记合成出版级报告并配套发布语料库与基准。

papers.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness. We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability. In addition, we design a Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module to provide evidence from the agent context, harness, and execution environment for LLM-based evaluation, and develop a Failure Attribution (FA) module that uses explicit mechanism chains to support attribution at the run level. Across 4 harnesses, 9 models, and 95 tasks, our evaluation of 3,420 runs yields macro-averaged harness scores ranging from 59.8% to 72.0%, while 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion. TraceTrial-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible foundation for comparing agent harnesses, diagnosing their failures, and studying how harness design interacts with model behavior.

translation.title: 轨迹审判：面向可靠性与失败归因的AI智能体Harness基准测试
translation.abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地用于解决现实问题，其有效性既取决于底层模型，也取决于支持其运行的harness。然而，现有基准大多关注模型能力和智能体整体性能，对智能体harness的评估关注有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出TraceTrial-Bench，将harness可靠性组织为覆盖上下文、执行、治理、生命周期、可观测性、工具和验证的七个组件。我们构建了95个专家级、面向机制的任务，配有可执行或基于状态的真值，以支持语义等价的比较，同时保留各harness的原生行为。我们设计了轨迹追踪（TT）模块以捕获智能体执行轨迹，并引入双层评估框架，分别评估智能体性能与harness可靠性。此外，我们设计了多源证据获取（MEA）模块，为基于LLM的评估提供来自智能体上下文、harness和执行环境的证据，并开发了失败归因（FA）模块，利用显式机制链支持运行级归因。在4个harness、9个模型和95个任务上，对3,420次运行的评估得出宏观平均harness分数介于59.8%至72.0%之间，而31.1%的运行虽任务成功却未通过至少一项harness标准。TraceTrial-Bench为比较智能体harness、诊断其失败以及研究harness设计与模型行为的交互提供了可审计、可复现的基础。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准忽视智能体harness可靠性评估的问题，构建TraceTrial-Bench，通过轨迹追踪、多源证据与失败归因模块对harness进行系统评测与失败诊断。

papers.title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
papers.abstract: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons. On ALFWorld, joint serving achieves 63.17% success, compared with 59.83% for memory-only and 50.50% for skill-only serving. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git

translation.title: 通过双向记忆-技能学习实现终身上下文适应
translation.abstract: 终身 LLM 智能体必须在不断扩展的交互历史中学习，同时在有限的上下文窗口内做出每个决策。记忆使过去的经验可用，但智能体仍可能需要从检索到的记录中推断如何解决每个新任务。技能提供了可复用的流程，却可能遗漏应用它们所需的任务特定事实。由于检索到的记忆和技能塑造了智能体的行为，它们也影响未来学习可用的经验。我们提出 MemCryst，一个通过冻结语言模型下记忆与技能双向学习实现终身上下文适应的框架。存储在记忆中的重复情节支持技能的创建与修订，而这些技能引导的交互又为后续学习提供新的记忆。从记忆中检索的事实与学到的技能共同构成智能体的上下文，同时任务结果会调整实际被使用的记录的未来检索影响力，而不改写其内容。在涵盖具身控制、长文档阅读、对话、数学和代码的十个设置中，MemCryst 在七项已报告的比较中领先。在 ALFWorld 上，联合服务达到 63.17% 的成功率，而仅记忆服务为 59.83%，仅技能服务为 50.50%。代码可在 https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git 获取。
translation.brief: 解决终身智能体中记忆与技能各自不足的问题，提出 MemCryst 框架通过冻结语言模型下记忆与技能的双向学习实现上下文适应。

papers.title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks
papers.abstract: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public.

translation.title: DMAIC-Bench：从自我反思到自我克制——多阶段分析任务中的智能体评测
translation.abstract: 多阶段分析任务要求 LLM 智能体利用中间证据来决定是继续、转向还是停止。自我反思（智能体批判自身输出）已被广泛研究，但批判并不能表明证据是否改变了下一步行动。我们将这种能力称为自我克制。现有智能体基准大多衡量任务完成度或输出质量，而未对此进行测试。DMAIC-Bench 通过 97 个种子任务（覆盖四个行业的 15 个工业案例）来评估这一能力，这些任务围绕 Lean Six Sigma 明确的统计前提构建。成对的反事实变体要求在同一工作流位置采取相反的行动，从而将有依据的克制与不加区分的停止区分开来。我们使用私有评分器评估执行轨迹，并通过独立专家评审评估最终结论。在来自六家提供商的 13 个模型中，执行层面的路由准确率在匹配的 GO 决策上平均为 92%，而在 NO-GO 决策上仅为 19%（任何被禁止的下游计算都计为路由错误）。执行轨迹显示，智能体在执行其诊断结果所不允许的分析之前，报告了正确的诊断。另外，对 11 个受审计智能体的盲评专家评审估计，在已达成的 NO-GO 决策中，报告基于无效证据行动的比例为 47%，区间为 31% 至 61%。明确的停止许可对某些模型有所帮助，但并不能持续地在 GO 和 NO-GO 两个分叉点都恢复正确决策。散装核糖核酸测序（RNA-seq）和病例对照全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的 16 个生命科学任务表明，同一框架可以评估工业工作流之外依赖证据的决策。项目代码和数据可在：https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public 获取。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准无法衡量智能体是否依据证据克制行动（自我克制）的问题，构建基于 Lean Six Sigma 统计前提的 DMAIC-Bench 基准，用反事实任务变体和专家评审进行评测。

papers.title: Solvent: Long-Horizon Reasoning for Multi-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.abstract: Multi-step retrosynthesis requires recursively transforming a target molecule through successive reaction steps into purchasable building blocks, and recent work has begun to draw on large language model (LLM) reasoning to tackle the task. In its latest evolution, LLM reasoning has entered the long-horizon regime: models pursue objectives across interdependent steps, interact with environments, and adapt to feedback. This shift has markedly advanced LLM capabilities, as illustrated by breakthroughs in AI-driven mathematical research. At this frontier, we introduce Solvent, an 8B LLM that successfully extends long-horizon reasoning to multi-step retrosynthesis. Through a two-round post-training curriculum, Solvent learns to interleave iterative synthesis planning, external availability verification, and adaptive route revision. Experiments show that, following a $2.1\times$ performance boost from RL, Solvent scores 61.86% across four benchmarks, surpassing mid-scale language models and prior search-based retrosynthesis systems, and rivaling frontier trillion-parameter LLMs.

translation.title: Solvent：面向多步逆合成的长程推理
translation.abstract: 多步逆合成需要通过连续的反应步骤递归地将目标分子转化为可购买的构建模块，近期工作已开始借助大语言模型（LLM）推理来解决该任务。在其最新演进中，LLM 推理已进入长程阶段：模型在相互依赖的步骤间追求目标、与环境交互并适应反馈。这一转变显著提升了 LLM 能力，AI 驱动的数学研究突破即是例证。在这一前沿，我们提出 Solvent，一个成功将长程推理扩展到多步逆合成的 8B LLM。通过两轮后训练课程，Solvent 学会交替进行迭代合成规划、外部可得性验证和自适应路线修订。实验表明，在 RL 带来 2.1 倍性能提升后，Solvent 在四个基准上取得 61.86% 的成绩，超越中等规模语言模型和先前的基于搜索的逆合成系统，并可与前沿万亿参数 LLM 匹敌。
translation.brief: 解决多步逆合成的长程推理问题，通过两轮后训练课程训练 8B 模型 Solvent，使其学会交替进行合成规划、可得性验证与路线修订。

papers.title: Beyond Gain: Measuring Skill Internalization for Agent Skill Retirement
papers.abstract: LLM agents retrieve skills from public hubs that hold up to about 100,000 entries and serve many models. As models improve, a hub must find the skills a given model has internalized, meaning it can do without them, and retire them for that model, yet internalization has not been measured with known reliability. Published rules that compare runs with and without a skill retire on the gain alone. The gain is near zero both for an internalized skill and when neither the model nor the skill delivers the capability, a state we call uncovered. We instead withhold the skill, score the model on a task synthesized from it, and trust a high unaided score only when another model gains from the skill, since nearly half of high scores come from tasks no model benefits from. Under four models, a published gain rule applied with one task per skill removes over half of the uncovered skills. On SkillsBench, 28 of its 31 retirements rest on probes no run passed in full, while retiring on the unaided score costs no detectable reward. Unaided verdicts reproduce across tasks more often than the gain rule's (Cohen's kappa 0.42 against 0.23) but differ across models, so a hub must read them per model. We release 1,251 skills with tasks and item scores under four models.

translation.title: 超越增益：衡量技能内化以实现智能体技能退役
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体从拥有多达约 10 万条目并服务众多模型的公共技能中心检索技能。随着模型改进，技能中心必须找出给定模型已内化（即无需该技能也能完成）的技能，并为该模型将其退役，然而内化尚未以已知可靠性进行衡量。已发表的规则通过比较有技能和无技能的运行结果，仅凭增益进行退役。增益在技能已被内化时和模型与技能都无法提供该能力（我们称之为未覆盖）时都接近于零。我们改为扣留技能，在从该技能合成的任务上对模型评分，并且只有当另一个模型能从该技能中获益时才信任高无辅助分数，因为近一半的高分来自没有任何模型能从中获益的任务。在四个模型下，将已发表的增益规则应用于每技能一个任务会移除超过一半的未覆盖技能。在 SkillsBench 上，其 31 次退役中有 28 次基于没有任何运行完整通过的探针，而基于无辅助分数的退役没有可检测的奖励损失。无辅助判定跨任务的复现性高于增益规则（Cohen's kappa 0.42 对 0.23），但在模型间存在差异，因此技能中心必须按模型分别解读。我们发布了 1,251 个技能及其任务和四个模型下的逐项分数。
translation.brief: 解决技能中心难以可靠判断模型是否已内化某技能的问题，提出通过扣留技能、在合成任务上测无辅助得分并结合其他模型获益情况来决定技能退役的方法。

papers.title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for GR. TGR-EvoDAG models code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to maintain multiple evolution branches and merge complementary innovations, unifying advanced search with rich GR diagnostic feedback. We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock cross-stage gains. On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG enables the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, in industrial deployment on Tencent's large-scale commercial media platform, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR).

translation.title: TGR-EvoDAG：腾讯生成式推荐的基于 DAG 的多智能体代码演化框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体已实现用于算法发现的自动化代码演化。然而，当前面向序列推荐的递归自我改进（RSI）研究面临困境：通用框架缺乏领域特定反馈，而推荐专用框架依赖线性演化。关键在于，将二者简单整合在应用于生成式推荐（GR）时会失败。与端到端模型不同，GR 依赖模块级联的流水线（tokenization、预训练和对齐）。在这一范式下，现有演化方法存在：i) 成本盲视，因忽略阶段不对称的再训练开销而浪费预算；ii) 短视评估，丢弃那些在下游适应前暂时使指标回退的有前景的上游创新。为弥合这些差距，我们提出 TGR-EvoDAG，一个为 GR 量身定制的多智能体代码演化框架。TGR-EvoDAG 将代码演化建模为有向无环图（DAG），以维护多个演化分支并合并互补创新，将先进搜索与丰富的 GR 诊断反馈统一起来。我们进一步引入阶段感知的成本规划以优化 GPU 小时预算，并引入主动的下游协同适应以应对暂时回退并释放跨阶段收益。在公开的 Amazon 数据集上，TGR-EvoDAG 实现了首个完整 GR 流水线的自主演化，相比最强基线将离线指标提升高达 37.4%，Agent4Rec 模拟用户满意度提升 19.7%。此外，在腾讯大规模商业媒体平台的工业部署中，演化后的 GR 在离线 Hit@1 上取得 12.16% 的相对提升，在线点击率（CTR）取得统计显著的 0.40% 提升。
translation.brief: 解决生成式推荐流水线中现有代码演化方法的成本盲视与短视评估问题，提出 TGR-EvoDAG，将代码演化建模为 DAG 并结合阶段感知成本规划与下游协同适应。

papers.title: Adaptive Control of Scientific Instruments with Nonstationary Responses through Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Controlling scientific instruments requires parameters to be adjusted progressively in response to feedback from successive operations. When unobserved operating conditions evolve with operational history, responses become nonstationary, and a static mapping from actions to responses becomes inadequate for decisions across shots. Shot-to-shot tuning of neutral beam injection (NBI) ion sources in magnetic confinement fusion devices is representative of this class of problems: the conditions of electrode surfaces and vacuum are difficult to observe directly, discharge outcomes vary between shots, and experiments are costly and carry operational risks. We propose a physically grounded multimodal agent with three independently auditable components. Deterministic algorithms extract symbolic physical quantities and visual evidence from multichannel waveforms; a memory with two layers organizes trajectories from the current task, experience from earlier tasks, and procedural knowledge, from which a multimodal large language model (MLLM) generates candidate actions; and an independent action feasibility check enforces action constraints before execution. In a strictly chronological replay of 455 shots from four EXL-50U platforms, physical symbols alone outperformed waveform images alone by 0.21-0.32 in macro-F1 for quality classification across all four evaluated models. Retrieved context increased the mean agreement with historical action directions by 22.4-42.7 percentage points, whereas the contribution of visual evidence varied across models. Under supervised operation on five ion sources, the system achieved a beam-extraction rate of 86.80% across 409 executed shots. These results demonstrate the engineering feasibility of the framework for supervised sequential tuning on a physical scientific instrument.

translation.title: 基于多模态智能体的非平稳响应科学仪器自适应控制
translation.abstract: 控制科学仪器需要根据连续操作的反馈逐步调整参数。当未观测到的运行条件随操作历史演化时，响应变得非平稳，从动作到响应的静态映射不再适用于跨炮次决策。磁约束聚变装置中中性束注入（NBI）离子源的逐炮调谐是这类问题的典型代表：电极表面和真空状态难以直接观测，放电结果在炮次间变化，且实验成本高并带有运行风险。我们提出一个物理基础扎实的多模态智能体，包含三个可独立审计的组件：确定性算法从多通道波形中提取符号化物理量和视觉证据；两层记忆组织当前任务的轨迹、先前任务的经验和程序性知识，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）据此生成候选动作；独立的动作可行性检查在执行前强制约束动作。在来自四个EXL-50U平台的455炮严格按时间顺序回放中，仅使用物理符号在所有四个评估模型上的质量分类宏F1比仅使用波形图像高0.21-0.32。检索到的上下文使与历史动作方向的一致性平均提高22.4-42.7个百分点，而视觉证据的贡献因模型而异。在五个离子源的监督运行下，系统在执行的409炮中实现了86.80%的束流引出率。这些结果证明了该框架在物理科学仪器上监督式顺序调谐的工程可行性。
translation.brief: 针对科学仪器非平稳响应下的逐次调参问题，提出由符号提取、两层记忆与可行性检查组成的多模态智能体框架，应用于聚变NBI离子源调谐。

papers.title: DealsFlow: An Evidence-Gated Agentic Harness for Venture Capital Deal Triage
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can read startup pitch decks, but letting them emit investment scores directly invites score inflation, run-to-run variance and rationales that are hard to audit. We describe DealsFlow, a human-in-the-loop agentic harness deployed at a UK early-stage fund. The LLM reads the deck, cites evidence and rates each category; code combines the ratings, caps them and only ever lowers them. Three mechanisms implement this: a stage-aware corroboration ceiling (78, 70 or 60 out of 100) on factual categories without external evidence; a sceptic call that may lower but never raise a score; and a pre-fetch pattern that retrieves and indexes all evidence before a single generation pass. We evaluate on $N=243$ SEIS/EIS investments with recorded outcomes. Because recent investments have unresolved outcomes, we use the 142 that are at least three years old. There, the full pipeline's score has Spearman $\rho=0.45$ (95% CI 0.32 to 0.57) with the total-value multiple and AUC 0.71 for identifying write-offs, against $\rho=0.38$ and AUC 0.68 for an unconstrained LLM. The gain is small and comes mostly from the sceptic call; we did not test whether its lower-only rule matters.
