Investments that later exceeded $2\times$ had 64% of factual categories corroborated, against 38% for write-offs (omnibus Kruskal-Wallis test over five outcome groups, $p=0.031$), and our retrieval was not date-restricted, so these figures may overstate screening skill. In a study of 20 inbound applications, analyst time per application fell from 44.7 to 18.9 minutes including verification and correction, and 84% of 240 cited claims were fully supported by their sources, but 70% of reports needed at least one correction.

translation.title: DealsFlow：面向风险投资交易初筛的证据门控智能体框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以阅读创业公司路演材料，但让它们直接输出投资评分会导致评分虚高、运行间方差大以及难以审计的理由。我们介绍DealsFlow，一个部署于英国某早期基金的人在回路智能体框架。LLM阅读路演材料、引用证据并对每个类别评分；代码组合评分、设置上限且只会降低评分。三个机制实现这一点：对无外部证据的事实类别设置阶段感知的佐证上限（78、70或60分，满分100）；怀疑者调用只会降低而不会提高评分；预取模式在单次生成前检索并索引所有证据。我们在N=243笔有记录结果的SEIS/EIS投资上评估。由于近期投资结果未定，我们使用142笔至少三年前的投资。在那里，完整流程的评分与总价值倍数的Spearman ρ=0.45（95% CI 0.32至0.57），识别减记的AUC为0.71，而无约束LLM为ρ=0.38和AUC 0.68。增益较小且主要来自怀疑者调用；我们未测试其只降不升规则是否重要。后来超过2倍回报的投资有64%的事实类别被佐证，而减记投资为38%（五组结果的omnibus Kruskal-Wallis检验，p=0.031），且我们的检索未做日期限制，因此这些数字可能高估筛选能力。在一项对20份入站申请的研究中，分析师每份申请的时间（含验证和修正）从44.7分钟降至18.9分钟，240条引用声明中84%被来源完全支持，但70%的报告需要至少一处修正。
translation.brief: 针对LLM直接输出投资评分导致的虚高与不可审计问题，构建带佐证上限、怀疑者调用和预取机制的人在回路智能体框架用于风投交易初筛。

papers.title: Async-RBench: Benchmarking Asynchronous Task Execution in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes. Final task success alone does not reveal whether these results were handled correctly, and natural asynchronous arrivals are hard to reproduce. We introduce Async-RBench, a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks covering eight scenarios. A scenario controller regulates result delivery using predefined task-state conditions, while an Event Response Contract (ERC) specifies what each response must change, preserve, avoid, and re-verify. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and outcome equally and is reported separately from task success. We evaluate nine agents and find DRS scores of 19.2 to 45.1, with the lowest scores on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents obtain lower task success with asynchronous than with batched delivery (26.0% vs. 29.7% on average). For three agents, prompting the main agent to rebuild its plan after every result improves DRS by only 2.6 to 3.5 points. Together, these findings highlight the challenges of reliable asynchronous task execution and the need to evaluate how agents handle incoming results alongside end-to-end task success.

translation.title: Async-RBench：LLM智能体异步任务执行基准测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地异步执行任务：主智能体在其子智能体运行时继续工作，任务状态可能在结果到达前发生变化。主智能体必须决定更新或保留哪些工作、重复哪些检查，同时避免被禁止的更改。仅凭最终任务成功无法揭示这些结果是否被正确处理，而自然的异步到达难以复现。我们提出Async-RBench，一个面向LLM智能体异步任务执行的基准，包含覆盖八个场景的200个可执行任务。场景控制器使用预定义的任务状态条件调节结果交付，而事件响应契约（ERC）规定每个响应必须更改、保留、避免和重新验证的内容。动态重规划评分（DRS）对响应过程和结果同等加权，并与任务成功分开报告。我们评估九个智能体，发现DRS分数为19.2至45.1，在重复报告和子智能体失败上得分最低。在我们的执行协议下，所有九个智能体在异步交付下的任务成功率均低于批量交付（平均26.0%对29.7%）。对三个智能体，提示主智能体在每个结果后重建计划仅将DRS提高2.6至3.5分。这些发现共同凸显了可靠异步任务执行的挑战，以及除端到端任务成功外评估智能体如何处理传入结果的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体异步任务执行缺乏可复现评估的问题，构建含200个任务、以事件响应契约和动态重规划评分为核心的基准Async-RBench。

papers.title: POSEIDON: Scaling Training Environments for Scientific Agents from Code Repositories
papers.abstract: Training environments remain a major bottleneck for agents in data-driven scientific discovery. Existing collections of executable and verifiable training environments are small, and their construction remains difficult to scale. To address this limitation, we introduce Poseidon, an automated pipeline for generating diverse, verifiable training environments from scientific code repositories at scale. From the same repository budget, Poseidon extracts nearly 10 times as many training environments as a prior approach by decomposing scientific workflows into four complementary task types: Reproduction, Subflow, Completion, and Correction, where each type targets a distinct capability for scientific research. A recursive improvement loop further refines failed candidates and recovers otherwise discarded environments. Using Poseidon, we construct Pearl, a collection of 97,659 executable and verifiable environments from 7,110 public repositories spanning 10 scientific disciplines. To the best of our knowledge, Pearl is the largest and most broadly multidisciplinary collection of scientific-agent training environments to date. Qwen3.5 models (9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B) trained on Pearl achieve consistent gains across six challenging scientific-agent benchmarks. Overall, the scale and diversity of Pearl offer opportunities for training scientific discovery agents.

translation.title: POSEIDON：从代码仓库扩展科学智能体训练环境
translation.abstract: 训练环境仍是数据驱动科学发现中智能体的主要瓶颈。现有的可执行、可验证训练环境集合规模小，且其构建难以扩展。为解决这一局限，我们提出Poseidon，一个从科学代码仓库大规模自动生成多样化、可验证训练环境的流水线。在相同的仓库预算下，Poseidon通过将科学工作流分解为四种互补任务类型——复现（Reproduction）、子流程（Subflow）、补全（Completion）和修正（Correction），每种类型针对科学研究的一项独特能力——提取的训练环境数量约为先前方法的10倍。递归改进循环进一步精炼失败的候选并回收原本会被丢弃的环境。使用Poseidon，我们构建了Pearl，一个来自10个科学学科7110个公共仓库、包含97,659个可执行可验证环境的集合。据我们所知，Pearl是迄今最大、学科覆盖最广的科学智能体训练环境集合。在Pearl上训练的Qwen3.5模型（9B、27B和35B-A3B）在六个具有挑战性的科学智能体基准上取得一致提升。总体而言，Pearl的规模和多样性为训练科学发现智能体提供了机会。
translation.brief: 针对科学智能体训练环境稀缺且难以扩展的问题，提出从科学代码仓库自动生成多样化可验证环境的流水线Poseidon，构建了97,659个环境的Pearl集合。

papers.title: ALLMTS: Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System
papers.abstract: Telephone triage is a safety critical task: from a brief intake note, a nurse must decide whether a caller needs an ambulance, an emergency department, an appointment, or self care at home. Queried directly, large language models (LLMs) are unreliable: they over-escalate routine cases and cannot justify their recommendations against an auditable clinical standard. We present the Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System (ALLMTS), which grounds every disposition in the same commercially maintained telehealth guidelines nurses use. Rather than asking an LLM to triage, ALLMTS makes it execute the guideline: it selects the appropriate guideline and evaluates its triage assessment questions. The disposition follows deterministically from the first positive answer, using the same traversal rule a nurse follows. We evaluate ALLMTS on 566 synthetic, expert-validated scenarios spanning 14 dispositions and designed to test specific guideline questions. ALLMTS achieves 0.95 accuracy, compared with 0.47 for a raw-LLM baseline. On a curated 50-scenario subset released as an open benchmark, ALLMTS reaches 0.98 accuracy, on par with the 0.944 correct disposition rate that a five nurse expert panel recorded on those same scenarios. Critically, on that subset the baselines have over-triage rates of up to 0.50 (0.44 on the full dataset), whereas ALLMTS reduces the over-triage rate to at most 0.02 while maintaining low under-triage. These results support coupling LLM language understanding with executable clinical guidelines for triage from intake notes.

translation.title: ALLMTS：基于LLM的自动化医疗分诊系统
translation.abstract: 电话分诊是安全关键任务：护士必须根据简短的接诊记录决定来电者是否需要救护车、急诊科、预约就诊或居家自我护理。直接查询大语言模型（LLM）并不可靠：它们会过度升级常规病例，且无法依据可审计的临床标准为其建议提供理由。我们提出基于LLM的自动化医疗分诊系统（ALLMTS），它将每个处置决定建立在护士使用的同一套商业维护的远程医疗指南上。ALLMTS不是让LLM直接分诊，而是让它执行指南：选择合适的指南并评估其分诊评估问题。处置决定从第一个肯定回答确定性地得出，使用与护士相同的遍历规则。我们在566个经专家验证、覆盖14种处置并设计用于测试特定指南问题的合成场景上评估ALLMTS。ALLMTS达到0.95准确率，而原始LLM基线为0.47。在一个作为开放基准发布的50个场景的精选子集上，ALLMTS达到0.98准确率，与五名护士专家组在这些场景上记录的0.944正确处置率相当。关键的是，在该子集上基线的过度分诊率高达0.50（完整数据集上为0.44），而ALLMTS将过度分诊率降至最多0.02，同时保持低漏诊率。这些结果支持将LLM语言理解与可执行临床指南相结合用于接诊记录分诊。
translation.brief: 针对LLM直接分诊不可靠且无法审计的问题，提出让LLM执行护士所用临床指南的分诊系统ALLMTS，处置决定由指南遍历确定性得出。

papers.title: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial research, CauProphet leverages prior discoveries to improve downstream analyses and outperforms all baselines in mean rank correlation with next-day returns, achieving a 25.4% improvement over a baseline agent. It also improves prediction accuracy from 21.3% to 28.6% in dynamic real-world settings. Further experiments validate its ability to perform reliable causal analysis and action selection across scientific and everyday tasks, demonstrating the potential of causal experience learning for next-generation LLM agents.

translation.title: CauProphet：教会智能体像人类一样发展因果认知
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益借助外部记忆和过往经验来支持长程任务。然而，现有智能体主要检索记录或摘要，缺乏形成并完善对世界因果理解的能力。受人类因果认知启发，我们提出 CauProphet，一个在其因果认知（Causal Cognition）中发展和更新因果知识的智能体。对于每个任务，CauProphet 将因果认知中的相关知识与当前证据相结合，构建一个因果信念（Causal Belief），即一种捕捉因果因素及可能行动效果的结构化信念。它利用该信念进行决策，并随着新观察的出现持续更新信念和因果认知，使因果知识能够超越个体经验而持久存在。评估表明，CauProphet 能够逐步获取因果知识并将其迁移到未来决策中。在金融研究中，CauProphet 利用先前的发现改进下游分析，在与次日收益率平均秩相关性上超越所有基线，相比基线智能体提升 25.4%。在动态真实场景中，它还将预测准确率从 21.3% 提升至 28.6%。进一步实验验证了其在科学和日常任务中进行可靠因果分析和行动选择的能力，展示了因果经验学习对下一代 LLM 智能体的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对现有 LLM 智能体缺乏因果理解能力的问题，提出 CauProphet，通过构建并持续更新结构化因果信念和因果认知库来积累并迁移因果知识。

papers.title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs.

translation.title: CASE：面向冻结多模态情感模型的混淆感知技能演化
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过基于多模态证据的推理实现细粒度情感理解，显著推进了多模态情感识别（MER）。然而，它们在多模态线索高度重叠、语义相近的情感之间仍表现出系统性混淆。现有方法通常通过全局参数微调来纠正这些错误，代价高昂且不灵活。我们转而观察到情感混淆是高度局部化的，因此更适合通过可复用的、针对特定情感对的专业知识来解决。基于这一洞察，我们提出混淆感知技能演化（CASE），这是首个面向 MER 的智能体技能框架。CASE 维护一个稀疏的、自演化的情感对专属 EmotionSkill 库，将情感专业知识从模型参数中外化，使学到的专业知识能够持续精炼，并轻松迁移到各种冻结的 MLLM 主干上。在推理时，CASE 动态检索合适的 EmotionSkill 以强化边界感知推理，同时保持 MLLM 主干冻结。在 CA-MER、DFEW 和 EMER 上的大量实验证明了 CASE 在通用型和情感专用型 MLLM 上的有效性和可迁移性。值得注意的是，CASE 将 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 CA-MER 基准上的平均准确率从 46.80% 提升至 59.13%，并在各 MLLM 上取得一致增益。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 在语义相近情感间的系统性混淆问题，提出 CASE，通过自演化的情感对专属技能库在冻结主干上动态检索以强化边界感知推理。

papers.title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
papers.abstract: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.

translation.title: 当智能体失败时：该归咎于模型还是执行框架？
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体由模型与执行框架（harness）组合而成，因此智能体基准性能反映的是二者的联合行为。我们主张应通过执行框架与底层模型的交互来评估框架。我们开发了一个包含五项互补指标的框架：(i) 有效完成率（VCR），即智能体无论任务正确与否都能正常完成并交付可评估结果的可靠程度；(ii) 模型-框架契合度，即框架在有效完成方面对给定模型任务达成的支持程度；(iii) 跨模型契合度，即框架在所有被评估模型上的整体适用性；(iv) 交互残差，即被组件级汇总掩盖的特定配对的执行优劣；(v) Token 负载，即智能体执行（包括失败尝试）的 token 需求。我们用四个通用框架（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI 和 DeepAgents）与四个核心模型，加上两个固定的原生模型-框架系统，在涵盖上下文管理、工具使用、长上下文规划、多模态交互和产物交接的六个基准上进行评估。包含原生参照和压力条件在内，111 个评估设置共产生 52,168 条轨迹。框架排名因模型和基准而异；任务性能和有效完成可能偏好不同的配对，相似的任务得分可能伴随不同的执行特征。OpenCode 在跨模型性能上排名第一，而 DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview 在共享的四基准面板上跨框架保持持续较高的平均 VCR。这些发现支持评估模型-框架交互、在模型中训练可迁移的框架使用能力，以及设计适配模型和任务的框架。
translation.brief: 针对智能体基准无法区分模型与执行框架各自贡献的问题，提出包含有效完成率、模型-框架契合度等五项指标的评估框架来分析模型与框架的交互。

papers.title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
papers.abstract: GUI grounding benchmarks ask whether an agent can localize a target that is already visible in a static screenshot. Real interfaces often violate this assumption: a target may be off-screen, appear only after a state change or hover, remain occluded, or become actionable after a delay. This leaves the ability to recover target visibility unevaluated. To measure this reveal step, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG), a benchmark in which an agent must first make the target visible through interaction and then click it. IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, with a compact action space of scrolling, moving, dragging, waiting, and clicking. In our human study, participants achieve 94.6% accuracy, while GPT-5.5 reaches 79.4% and the strongest evaluated open-source VLM reaches only 31.6%. To identify the source of this gap, we conduct two controlled interventions. Telling Qwen3-VL which interaction to perform raises its accuracy only from 30.8% to 33.9%, whereas performing the interaction for the model raises it to 81.9%. The bottleneck is executing the reveal interaction, not recognizing the target once it is exposed. We further show that this capability is learnable, demonstrating that visibility recovery can be strengthened consistently across model families.

translation.title: IGG：可见性约束下的交互式 GUI 定位基准
translation.abstract: GUI 定位基准测试的是智能体能否在静态截图中定位一个已经可见的目标。真实界面常常违反这一假设：目标可能在屏幕外、仅在状态改变或悬停后出现、被遮挡，或延迟后才可操作。这使得恢复目标可见性的能力未被评估。为衡量这一揭示步骤，我们提出交互式 GUI 定位（IGG）基准，其中智能体必须先通过交互使目标可见，然后点击它。IGG 包含 16 个可控 GUI 环境中的 601 个任务和七种可见性约束子类型，动作空间精简为滚动、移动、拖拽、等待和点击。在人类研究中，参与者达到 94.6% 的准确率，而 GPT-5.5 达到 79.4%，最强的开源 VLM 仅达到 31.6%。为找出差距来源，我们进行了两项受控干预。告诉 Qwen3-VL 应执行哪种交互仅将其准确率从 30.8% 提升至 33.9%，而替模型执行该交互则将其提升至 81.9%。瓶颈在于执行揭示交互，而非在目标暴露后识别目标。我们进一步证明该能力是可学习的，表明可见性恢复能力可以在不同模型家族中一致地得到增强。
translation.brief: 针对现有 GUI 定位基准忽略目标不可见情形的问题，提出 IGG 基准，要求智能体先通过交互使目标可见再点击，并揭示瓶颈在于执行揭示交互而非目标识别。

papers.title: What Transfers Across Protein Pockets? Experience Reuse in Molecular Optimization for Agentic Structure-Based Drug Design
papers.abstract: LLM agents optimize a ligand in a protein pocket by editing it step by step and docking each edit. Recent agents first spend extra dockings probing the complex with controlled edits; guidance induced from these probes is reported to help more than the chemical knowledge the model already carries. The probes are then discarded with the instance that produced them, so the obvious next step is to keep them in an experience base, letting a new pocket inherit what earlier ones already paid for. Such a base is read through a \emph{key}: the record properties under which past edits are pooled and a new one is looked up. Using the full log of one such run over the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets, we ask whether its keys recur on a pocket the base has never seen and still separate improving from worsening edits. \crchange{Using} the contacts at the site being edited, the action, and the round as \crchange{a} key, the base separates them sharply. Within our analysis, this separation is largely explained by how much the edit changed the molecule's size, the action, and the round, none of which describes the target. That is not because the target is irrelevant: naming it outright separates them several times more sharply. For a pocket absent from the base, transfer must rely on a description rather than its identity. Among the exact-match descriptions we evaluate, the more specific ones rarely recur, whereas the coarser ones provide little separation; the signals that do transfer primarily describe the edit and the molecule it produced rather than the target. Under the representations and lookup scheme studied here, an experience base may be more useful for prioritizing an agent's own proposals for docking than for directly prescribing what to build.

translation.title: 什么能在蛋白质口袋间迁移？智能体化结构导向药物设计中分子优化的经验复用
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体通过逐步编辑配体并对每次编辑进行对接，来优化蛋白质口袋中的配体。近期的智能体首先花费额外的对接次数通过受控编辑探测复合物；据报告，从这些探测中归纳的引导比模型已有的化学知识更有帮助。然而这些探测随后随产生它们的实例一起被丢弃，因此显而易见的下一步是将它们保存在经验库中，让新口袋继承先前口袋已经付出的代价。这样的库通过一个键（key）来读取：即过去编辑被归组、新编辑被查询所依据的记录属性。利用对 CrossDocked2020 测试集口袋的一次完整运行日志，我们探究其键是否在一个该库从未见过的口袋上复现，并仍能区分改善与恶化的编辑。使用被编辑位点的接触、动作和轮次作为键，该库能清晰区分它们。在我们的分析中，这种区分主要由编辑对分子大小的改变程度、动作和轮次解释，而这些都不描述靶标。这并非因为靶标无关紧要：直接指明靶标能将区分度提高数倍。对于库中不存在的口袋，迁移必须依赖描述而非其身份。在我们评估的精确匹配描述中，更具体的描述很少复现，而更粗略的描述提供的区分度很小；真正能迁移的信号主要描述编辑本身及其产生的分子，而非靶标。在本文研究的表示和查询方案下，经验库可能更适合用于对智能体自身的候选分子进行对接优先级排序，而非直接规定该构建什么。
translation.brief: 针对分子优化智能体经验库能否跨蛋白质口袋迁移的问题，通过分析经验库键的复现与区分能力，发现可迁移的信号主要描述编辑和分子而非靶标。

papers.title: LGMT: A Tool for Testing the Logical Reasoning Reliability of LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as reasoning components in modern software systems, yet a model that answers a logical query correctly can contradict itself when the same problem is restated in an equivalent form. Static benchmarks evaluate queries in isolation and therefore fail to expose such inconsistencies. To address this limitation, we present LGMT, an open-source tool that detects reasoning inconsistencies through metamorphic relations grounded in first-order logic. Given a source test case in premise-conclusion form, LGMT generates logically equivalent follow-up cases and checks whether the model's entailment predictions agree across the pair, without ground-truth labels. The tool provides 20 built-in metamorphic relations, supports custom ones verified by the Z3 theorem prover, and runs from a CLI or a web studio, including an offline mock mode requiring no API key. Across six widely used LLMs on a bundled benchmark of 3,091 metamorphic groups, LGMT reveals inconsistency rates ranging from 20.84% to 29.44%. LGMT is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U.

translation.title: LGMT：一种测试LLM逻辑推理可靠性的工具
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在现代软件系统中越来越多地充当推理组件，然而一个模型在正确回答某个逻辑查询后，当同一问题以等价形式重新表述时却可能自相矛盾。静态基准将查询孤立评估，因此无法暴露此类不一致性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了LGMT，一个开源工具，它通过基于一阶逻辑的蜕变关系检测推理不一致性。给定一个前提-结论形式的源测试用例，LGMT生成逻辑等价的后续用例，并检查模型的蕴含预测在用例对之间是否一致，且无需真实标签。该工具提供20个内置蜕变关系，支持经Z3定理证明器验证的自定义关系，并可从CLI或网页工作室运行，包括无需API密钥的离线模拟模式。在六个广泛使用的LLM上，针对内置的3,091个蜕变组基准，LGMT揭示的不一致率介于20.84%至29.44%之间。LGMT已在GitHub上公开：https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool，演示视频见 https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U。
translation.brief: 针对静态基准无法暴露LLM逻辑推理不一致的问题，提出基于一阶逻辑蜕变关系、无需真实标签的等价测试用例生成与一致性检测工具LGMT。

papers.title: Do Language Models Trust Their Own Justifications? A Study on Functional Consistency
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in text classification tasks, where they not only output class predictions but also generate explanations that highlight the tokens deemed most relevant for reaching the predicted label. Yet it remains unclear whether these highlighted elements are behaviorally consistent with the model's own predictions under targeted interventions, which we refer to as functional auto-consistency. While much of the literature evaluates the textual plausibility of such explanations, few studies assess their functional consistency with the model's actual behavior. In this work, we propose an experimental framework based on the principle of auto-consistency: if a model identifies certain tokens as decisive, then isolating, removing, or semantically inverting them should produce systematic and interpretable changes in its predictions. We operationalize this evaluation through sufficiency, comprehensiveness, and counterfactuality metrics, and conduct experiments on IMDB and Steam reviews across both closed-source (GPT-4o-mini) and open-source LLMs (Gemma3, Granite8B, DeepSeek). Results show that GPT-4o-mini follows the expected progression across all metrics, Gemma3 and Granite8B maintain coherence under sufficiency but lose consistency under more demanding interventions, while DeepSeek variants display structural deviations, either failing to preserve sufficiency or overreacting under comprehensiveness and counterfactuality. These findings show that explanation reliability varies across LLM families and scales, with smaller models displaying contradictions and larger ones exhibiting over-sensitivity. By combining sufficiency, comprehensiveness, and counterfactuality, our approach provides a systematic methodology for assessing the functional consistency of LLM self-explanations.

translation.title: 语言模型信任自己的解释吗？一项关于功能一致性的研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛应用于文本分类任务，它们不仅输出类别预测，还生成解释，标出被认为对得出预测标签最相关的词元。然而，这些被标出的元素在针对性干预下是否与模型自身的预测在行为上保持一致，即我们所说的功能自洽性，仍不清楚。尽管文献大多评估此类解释的文本合理性，但很少有研究评估它们与模型实际行为的功能一致性。在本工作中，我们提出一个基于自洽性原则的实验框架：如果模型认为某些词元是决定性的，那么隔离、移除或语义反转它们应导致其预测发生系统性且可解释的变化。我们通过充分性、全面性和反事实性指标来操作化这一评估，并在IMDB和Steam评论上对闭源（GPT-4o-mini）和开源LLM（Gemma3、Granite8B、DeepSeek）进行实验。结果表明，GPT-4o-mini在所有指标上符合预期进程，Gemma3和Granite8B在充分性下保持一致但在更严格的干预下失去一致性，而DeepSeek变体表现出结构性偏差，要么未能保持充分性，要么在全面性和反事实性下反应过度。这些发现表明解释的可靠性因LLM家族和规模而异，较小的模型表现出矛盾，较大的模型表现出过度敏感。通过结合充分性、全面性和反事实性，我们的方法为评估LLM自我解释的功能一致性提供了系统化的方法论。
translation.brief: 针对LLM自我解释与其实际预测行为是否一致（功能自洽性）缺乏评估的问题，提出基于充分性、全面性、反事实性干预的实验框架来系统检验解释的功能一致性。

papers.title: Agentic Hazard Mapper: Emulating Expert Map-Making with AI Agents for Risk Communication
papers.abstract: Hazard maps are essential tools for public risk communication, preparedness, and evacuation planning, yet effective cartographic design is not always ensured due to limited access to cartographic expertise across local governments and communities. We present Agentic Hazard Mapper, a multi-agent system that automates hazard-map production by emulating professional cartographic workflows and iterative design trade-offs while adapting design decisions to different data, locations, and hazard contexts. We conducted a formative study with map experts to inform the system design, followed by a user study and interviews with map experts and hazard practitioners. The generated maps improved participants' spatial understanding and evacuation-planning performance, reduced perceived workload and task completion time, and were generally preferred over corresponding municipal maps. We further discuss human oversight, adaptation across users and communication contexts, and opportunities to extend agentic support across broader stages of hazard-map production and risk communication.

translation.title: Agentic Hazard Mapper：用AI智能体模拟专家制图以进行风险沟通
translation.abstract: 灾害地图是公众风险沟通、备灾和疏散规划的重要工具，但由于地方政府和社区获取制图专业知识的机会有限，有效的地图设计并不总是得到保证。我们提出Agentic Hazard Mapper，一个多智能体系统，通过模拟专业制图工作流程和迭代设计权衡来自动化灾害地图生产，同时使设计决策适应不同的数据、位置和灾害情境。我们与地图专家进行了形成性研究以指导系统设计，随后与地图专家和灾害从业者进行了用户研究和访谈。生成的地图提升了参与者的空间理解和疏散规划表现，降低了感知工作量和任务完成时间，并且在总体上比相应的市政地图更受青睐。我们还讨论了人类监督、跨用户和沟通情境的适应，以及在灾害地图生产和风险沟通更广泛阶段扩展智能体支持的机会。
translation.brief: 针对地方政府和社区缺乏制图专业知识、灾害地图质量不佳的问题，构建模拟专家制图工作流的多智能体系统Agentic Hazard Mapper来自动生成灾害地图。

papers.title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.

translation.title: ActionRAG：面向LLM智能体长期记忆的证据精炼图扩散
translation.abstract: LLM智能体需要能从不断增长的交互历史中恢复精确且相互一致证据的长期记忆，尤其当答案依赖于事实之间的关系而非孤立的语义匹配时。当前的记忆流水线在两个阶段仍然脆弱：索引错误可能分割重复实体或合并不同实体，而在线检索常常将初始相似度分数视为最终结果，即使周围的图结构提供了修订它们的证据。我们提出ActionRAG，一种将谨慎索引与查询时图回溯评估相结合的图记忆架构。其索引流水线协调类型标签并应用分层实体消解。给定查询时，双通道的实体和三元组检索形成初始证据集并诱导一个有界局部图。查询条件下的接收者归一化扩散利用局部路径结构精炼三元组分数。种子保护、枢纽惩罚通量和三元组物化在恢复遗漏连接的同时保留直接证据。我们在MemoryAgentBench（MAB）上评估ActionRAG，该基准测试准确检索、冲突消解、长程理解和测试时学习。在其八个确定性评分列上，ActionRAG达到55.1的平均准确率，比最强的基于检索的记忆基线提高5.4分。在MAB的查询时成本核算下，四个报告成本列的平均综合成本保持在每查询0.001美元以下，在我们消费级Apple Silicon设备上单独测得的检索侧p99组件之和为440.7毫秒。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体记忆管线在索引错误和检索分数不修正方面的脆弱性，提出结合谨慎索引与查询时图扩散回溯评估的图记忆架构ActionRAG。

papers.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.

translation.title: HarnessMM：面向Harness词元效率的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 智能体harness在工具反馈后反复调用推理，即使早先的调用已经确定了下一步动作。我们提出HarnessMM（Harness Minus Minus），一种通过受保护决策复用和递归自我改进（RSI）提升harness词元效率的方法。RSI从训练反馈中迭代精炼配套的harness配置，并通过验证选择部署的配置。位于模型-工具边界的控制器复用已解决的决策来替代后续的推理回调，同时保持actor权重固定。可执行决策图存储精确动作、字面参数、因果依赖和公共保护条件。受保护决策复用从观察到的回执中激活这些持久化决策；经认证的回调替换通过原生接口执行它们并记录移除已注册的慢回调。新的语义决策、不支持的证据和选择器弃权会再次调用原始actor。该表示限制了反馈可以改变的内容，而完整任务测量确立质量和成本。在HumanEval上，HarnessMM将Codex成功率保持在90.82%，同时将每任务词元数（k）从66.72降至47.02（节省29.54%）。对于DeepSeek Harness，成功率从71.43%升至85.71%，同时每任务词元数（k）从96.28降至11.62（节省87.93%）。一项单独的MBPP消融实验测得比单次使用图低26.91%的成本，比保留回调低19.52%的成本。这些结果确立了受保护决策复用是减少现有harness中重复推理的实用方法。
translation.brief: 针对智能体harness在工具反馈后重复调用推理浪费词元的问题，提出基于受保护决策复用与递归自我改进（RSI）的HarnessMM方法来复用已解决的决策。

papers.title: Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
papers.abstract: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and they need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on, not stakeholder documentation. A seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline recovered this logic, processing 241 repositories across 18 services into thousands of artifacts describing scope, journeys, rules and acceptance criteria. Recovery does not confer usability. Entities like offer, eligibility, and activation recur across services under a shared vocabulary, related in name but operationally distinct, so one end-to-end journey implicates over a thousand near-identical rules that must not be conflated. Flat vector retrieval fails, returning an identical rule from the wrong service at high similarity with no signal of error. Content-level ontology, the traditional remedy, did not exist, and relating every occurrence of recurring entities would have cost more than the engagement and not survived a release cycle. We place the ontology at the artifact level. In this machine-generated corpus, each artifact retains its producer, component, service, domain and type, provenance that disambiguates before content is read. We present a knowledge layer that organizes before retrieving: a self-describing catalog, a sparse metadata registry, and a navigation hypergraph defined over artifacts rather than extracted entities. Queries resolve to artifact identifiers that constrain vector search, so the competing rule from another service is absent rather than outranked, making disambiguation structural, not statistical. Built in under a week and admitting new services by convention, the layer serves SDLC agents, developers, quality engineers and analysts. It supported root-cause analysis and resolution of 100+ production defects with developer verification and attributed 35 release regression failures to specific rules and services.

translation.title: 面向多智能体系统的企业级 RAG 重构：先组织后检索的知识层
translation.abstract: 企业正在软件开发生命周期中部署智能体 AI，它们需要的是所操作系统的行为逻辑，而非利益相关者文档。一个七智能体逆向工程流水线恢复了这种逻辑，将 18 个服务下的 241 个代码仓库处理成数千个描述范围、旅程、规则和验收标准的工件。恢复并不等于可用性。offer、eligibility、activation 等实体在共享词汇下跨服务反复出现，名称相关但操作上截然不同，因此一条端到端旅程会牵涉上千条几乎相同却不可混淆的规则。扁平向量检索失效，会以高相似度返回来自错误服务的相同规则且无错误信号。传统补救方案——内容级本体——并不存在，而关联每个重复实体的所有出现位置的成本会超过项目本身，且无法在一个发布周期内存活。我们将本体置于工件层面。在这个机器生成的语料库中，每个工件保留其生产者、组件、服务、领域和类型，这些溯源信息在读取内容之前就完成消歧。我们提出一个先组织后检索的知识层：自描述目录、稀疏元数据注册表，以及定义在工件而非抽取实体之上的导航超图。查询解析为约束向量搜索的工件标识符，因此来自其他服务的竞争规则是缺席而非被排序靠后，使消歧成为结构性的而非统计性的。该层在一周内建成，并可通过约定接纳新服务，服务于 SDLC 智能体、开发者、质量工程师和分析师。它支持了 100 多个生产缺陷的根因分析与修复（经开发者验证），并将 35 个发布回归失败归因到具体规则和服务。
translation.brief: 解决企业多智能体系统中扁平向量检索无法消歧跨服务相似规则的问题，采用在工件层面构建自描述目录、稀疏元数据注册表和导航超图的知识层，先组织后检索实现结构性消歧。

papers.title: From Deliberately Constructed Systemic Representations of the World of Activity to Dialogue: A Five-Level Communication Architecture for Strong Language-Based ASI
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a five-level organization of message formation and understanding within thinking and activity in which ASI participates. Its central thesis is that a language model's context is fundamentally incapable of presenting the foundations of utterance formation for examination and verification. These foundations are established in advance by acquired schemas, systemic representations of the world of activity, and connections accepted as true within them. Neither context nor trained LLM weights, in themselves, attest to the presence of deliberately constructed systemic representations. The five levels distinguish systemic representations of the world of activity, a particular situation cut out from those representations, its narrative description, the full sense of a message, and text. A situation's schema-model is not identical to a story about it. A recipient reconstructs the full sense from an abbreviated text through jointly constructed and agreed-upon representations and joint activity. Reverse work proceeds from the full sense through an extended description and the situation's schema-model to the reconstruction of systemic foundations. The theoretical foundations draw on the systems methodology of G. P. Shchedrovitskiy, the structural differential of A. Korzybski, and the Meaning-Text theory of I. A. Mel'chuk. The contribution is a specific systemic-activity organization of content for examining and adjusting message foundations and controlling the consequences of their transformation. Further research concerns large graphical models of activity on reconstructible systemic foundations, distinct from text generation from context.

translation.title: 从刻意构建的活动世界系统表征到对话：面向强语言型 ASI 的五层通信架构
translation.abstract: 本文提出 ASI 参与的思维与活动中消息形成与理解的五层组织。其核心论点是：语言模型的上下文从根本上无法呈现话语形成的基础以供检验和验证。这些基础由习得的图式、活动世界的系统表征以及其中被接受为真的联系预先建立。上下文和训练得到的 LLM 权重本身都不能证明存在刻意构建的系统表征。五个层次区分了活动世界的系统表征、从这些表征中切出的特定情境、其叙事描述、消息的完整意义以及文本。情境的图式模型不等同于关于它的故事。接收者通过共同构建并达成一致的表征和共同活动，从缩略文本中重构完整意义。逆向工作则从完整意义出发，经由扩展描述和情境的图式模型，重构系统基础。理论基础借鉴 G. P. Shchedrovitskiy 的系统方法论、A. Korzybski 的结构微分以及 I. A. Mel'chuk 的意义-文本理论。贡献是一种具体的系统-活动内容组织，用于检验和调整消息基础并控制其转换的后果。进一步研究涉及在可重构系统基础上的大型活动图形模型，有别于从上下文生成文本。
translation.brief: 解决语言模型上下文无法呈现话语形成基础的问题，提出基于系统-活动方法学的五层消息形成与理解架构，用于检验和调整消息基础。

papers.title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
papers.abstract: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent's position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen's paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs

translation.title: "真"与"假"加起来等于一吗？LLM 智能体意见模拟中的补集一致性
translation.abstract: 在 LLM 智能体意见模拟中，每个智能体在看到自己先前的概率和邻居报告的概率后，报告一个断言为真的概率，该数字成为其下一轮的状态。如果该数字描述的是智能体的立场而非它所看到的句子，那么将断言改写为其补集并将每个概率 p 替换为 1 - p 应返回互补的答案，因此两次报告之和应为 1。我们用三个小型开源模型测试：Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 和 Gemma-3-4B。在取自运行中网络模拟的 2,304 个智能体状态上，Qwen 的配对报告平均和为 1.18；在来自 AVeriTeC 的 48 个真实事实核查断言上，其和同样超过 1。一个包含 24 个世界（每个恰好有两种可能结果）的受控基准显示三个模型都存在同样的失败。该偏差是同义改写所产生变化的两到十倍，且在重复采样、不同同伴群体规模和报告强度下持续存在。当报告被反馈到从互补状态出发的两个群体时，群体不再保持镜像：每个模型在五轮后分歧均为正。将每个答案与其配对答案的补集取平均可在构造上恢复一致性，并降低两种措辞下的平均 Brier 损失，但在最后一轮，三个模型中只有一个优于两种原始措辞中较好的那个。在同一模型上的调度-目标实验给出小而稳定的交互，因为此类扫描保持断言措辞固定。因此，在将模拟概率解读为信念之前，需要先进行措辞一致性测试。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体意见模拟中概率报告在断言补集改写下不满足和为 1 的一致性问题，通过补集改写实验和受控基准系统性地检验三个开源模型的补集一致性。

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.abstract: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) global rank allocation, where uncalibrated error proxies fail to capture complex error propagation, and (ii) decomposition quality, where Fisher-based estimators suffer from severe rank collapse. In this work, we address these limitations by introducing Layer-wise Error Modeling Search (LEMS) and KFAC-SVD. LEMS advances rank allocation by introducing a layer-wise error surrogate that integrates local and global layer importance alongside a propagation bias, enabling effective global rank allocation via an ILP formulation. KFAC-SVD improves decomposition quality by utilizing token-wise statistics, mitigating the rank deficiency observed in prior Fisher-based SVD approaches. Across Mistral, Qwen3, and Llama 3 model families, we show that LEMS consistently outperforms existing search strategies, delivering significant zero-shot accuracy gains of up to 4.7 p.p. that generalize to model sizes of 70B parameters, while KFAC-SVD achieves an average perplexity improvement of 19%. Project page and code: https://lems-svd.github.io

translation.title: 通过逐层误差模型搜索推进基于 SVD 的 LLM 压缩
translation.abstract: 基于低秩 SVD 的压缩是降低 LLM 计算成本的有力策略。然而，现有方法面临两个关键局限：(i) 全局秩分配——未经校准的误差代理无法捕捉复杂的误差传播；(ii) 分解质量——基于 Fisher 的估计器存在严重的秩坍缩。本文通过引入逐层误差建模搜索（LEMS）和 KFAC-SVD 来解决这些局限。LEMS 通过引入整合局部与全局层重要性以及传播偏差的逐层误差代理来改进秩分配，并通过 ILP 形式化实现有效的全局秩分配。KFAC-SVD 利用 token 级统计量提升分解质量，缓解了先前基于 Fisher 的 SVD 方法中观察到的秩亏问题。在 Mistral、Qwen3 和 Llama 3 模型家族上，我们表明 LEMS 持续优于现有搜索策略，带来高达 4.7 个百分点的显著零样本准确率提升，并可推广至 70B 参数规模的模型；KFAC-SVD 则实现平均 19% 的困惑度改进。项目页面与代码：https://lems-svd.github.io
translation.brief: 解决基于 SVD 的 LLM 压缩中全局秩分配不准和 Fisher 估计秩坍缩的问题，提出 LEMS 逐层误差代理结合 ILP 进行秩分配，以及利用 token 级统计的 KFAC-SVD 改善分解质量。

papers.title: Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding
papers.abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed representation (as the student). At equal compression ratios, Boa matches or surpasses the performance of existing state-of-the-art offline compression baselines, while being an order of magnitude faster than Transformer-based implementations, thereby reducing end-to-end latency rather than adding compression time overhead. We demonstrate that Boa also scales well to longer contexts and to compression ratios as aggressive as 16x. By enabling effective compression that is cheap enough to run on every query at inference time, Boa becomes a practical and general tool for efficient long-context inference.

translation.title: 基于状态空间编码的线性时间上下文压缩
translation.abstract: 基于 Transformer 的大语言模型（LLM）随上下文规模增大而产生巨大的计算和内存成本，这促使人们在推理前将上下文压缩为更短表示的方法。现有的软提示压缩方法通常使用与目标模型相同的 Transformer 骨干，生成压缩表示会带来显著的延迟开销，这限制了它们只能用于离线场景——上下文压缩一次后在多次查询中复用。我们提出 Boa Compressor，一个基于 Mamba 状态空间模型（SSM）的即插即用在线上下文压缩器，可在单次线性时间遍历中编码任意长度的上下文，生成用于条件化冻结目标 LLM 的表示。SSM 通过蒸馏训练，使摄取完整上下文的 LLM（作为教师）与摄取压缩表示的同一 LLM（作为学生）的下一 token logit 分布相匹配。在相同压缩比下，Boa 匹配或超越现有最先进的离线压缩基线，同时比基于 Transformer 的实现快一个数量级，从而降低端到端延迟而非增加压缩时间开销。我们证明 Boa 还能良好扩展到更长上下文和高达 16 倍的激进压缩比。通过使有效压缩足够廉价以在推理时对每次查询运行，Boa 成为高效长上下文推理的实用且通用的工具。
translation.brief: 解决 Transformer 软提示压缩延迟过高只能离线使用的问题，提出基于 Mamba SSM 的 Boa 压缩器，通过蒸馏训练实现单次线性时间在线上下文压缩。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided LLM for Intent-Driven Service Orchestration in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial 6G Networks
papers.abstract: Natural-language service intents in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) 6G networks can be incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent, making unconstrained LLM generation challenging for reliable network-facing orchestration. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided LLM framework that combines grammar-constrained semantic parsing with a knowledge-graph (KG)-driven clarification loop to produce validated, orchestration-ready service profiles across four representative service classes. On a 200-sample intent dataset, the framework achieves 89% classification accuracy and 95% policy validity with an average of 0.66 clarification turns per request. Compared with a Pure-LLM baseline, the proposed framework improves policy validity and contradiction detection while requiring fewer clarification turns, demonstrating the value of explicit knowledge-guided reasoning for robust intent processing in integrated TN/NTN 6G orchestration.

translation.title: 知识引导的LLM用于天地一体化6G网络中意图驱动的服务编排
translation.abstract: 在天地一体化（TN/NTN）6G网络中，自然语言服务意图可能不完整、含糊或不一致，使得无约束的LLM生成难以实现可靠的网络侧编排。本文提出一种知识引导的LLM框架，将语法约束的语义解析与知识图谱（KG）驱动的澄清循环相结合，在四类代表性服务上生成经过验证、可直接编排的服务配置。在200条意图样本数据集上，该框架达到89%的分类准确率和95%的策略有效性，平均每请求仅需0.66轮澄清。与纯LLM基线相比，该框架在提升策略有效性和矛盾检测能力的同时减少了澄清轮数，展示了显式知识引导推理在天地一体化6G编排中鲁棒意图处理的价值。
translation.brief: 针对自然语言服务意图不完整、含糊导致LLM编排不可靠的问题，提出结合语法约束语义解析与知识图谱驱动澄清循环的知识引导LLM框架。

papers.title: Recursive Semantic Divergence for LLM Agent Consistency
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents with tool use exhibit inconsistent behavior across independent runs from identical states, calling different tools, producing contradictory outputs, or pursuing divergent strategies. This variability compounds over time and undermines deployment reliability. Existing evaluation metrics primarily measure task correctness via completion-based scores and do not capture consistency in agent behavior across executions. Separately, agent behavior is analyzed either at the token level using probability distributions or at the single-response level using semantic clustering, but neither captures how inconsistency propagates across future turns of a trajectory. We introduce Recursive Semantic Divergence (RSD), an unsupervised trajectory-level consistency metric adapted from bisimulation metrics in reinforcement learning. RSD measures the expected cumulative semantic disagreement between two independent rollouts of the same agent from the same state, using natural language inference to detect logical inconsistency. It is defined recursively over future states and approximated by a neural network trained on independent rollouts. The learned metric estimates future divergence from the current state, providing a consistency score at each turn without requiring the full trajectory to complete. When used as a reward signal for fine-tuning, RSD reduces the variation in task progress from 132% to 91% on tau2-bench and from 90% to 44% on toolsandbox, while improving performance across benchmarks and model scales. Training with RSD as an additional reward signal matches supervised fine-tuning performance with substantially lower variance, without requiring ground-truth labels.

translation.title: 面向LLM智能体一致性的递归语义散度
translation.abstract: 使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在相同状态下独立运行时表现出不一致行为：调用不同工具、产生矛盾输出或采取分歧策略。这种变异性随时间累积，损害部署可靠性。现有评估指标主要通过任务完成度衡量正确性，无法刻画智能体跨执行的行为一致性；而对智能体行为的分析要么在token层面使用概率分布，要么在单响应层面使用语义聚类，均无法捕捉不一致性如何沿轨迹的未来轮次传播。我们提出递归语义散度（RSD），一种借鉴强化学习双模拟度量的无监督轨迹级一致性指标。RSD度量同一智能体从同一状态出发的两次独立rollout之间的期望累积语义分歧，利用自然语言推理检测逻辑不一致。它对未来状态递归定义，并通过在独立rollout上训练的神经网络近似。学习到的度量从当前状态估计未来分歧，在无需完整轨迹的情况下为每一轮提供一致性评分。作为微调的奖励信号时，RSD将tau2-bench上的任务进度波动从132%降至91%，toolsandbox上从90%降至44%，同时在各基准和模型规模上提升性能。以RSD作为额外奖励信号进行训练，在无需真实标签的情况下以显著更低的方差达到监督微调的性能。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体跨运行行为不一致且现有指标无法刻画的问题，提出借鉴双模拟度量的递归语义散度（RSD）作为轨迹级一致性指标和微调奖励信号。

papers.title: SLICE-Mem: Salience-Gated Lightweight Information Curation for Efficient LLM Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to maintain personalized and temporally coherent interactions, but repeated LLM inference for memory admission, extraction, and organization introduces substantial cost and latency. We present SLICE-Mem, a lightweight memory framework that combines salience-guided admission and predicate-centered information extraction. A compact classifier identifies user turns worth retaining, and a semantic-dependency-based extractor converts admitted turns into concise memory entries. This online pipeline requires no generative LLM calls, while cross-entry reconciliation is deferred to an offline consolidation stage. We evaluate SLICE-Mem on the weekly subset of Memora and LongMemEval-S using 8B and 30B Qwen backbones for memory construction and consolidation on both benchmarks. Compared with the generative-memory baseline MemOS under the Qwen3-30B configuration, SLICE-Mem's online pipeline achieves 46.60 versus 46.68 FAMA (Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy) on Memora Weekly and 56.8% versus 59.3% accuracy on LongMemEval-S, while reducing total LLM token consumption by 92.4% and 99.5%, respectively. These results demonstrate that SLICE-Mem can preserve useful evidence for long-term memory with substantially less reliance on LLM-based memory construction.

translation.title: SLICE-Mem：面向高效LLM智能体记忆的显著性门控轻量信息管理
translation.abstract: 长期记忆使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够保持个性化且时间连贯的交互，但记忆准入、提取和组织所需的重复LLM推理带来巨大成本和延迟。我们提出SLICE-Mem，一个结合显著性引导准入和以谓词为中心信息抽取的轻量记忆框架。一个紧凑的分类器识别值得保留的用户轮次，一个基于语义依存的抽取器将准入轮次转化为简洁的记忆条目。该在线流程无需生成式LLM调用，跨条目的协调则推迟到离线整合阶段。我们在Memora的weekly子集和LongMemEval-S上，使用8B和30B的Qwen骨干进行记忆构建与整合评估。在Qwen3-30B配置下与生成式记忆基线MemOS相比，SLICE-Mem的在线流程在Memora Weekly上取得46.60对46.68的FAMA（遗忘感知记忆准确率），在LongMemEval-S上取得56.8%对59.3%的准确率，同时分别将LLM总token消耗降低92.4%和99.5%。这些结果表明SLICE-Mem能以对LLM记忆构建的大幅减少依赖来保留长期记忆的有用证据。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体长期记忆构建中重复LLM推理成本高的问题，提出用紧凑分类器做显著性门控准入加语义依存抽取的免生成式LLM在线记忆流水线。

papers.title: Merge-Based Vocabulary Extension Stalls at the Pre-Tokenizer: An English-Preserving Repair for Nepali, Tested in Continued Pretraining
papers.abstract: Llama-3, Qwen3 and many other open LLMs pre-tokenize text with a regular expression whose word class admits only Unicode letters. Devanagari vowel signs are combining marks, so this regex splits Nepali words at every vowel sign, and models that use it spend 2.6 to 5.8 times as many tokens on Nepali as on the same English text. Merge-based vocabulary extension cannot join the split pieces: for Llama-3 and Qwen3 no number of new merges brings this premium below about 2.2, and ten released extensions already end within 4% of this pre-token floor. We give a small edit to the deployed regex that provably keeps every token id of text without combining marks or Devanagari characters. With 32,000 new merges it brings Nepali to 1.01 times English, about 54% fewer Nepali tokens than standard extension. In small-budget continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B, the original tokenizer gave the lowest held-out Nepali bits per byte under every recipe we tested. Matching the repair's training steps to standard extension, with about 35% of the data repeated, reversed their order on Qwen but not on Llama. Whether the token savings give a favourable latency and quality trade-off in generation remains untested. We release the tokenizers and code.

translation.title: 基于合并的词表扩展在预分词器处受阻：一种保留英文的天堡里语修复方案及持续预训练验证
translation.abstract: Llama-3、Qwen3及许多其他开源LLM使用正则表达式预分词文本，其词类仅接受Unicode字母。天城文元音符号是组合标记，因此该正则会在每个元音符号处切分尼泊尔语单词，使用该正则的模型在尼泊尔语文本上消耗的token是同等英文文本的2.6至5.8倍。基于合并的词表扩展无法将切分的片段合并：对Llama-3和Qwen3而言，无论新增多少合并都无法将该溢价降到约2.2以下，且十个已发布的扩展已落在该预分词下限的4%以内。我们对已部署的正则做了一个小修改，可证明地保留所有不含组合标记或天城文字符文本的每个token id。通过32,000个新合并，它将尼泊尔语降至英文的1.01倍，比标准扩展少约54%的尼泊尔语token。在对Llama-3.2-1B和Qwen3-0.6B的小预算持续预训练中，在我们测试的所有配方下，原始分词器给出的留出尼泊尔语bits per byte最低。将修复方案与标准扩展的训练步数对齐并重复约35%的数据后，在Qwen上逆转了两者排序，但在Llama上没有。token节省是否在生成中带来有利的延迟与质量权衡仍未验证。我们发布了分词器和代码。
translation.brief: 针对正则预分词器切分尼泊尔语单词导致token膨胀且合并式词表扩展无法修复的问题，提出对正则的小修改以保留英文token不变并大幅降低尼泊尔语token数。

papers.title: SUDO: From Scientific Publications to Global Scholarly Discourse
papers.abstract: Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) support literature search, scientific discovery, and agent-assisted research. Yet, most approaches to SKG construction pre-specify the knowledge unit to be represented, typically named scholarly entities or contribution-level statements, and retain only the publication content expressible through that unit. This choice produces two dominant yet distinct paradigms: concept-centric SKGs that preserve entities and local relations, and statement-centric SKGs that capture high-level discourse in sentences. In both cases, the graph reflects a chosen extraction target rather than how a paper constructs and communicates knowledge. We introduce SUDO, the Scholarly Upper Discourse Ontology, which defines how knowledge elements are organized and related to form a paper's research narrative, namely its scholarly discourse. Using linguistic principles that generalize across fields and tasks, SUDO enables each publication's scholarly discourse to be constructed from the bottom up as a coherent, source-grounded representation. Applied consistently across papers, the same structure connects their research narratives into a global scholarly discourse without discarding local context or provenance. We demonstrate SUDO's capabilities across a comprehensive suite of scholarly knowledge-modeling use cases and performance improvements on a downstream Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific QA task.

translation.title: SUDO：从科学出版物到全球学术话语
translation.abstract: 学术知识图谱（SKG）支持文献检索、科学发现和智能体辅助研究。然而，大多数SKG构建方法预先指定要表示的知识单元，通常是命名的学术实体或贡献级陈述，并仅保留能通过该单元表达的出版内容。这一选择产生了两种主流但不同的范式：保留实体和局部关系的概念中心SKG，以及以句子捕捉高层话语的陈述中心SKG。在这两种情况下，图谱反映的是选定的抽取目标，而非论文如何构建和传达知识。我们提出SUDO（学术上层话语本体），定义知识元素如何组织和关联以构成论文的研究叙事，即其学术话语。借助可跨领域和任务泛化的语言学原则，SUDO使每篇出版物的学术话语能够自底向上构建为连贯的、有源可溯的表示。跨论文一致应用时，同一结构将它们的研究叙事连接为全球学术话语，而不丢弃局部上下文或来源信息。我们通过一套全面的学术知识建模用例以及在基于大语言模型（LLM）的科学问答下游任务上的性能提升，展示了SUDO的能力。
translation.brief: 针对现有学术知识图谱按预指定知识单元抽取而丢失论文知识组织方式的问题，提出定义学术话语结构的上层本体SUDO，自底向上构建可跨论文连接的全球学术话语表示。

papers.title: A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract: Speaking-style captioning (SSC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of how speech is delivered, capturing paralinguistic attributes such as vocal timbre, prosody, and expressivity. Many downstream applications, including conversational AI agents, controllable speech generation, and large-scale audio annotation, require dimension-specific style captions that describe targeted aspects of speech (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style), rather than a single undifferentiated description. However, existing work lacks a unified formulation for controllable speaking-style captioning. We address this gap by formulating SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task, where explicit instructions specify the speaking-style dimensions to be described. We introduce StyleInstructCaps, the first standardized benchmark for controllable speaking-style captioning in audio-language models. StyleInstructCaps provides a dataset and evaluation framework that measures metadata groundedness, hallucination, instruction-following ability, generalization to unseen instructions and audio datasets, and speaker-style consistency. Across nine state-of-the-art audio-language models, we find that strong instruction-following ability does not necessarily imply grounded speaking-style understanding, and that SSC-specific instruction-diverse training substantially improves groundedness, controllability, and speaker consistency.

translation.title: 音频-语言模型中可控说话风格描述的基准测试
translation.abstract: 说话风格描述（SSC）旨在生成关于语音如何被表达的自然语言描述，捕捉音色、韵律和表现力等副语言属性。许多下游应用，包括对话式AI智能体、可控语音生成和大规模音频标注，都需要描述语音特定方面（如说话人特质、情感或表达风格）的维度特定风格描述，而非单一的无差别描述。然而，现有工作缺乏可控说话风格描述的统一形式化。我们通过将SSC形式化为一个指令跟随的音频-语言任务来填补这一空白，其中显式指令指定要描述的说话风格维度。我们提出StyleInstructCaps，这是首个针对音频-语言模型中可控说话风格描述的标准化基准。StyleInstructCaps提供了数据集和评估框架，衡量元数据依据性、幻觉、指令跟随能力、对未见指令和音频数据集的泛化能力以及说话人风格一致性。在九个最先进的音频-语言模型上，我们发现强大的指令跟随能力并不一定意味着有依据的说话风格理解，而SSC专用的指令多样化训练能显著提升依据性、可控性和说话人一致性。
translation.brief: 针对可控说话风格描述缺乏统一形式化的问题，提出将SSC形式化为指令跟随的音频-语言任务并构建首个标准化基准StyleInstructCaps。

papers.title: EviGround-CT: Sentence-to-Volume Grounding for Verifying LLM-Generated Chest CT Reports
papers.abstract: Chest computed tomography (CT) reports generated by large language models (LLMs) can describe positive findings that lack localized evidence in the scan. We propose EviGround-CT to verify these findings after report generation. A deterministic extractor identifies positive finding sentences, and a 3D grounding model predicts an evidence mask for each sentence. Using the full sentence retains anatomical location, laterality, and descriptive modifiers in the grounding query. We evaluate report generation on CT-RATE, and grounding and verification on a held-out 100-case ReXGroundingCT subset. Using the available annotations, sentence-grounded verification raises evidence-supported precision (ESP) from 0.263 to 0.365 across 137 extracted in-scope positives, compared with category conditioning. The corresponding unsupported positive finding rate falls from 0.737 to 0.635. The paired case-level bootstrap ESP difference is +0.102 (95% confidence interval: [0.028, 0.181]). The predicted masks associate individual report statements with spatial evidence that can be inspected alongside the CT.

translation.title: EviGround-CT：用于验证LLM生成胸部CT报告的句子到体积定位
translation.abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）生成的胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）报告可能描述在扫描中缺乏定位证据的阳性发现。我们提出EviGround-CT来在报告生成后验证这些发现。一个确定性提取器识别阳性发现句子，一个3D定位模型为每个句子预测证据掩码。使用完整句子可在定位查询中保留解剖位置、侧向性和描述性修饰语。我们在CT-RATE上评估报告生成，在一个留出的100例ReXGroundingCT子集上评估定位和验证。利用现有标注，在137个提取的范围内阳性发现上，句子级定位验证将证据支持精确率（ESP）从0.263提升至0.365，相比类别条件化方法。相应的不受支持的阳性发现率从0.737降至0.635。配对的病例级bootstrap ESP差异为+0.102（95%置信区间：[0.028, 0.181]）。预测的掩码将单个报告陈述与可 alongside CT 一起查看的空间证据相关联。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成的胸部CT报告中缺乏影像证据的阳性发现，提出用确定性提取器加3D定位模型对每个发现句子预测证据掩码进行验证。

papers.title: Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. Third, we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally, by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.

translation.title: 位置、角色还是标签？LLM智能体中指令冲突的受控研究
translation.abstract: LLM智能体接收来自操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果和保存记忆的指令，这些指令常常相互冲突。指令层级基准测试询问更高排名的来源是否获胜，但一个来源同时设定了位置、角色和标签。首先，我们构建了WhoWins，包含1,080个代码评分的场景，涵盖五种任务类型，每个场景最多有五条互斥指令，以及七个仅改变指令传递方式的受控实验。其次，我们研究了14个开放权重模型（0.6B至122B，思考模式开和关），共1,887,356条评分回复，并在留出场景上检验主要发现。在同一条消息内，两条冲突行中的第一条以72.42%至94.66%的比率获胜；跨消息时保持22.95%至62.65%。在system（或developer）消息中先发送的策略，在所有Qwen模型中都会输给后面的行，但在gpt-oss执行动作时大多获胜。在工具和文件写入任务中，它在所有模型-模式组合中的获胜率都低于同样的文本作为带标签的用户消息先发送的情况。第三，我们测试成对冲突能否预测更大的冲突；一旦知道任务行的位置，预测在所有模型-模式组合中都会改善。最后，根据我们的关键词模式，在已判定的成对回复中最多只有2.92%标记或回避了冲突。
translation.brief: 针对指令来源同时设定位置、角色和标签导致无法归因冲突行为的问题，构建WhoWins受控基准并系统实验分离各因素对LLM智能体指令冲突解决的影响。

papers.title: Hey, guess what: CUES lead to inferences about typicality
papers.abstract: Throughout life, we accumulate knowledge of how typical certain events are. We use this knowledge in daily conversation, often interpreting meaning beyond what has been said explicitly. In this work, we take steps to better understand this meaning recovery, investigating both atypicality and typicality inferences. First, we construct two corpora, EventTyp and the human-validated EventTypGold. We conduct large-scale human and LLM experiments and find that for humans, three CUES predict inferences about typicality: Commonsense Knowledge, Utterance Emphasis, and Snark. However, in most experimental settings, we find that LLMs lack the prerequisite Commonsense Knowledge necessary to accurately assess an event's general typicality, and therefore struggle to follow these CUES.

translation.title: 嘿，你猜怎么着：CUES引发关于典型性的推断
translation.abstract: 在一生中，我们积累关于某些事件有多典型的知识。我们在日常对话中使用这种知识，常常解读超出明确说出的内容的含义。在这项工作中，我们采取措施更好地理解这种含义恢复，同时研究非典型性和典型性推断。首先，我们构建了两个语料库，EventTyp和经人工验证的EventTypGold。我们进行了大规模的人类和LLM实验，发现对人类而言，三个CUES可预测关于典型性的推断：常识知识（Commonsense Knowledge）、话语强调（Utterance Emphasis）和讽刺（Snark）。然而，在大多数实验设置中，我们发现LLM缺乏准确评估事件一般典型性所需的常识知识，因此难以遵循这些CUES。
translation.brief: 针对会话中典型性含义推断机制不明的问题，构建EventTyp语料库并通过大规模人类与LLM实验识别出影响典型性推断的三个线索。

papers.title: Two Uncertainties Are Not One: Disagreement versus Decision-Risk in Cheap Structured Content Moderation
papers.abstract: Content moderation compresses a graded, contested human judgment into a binary act (leave up / take down) over billions of items, at a scale where running a frontier LLM on every post is uneconomical. A new class of frozen "System One" models returns typed, calibrated decisions instead of text at ~USD 0.000025 per call and ~100 ms. We run the first independent audit of one such model on 142,658 human-labeled comments, and benchmark it against 14 frontier reasoning models (the GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini 3, and Grok families) on a shared probe set. Two findings stand out. First, the cheap model is accuracy-competitive: its zero-shot classification AUROC (0.83) is not statistically separable (paired bootstrap, n=56; a failure to reject parity, not proof of equivalence) from 13 of the 14 frontier systems while costing 1-3 orders of magnitude less, and it is no worse calibrated than several of them. Second, "confidence" conflates two uncertainties that come apart: human disagreement (where annotators split on satire and coded language) and decision risk (where the automatic action is costly-wrong). Under an asymmetric moderation loss these call for opposite escalation signals, so no single confidence number serves both. Because the model prices extra questions at nearly zero, decomposing the judgment into parallel sub-questions and reading their spread recovers a human-disagreement signal that the model's native confidence misses -- but this remedy is specific: it helps the weakest, disagreement-blind models and only when the decomposition aligns with the sources of disagreement; a specialist toxicity model and the strongest LLMs do not need it, and the effect is distribution-sensitive. We will release the instrument, the cached runs, and the analysis.

translation.title: 两种不确定性并非一种：廉价结构化内容审核中的分歧与决策风险
translation.abstract: 内容审核将分级的、有争议的人类判断压缩为对数十亿条目的二元行为（保留/删除），其规模使得在每个帖子上运行前沿LLM都不经济。一类新的冻结的"System One"模型以每次调用约0.000025美元和约100毫秒的成本返回类型化、校准的决策而非文本。我们在142,658条人工标注的评论上对这样一个模型进行了首次独立审计，并在共享探测集上将其与14个前沿推理模型（GPT-5.x、Claude、Gemini 3和Grok系列）进行基准比较。有两个发现突出。首先，廉价模型在准确率上具有竞争力：其零样本分类AUROC（0.83）与14个前沿系统中的13个在统计上不可区分（配对bootstrap，n=56；这是未能拒绝等同性，而非等同性的证明），而成本低1-3个数量级，且其校准不逊于其中几个。其次，"置信度"混淆了两种会分离的不确定性：人类分歧（标注者在讽刺和隐语上意见分裂之处）和决策风险（自动行动代价高昂地出错之处）。在非对称审核损失下，这两者需要相反的升级信号，因此没有任何单一的置信度数字能同时服务两者。由于该模型对额外问题的定价几乎为零，将判断分解为并行子问题并读取其分布可以恢复模型原生置信度所遗漏的人类分歧信号——但这一补救是特定的：它只帮助最弱的、对分歧盲目的模型，且仅在分解与分歧来源对齐时有效；专门的毒性模型和最强的LLM不需要它，且该效应对分布敏感。我们将发布工具、缓存的运行结果和分析。
translation.brief: 针对廉价内容审核模型中置信度混淆人类分歧与决策风险两种不确定性的问题，通过将判断分解为并行子问题并读取其分布来恢复人类分歧信号。

papers.title: FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kinds of scenario. On AppWorld challenge tasks at 4k, it outperforms the second-best method by 11.5%, and on 147 unused tasks with predictions fixed in advance it outperforms A-Mem with a summary by 12.2%. On LongMemEval and LoCoMo, it matches a dedicated keyword retriever that writes no memory, while memories built on text written by an LLM fall far behind at tight budgets. Ablations show that the timeline carries AppWorld completion, whereas recovery mainly saves steps there and decides accuracy on exact facts. Code is available at https://github.com/WujiangXu/Flex-Amem

translation.title: FlexA-Mem：面向LLM Agent的预算自适应智能体记忆
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）agent工作在记忆需求差异极大的场景中。关于过去对话的问题需要它所指名的确切事实，而多步任务则需要已执行步骤的轨迹以及下一步无法指名的细节。现有记忆各自只针对一种场景设计和测试。A-Mem等检索式记忆会遗漏当前查询未表达的步骤，摘要会丢失确切字符串，而将两者配对则需预先固定预算的分配。我们提出FlexA-Mem，一种通用记忆：它将每段历史一次性写入不可变存储，并在每次调用时渲染出一份新记忆。渲染出的记忆是一份紧凑的时间线记录，加上由固定规则（无需LLM调用）填入剩余空间的细节。这些细节要么是作为原始文本或摘录的相关单元，要么是与查询最匹配的逐字片段。凭借单一存储，FlexA-Mem可同时服务两类场景。在4k预算的AppWorld挑战任务上，它比次优方法高出11.5%；在147个未使用且预测预先固定的任务上，它比A-Mem加摘要的组合高出12.2%。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上，它与不写记忆的专用关键词检索器相当，而在紧张预算下基于LLM生成文本构建的记忆则远远落后。消融实验表明，时间线支撑了AppWorld的任务完成，而细节恢复主要在该场景中节省步骤，并决定确切事实类问题的准确率。代码见 https://github.com/WujiangXu/Flex-Amem
translation.brief: 针对LLM agent在不同场景下记忆需求不同的问题，提出将历史一次性写入不可变存储、每次调用时按预算动态渲染记忆的FlexA-Mem方法。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance
papers.abstract: Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores. Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen's kappa. Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%). Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness.

translation.title: 药物警戒中个体病例安全报告的多智能体检索增强因果评估（MARCA）
translation.abstract: 引言：日益增多的个体病例安全报告（ICSR）给药物警戒中由专家主导的因果评估带来挑战。我们开发了MARCA（Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment），一个基于Naranjo量表评估的四智能体框架，并评估了其与人类专家的一致性，以及非RAG与RAG标注分数之间的探索性差异。方法：MARCA结合科学文献检索、药品说明书评估、客观证据分类和临床因果推理，使用Gemini 2.5 Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2。智能体生成的理由为人工辅助评分提供依据。共识专家参考标准涵盖来自FAERS（2025年Q1-Q2）的215份ICSR和1,562个药物-事件组合（DEC）。一致性用百分比一致性和Cohen's kappa衡量。结果：问题层面的一致性为：Naranjo Q2为96.8%（kappa = 0.491；95% CI 0.265-0.663），Q5为85.4%（kappa = 0.269；95% CI 0.180-0.340），Q10为96.8%（kappa = 0.922；95% CI 0.885-0.951）。最终因果分类一致性为79.4%（95% CI 71.8-85.3；kappa = 0.587，95% CI 0.450-0.690）。在60个DEC的回顾性子集中，RAG标注分数在Q5（83.3% vs 65.0%）和Q10（100.0% vs 18.3%）上的一致性高于非RAG分数。讨论：MARCA辅助评估在Naranjo各问题上的一致性差异较大，在替代原因方面一致性较低。回顾性RAG比较属探索性研究，不能确立前瞻性有效性。
translation.brief: 针对药物警戒中ICSR因果评估专家资源不足的问题，提出结合文献检索、说明书评估、证据分类和临床推理的四智能体RAG框架MARCA。

papers.title: Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.

translation.title: 蒸馏、辩论、发现：将多智能体研究构思扎根于图蒸馏洞见
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于支持研究想法生成和科学发现。多智能体辩论通过汇聚多元视角来共同发展研究想法，为该任务提供了一种协作方式。然而，一个关键挑战是如何为智能体赋予独特且有意义的专长以引导其贡献。受研究者们在协作中借鉴积累的研究经验的启发，我们提出InsightAgents，一个通过从相关论文的图中蒸馏洞见来构建扎根于文献的智能体专长的框架。在能够追溯研究方法演进、揭示潜在假设并识别未解决挑战的洞见引导下，智能体们共同确定一个研究问题，并通过辩论提出、质疑和改进潜在方案，最终形成研究提案。我们在100个NLP研究主题上，通过两个LLM裁判的成对比较，将InsightAgents与三个研究想法生成框架进行评估。在在线和离线两种知识设置下，InsightAgents在两位裁判下均在五个评估维度上取得最高平均分。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体研究构思中智能体缺乏独特专长的问题，提出从相关论文图中蒸馏洞见来构建各智能体文献专长的InsightAgents框架。

papers.title: How Does Post-Training Shape LLM Value Preferences?
papers.abstract: During post-training, large language models (LLMs) learn value preferences from corpora that may contain imbalanced proportions of opinions associated with different demographic groups. Amplifying these imbalances may further underrepresent some groups' opinions. However, how opinion mixtures shape value preferences across post-training paths remains unclear. To answer this question, we conduct controlled experiments using post-training corpora with different opinion mixtures and five post-training paths based on SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We find that post-training amplifies opinion imbalances differently across post-training paths. Once value preferences are amplified, whether further post-training can remove them depends on both the post-training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus. More concerningly, a model's stability under interventions depends on whether further post-training changes its value preference. Moreover, these value preferences are transferred to student models even when distillation uses corpora with no explicit opinion questions. These findings suggest that both the opinion mixture in post-training corpora and the choice of post-training method should be considered when developing, evaluating, and reusing LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ku-nlp/llm-value-preferences.

papers.title: Quantifying Meaning with SCAPE-T: Semantic Complexity from Encoder-Only Transformer Attention
papers.abstract: Automated semantic complexity estimation remains underexplored in NLP, despite important applications in linguistics and interpretability. This paper defines semantic complexity as the code length required to uniquely specify a text's semantic meaning, and operationalises it via SCAPE-T, an attention-derived metric based on encoder-only transformers. Existing measures either model reader effort (readability, lexical difficulty), which correlates with surface features (word length, syntax), or quantify surface features directly (type-token ratio, word frequency). SCAPE-T targets semantic integration directly by combining three submetrics: (i) inverse-weighted self-focus (token-to-self), (ii) CLS focus (token-to-CLS), and (iii) inter-head redundancy (cosine similarity across heads), using layer-weighted aggregation; data-driven learning is confined to hyperparameter tuning for calibration. Development uses philosophical prose vs. MCTest stories; evaluation is on children's stories vs. technical Wikipedia articles, with pairwise accuracy on contrasts as the primary criterion. Baselines include readability, syntactic/lexical, and LLM-derived measures. SCAPE-T substantially outperforms all tested baselines under word-length control, with a pairwise accuracy of 78.5% (95% bootstrap CI: 76.1-80.4, N=10k pairwise comparisons; +12.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline); without that control, readability heuristics overtake, consistent with their reliance on surface features. On a short-terms abstractness dataset, SCAPE-T also leads. Ablations show each submetric contributes materially. Overall, the results show SCAPE-T isolates conceptual structure from lexical/syntactic confounds better than existing methods, and generalises across two held-out domains.

translation.title: 用SCAPE-T量化意义：基于Encoder-Only Transformer注意力的语义复杂度
translation.abstract: 自动化语义复杂度估计在NLP中仍属探索不足，尽管它在语言学和可解释性中有重要应用。本文将语义复杂度定义为唯一指定文本语义含义所需的编码长度，并通过SCAPE-T将其操作化——这是一个基于encoder-only transformer、由注意力导出的指标。现有度量要么建模读者努力（可读性、词汇难度），与表层特征（词长、句法）相关，要么直接量化表层特征（类符-形符比、词频）。SCAPE-T通过组合三个子指标直接针对语义整合：（i）逆加权自我聚焦（token对自身）、（ii）CLS聚焦（token对CLS）、（iii）头间冗余（各头之间的余弦相似度），并采用层加权聚合；数据驱动的学习仅限于用于校准的超参数调优。开发使用哲学散文与MCTest故事；评估在儿童故事与技术类维基百科文章上进行，以对比的成对准确率为主要标准。基线包括可读性、句法/词汇和LLM导出的度量。在词长控制下，SCAPE-T大幅超越所有测试基线，成对准确率为78.5%（95% bootstrap CI：76.1-80.4，N=10k成对比较；比最强基线高12.7个百分点）；在没有该控制时，可读性启发式方法反超，这与它们依赖表层特征相一致。在一个短术语抽象度数据集上，SCAPE-T同样领先。消融实验表明每个子指标都有实质贡献。总体而言，结果表明SCAPE-T比现有方法更能将概念结构与词汇/句法混淆因素分离，并在两个留出域上具有泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对语义复杂度自动化估计缺失的问题，提出从encoder-only transformer注意力导出的三子指标聚合度量SCAPE-T。

papers.title: Adaptive Transfer of Representational Signatures for LLM Reliability Detection
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are reported to be susceptible to reliability issues including hallucinations and reasoning errors. Existing quality detectors can predict unreliable outputs based on internal representations with decent accuracies. However, training these detectors often requires substantial domain-specific labeled data, which limits their applicability to new domains. We propose to address this challenge by transferring representational signatures across related domains. More specifically, we build a statistical framework that first extracts low-dimensional signatures for each domain, then uses cross-fitting to learn composition weights of domain-specific predictors. The weights adapt to each source domain's predictive relevance to the target domain. Our asymptotic analysis of a least-squares analogue characterizes the limiting prediction risk and aggregation weights in terms of domain discrepancies and representation bias. Experiments across multiple hallucination datasets and open-weight LLMs show that, with only 25 labeled questions in the new domain, adaptive transfer improves hallucination-detection AUROC by 6.8%. For reasoning-step prediction, it improves AUROC by 8.4%.

translation.title: 面向LLM可靠性检测的表示签名自适应迁移
translation.abstract: 据报道，大语言模型（LLM）容易受到幻觉和推理错误等可靠性问题的影响。现有的质量检测器可以基于内部表示以不错的准确率预测不可靠输出。然而，训练这些检测器通常需要大量领域特定的标注数据，这限制了它们在新领域的适用性。我们提出通过在相关领域之间迁移表示签名来解决这一挑战。更具体地，我们构建了一个统计框架，首先为每个领域提取低维签名，然后使用交叉拟合来学习领域特定预测器的组合权重。这些权重会根据每个源领域对目标领域的预测相关性进行自适应调整。我们对最小二乘类似物的渐近分析，从领域差异和表示偏差的角度刻画了极限预测风险和聚合权重。在多个幻觉数据集和开源权重LLM上的实验表明，在新领域仅有25个标注问题的情况下，自适应迁移将幻觉检测AUROC提升了6.8%。对于推理步骤预测，它将AUROC提升了8.4%。
translation.brief: 解决质量检测器在新领域缺乏标注数据的问题，核心方法是通过统计框架跨领域迁移低维表示签名并自适应学习预测器组合权重。

papers.title: Propasafe-Hybrid: A Text-Based Hybrid Propaganda Detection Tool
papers.abstract: Propagandistic content increasingly circulates through online news and social media, where readers often encounter it with limited scrutiny, highlighting the need for reliable and fine-grained detection. This paper introduces Propasafe-Hybrid, a sentence-level system that integrates a fine-tuned transformer classifier with LLM-based technique classification to identify, label, and explain specific propaganda strategies. The pipeline generates actionable outputs, including highlighted sentences, technique assignments, and concise rationales, so users can immediately understand why a sentence was flagged and how each label was determined. To control inference cost, Propasafe-Hybrid employs a cost-aware pre-filtering stage that forwards only high-likelihood sentences to LLMs, reducing token usage while preserving the underlying decision logic. Together, these design choices enhance the explainability, efficiency, and practical usability of sentence-level propaganda detection in real-world news environments.

translation.title: Propasafe-Hybrid：一种基于文本的混合宣传检测工具
translation.abstract: 宣传性内容越来越多地通过在线新闻和社交媒体传播，读者往往在缺乏仔细审视的情况下接触到这些内容，这凸显了对可靠且细粒度检测的需求。本文介绍了Propasafe-Hybrid，一个句子级系统，它将微调的transformer分类器与基于LLM的技术分类相结合，以识别、标注并解释具体的宣传策略。该流水线生成可操作的输出，包括高亮句子、技术标签分配和简明理由，使用户能够立即理解某个句子为何被标记以及每个标签是如何确定的。为控制推理成本，Propasafe-Hybrid采用了成本感知的预过滤阶段，仅将高可能性句子转发给LLM，在保留底层决策逻辑的同时减少token使用量。这些设计选择共同增强了句子级宣传检测在真实新闻环境中的可解释性、效率和实用可用性。
translation.brief: 解决句子级宣传策略检测的可解释性与成本问题，核心方法是结合微调transformer分类器与LLM技术分类，并用成本感知预过滤降低推理开销。

papers.title: Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance
papers.abstract: We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student's held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. In the lowest observed-score quartile, however, boosting's error is 7.30 points, versus 8.07 for the median and 6.67 for the mean; Ridge has the lowest fitted-model error at 6.37 despite its worse overall error of 3.331. Scores concentrate near the ceiling: 160 students (91.4%) score above 90, and the lowest quartile contributes 62.1% of boosting's total absolute error. This retrospective comparison shows how baseline choice and error distribution affect predictive value, informing evaluation of student-support tools without establishing a learning effect.

translation.title: LLM辅导交互对学生成绩的增量预测价值
translation.abstract: 我们评估来自大语言模型辅导员的学期级交互特征是否能在常数基线之外改进作业分数预测。StudyChat提供了来自两个本科人工智能课程学期的16,851条学生-助教交互记录，其结果与203条学生-学期记录中的175条相匹配。六个拟合估计器与训练折均值和中位数基线共享重复嵌套交叉验证。在将每个学生的留出预测在十次重复上取平均后，Gradient Boosting达到3.023分绩点的平均绝对误差，而中位数基线为3.138。配对差异为-0.114，条件95% bootstrap区间为[-0.245,0.013]。表示变化和学期特定的中位数也带来类似的小幅提升。然而，在最低观测分数四分位中，boosting的误差为7.30分，中位数为8.07，均值为6.67；Ridge的拟合模型误差最低，为6.37，尽管其总体误差更差，为3.331。分数集中在接近满分处：160名学生（91.4%）得分超过90，最低四分位贡献了boosting总绝对误差的62.1%。这一回顾性比较展示了基线选择和误差分布如何影响预测价值，为评估学生支持工具提供了参考，但并未确立学习效果。
translation.brief: 研究LLM辅导交互特征能否改进学生作业分数预测，核心方法是用重复嵌套交叉验证比较多种估计器与常数基线的预测误差。

papers.title: Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants
papers.abstract: French users may omit apostrophes and diacritics or make keyboard typos in everyday input. The effects of these common variations on language model performance and prediction reliability remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we construct a controlled French surface-variant benchmark covering seven task types, with 4,200 original-low-high triplets (12,600 input instances). Each high-intensity variant retains all low-intensity edits and adds further changes. We evaluate six models from two LLM families.
