The results show that accuracy decreases and Brier score and negative log-likelihood (NLL) increase with perturbation intensity. Larger models show smaller accuracy losses under high intensity, but increases in Brier score and NLL do not consistently decrease with scale. Keyboard typos cause the largest losses in accuracy and the quality of predicted probabilities at the predefined high-intensity settings. Finally, calibration temperatures fitted on original inputs transfer effectively to surface variants. Combining calibration with input restoration further improves Brier score and NLL over either method alone while preserving restored accuracy. Our benchmark provides a unified framework for jointly evaluating task accuracy and prediction reliability under common French surface variations.

translation.title: 小改动，大变化：基于法语输入变体的LLM准确性与可靠性基准测试
translation.abstract: 法语用户在日常输入中可能省略撇号和变音符号，或产生键盘输入错误。这些常见变体对语言模型性能和预测可靠性的影响仍不够清楚。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个受控的法语表层变体基准，涵盖七种任务类型，包含4,200个原始-低强度-高强度三元组（12,600个输入实例）。每个高强度变体保留所有低强度编辑并添加进一步变化。我们评估了来自两个LLM家族的六个模型。结果表明，随着扰动强度增加，准确率下降，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）上升。较大的模型在高强度下表现出较小的准确率损失，但Brier分数和NLL的增加并不随规模一致下降。在预定义的高强度设置下，键盘输入错误导致准确率和预测概率质量的最大损失。最后，在原始输入上拟合的校准温度可以有效迁移到表层变体上。将校准与输入恢复相结合，比单独使用任一方法进一步改善了Brier分数和NLL，同时保持了恢复后的准确率。我们的基准为在常见法语表层变体下联合评估任务准确性和预测可靠性提供了统一框架。
translation.brief: 研究法语常见输入变体（省略符号、键盘错误等）对LLM准确性和预测可靠性的影响，核心方法是构建受控表层变体基准并结合校准与输入恢复进行评估。

papers.title: Towards a Learnable Retriever for Textual Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract: Textual graph question answering (GraphQA) and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) have gained increasing attention as a way to ground large language models (LLMs) on structured knowledge. Despite extensive efforts, existing methods still face two key gaps. The first is an architectural gap: existing methods typically fine-tune an LLM-based generator, but do not also make the retriever itself a learnable LLM for graph evidence selection within one end-to-end retrieve-then-generate pipeline. The second is a retrieval-supervision gap: existing retrievers rarely use gold answer signals to supervise evidence selection. As a result, they may fail to recall evidence nodes required for reasoning, resulting in insufficient coverage of the gold answer set; meanwhile, naive attempts to boost recall often introduce excessive irrelevant information that compromises compactness and overwhelms the LLM. To address these gaps, we propose TaLenT, an LLM-based end-to-end retriever-generator framework for textual GraphQA. To bridge the architectural gap, TaLenT pairs a learnable LLM-based retriever for evidence selection with a fine-tuned LLM-based generator within one unified retrieve-then-generate pipeline. To bridge the retrieval-supervision gap, we leverage gold answer signals as retriever supervision. Specifically, we stratify graph nodes into gold answers, answer-related nodes, and irrelevant noise. We then adopt a weighted pseudo-label loss to prioritize gold answers and preserve answer-related nodes for coverage, while discarding irrelevant noise for compactness. Experimental results across three GraphQA datasets demonstrate that TaLenT consistently improves downstream performance.

translation.title: 迈向面向文本图问答的可学习检索器
translation.abstract: 文本图问答（GraphQA）和基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）作为将大语言模型（LLM）建立在结构化知识上的方法，受到越来越多的关注。尽管已有大量努力，现有方法仍面临两个关键差距。第一个是架构差距：现有方法通常微调基于LLM的生成器，但并未在同一个端到端先检索后生成的流水线中让检索器本身也成为可学习的LLM来进行图证据选择。第二个是检索监督差距：现有检索器很少使用标准答案信号来监督证据选择。因此，它们可能无法召回推理所需的证据节点，导致对标准答案集合的覆盖不足；同时，提升召回率的朴素尝试往往会引入过多无关信息，损害紧凑性并使LLM不堪重负。为解决这些差距，我们提出了TaLenT，一个面向文本GraphQA的基于LLM的端到端检索器-生成器框架。为弥合架构差距，TaLenT在统一的先检索后生成流水线中，将用于证据选择的可学习LLM检索器与微调的LLM生成器配对。为弥合检索监督差距，我们利用标准答案信号作为检索器监督。具体而言，我们将图节点分层为标准答案、答案相关节点和无关噪声，然后采用加权伪标签损失来优先考虑标准答案并保留答案相关节点以保证覆盖，同时丢弃无关噪声以保持紧凑性。在三个GraphQA数据集上的实验结果表明，TaLenT持续改进了下游性能。
translation.brief: 解决文本图问答中检索器不可学习且缺乏答案信号监督的问题，核心方法是提出TaLenT框架，用LLM检索器配合基于标准答案的加权伪标签损失进行证据选择。

papers.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.

translation.title: Trajectory2Gym：面向工具使用智能体的基于决策的组合式交互合成
translation.abstract: 成功的工具使用轨迹未必是有用的监督信号。即使是成功的交互，也可能对多步依赖的表示不足，或包含在决策时无法由智能体可见信息所支持的动作。我们识别出有效轨迹监督的两个耦合要求：组合覆盖，即重要的观察-动作依赖得到表示；以及决策落地，即每个被监督的动作都由学习者可见的交互历史所支撑。我们提出 Trajectory2Gym，围绕支撑不足的组合结构构建可执行交互，并仅从其实际执行中已落地的决策中提取监督。结构支撑选择用于分配所得经验，而父节点归一化的监督微调以语义交互作为训练权重的单位。这将轨迹生成重新定义为对可学习交互经验的刻意构建，而非成功轨迹的收集。在五个 Qwen3 规模上，Trajectory2Gym 在所有测试规模上都提升了 Tau1、Tau2 和 BFCL 的表现，将等权三基准均值提高了 16.9-29.8 个百分点。增益在有状态和多轮交互中最为显著，即后续决策依赖先前观察和反馈的场景。我们的结果表明，扩展工具使用智能体不仅取决于收集更多成功轨迹，还取决于构建依赖得到表示、决策可从智能体可见历史中学习的交互。
translation.brief: 针对成功轨迹监督中组合依赖表示不足和决策缺乏依据的问题，提出通过构建可执行交互并仅从落地决策中提取监督来生成训练数据的方法。

papers.title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
papers.abstract: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.

translation.title: 言语是心灵之声：基于心理引导证据推理的社交痕迹抑郁严重程度估计
translation.abstract: 抑郁严重程度估计对心理健康评估和干预至关重要，但传统方法依赖于需要用户主动参与的临床访谈或自评问卷。随着在线社交媒体的广泛使用，用户留下了可能反映其心理状态的丰富社交痕迹，这催生了基于社交媒体的抑郁严重程度估计任务。现有工作已从基于文本特征的分类发展到基于 LLM 对标准化量表条目进行问卷填写，但在用户特定心理先验建模、多样化语义检索以及对心理证据的细粒度推理方面仍有不足。为解决这些局限，我们提出 UMer，一个基于社交痕迹进行抑郁严重程度估计的用户特定心理证据推理框架。UMer 首先从历史社交痕迹中提炼用户特定的心理先验，以捕捉用户的心理倾向、行为模式和自我表达风格。然后执行量表引导的多查询检索，从与条目相关的帖子中构建证据记忆。最后进行由粗到细的证据感知推理，区分直接和间接证据，并以可解释的理由预测条目级分数。在真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，UMer 不仅取得了优于现有基线的竞争性表现，还提供了基于证据的可解释性，并能泛化到其他基于量表的任务。
translation.brief: 针对社交媒体抑郁严重程度估计中缺乏用户心理先验建模和细粒度证据推理的问题，提出从历史痕迹提炼心理先验并进行由粗到细证据推理的 UMer 框架。

papers.title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
papers.abstract: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. Its human-preference rating is also close to NVIDIA Instruct after statistical adjustment for answer length and formatting. In Stage 2, each agent receives the comparison records and votes involving its Stage 1 model and is given three additional days for further training. Using NVIDIA Instruct as a common reference across the two evaluation rounds, we observe an improvement from Stage 1 to Stage 2 in the style-adjusted relative rating of eight of the ten models. We show that benchmark gains were modest, with no clear link to preference gains, while some agents encouraged longer responses and one model showed increased harmful compliance on StrongREJECT. RSI Arena provides an auditable setting for studying how human feedback can guide autonomous model development. It takes a step toward recursive self-improvement with human feedback (RSIHF), in which people help define what improvement means for the AI systems they use.

translation.title: RSI Arena：迈向带有人类反馈的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: AI 智能体能否自主训练有用的语言模型，并利用用户反馈对其进行改进？我们提出 RSI Arena，一项关于自主后训练的两阶段研究，作为迈向递归自我改进的一步。十个前沿模型作为训练智能体，每个都从 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base 出发。在为期六天的第一阶段中，每个智能体拥有 1,000 GPU 小时和 300 美元 API 额度，在共享的 64-GPU 集群上独立选择数据、实现训练流程并选择检查点。我们在 20 个基准上并通过盲测人类评估来评价它们的模型。所有十个智能体都产出了可用的助手，其中最强的模型由 GPT-6 Astra 训练，在 12 个能力基准上平均弥合了基座到 Instruct 差距的 76%（中位数）。在统计调整回答长度和格式后，其人类偏好评分也接近 NVIDIA Instruct。在第二阶段，每个智能体收到涉及其第一阶段模型的比较记录和投票，并获得额外三天时间进行进一步训练。以 NVIDIA Instruct 作为两轮评估的共同参照，我们观察到十个模型中有八个的风格调整相对评分从第一阶段到第二阶段有所提升。我们表明基准提升有限，且与偏好提升没有明确关联，而一些智能体鼓励了更长的回答，一个模型在 StrongREJECT 上表现出更高的有害顺从性。RSI Arena 为研究人类反馈如何引导自主模型开发提供了一个可审计的环境。它向带有人类反馈的递归自我改进（RSIHF）迈出了一步，即由人们帮助定义改进对其所使用的 AI 系统意味着什么。
translation.brief: 研究 AI 智能体能否自主进行模型后训练并利用人类反馈持续改进，通过两阶段竞技场实验让十个前沿模型作为训练智能体自主训练语言模型。

papers.title: Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.

translation.title: LLM 介导的 ADHD 自我诊断中的性别关联
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于医疗自我诊断。然而，人口统计线索如何塑造这些交互中的输出仍知之甚少。这对 ADHD 等诊断尤为关键，因为其持续的性别差异与临床证据并不完全一致。我们改编了语境关联测试（CAT），以评估 GPT-4o 在零样本自我诊断设置中是否会对性别化的 ADHD 关联做出反应。我们表明，显式提示会持续放大某些 ADHD 亚型关联，而隐式提示则产生接近代理对齐的分布。这些分歧表明，显式的人口统计线索可能激活了偏差缓解机制，导致过度纠正而非消除偏差，而隐式线索似乎反映了模型的默认行为。我们的结果表明，评估 LLM 介导的自我诊断中的性别偏差，需要仔细关注模型所编码的人口统计关联。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 在 ADHD 自我诊断中是否受性别线索影响，通过改编语境关联测试（CAT）对比显式与隐式性别提示下的输出差异。

papers.title: Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators
papers.abstract: LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. Although evaluator design exposes a large combinatorial space, several discovered design principles transfer consistently across annotation protocols and language pairs. We synthesize these findings into ORBIT, a family of LLM-based MT evaluators. Our strongest configurations achieve expert-level performance in error span detection and in Accuracy and Fluency ranking at roughly 20x lower cost than expert human annotation.

translation.title: 超越提示：基于 LLM 的机器翻译评估器系统研究
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的评估器已迅速成为机器翻译评估的标准工具，但塑造其行为的设计选择仍知之甚少。我们系统研究了指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型选择和多步工作流如何影响片段级和排序式 MT 评估。我们在 WMT24 和 WMT25 英俄翻译上收集了新的专家 RATE 标注，并在另外五个语言对的 MQM 和 ESA 标注基准上进行迁移验证。我们的实验揭示了四个稳健发现：指令结构塑造评估器行为，高质量示例比数量更重要，前沿骨干模型展现出不同的评估器特征（召回导向、精确导向或排序导向），跨多样化骨干融合输出优于单评估器多次调用设置。尽管评估器设计暴露出巨大的组合空间，但若干发现的设计原则在不同标注协议和语言对之间保持一致的可迁移性。我们将这些发现综合为 ORBIT，一个基于 LLM 的 MT 评估器家族。我们最强的配置在错误片段检测以及准确性和流利度排序上达到专家级表现，成本约为专家人工标注的 1/20。
translation.brief: 系统研究指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型和多步工作流对 LLM 机器翻译评估器的影响，并据此构建 ORBIT 评估器家族。

papers.title: StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.abstract: Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. StateWise fine-tunes the LLM on two complementary skills, summarizing a dialogue into its constraint state and responding conditioned on that state, then self-trains on its own trajectories, keeping only turns that pass an exact round-trip check against the compiled state. This teaches 7-8B models to track the state almost perfectly but, surprisingly, not to obey it: on Llama-3.1-8B every supervised variant roughly doubles relapse. We therefore add a preference stage on self-generated relapse contrasts, where the rejected response enacts a revoked rule and the chosen one passes the round-trip check. On two backbones with held-out constraint families and unseen phrasings, StateWise cuts relapse by 8-22 points relative to supervised self-training, lifts conversation success by 8-19 points over the backbone, and beats an oracle compiled-ledger baseline on relapse with no inference-time scaffolding. We also characterize the recipe's cost on general instruction-following benchmarks and study weight interpolation as a mitigation.

translation.title: StateWise：教语言模型在多轮对话中追踪并遵守不断演变的约束
translation.abstract: 对话助手的用户很少一开始就说出所有需求：他们会添加约束、修改、撤回、跑题再返回。指令微调的 LLM 在这方面存在两类失败：随着轮次累积，活跃约束不再被遵守（持续性失败），以及已撤回的约束仍被继续执行（复发）。据我们所知，现有的唯一修复方法是使用外部账本，在每一轮重新注入编译后的规范。我们提出 StateWise，一种自我改进的方法，教单个 LLM 维护自己可修订的约束状态——一种带有墓碑标记（tombstone）以记录已撤销约束的类型化状态——从而可以通过可执行检查器来度量持续性和复发，并免费编译出真值状态。StateWise 在两项互补技能上微调 LLM：将对话总结为约束状态，以及基于该状态进行响应，然后在其自身轨迹上进行自我训练，只保留通过针对编译状态的精确往返检查的轮次。这使 7-8B 模型几乎完美地追踪状态，但令人惊讶的是，并不能遵守状态：在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，每个监督变体大约使复发翻倍。因此，我们在自我生成的复发对比上添加偏好阶段，其中被拒绝的响应执行了已撤销的规则，而被选中的响应通过往返检查。在两个骨干模型上，针对留出的约束族和未见过的表述，StateWise 相比监督式自我训练将复发降低了 8-22 个百分点，相比骨干模型将对话成功率提升了 8-19 个百分点，并且在复发方面击败了 oracle 编译账本基线，且无需推理时脚手架。我们还刻画了该配方在通用指令遵循基准上的代价，并研究了权重插值作为一种缓解手段。
translation.brief: 解决多轮对话中 LLM 无法持续遵守约束和错误恢复已撤回约束的问题，核心方法是让模型自我维护带墓碑的类型化约束状态，并通过往返检查与复发对比偏好训练实现自我改进。

papers.title: TriageRAG: Failure-Aware Self-Training for Adapting Retrieval-Augmented Language Models to Specialized Domains
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive questions from retrieved evidence, but adapting a general-purpose RAG system to a specialized domain such as medicine is difficult when only an unlabeled corpus is available. Self-training approaches such as SimRAG address this by letting the LLM write its own question-answer pairs from domain passages and fine-tuning on the pairs that survive a round-trip consistency filter. We observe that these approaches treat every retained example identically: they never ask whether the student already knows the answer, already extracts it correctly from the retrieved context, or fails - and if so, whether the failure lies with the reader or with the retriever. To tackle this, we propose TriageRAG, a failure-aware self-training approach that probes the student on each self-generated question with and without retrieved context, triages it into one of four categories (known, solved, context-failure, retrieval-failure), and routes each category to the training signal that addresses it, including a parametric route that teaches the reader to answer when retrieval misses. Probing is cheap and repeated every round, so the training mixture follows the student, and the triage histogram doubles as a label-free diagnostic of where the domain gap lies. Experiments on 11 datasets spanning three domains with a Qwen3-4B backbone, and on CS-Bench with Qwen3-8B, demonstrate that TriageRAG outperforms a budget-matched SimRAG by 1.2-6.4 points and is the only method that recovers the closed-book level in every case where retrieval hurts the base model. A single ablation identifies the mechanism: round-trip filtering removes every training context that lacks the evidence, and a reader that never sees such contexts learns to over-trust noisy retrieval.

translation.title: TriageRAG：面向专用领域检索增强语言模型适配的失败感知自我训练
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）使大语言模型（LLM）能够基于检索到的证据回答知识密集型问题，但在仅有无标注语料可用时，将通用 RAG 系统适配到医学等专用领域非常困难。SimRAG 等自我训练方法通过让 LLM 从领域段落中自行编写问答对，并在通过往返一致性过滤的问答对上进行微调来解决这一问题。我们观察到，这些方法对所有保留的示例一视同仁：它们从不询问学生模型是否已经知道答案、是否已经能从检索到的上下文中正确提取答案、或者是否失败——如果失败，失败是出在阅读器还是检索器上。为解决此问题，我们提出 TriageRAG，一种失败感知的自我训练方法，它在有和没有检索上下文的情况下用每个自我生成的问题探测学生模型，将其归入四个类别之一（已知、已解决、上下文失败、检索失败），并将每个类别路由到相应的训练信号，包括一个参数化路径，教阅读器在检索未命中时也能回答。探测成本低且每轮重复进行，因此训练混合随学生模型而变化，且分类直方图可作为领域差距所在的无标注诊断。在三个领域的 11 个数据集上使用 Qwen3-4B 骨干模型，以及在 CS-Bench 上使用 Qwen3-8B 的实验表明，TriageRAG 超出预算匹配的 SimRAG 1.2-6.4 个百分点，并且是唯一在检索损害基础模型的每种情况下都能恢复闭卷水平的方法。单一消融实验揭示了机制：往返过滤移除了所有缺乏证据的训练上下文，而从未见过此类上下文的阅读器学会了过度信任有噪声的检索。
translation.brief: 解决仅有无标注语料时将 RAG 适配到专用领域的问题，核心方法是通过有/无检索上下文的探测对学生模型进行失败分类，并按类别路由差异化训练信号。

papers.title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. To focus generation on the Solver's learning frontier, we derive a Goldilocks reward for the QA Generator from the Solver's group-wise rollout success rate: questions solved by all rollouts or by none receive zero reward, whereas questions near the current frontier are favored. We optimize the two policies independently with GRPO, without sharing parameters or gradients. Across six multimodal deep-search benchmarks, MTA-Zero improves a Qwen3-VL-8B Solver from 36.91% to 51.58% mean accuracy and achieves performance comparable to GPT-5 under the same agent workflow. The same framework also improves a newer Qwen3.6-27B Solver by 10.82 points. These results show that verified online question generation provides a policy-specific curriculum for continually improving multimodal deep-search agents.

translation.title: MTA-Zero：通过在线 QA-Solver 共同训练实现自我改进的多模态深度搜索
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已成为强大的视觉推理器，但在需要图像定位、工具选择和整合网络证据的开放世界多步搜索方面仍然受限。现有方法通常构建和过滤固定的离线语料库，其问题分布无法随着目标深度搜索智能体的改进而适应。基于 MTA-Agent 的图像定位 QA 构建，我们提出 MTA-Zero，一个用于自我改进多模态深度搜索智能体的在线多模态 QA-Solver 共同训练框架，无需预计算的多跳语料库。从图像定位的 VQA 种子上下文开始，可训练的 QA 生成器在线检索证据并构建经过验证的多跳问题。然后，一个独立的深度搜索 Solver 选择工具、收集证据并回答生成的问题。为了将生成聚焦于 Solver 的学习前沿，我们从 Solver 的组级 rollout 成功率为 QA 生成器推导出一个 Goldilocks 奖励：所有 rollout 都解决或都未解决的问题获得零奖励，而接近当前前沿的问题受到青睐。我们使用 GRPO 独立优化两个策略，不共享参数或梯度。在六个多模态深度搜索基准上，MTA-Zero 将 Qwen3-VL-8B Solver 的平均准确率从 36.91% 提高到 51.58%，并在相同智能体工作流下达到与 GPT-5 相当的性能。同一框架还将较新的 Qwen3.6-27B Solver 提升了 10.82 个百分点。这些结果表明，经过验证的在线问题生成为持续改进多模态深度搜索智能体提供了特定于策略的课程。
translation.brief: 解决多模态深度搜索智能体自我改进缺乏自适应训练问题分布的问题，核心方法是让 QA 生成器在线构建经验证的多跳问题，并基于 Solver 组级成功率设计 Goldilocks 奖励进行 GRPO 共同训练。

papers.title: IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent
papers.abstract: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.

translation.title: IntentDelta：一个面向演变用户意图的人工构建基准
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体必须随着用户在复杂任务中修改需求和优先级而进行适应。我们提出 IntentDelta，一个人工构建的多轮基准，包含跨 WebShop 和 TravelPlanner 的 638 条轨迹和 3,766 轮。每一轮将用户话语与累积意图状态和人工参考动作配对。这些轨迹经过交叉验证，涵盖了由可行性和偏好驱动的约束与优先级变化。我们在意图恢复和动作质量方面评估了十一个智能体。TravelPlanner 中的平均意图恢复率为 33.1%，WebShop 中为 44.7%，而平均动作得分分别为 31.6% 和 41.0%。智能体难以保留较早的需求，也难以区分软偏好与必须满足的约束。正确的意图恢复也不能保证成功执行，这凸显了将演变的用户意图转化为动作的挑战。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏评估智能体应对演变用户意图能力基准的问题，核心方法是人工构建包含累积意图状态与参考动作的多轮轨迹基准并系统评测。

papers.title: EdgeDeID: A 0.6B Clinical De-identifier Trained Without Real Patient Data
papers.abstract: De-identifying clinical notes with a hosted language model discloses the information the step is meant to protect. We present EdgeDeID, a 0.6B-parameter decoder-only de-identifier that runs locally and is trained without real patient text: three LLM teachers write synthetic notes, a single labeler re-annotates them into one convention, and the model learns to emit a typed XML schema of the identifiers it finds. On a 100-note synthetic in-domain benchmark with manually verified annotations it reaches 0.994 micro-F1 and leaves no missed identifier in 99% of notes, against 0.857 and 12% for the strongest of eight off-the-shelf systems. Quantized, it runs on CPU in 615 MB. Of three additions to supervised training, only a verifier adapter helps: it separates complete from incomplete outputs of other systems at 0.94 AUROC, whereas reinforcement learning with a recall-weighted reward and a rule-based post-processing layer leave in-domain results unchanged. On MIMIC ICU nursing notes F1 falls to 0.48. The errors follow two properties our synthetic notes lack, telegraphic style and low identifier density, and three hand-written in-context examples recover 0.08 F1 without annotated target data.

translation.title: EdgeDeID：一个无需真实患者数据训练的 0.6B 临床去标识化模型
translation.abstract: 使用托管语言模型对临床笔记进行去标识化会泄露该步骤本应保护的信息。我们提出 EdgeDeID，一个 0.6B 参数的仅解码器去标识化模型，可在本地运行，且训练时无需真实患者文本：三个 LLM 教师编写合成笔记，一个标注器将其重新标注为统一规范，模型学习输出其识别到的标识符的类型化 XML 模式。在一个包含 100 条合成领域内笔记、人工验证标注的基准上，它达到 0.994 的 micro-F1，并在 99% 的笔记中不留任何遗漏的标识符，而八个现成系统中最强者的对应数字为 0.857 和 12%。量化后，它可在 615 MB 内存下的 CPU 上运行。在对监督训练的三项补充中，只有验证器适配器有帮助：它以 0.94 的 AUROC 区分其他系统的完整与不完整输出，而采用召回加权奖励的强化学习和基于规则的后处理层则未改变领域内结果。在 MIMIC ICU 护理笔记上，F1 降至 0.48。这些错误遵循我们的合成笔记所缺乏的两个特性——电报式风格和低标识符密度——而三个手写的上下文示例在不使用标注目标数据的情况下恢复了 0.08 的 F1。
translation.brief: 解决临床笔记去标识化不能使用真实患者数据且需本地部署的问题，核心方法是用多个 LLM 教师生成合成笔记并统一标注，训练小型本地模型输出类型化 XML 标识符模式。

papers.title: When Personas Become Harmful: Guiding LLMs with Global Citizenship Values Alignment
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly being used by users from diverse demographics with pluralistic values and distinct backgrounds. Maintaining safety while respecting value-laden personas is uniquely challenging because persona-conditioned requests are often not overtly malicious, unlike those in existing safety benchmarks. Alignment methods aimed at adversarial requests therefore may miss the harm that emerges from persona use, leaving models to either refuse legitimate value expression or blindly follow unsafe personas. We construct a dataset of 11k controversial topics paired with value-based personas mapping to value dimensions from the Schwartz Value Survey. Through an agentic pipeline that iteratively refines the topic and persona, we surface and collect harmful responses from well-aligned commercial LLMs with a more than 47% success rate. We use UNESCO's global citizenship principles as a minimal common ground for distinguishing valid value expressions from harmful behaviors, and introduce a controllable alignment model that lets users balance persona adherence and safety at inference time. The resulting model is safer and more persona-adherent than baselines on most samples.

translation.title: 当人格设定变得有害：基于全球公民价值观对齐引导大语言模型
translation.abstract: LLM 正被来自不同人口群体、具有多元价值观和不同背景的用户日益广泛地使用。在尊重带有价值取向的人格设定的同时保持安全性是一个独特的挑战，因为基于人格设定的请求通常不像现有安全基准中的请求那样具有明显的恶意。因此，针对对抗性请求的对齐方法可能无法捕捉到人格设定使用所产生的危害，导致模型要么拒绝合法的价值表达，要么盲目遵循不安全的人格设定。我们构建了一个包含 11k 个争议话题的数据集，并配以映射到 Schwartz Value Survey 价值维度的基于价值的人格设定。通过一个迭代优化话题和人格设定的 agentic pipeline，我们从对齐良好的商业 LLM 中以超过 47% 的成功率诱导并收集到有害响应。我们以 UNESCO 的全球公民原则作为区分有效价值表达与有害行为的最小共识，并引入一个可控对齐模型，让用户在推理时平衡人格遵循与安全性。所得模型在大多数样本上比基线更安全且更遵循人格设定。
translation.brief: 针对人格设定请求引发的安全危害问题，构建基于 Schwartz 价值维度的人格-话题数据集，并以 UNESCO 全球公民原则为最小共识训练可控对齐模型，在推理时平衡人格遵循与安全性。

papers.title: What Makes a Question Curious? Measuring Model Curiosity in Human-LLM Interactions
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as partners in everyday communication. In these interactions, useful assistance may require not only answering, but also asking the right questions that surface knowledge gaps, assumptions, and alternatives. In this study, we refer to such epistemic question-asking as model curiosity, and introduce a theory-grounded taxonomy that distinguishes curiosity-oriented questions from generic model questioning. Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.

translation.title: 什么让问题充满好奇？衡量人机交互中的模型好奇心
translation.abstract: 大语言模型日益成为日常交流中的伙伴。在这些交互中，有用的辅助不仅需要回答问题，还需要提出恰当的问题，以揭示知识空白、假设和替代方案。在本研究中，我们将这种认知性的提问称为模型好奇心（model curiosity），并引入一个有理论依据的分类体系，将好奇心导向的问题与一般性模型提问区分开来。在四个对话数据集上，我们发现好奇心导向的问题仍然稀少（占所有问题的 17-28%），但与更具探索性和认知上更丰富的后续用户回复相关，且在不同数据集上呈现不同的模式。我们进一步开展人类研究以评估模型好奇心的有用性，发现好奇心可以鼓励探索，尤其是在建议、创意和研究场景中。这些发现对构建更具选择性地提问、以支持更深入探索和人机协作的 LLM 具有启示意义。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 提问质量缺乏刻画的问题，提出基于理论的模型好奇心分类体系，并在多个对话数据集和人类研究中分析好奇心导向提问对用户探索行为的影响。

papers.title: Beyond Belief: Evaluating and Mitigating LLM Susceptibility to Misinformation
papers.abstract: Tool-using large language models (LLMs) must decide whether external information warrants action. We investigate whether their expressed credibility judgments reliably indicate behavioral resistance to misinformation. We evaluate five LLMs on 196 constructed false notices paired with legitimate counterparts and 204 archived attacks adapted to simulated tool use. When asked to act on the constructed notices, models issue harmful tool calls in 27%--99% of cases they have rated untrustworthy. Removing the preliminary rating step increases harmful execution by 15 percentage points on average, showing that credibility elicitation itself changes the behavior being evaluated. Interventions that improve credibility discrimination do not consistently yield safer actions. A simple forewarning significantly reduces harmful execution in four of five models, but neither tested generated-example prebunk outperforms it in the main evaluation. These reductions can also compromise legitimate task completion. Supervised fine-tuning on generated false notices reduces harmful execution on held-out archived attacks under the rating-first protocol, with model-dependent utility costs and weaker protection without rating elicitation. Our findings motivate evaluating misinformation defenses through both harmful actions and legitimate task completion, while accounting for the behavioral effects of the evaluation protocol.

translation.title: 超越信念：评估与缓解 LLM 对错误信息的易感性
translation.abstract: 使用工具的大语言模型（LLM）必须判断外部信息是否值得采取行动。我们研究其表达的可信度判断是否能可靠地反映其对错误信息的行为抵抗。我们在 196 条构造的虚假通知（配有合法对照）以及 204 条改编自存档攻击、适配模拟工具使用的攻击上评估了五个 LLM。当被要求对构造的通知采取行动时，模型在其已评为不可信的案例中有 27%–99% 发出了有害的工具调用。移除初步评级步骤平均使有害执行增加 15 个百分点，表明可信度引导本身会改变被评估的行为。提升可信度辨别能力的干预措施并不总能带来更安全的行为。一个简单的预先警告在五个模型中的四个上显著减少了有害执行，但在主评估中，两种测试的生成示例预辟谣方法均未超越它。这些减少也可能损害合法任务的完成。在生成的虚假通知上进行监督微调，在评级优先协议下减少了在留出存档攻击上的有害执行，但效用代价因模型而异，且在没有评级引导时保护较弱。我们的发现表明，应通过有害行为和合法任务完成两方面评估错误信息防御，同时考虑评估协议的行为效应。
translation.brief: 针对工具使用型 LLM 易执行错误信息的问题，通过构造虚假通知和存档攻击系统评估其可信度判断与实际行为的不一致，并测试预警告、预辟谣和微调等干预措施的效果。

papers.title: "High-Quality" Data for Early-Stage Instruction Tuning: An Empirical Study of Data Quality Metrics
papers.abstract: "Data quality" is widely invoked in instruction tuning, but the term is often underspecified. We study it as an operational property by asking which simple example-level metrics, drawn from prior work on data selection, text quality, and instruction tuning, best predict training utility under a fixed finetuning budget. For each metric, we sort instruction-response examples by score, partition them into low, middle, and high bins with roughly equal token mass, finetune separately on each bin, and compare validation perplexity and LLM-as-judge scores for the models' generated answers as a function of cumulative training tokens. Our results suggest that answer-dense supervision, as captured by response ratio, is a stronger and more portable predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative proxies.

translation.title: 早期指令微调的"高质量"数据：数据质量指标的实证研究
translation.abstract: "数据质量"在指令微调中被广泛提及，但这一术语往往缺乏明确界定。我们将其作为一种可操作的性质来研究：在固定微调预算下，哪些来自数据选择、文本质量和指令微调等先前工作的简单样本级指标最能预测训练效用。对于每个指标，我们按分数对指令-回复样本排序，将其划分为 token 量大致相等的低、中、高三档，分别在各档上微调，并比较各模型生成答案的验证困惑度和 LLM-as-judge 分数随累计训练 token 数的变化。我们的结果表明，以回复比例（response ratio）刻画的答案密集型监督，比常用的替代代理指标是更强、更可迁移的指令微调效用预测因子。
translation.brief: 针对"数据质量"定义模糊的问题，实证比较多种样本级质量指标对指令微调效用的预测能力，发现回复比例是最强且最可迁移的预测因子。

papers.title: Reversible Pseudonymisation of Documents Sent to External LLMs: an Open Bilingual Benchmark and an Engine
papers.abstract: Professionals send working documents to external large language models. A common safeguard is reversible pseudonymisation: personal data are replaced with placeholders before the request and restored locally in the answer. We present an open benchmark of five existing open tools and a regular-expression baseline on Russian and UK English, and an open engine built on the two strongest tools. The benchmark excludes each tool's own authors' dataset from its verdict, compares the engine with each tool on identical datasets for detection, reports masking precision, and tests on a held-out set of synthetic documents whose files, hashes, decision rules, run plan and stopping rule were published before any run. Two local LLMs test whether placeholders survive. All evaluation data are synthetic, and the benchmark was run by the author of the engine; code, data, predictions and raw answers are released. On external datasets no existing tool meets all predefined thresholds: in UK English the identifier and leak thresholds are not met, in Russian the identifier threshold is borderline. On the last held-out set of 1,000 documents per language, the best existing tools leave a whole value visible in 61% (Russian) and 58% (UK) of documents. On these documents, from the generator it was developed on, the engine does so in 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] and 0.2% [0.1; 0.7], leaves any part of a value visible in 0.8% and 0.2%, and meets all detection thresholds in both languages. In UK English it also restores at least 99% of its placeholders after 760 answers. In Russian it restores only 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] of name placeholders, against a 99% threshold, mainly because the inflection it borrows from pii-guard produces wrong surname forms. The engine was developed over six earlier held-out sets from the same generator; real documents were not tested.

translation.title: 发送至外部 LLM 的文档可逆假名化：开放双语基准与引擎
translation.abstract: 专业人士会将工作文档发送给外部大语言模型。一种常见的保护措施是可逆假名化：在请求前将个人数据替换为占位符，并在本地于答案中还原。我们提出了一个开放基准，涵盖五个现有开源工具和一个正则表达式基线，测试语言为俄语和英式英语，并提出了一个基于其中两个最强工具构建的开放引擎。该基准在评判时排除各工具自身作者的数据集，在相同数据集上将引擎与各工具进行检测比较，报告掩码精确率，并在一个留出的合成文档集上测试，其文件、哈希、决策规则、运行计划和停止规则均在任何运行之前发布。两个本地 LLM 用于测试占位符能否存活。所有评估数据均为合成数据，且基准由引擎作者运行；代码、数据、预测和原始答案均已发布。在外部数据集上，没有任何现有工具满足所有预定义阈值：在英式英语中未达到标识符和泄漏阈值，在俄语中标识符阈值处于边缘。在最后一个每种语言 1,000 篇文档的留出集上，最好的现有工具在 61%（俄语）和 58%（英式英语）的文档中留下完整可见的值。在这些文档上，对于其开发所用的生成器，引擎分别仅在 0.3% [0.1; 0.9] 和 0.2% [0.1; 0.7] 的文档中留下完整可见的值，在 0.8% 和 0.2% 的文档中留下任何部分可见的值，并在两种语言中均满足所有检测阈值。在英式英语中，它在 760 个答案后仍能还原至少 99% 的占位符。在俄语中，它仅还原 94.6% [93.6; 95.6] 的姓名占位符，低于 99% 的阈值，主要原因是其从 pii-guard 借用的词形变化产生了错误的姓氏形式。该引擎是在来自同一生成器的六个更早的留出集上开发的；真实文档未经测试。
translation.brief: 针对发送给外部 LLM 的文档中个人数据泄漏问题，构建俄英双语可逆假名化开放基准，并基于两个最强工具开发一个在检测和还原上显著优于现有工具的假名化引擎。

papers.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value. Taking RAG as a reference, we dissect the net value of memory into the gains and losses over direct retrieval, termed memory benefit and memory tax. These gains and losses arise because memory process changes how the raw information is organized and accessed. We view such changes as the double-edged deviations from the raw history. They are originally designed and introduced to benefit the task, for example by reorganizing facts or distilling preferences, but some may also remove or obscure evidence, giving rise to memory tax. Since memory benefit reflects the expected gains of its design, we then focus more on the overlooked memory tax, study how it arises from the system and evaluation side, and generalize the concept to more application scenarios of memory. We hope the notion of memory tax can provide a new lens and shift more attention from standalone performance to the net value of memory, informing more reliable memory designs and evaluations. We will open-source the code and results to the community. Project Page: https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/

translation.title: 记忆税：剖析Agent记忆的净价值
translation.abstract: 记忆在长程Agent中的应用日益增多，但相比直接从原始历史检索，构建记忆的净价值仍不明确。通过跨多个基准和模型骨干的大规模评估，我们发现许多专用记忆系统在很多情况下表现不如朴素RAG，表明其净价值为负。以RAG为参照，我们将记忆的净价值分解为相对直接检索的收益与损失，分别称为记忆收益和记忆税。这些收益与损失源于记忆过程改变了原始信息的组织与访问方式。我们将这些变化视为对原始历史的双刃剑式偏离：它们最初为惠及任务而设计引入，例如重组事实或提炼偏好，但有些也可能移除或掩盖证据，从而产生记忆税。由于记忆收益反映其设计的预期收益，我们更聚焦于被忽视的记忆税，研究它如何从系统和评估两侧产生，并将该概念推广到记忆的更多应用场景。我们希望记忆税这一概念能提供新的视角，将更多注意力从独立性能转向记忆的净价值，为更可靠的记忆设计与评估提供依据。我们将向社区开源代码和结果。项目页面：https://hexuan21.github.io/MemoryTax/
translation.brief: 针对记忆系统相比直接检索原始历史的净价值不明确的问题，提出将净价值分解为记忆收益与记忆税的分析框架并大规模实证剖析其来源。

papers.title: The LALA Benchmark: Evaluating Literary and Linguistic Analysis in LLMs
papers.abstract: We introduce the Literature and Linguistics Analysis Benchmark (LALA), comprising 236 open-ended questions written by experts in linguistics and literary studies, together with expert-provided ideal answers. By comparing models within families and at similar training scales using human and LLM judges, LALA identifies differences in linguistic competence associated with post-training, offering a framework for evaluating future models and guiding targeted improvements. We administered questions to 17 language models and evaluated their responses using both human expert assessment and two LLM evaluators, Sol and Qwen. Base models displayed little of the linguistic competence assessed by the benchmark, whereas their post-trained versions performed markedly better, suggesting that post-training plays a central role in making linguistic knowledge accessible and usable. Parameter count, by contrast, showed no statistically significant association with partial-credit performance, and competencies remained unevenly distributed across linguistic domains. We interpret this pattern as evidence that post-training adds linguistic competencies piecemeal, without producing a general linguistic intelligence capable of extending them beyond the learned policies that support them. Models performed best on logical relations between statements and selected discourse-level tasks, while even the strongest post-trained models continued to struggle with ambiguity, literary style, reference, and misleading assumptions. Human and Sol evaluations produced nearly identical model rankings in both the original and ReliableEval runs, supporting the replicability of the comparative results.

translation.title: LALA基准：评估大语言模型的文学与语言学分析能力
translation.abstract: 我们提出文学与语言学分析基准（LALA），包含236道由语言学和文学研究专家撰写的开放式问题，并附有专家提供的理想答案。通过在同家族、相似训练规模的模型间进行比较，并使用人类和LLM评审，LALA识别出与后训练相关的语言能力差异，为评估未来模型和指导针对性改进提供框架。我们对17个语言模型施测，并使用人类专家评估和两个LLM评审Sol与Qwen来评估其回答。基座模型几乎不具备该基准所考察的语言能力，而后训练版本表现明显更好，表明后训练在使语言知识可用方面起核心作用。相比之下，参数量与部分得分性能没有统计显著关联，且各项能力在语言学领域间分布不均。我们将这一模式解读为：后训练是零碎地添加语言能力，并未产生能够将能力泛化到所学策略之外的一般性语言智能。模型在语句间逻辑关系和部分语篇级任务上表现最好，而即使最强的后训练模型仍在歧义、文学风格、指代和误导性假设上表现不佳。人类与Sol的评估在原始和ReliableEval运行中产生了几乎相同的模型排名，支持比较结果的可复现性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM语言与文学分析能力缺乏系统评估的问题，构建由专家撰写的开放式基准LALA，结合人类与LLM评审比较基座与后训练模型的语言能力差异。

papers.title: T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

translation.title: T2D：面向高效投机解码的目标模型到草稿模型的剪枝与适配
translation.abstract: 投机解码能显著加速大语言模型（LLM）的自回归文本生成，但其效果主要取决于两个关键因素：草稿模型与目标模型之间的分布对齐，以及草稿模型在推理时的延迟。然而，现有方法通常使用独立预训练的小型草稿模型，或将目标模型剪枝到人工选择的架构，因而无法显式平衡草稿模型对齐与token生成效率之间的权衡。为填补这一空白，我们将草稿模型设计形式化为优化问题，提出T2D框架，通过延迟感知的结构化剪枝和知识蒸馏直接从目标模型构建草稿模型。由此，T2D获得的草稿模型在实测推理延迟和目标模型响应上的交叉熵损失两方面被联合优化，带来卓越的投机解码性能。通过在多领域投机解码基准和多个不同规模目标模型家族上的大量实验，我们展示了T2D最多可剪除目标模型92%的参数，获得优于竞争基线的高性能草稿模型。此外，通过T2D获得的草稿模型还能以即插即用的方式被其他投机解码token对齐和知识蒸馏方法使用，带来进一步提升。我们的发现强调了在草稿模型的架构-对齐前沿上联合导航的重要性，以充分释放LLM投机解码的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对草稿模型与目标模型对齐和推理延迟难以兼顾的问题，提出T2D框架，用延迟感知结构化剪枝加知识蒸馏直接从目标模型构建草稿模型。

papers.title: $\Delta\tau$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
papers.abstract: In this paper, we introduce $\Delta\tau$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $\Delta\tau$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $\Delta\tau$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.

translation.title: Δτ-Bench：推动Agent应对动态变化的能力前沿
translation.abstract: 本文提出Δτ-Bench，一个可执行的Agent基准，用于建模大型工具生态系统的结构演化。在Δτ-Bench中，独立演化的服务不断重塑任务的完成方式：熟悉的工具可能消失或被替换，同时更高效的替代方案在功能重叠和噪声文档中涌现。面对这一移动的能力前沿，我们评估Agent能否主动发现高效的工具使用路径并及时修正其积累的程序性知识，这汇集了现有基准未能考察的多重需求。Δτ-Bench包含1,588个经过验证的多轮任务，覆盖42个领域和六个通过能力保持变换生成的连续生态系统状态。我们的评估显示，即使最强的模型或harness也仅达到42.3%的任务成功率，而现有技能学习方法带来的初始收益无法在生态系统演化中持续转化为更好的适应能力。这些发现促使我们提出Steward，一个生态系统管理器，通过增量技能维护和任务执行期间的动态配置来联合管理工具与程序性知识。实验表明，Steward在生态系统变化中保持更高的任务成功率且技能维护开销更低，同时提升了对中断工作流的恢复和对更高效替代方案的采用。
translation.brief: 针对工具生态系统持续演化导致Agent难以适应的问题，构建动态工具生态基准Δτ-Bench，并提出联合管理工具与程序性知识的Steward系统。

papers.title: A Russian, a Brazilian, and a German Walk into a Bar, Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics
papers.abstract: Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. Larger models maintain a more consistent cross-lingual worldview, while smaller models are more easily swayed. All models also exhibit high sensitivity to minor surface-level input variations, producing notable stance even in larger models.

translation.title: 一个俄罗斯人、一个巴西人和一个德国人走进酒吧，问了同一个问题——得到三种不同的回答：剖析LLM在争议话题上的观点多样性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在答案可验证的任务上表现出强大性能，但许多现实世界的查询涉及主观性、分歧和冲突证据。现有的此类查询基准大多以英语为中心，忽视了全球用户持有的巨大观点多样性。为系统研究LLM观点如何随语言变化，我们构建了PerspectivesQA，一个经人工验证、覆盖18种语言的全球争议话题多语言数据集，并提出ROOTS框架，从语言、观点和表述框架三个维度刻画多样性。我们评估了涵盖开源与专有家族、不同规模的八个多样化模型，发现LLM在英语中对回答进行模糊处理，而在低资源语言中则明确表态。更大的模型保持更一致的跨语言世界观，而较小的模型更容易被动摇。所有模型对轻微的表层输入变化也表现出高度敏感，即使较大的模型也会产生明显的立场倾向。
translation.brief: 针对LLM跨语言观点多样性缺乏系统研究的问题，构建多语言争议话题数据集PerspectivesQA并提出ROOTS框架，从语言、观点和框架三维度剖析模型立场差异。

papers.title: Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

translation.title: 从Transformer到GPT-5：大语言模型设计的进展、局限与未来方向
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）凭借上下文理解、少样本/零样本学习、代码生成、推理与问题求解等卓越能力彻底改变了人工智能（AI）。近期关于LLM的研究成果丰硕，但对其系统性分类的研究仍然有限。本研究对LLM进行了详细分类，从BERT等早期模型一直梳理到GPT、Gemini、Claude和Grok等LLM。我们深入探讨了用于训练LLM的数据集、训练所需的算力、硬件规格、架构与参数等主题，并进一步分析了其局限性、计算挑战和开放问题。本研究主要聚焦LLM的发展时间线，展现其随时间的演进。研究发现呈现出清晰规律：在架构复杂度与数据质量之间优化配比的模型表现出更强的推理稳定性和更好的对齐性，而无需按比例增加计算负载。这种扩展性与可持续性之间的理想平衡正是当前一代AI的标志性特征。
translation.brief: 该论文对从BERT到GPT-5等大语言模型进行系统分类梳理，分析其数据集、算力、架构与参数，并总结其局限与未来方向。

papers.title: CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling
papers.abstract: Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. Guided by the adaptive control of thought, it then retrieves and activates knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology. Crucially, to achieve effective compression of history and knowledge, we ground multi-turn dialogues in information theory and derive a principled optimization objective for extracting the core sense-making information. Coupled with a competitive slot mechanism, CoLink condenses the global context into dedicated memory and knowledge slots, efficiently distilling lengthy, redundant inputs into an extremely compact latent representation. Extensive empirical results on both public and our MMD datasets validate CoLink's superiority and generalizability in knowledge linking and sense modeling.

translation.title: CoLink：面向多轮对话建模的全局压缩与知识链接
translation.abstract: 由于上下文窗口受限和高效检索困难，从长程对话历史中提取显著信息对大语言模型（LLM）而言仍是一项重大挑战。现有方法通常依赖历史组织或局部token级优化，存在信息丢失、检索冗余和短视注意力等问题。受认知科学中对话构成意义建构与记忆关联这一观点的启发，我们提出CoLink，一个通过信息链接与压缩来增强LLM在领域特定多轮对话中全局上下文感知能力的框架。CoLink首先将历史上下文聚类为主题图，以建立与外部知识的跨语义关联；随后在自适应思维控制（adaptive control of thought）的指导下，通过协同语义相关性与图结构拓扑来检索和激活知识。关键在于，为实现对历史与知识的有效压缩，我们将多轮对话建立在信息论基础上，推导出一个有原则的优化目标以提取核心的意义建构信息。结合竞争性槽位机制，CoLink将全局上下文压缩到专用记忆槽与知识槽中，把冗长的输入高效蒸馏为极其紧凑的潜在表示。在公开数据集和我们构建的MMD数据集上的大量实证结果验证了CoLink在知识链接与意义建模方面的优越性与泛化能力。
translation.brief: 该论文针对多轮对话中长历史信息丢失与检索冗余问题，提出CoLink框架，通过主题图聚类、知识链接与基于信息论的压缩将全局上下文蒸馏为紧凑的记忆与知识槽位。

papers.title: The Price of Scale in Proactive Memory Recall
papers.abstract: A long-lived assistant that brings up memories without being asked must decide at every turn whether anything in its store is worth an interruption. We show that this decision is a multiple-testing problem whose difficulty grows with the store size $N$. On streaming replays of LongMemEval and LoCoMo, a similarity threshold tuned to 5% false alarms at $N=8$ reaches 87-100% at $N=2048$, across embedding models and for explicit and implicit cues; LLM judges show the same growth from a lower base. We prove that a gate with false-alarm rate $\alpha$ operates at a per-item false-positive rate of about $-\ln(1-\alpha)/N$, which pins its hit rate to the far left of the single-comparison ROC curve and, under regular variation, makes it decay as a power of $N$ with an explicit constant. The resulting prediction matches the hit rate of a per-$N$ oracle threshold to within one percentage point. The analysis explains why lexical and semantic channels need thresholds growing like $\ln N$ and $\sqrt{\ln N}$, and why per-cue normalisation roughly doubles the hit rate at matched false alarms. A cue-swap conformal gate, which compares the current cue with the user's other cues on the same store, needs no labels and has a finite-sample false-alarm guarantee under exchangeability; on LongMemEval it holds false alarms near 5% at the hit rate of a label-tuned threshold. Three annotators (Fleiss' $\kappa=0.63$) find that about nine in ten false alarms are genuine interruptions. Code and data: https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale

translation.title: 主动记忆召回中的规模代价
translation.abstract: 一个能在无人询问时主动提起记忆的长寿命助手，必须在每一轮决定其存储中是否有任何内容值得打断用户。我们证明这一决策是一个多重检验问题，其难度随存储规模 $N$ 增长。在LongMemEval和LoCoMo的流式回放中，在 $N=8$ 时调校至5%误报率的相似度阈值，在 $N=2048$ 时误报率达到87-100%，且在不同嵌入模型以及显式与隐式线索下均如此；LLM裁判也呈现同样的增长趋势，只是起点更低。我们证明误报率为 $\alpha$ 的门控机制其逐项假阳性率约为 $-\ln(1-\alpha)/N$，这将其命中率钉在单次比较ROC曲线的最左端，并且在正则变化条件下使其以 $N$ 的幂次衰减且具有显式常数。由此得到的预测与逐 $N$ oracle阈值的命中率相差不到一个百分点。该分析解释了为什么词汇通道和语义通道需要分别以 $\ln N$ 和 $\sqrt{\ln N}$ 速度增长的阈值，以及为什么逐线索归一化在相同误报率下能将命中率大致翻倍。一种线索交换conformal门控，通过将当前线索与用户在同一存储上的其他线索进行比较，无需标签，并在可交换性假设下具有有限样本误报保证；在LongMemEval上，它在接近标签调校阈值命中率的情况下将误报率保持在5%左右。三位标注者（Fleiss' $\kappa=0.63$）发现约九成的误报确实是真实的打断。代码与数据：https://github.com/RiverChenStillCompiling/price-of-scale
translation.brief: 该论文研究主动记忆召回中误报随记忆库规模增长的问题，将其形式化为多重检验问题并给出理论分析，同时提出无需标签的线索交换conformal门控方法。

papers.title: STEP: Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction Correctness via Per-Step Probability Scoring
papers.abstract: Estimating the correctness of large language model (LLM) predictions without access to ground truth is critical for reliable deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing approaches, such as entropy and perplexity, operate solely on final output statistics, discarding the rich information encoded in intermediate reasoning steps. To address this limitation, we propose STEP (Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness), a training-free framework that scores each reasoning step via lightweight forward passes to obtain a soft probability distribution qi over candidate answers, from which we derive a set of soft trajectory features capturing per-step confidence and its progression toward the final answer. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements, particularly in AUROC, over output-based baselines and hard-indicator trajectory methods. Notably, Temporally-Weighted Consistency, which assigns higher importance to later reasoning steps where answer distributions have stabilized, contributes the largest gains, highlighting the importance of temporal structure in reasoning trajectories. These results further validate the advantage of preserving continuous probability signals over binary discretization.

translation.title: STEP：基于逐步概率评分的预测正确性软轨迹估计
translation.abstract: 在无法获取真实标签的情况下估计大语言模型（LLM）预测的正确性，对于在高风险场景中可靠部署至关重要。现有方法（如熵和困惑度）仅基于最终输出统计量，丢弃了中间推理步骤中编码的丰富信息。为解决这一局限，我们提出STEP（Soft Trajectory Estimation of Prediction correctness），一个免训练框架，通过轻量级前向传播对每个推理步骤进行评分，得到候选答案的软概率分布 $q_i$，并由此导出一组捕捉逐步置信度及其向最终答案演进过程的软轨迹特征。在多个基准上的大量实验表明，相较于基于输出的基线和硬指标轨迹方法，该方法取得了一致且显著的提升，尤其在AUROC上。值得注意的是，时间加权一致性（Temporally-Weighted Consistency）——为答案分布已趋于稳定的后期推理步骤赋予更高权重——贡献了最大增益，凸显了推理轨迹中时间结构的重要性。这些结果进一步验证了保留连续概率信号相对于二值离散化的优势。
translation.brief: 该论文针对无真实标签下LLM预测正确性估计问题，提出免训练的STEP框架，通过逐步前向评分构建软轨迹特征来提升估计效果。

papers.title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

translation.title: 大语言模型：面向工程师的通俗概述
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是在海量文本集合上训练的神经网络，通过预测下一个词来生成文本。使用ChatGPT及其他生成式人工智能（AI）工具的工程师需要清楚了解训练改变了什么、提示又增加了什么。本文从连接上下文中词语的Transformer和模型学习预测文本的预训练讲起，随后解释微调如何使模型适应请求，以及利用人类答案排序的基于人类反馈的强化学习。接着介绍提供文档的检索增强生成（RAG）、鼓励中间推理步骤的思维链提示以及使用工具的智能体。FlashAttention通过减少注意力过程中的数据搬运来降低训练与运行成本；量化低秩适配（QLoRA）可节省微调内存。读者将获得一张生命周期图以及比较各方法及其局限的表格。一份用于评判LLM评估结论的简短清单，可帮助识别训练数据中的测试材料（数据污染）和基于模型的评分（LLM-as-a-judge）。文章还涵盖超长输入（长上下文）和幻觉（即虚假或无依据的断言）。应将事实准确性与答案听起来是否有帮助分开检验。
translation.brief: 该论文以通俗语言向工程师介绍LLM的核心技术（预训练、微调、RAG、FlashAttention、QLoRA等）及其评估中的常见陷阱。

papers.title: Entity Matching using Decision Models
papers.abstract: Entity matching is the task of deciding whether two records describe the same real-world entity. Current entity matching methods rely on pre-trained language models (PLMs) which require task specific fine-tuning or generative large language models (LLMs) which do not require task-specific fine-tuning but are slow and expensive at matching large record sets. Decision models are a new class of LLM-based models that return a probability for each predefined answer option rather than generate text. This paper investigates decision models as an alternative to generative LLMs and fine-tuned PLMs for entity matching. We evaluate six decision models in a zero-shot setting across eight benchmarks and compare their performance with that of the generative LLM GPT-6 Luna and the PLM-based matcher Ditto. Our experiments show that, without task-specific training data, the four strongest decision models achieve mean F1 scores close to that of GPT-6 Luna, with the best model slightly surpassing it. This model also outperforms Ditto on six of the eight benchmarks. All decision models are faster than GPT-6 Luna, and most are less expensive. For three of the four strongest decision models, the predicted match probabilities are well calibrated without requiring any task-specific recalibration. A model cascade that routes the least confident record pairs to an ensemble of generative LLMs improves the mean F1 scores of the four strongest decision models by 1.9-4.0 percentage points. Using the best decision model and its best-performing prompt for each benchmark, the cascade surpasses the highest published F1 scores from literature on four of the eight benchmarks.

translation.title: 基于决策模型的实体匹配
translation.abstract: 实体匹配是判断两条记录是否描述同一现实世界实体的任务。当前的实体匹配方法依赖于需要任务特定微调的预训练语言模型（PLM），或无需任务特定微调但在匹配大规模记录集时速度慢且成本高的生成式大语言模型（LLM）。决策模型是一类新的基于LLM的模型，它为每个预定义的答案选项返回一个概率，而不是生成文本。本文研究决策模型作为生成式LLM和微调PLM在实体匹配中的替代方案。我们在零样本设置下，在八个基准上评估了六个决策模型，并将其性能与生成式LLM GPT-6 Luna和基于PLM的匹配器Ditto进行比较。实验表明，在没有任务特定训练数据的情况下，四个最强的决策模型取得了接近GPT-6 Luna的平均F1分数，其中最佳模型略胜一筹。该模型还在八个基准中的六个上优于Ditto。所有决策模型都比GPT-6 Luna更快，且大多数成本更低。对于四个最强决策模型中的三个，其预测的匹配概率无需任何任务特定的重新校准即具有良好的校准性。一种将置信度最低的记录对路由到生成式LLM集成的模型级联，使四个最强决策模型的平均F1分数提高了1.9-4.0个百分点。使用每个基准上的最佳决策模型及其最佳提示，该级联在八个基准中的四个上超越了文献中已发表的最高F1分数。
translation.brief: 研究用返回概率的决策模型替代生成式LLM和微调PLM进行实体匹配，并通过模型级联结合生成式LLM集成提升性能。

papers.title: Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems
papers.abstract: Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of $\tau^2$-bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downstream call completion. The model achieves tool-state macro-F1 scores of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and the external benchmark, respectively. For correct calls, the estimated mean lead over a turn-end cascade, using the same formatter, is 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on $\tau^2$-bench. These results demonstrate a data-driven path toward spoken agents that act while listening. We will open-source the pipeline and the training scripts.

translation.title: 听够了就行动：口语对话系统中的早期工具调用
translation.abstract: 对延迟敏感的口语智能体不仅需要知道调用哪个工具，还需要知道何时听到的信息已足以采取行动。即使请求已经可以执行，等待话轮结束也会延迟执行。然而，现有的口语智能体和口语对话语料库都没有定义请求何时变得可执行的最早时间点。我们引入了一个合成口语对话流水线，提供最早可执行点监督，标记观察到的语音何时能够确定某个工具及其所需参数。通过受控任务生成、语音合成与对齐以及门控标注，我们构建了涵盖48个领域的26,694段对话，总计786小时，且训练和测试的参数值互不重叠。我们还为τ²-bench创建了音频渲染版本用于外部评估。我们在该语料库上训练了一个全模态语言模型，实现因果的、块级别的决策以及用于下游调用补全的部分转录生成。该模型在保留对话和外部基准上的工具状态宏F1分数分别为0.48和0.47。对于正确的调用，使用相同格式化器，估计的相对话轮结束级联的平均提前量为：域内1.8-2.0秒，τ²-bench上1.1秒。这些结果展示了一条数据驱动的路径，使口语智能体能够边听边行动。我们将开源该流水线和训练脚本。
translation.brief: 构建带最早可执行点标注的合成口语对话数据集，训练全模态模型实现边听边进行工具调用以降低延迟。

papers.title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
papers.abstract: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

translation.title: iPrefBench：面向个性化移动使用智能体的以用户为中心的基准
translation.abstract: 一个真正了解用户并代表其行事的智能体是AI助手长期以来的承诺。计算机使用智能体通过在应用间熟练执行完全指定的任务，使这一承诺触手可及。然而，现实世界的用户请求往往是不完整的。为了为特定用户正确行事，智能体必须从用户的活动历史中推断部分缺失信息，并就只有用户才能提供的信息进行询问，同时不做出无依据的假设，也不以不必要的问题打扰用户。我们提出iPrefBench，一个在可执行的iOS环境中、带有交互式模拟用户、评估个人移动使用智能体推断和询问能力的基准。iPrefBench基于一个包含3,051个历史活动事件的一致性人设，包含跨26个应用的130个不完整的用户任务。每个被省略的用户相关需求在构造上要么可从历史推断，要么只能通过询问获得。iPrefBench从两方面评估个性化移动智能体：是否为用户正确完成任务（即个性化任务完成），以及是否在必要时寻求用户输入（即用户-智能体交互）。对7个前沿智能体的评估揭示了执行能力与个性化能力之间的巨大差距。智能体的动作完成分数很高（最高91.6%），但完整任务成功率较低（最高47.7%），原因在于个性化能力滞后。它们尤其难以处理只能通过询问获得的信息，未能请求足够多的必要信息。我们的发现凸显了个性化智能体在知道该推断什么、何时询问方面的挑战。我们希望iPrefBench能成为构建了解用户并与用户协作的智能体的宝贵测试平台。
translation.brief: 提出在可执行iOS环境中评估个性化移动智能体推断与询问能力的基准，揭示执行能力强但个性化不足的问题。

papers.title: From Belief Inference to Task Action: A Multi-Level Evaluation of Theory of Mind on Verifiable Tasks
papers.abstract: Effective collaboration requires language models to understand what others know and believe, and to act accordingly. Models that assume others share their information may omit necessary communication and undermine coordination. Many theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks assess mental-state inference through story questions, but correct answers do not establish that models can use these judgments in subsequent tasks. We introduce a multi-level evaluation built on existing, verifiable tasks. We extend household collaboration and calendar scheduling with asymmetric information while retaining their original constraints and validators. Independent interfaces assess world understanding, information access, beliefs, decisions, and execution. Controls supply personal evidence or correct beliefs to distinguish state recovery from state use. Across six model configurations, these abilities diverge. On matched scheduling cases, Claude recovers all agent beliefs correctly but produces subjectively optimal plans in only 67.9% of cases. In household collaboration, supplying beliefs raises Qwen-27B success from 55.0% to 75.0%, yet Qwen-4B answers every fixed supplied-belief source question correctly while completing only 20.0% of the corresponding continuation condition. These results show why ToM evaluation must connect perspective inference to independently verified decisions and task consequences.

translation.title: 从信念推断到任务行动：在可验证任务上对心智理论的多层次评估
translation.abstract: 有效的协作要求语言模型理解他人知道什么、相信什么，并据此采取行动。假设他人与自己信息相同的模型可能会省略必要的沟通并破坏协调。许多心智理论（ToM）基准通过故事问题评估心理状态推断，但正确的答案并不能证明模型能够在后续任务中运用这些判断。我们基于现有的可验证任务构建了一个多层次评估。我们在保留原有约束和验证器的前提下，为家庭协作和日程安排任务扩展了非对称信息。独立的接口分别评估世界理解、信息获取、信念、决策和执行。对照条件提供个人证据或正确信念，以区分状态恢复与状态运用。在六个模型配置中，这些能力出现了分化。在匹配的日程安排案例中，Claude能正确恢复所有智能体的信念，但仅在67.9%的案例中产生主观最优的计划。在家庭协作中，提供信念使Qwen-27B的成功率从55.0%提升到75.0%，而Qwen-4B虽然能正确回答所有固定的提供信念来源问题，却只能完成相应续接条件中20.0%的任务。这些结果表明，ToM评估必须将视角推断与独立验证的决策和任务后果联系起来。
translation.brief: 在可验证的协作与日程任务上构建多层次ToM评估，区分模型能否恢复信念与能否将信念用于任务行动。

papers.title: BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams
papers.abstract: User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emph{remember} concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emph{infer} underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.

translation.title: BehaviorMem：从真实电商行为流构建和评估用户记忆
translation.abstract: 用户记忆帮助个性化系统在时间维度上不断加深对用户的理解。在电商场景中，用户通过显式语言和与产品的隐式交互来表达偏好和需求。我们研究从这些交互日志构建的记忆，考察它如何记住具体证据和已确立的兴趣，并利用这些证据推断底层需求和偏好，从而在观察充分的产品领域之外做出判断。现有记忆方法主要针对基于语言的交互，评估提供的真实行为数据有限，且对这些能力的区分不足。这使得如何从行为日志中联合支持并分别评估记忆与推断仍是开放问题。我们围绕这些联合需求形式化了持续行为用户记忆问题，并开发了专门的评估框架和记忆方法。BehaviorMemBench是一个基于真实电商日志构建的基准，涵盖1,194名用户、超过三年时间的17,462个行为批次，具有自动的未来行为标签和与任务无关的记忆接口，可在统一协议下分别评估记忆和推断。BehaviorMem是一种记忆设计，在双轴状态中组织跨长期和短期范围的显式行为事实和推断出的用户特征，具有基于证据的形成、持续维护和与查询无关的读取。在两个构建器和两个任务读取器上的实验表明，BehaviorMem在记忆和推断方面领先于被评估的智能体记忆，并揭示了两种能力上不同的方法排名以及具有竞争力的统计基线。在公开数据集上的验证进一步支持了其对基于行为历史的下游任务的有用性。
translation.brief: 提出从真实电商行为日志构建用户记忆的问题，设计双轴状态的BehaviorMem方法及可分别评估记忆与推断能力的基准。

papers.title: Text Is the Bottleneck: A Small-Scale Replication of LLM Game Playing in Riichi Mahjong
papers.abstract: We replicate the riichi-mahjong track of "Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?" (arXiv:2509.01328) under a drastically smaller budget: models of at most 2B parameters, one 16 GB consumer GPU, about five GPU-days. (1) With matched data and labels, text is the bottleneck: on the same 100k-decision training set, a 2.6M-parameter convolutional board encoder agrees with the strong AI Mortal on 80.6% of test decisions, above every text-prompt LLM we train (best 77.8%), and places better at the table (2.85 over 1,000 games vs. ~3.0 for the LLMs; paired difference at n=100 not significant). Scaled to 1.71M decisions, a 4.9M-parameter Transformer reaches 94.7% agreement, beats the 0.8B LLMs on identical seeds (-0.45 ranks, sign test p=0.005), and is statistically equivalent to parity against three Mortal champions (TOST within 0.10 ranks, p=6e-4); parity against a teacher-opponent is roughly the ceiling of pure imitation. (2) Training toward the teacher raises teacher agreement more than a 2.5x parameter increase does (+2.5 vs. +1.5 points); on human-record agreement both effects are +1.0, and neither is visible at the table. (3) Few-point agreement differences do not resolve into playing strength within a family: +2.5 agreement points coincide with a paired placement difference of +0.02 +/- 0.12 ranks (p=1.0), and +2.0 points at 2B with -0.06 (p=0.37) - both below the ~0.25-rank resolution of 100 paired games. We also document a paper-code mismatch in the original winner filter, reconstruct its two private engine patches, and show that a divide-and-conquer pipeline makes template-generated Japanese rationales 93% sentence-exact (43% without facts). Per Tenhou's terms we release no trained weights - only code, configurations, and evaluation protocols.

translation.title: 文本才是瓶颈：LLM 立直麻将游戏的小规模复现
translation.abstract: 我们在大幅缩小的预算下复现了《Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?》(arXiv:2509.01328) 的立直麻将赛道：模型参数量不超过 2B，一块 16 GB 消费级 GPU，约五个 GPU 天。(1) 在匹配的数据和标签下，文本是瓶颈：在同一个 10 万决策训练集上，一个 260 万参数的卷积棋盘编码器与强 AI Mortal 在测试决策上的一致率达 80.6%，高于我们训练的所有文本提示 LLM（最好 77.8%），且在牌桌上名次更好（1000 局平均 2.85，LLM 约 3.0；n=100 的配对差异不显著）。扩展到 171 万决策后，一个 490 万参数的 Transformer 达到 94.7% 的一致率，在相同种子下击败 0.8B 的 LLM（-0.45 名次，符号检验 p=0.005），并与三位 Mortal 冠军在统计上等价（TOST 在 0.10 名次内，p=6e-4）；与教师对手的等价大致是纯模仿学习的上限。(2) 向教师对齐训练带来的教师一致率提升超过 2.5 倍参数量增加的效果（+2.5 对 +1.5 个百分点）；在人类对局记录一致率上两者均为 +1.0，且在牌桌上均不可见。(3) 家族内部几个百分点的一致率差异并不转化为牌力：+2.5 个百分点的一致率对应 +0.02 ± 0.12 名次的配对差异（p=1.0），2B 下的 +2.0 个百分点对应 -0.06（p=0.37）——均低于 100 局配对对局约 0.25 名次的分辨率。我们还记录了原论文胜者过滤器中的论文-代码不一致，重构了其两个私有引擎补丁，并展示分治流水线使模板生成的日语理由达到 93% 的句子级精确率（无事实时为 43%）。根据 Tenhou 的条款，我们不发布训练权重——只发布代码、配置和评估协议。
translation.brief: 该论文在小预算下复现 LLM 立直麻将研究，通过对比小模型与 LLM 的教师一致率和牌力，证明文本输入是瓶颈，并采用卷积/Transformer 棋盘编码器进行模仿学习。

papers.title: Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer
papers.abstract: Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare "the answer is X" does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the same position changes error by a few points. Second, attributing the note to an authority rather than to another participant, and phrasing it assertively, each raise error by 10-27 points, while the two authorities we tested differ by under two. Third, replaying a correct worked answer before the advice protects it whether the text is shown as the model's own or as someone else's, and the same replay keeps wrong answers from being corrected by a bare correct note. The position result replicates under an independently written prompt. Code, items and all result tables are released at https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety.

translation.title: 位置比渠道更重要：把语言模型从正确答案上劝下来
translation.abstract: 语言模型如今在回答问题时会伴随其他声明：系统提示中的一条备注、来自另一个 agent 的消息、或它自己先前的回答。我们研究需要什么才能让模型放弃它本来能答对的答案，并将以往研究中总是同时变化的三个因素分离开来：建议在提示中的位置、声称的建议作者、以及模型已经写下的内容。在 Qwen3.5-27B 和四选项 MMLU-Pro 题目上，每次比较中其余建议保持不变，我们发现三点。第一，位置的影响远大于 API 渠道，且对裸声明和论证方向相反：一句裸的"答案是 X"在模型作答之前危害最大，而同一句附带虚假理由的声明在问题之前危害最大——它使模型几乎不会答错的题目错误率从 1% 升至 67%；在同一位置将声明从系统消息移到用户消息只改变几个百分点的错误率。第二，将备注归于权威而非另一位参与者，以及使用断言式措辞，各自使错误率提高 10-27 个百分点，而我们测试的两个权威之间差异不到两个百分点。第三，在建议之前重放一个正确的完整解答可以保护答案，无论该文本显示为模型自己所写还是他人所写；同样的重放也会阻止错误答案被一句裸的正确备注纠正。位置效应在独立撰写的提示下得到复现。代码、题目和全部结果表发布于 https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety。
translation.brief: 该论文研究如何用外部建议让语言模型放弃其本可答对的答案，通过控制变量实验分离建议位置、来源权威性和模型已有输出三个因素，发现提示中的位置影响最大。

papers.title: Semantic Atoms for Scalable Text Analysis in Data Analytics in the Era of LLM-Based Agents
papers.abstract: Much of the information needed for data analysis is buried in text columns: an analyst may infer customer frustration from complaint text and use it to explain resolution time. We call workloads in which processing text columns is central to subsequent data analysis TADA (\emph{Text Analysis in Data Analytics}). In an agentic setting, the user's query dynamically specifies this processing, and answering it interleaves LLM-based semantic steps with exact SQL or Python operations. This mixed execution raises two design questions: which work should be neural and which symbolic, and which semantic outputs later steps can reuse. We address them for agent-planned TADA workflows with two complementary, query-driven semantic atoms. Each atom takes a sequence of text items and a natural-language query specifying the semantic task: \textbf{Tagging} returns one string per input item, while \textbf{Categorization} returns $M$ category objects over $N$ input items. Tagging results are materialized as a row-aligned column and Categorization results as a category table; SQL or Python then performs exact computation over this exposed state. We realize this interface in TADA-Agent, whose atoms run inside generated Python programs and internally handle inputs beyond a reliable context window. We evaluate TADA-Agent on TABench, a benchmark of 40 complete analysis requests over spreadsheet tables spanning workflow composition, input--output structure, and literature-grounded analytical scenarios. Against a semantic-operator baseline and relative to a held-out TADA reference run, TADA-Agent delivers comparable row-level semantic quality, has higher complete-artifact preservation estimates, and uses over an order of magnitude fewer semantic-model requests under the evaluated native execution paths.

translation.title: LLM-Based Agent 时代数据分析中可扩展文本分析的语义原子
translation.abstract: 数据分析所需的许多信息埋藏在文本列中：分析师可能从投诉文本推断客户不满，并用它解释处理时长。我们将文本列处理是后续数据分析核心的工作负载称为 TADA（Text Analysis in Data Analytics）。在 agentic 设定下，用户查询动态指定这种处理，回答它需要将基于 LLM 的语义步骤与精确的 SQL 或 Python 操作交织执行。这种混合执行引出两个设计问题：哪些工作应是神经的、哪些应是符号的，以及哪些语义输出可被后续步骤复用。我们针对 agent 规划的 TADA 工作流，用两个互补的、查询驱动的语义原子来回答：每个原子接受一列文本项和指定语义任务的自然语言查询——**Tagging** 为每个输入项返回一个字符串，而 **Categorization** 对 N 个输入项返回 M 个类别对象。Tagging 结果物化为行对齐的列，Categorization 结果物化为类别表；SQL 或 Python 随后在这个暴露的状态上执行精确计算。我们在 TADA-Agent 中实现该接口，其原子在生成的 Python 程序内运行，并内部处理超出可靠上下文窗口的输入。我们在 TABench 上评估 TADA-Agent——这是一个包含 40 个完整分析请求的基准，覆盖电子表格上的工作流组合、输入-输出结构和基于文献的分析场景。相对于语义算子基线和留出的 TADA 参考运行，TADA-Agent 提供相当的行级语义质量、更高的完整工件保留率估计，并在评估的原生执行路径下使用少一个数量级以上的语义模型请求。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 agent 规划的文本分析-数据分析混合工作流，提出 Tagging 和 Categorization 两个查询驱动的语义原子，将语义输出物化为结构化状态供 SQL/Python 精确计算复用。

papers.title: Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.

translation.title: 自适应检索、选择性回答：评估 Agentic RAG 中的保形事实性
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）可以改善事实基础，但不保证每条生成的声明都有依据。已有工作研究了单阶段 RAG 中声明级保形事实性，最近也扩展到多跳 RAG。我们考察其在 agentic RAG 中的行为：语言模型策略自适应地发出后续检索查询或在生成回答前终止检索。我们保留基于检索的相关性评分公式和生成后保形过滤，并评估六种模型-数据集配置：GPT-6 Luna 和 Llama 3.1 8B 在 HotpotQA、Natural Questions 和 TriviaQA 上。每种配置使用 60 个固定问题、100 个带种子的 30/30 校准-测试划分、五个保形目标水平以及无保形预测基线。在六种配置中，更高的目标水平伴随更高的观测完全支持率和更低的回答可用性。在 95% 目标下，非空回答覆盖率从 17.23% 到 60.17%，声明保留率从 10.72% 到 43.16%，非空输出中的完全支持率从 89.14% 到 95.56%。我们显式地形式化自适应检索轨迹，并刻画在 agent 终止后应用保形事实性时的可靠性-信息量权衡。
translation.brief: 该论文研究保形事实性过滤在自适应检索的 agentic RAG 中的表现，通过六种模型-数据集配置实验刻画可靠性提升与回答可用性下降之间的权衡。

papers.title: RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge
papers.abstract: Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation.
