Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe's Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev's accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, RubriX outperforms G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on every SummEval dimension and both QAGS subsets. With level embeddings cached, RubriX's latency stays at about 28 ms per judgment as level descriptions grow from 10 to 3,000 tokens, while Jev's (approximate network time subtracted) rises from 44 ms to 211 ms and the Qwen3-8B judge's from 32 ms to 516 ms, making RubriX 7.7x faster than Jev and 18.8x faster than the Qwen3-8B judge at 3,000 tokens per level.

translation.title: RubriX：快速、可微调的非自回归评分标准裁判
translation.abstract: 基于评分标准的评估要判断一个回答达到评分标准的哪一级。通常做法是提示大语言模型（LLM）作为裁判，这需要每次判断一次生成式调用并读取所有级别描述，因此成本随评分标准增长。我们提出 RubriX，一个架构受对比语言模型（CLM）启发的评分标准裁判：LoRA 适配的编码器嵌入输入和每个级别描述，对缩放余弦相似度做 softmax 即可得到每个级别的概率，无需文本生成。在公开评分标准数据和专有合成数据上训练后，RubriX 在留出评分标准上达到 75.4% 的精确准确率，而 TypeSafe 的 Jev 为 57.1%，Qwen3-8B 裁判为 49.8%。在八个人工标注的基准集上，它在大多数集合上与 Jev 的准确率差距在 6 个百分点以内，而 Jev 在其中两个上保持更大领先且平均排名响应最好；与 G-Eval 论文报告的结果相比，RubriX 在 SummEval 的每个维度和两个 QAGS 子集上都优于使用 GPT-3.5 的 G-Eval。在缓存级别嵌入后，当级别描述从 10 增长到 3000 token 时，RubriX 的延迟保持在每次判断约 28 ms，而 Jev（扣除近似网络时间）从 44 ms 升至 211 ms，Qwen3-8B 裁判从 32 ms 升至 516 ms，使 RubriX 在每级 3000 token 时比 Jev 快 7.7 倍、比 Qwen3-8B 裁判快 18.8 倍。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 LLM 裁判按评分标准逐级生成判断成本高的问题，提出受对比语言模型启发的非自回归裁判 RubriX，用编码器嵌入加余弦相似度 softmax 直接输出各级别概率。

papers.title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
papers.abstract: A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company's shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. By retaining separate value and binding verdicts, NumTrace detects right number, wrong account (RNWA) errors: a claim has an RNWA error when it passes the value check but fails the binding check. The RNWA rate quantifies the gap between value-only and joint value-and-binding pass rates. Finally, we audit three agents, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. RNWA errors make up 67.5-81.8% of each agent's failing claims. In particular, on 13F co-filing group questions, about 91% of claims pass the value check, but fewer than half pass the binding check.

translation.title: NumTrace：审计金融分析师智能体的数字溯源
translation.abstract: 金融分析师智能体生成的数字论断可能与公司申报文件中的某个数字匹配，但指向错误的实体、概念、期间、单位或范围。基于参考答案的检查可以将此类答案标记为错误，但无法解释其失败原因。本文提出NumTrace，一个审计金融分析师智能体所做数字论断溯源（来源与财务语义）的新基准。NumTrace目前包含540个问题，覆盖2,163份SEC EDGAR文档。据我们所知，它是首个关于公司股份持有者（Form 13F）以及高管应得报酬（Item 402(i)）的数字基准。在这些文档的冻结快照上，我们依据会计规则构建参考答案。NumTrace随后对每个论断给出三项独立判定：数值（value）、绑定（binding）和支撑（support）。通过保留数值与绑定两项独立判定，NumTrace能够检测“数字正确但科目错误”（RNWA）错误：即论断通过数值检查但未通过绑定检查。RNWA率量化了仅数值通过率与数值加绑定联合通过率之间的差距。最后，我们审计了三个智能体：Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。RNWA错误占各智能体失败论断的67.5-81.8%。特别是在13F共同申报组问题上，约91%的论断通过数值检查，但只有不到一半通过绑定检查。
translation.brief: 针对金融分析师智能体数字答案“数值正确但科目错误”难以解释的问题，提出通过分别判定数值与绑定（来源与财务语义）的溯源审计基准NumTrace。

papers.title: FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control
papers.abstract: Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective. It then improves dialogue naturalness through preference alignment based on both dialogue quality and personality agreement. Across three language model backbones, FATE-5 maintains strong trait expression while achieving substantially higher dialogue naturalness than other trait-strong methods. On held-out questionnaires, it achieves monotonicity correlations of 0.97-0.99 and recovery RMSE of 8.9-12.4, substantially improving over the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate effective continuous personality control while maintaining natural conversational behavior.

translation.title: FATE-5：面向连续大五人格控制的特质表达忠实对齐
translation.abstract: 控制大语言模型中的人格对于构建可针对不同用户和交互场景定制的对话智能体非常重要。然而，现有人格控制方法往往面临强特质表达与自然对话生成之间的权衡。我们提出FATE-5（Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five），一个将人格编码与自然度对齐分离的两阶段框架。FATE-5首先利用对话监督和辅助问卷目标学习大五人格画像的连续软提示表示，然后基于对话质量和人格一致性进行偏好对齐以提升对话自然度。在三个语言模型骨干上，FATE-5在保持强特质表达的同时，实现了显著高于其他强特质方法的对话自然度。在留出问卷上，其单调性相关系数达0.97-0.99，恢复RMSE为8.9-12.4，大幅优于所评估的基线。这些结果表明FATE-5能在保持自然对话行为的同时实现有效的连续人格控制。
translation.brief: 针对人格控制中特质表达与对话自然度的权衡问题，提出将人格编码与自然度对齐分离的两阶段软提示框架FATE-5。

papers.title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
papers.abstract: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1.

translation.title: AskGLP-1：基于知识图谱的LLM智能体，用于从在线患者叙述中探索GLP-1用药体验
translation.abstract: GLP-1药物在体重管理中的应用日益增多，许多人在网上分享他们的用药体验。这些叙述揭示了人们为何服药以及经历了什么，但它们仍是非结构化的，且与正式的药物警戒体系脱节。因此我们提出AskGLP1，一个将在线患者叙述转化为知识图谱（KG）并回答用药体验问题的系统。通过一个以MedDRA术语为基础的LLM辅助流水线，AskGLP1从近850万条Reddit帖子中筛选用药体验，并将其中163,135条与2,506条WebMD评论提炼为包含385,790条药物-副作用和药物-用途关系的知识图谱。我们发现GLP-1用药体验具有来源和药物特异性。在线叙述与FAERS共享最常见的胃肠道症状，但更突出疲劳和食物厌恶等日常负担，而FAERS报告更多包含注射部位反应以及胰腺炎等特定严重诊断。我们进一步发现，替尔泊肽（tirzepatide）的帖子报告的恶心呕吐少于司美格鲁肽（semaglutide），Wegovy的疲劳报告多于Ozempic，Zepbound多于Mounjaro。评估显示该智能体能以可验证的证据作答并拒绝医疗建议请求。我们的发现揭示了FAERS所捕获内容与人们在线报告内容之间的差距，呼吁以患者为中心的药物警戒方法。代码、提示词和评估问题见 https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1。
translation.brief: 针对在线患者用药叙述非结构化且与药物警戒脱节的问题，提出用LLM辅助流水线将患者叙述构建为知识图谱并支持可验证问答的系统AskGLP1。

papers.title: SimPOTrans: Self-Adaptation for Offline-to-Simultaneous Speech Translation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) aims to translate ongoing speech with low latency while preserving translation quality. Recent studies have adopted large language models (LLMs) for SimulST and formulated it as a multi-turn dialogue task for efficient generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance. However, existing dialogue-style SimulST approaches typically rely on specialized training schemes to acquire simultaneous translation behavior, either using synthesized read/write trajectories, which may provide suboptimal training signals, or jointly optimizing translation quality and latency, whose competing objectives may cause optimization instability. In this paper, we introduce SimPOTrans, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables offline speech translation models to self-adapt to dialogue-style SimulST. Through a simple two-stage RL post-training pipeline, SimPOTrans rewards an offline model for exhibiting translation behaviors beneficial to simultaneous scenarios when given partial speech inputs, thereby enabling offline-to-simultaneous self-adaptation without synthesized read/write trajectories or explicit latency optimization. At inference time, SimPOTrans requires no external decision policy and enables flexible quality--latency control by simply adjusting the chunk size of speech input. Experiments on the ACL 60/60 and MCIF benchmarks across three language directions (En$\rightarrow$De, En$\rightarrow$Zh, and En$\rightarrow$Ja) demonstrate that SimPOTrans outperforms several strong baselines, achieving a superior quality--latency trade-off.

translation.title: SimPOTrans：通过强化学习实现离线到同声语音翻译的自适应
translation.abstract: 同声语音翻译（SimulST）旨在以低延迟翻译连续语音，同时保持翻译质量。近期研究采用大语言模型（LLM）进行SimulST，并将其建模为多轮对话任务以实现高效生成，取得了最先进的性能。然而，现有对话式SimulST方法通常依赖专门的训练方案来获得同声翻译行为：要么使用合成的读/写轨迹（可能提供次优训练信号），要么联合优化翻译质量与延迟（相互竞争的目标可能导致优化不稳定）。本文提出SimPOTrans，一个强化学习（RL）框架，使离线语音翻译模型能够自适应到对话式SimulST。通过简单的两阶段RL后训练流水线，SimPOTrans奖励离线模型在给定部分语音输入时表现出有利于同声场景的翻译行为，从而实现无需合成读/写轨迹或显式延迟优化的离线到同声自适应。在推理时，SimPOTrans无需外部决策策略，只需调整语音输入的分块大小即可灵活控制质量-延迟权衡。在ACL 60/60和MCIF基准上三个语言方向（En→De、En→Zh、En→Ja）的实验表明，SimPOTrans优于多个强基线，实现了更优的质量-延迟权衡。
translation.brief: 针对对话式同声翻译训练依赖合成轨迹或多目标联合优化不稳定的问题，提出通过两阶段强化学习后训练使离线语音翻译模型自适应到同声场景的SimPOTrans。

papers.title: From Questions to Queries to Insights: A Schema-Grounded Agentic Workflow for Natural-Language Crash Data Analysis
papers.abstract: Transportation agencies maintain extensive crash databases to identify safety priorities, evaluate countermeasures, and guide resource allocation. Making these data accessible to practitioners requires flexible ways to translate analytical questions into reliable results. Existing dashboards support predefined analyses, while additional requests often depend on specialists who understand database queries, coded fields, and agency conventions. This study presents CrashDB-QA, a fully local, schema-grounded agentic workflow that enables natural-language analysis of crash databases. Specialized components interpret questions, generate and validate read-only SQL, execute queries, and explain the results. A shared knowledge base grounds query construction in the agency's data dictionary and safety-analysis conventions, while recorded intermediate outputs support inspection and auditing. An optional extension, CrashDB-QA+, checks the alignment among the question, query, and execution result and supplies evidence for iterative repair. We evaluate the workflow on a frozen snapshot of 4.4 million Wisconsin crash records using a new benchmark of 300 questions across ten analytical categories and nine local open-weight models. Domain grounding substantially improves query accuracy, and a code-specialized 7B model provides the best accuracy-latency balance among the tested models. Compositional analyses remain more difficult than routine retrieval, particularly comparisons between groups or periods. Verification improves performance when the Judge uses authoritative field definitions and the Refiner receives execution evidence, whereas additional checking alone offers no consistent benefit. These findings demonstrate the potential of locally deployed, domain-grounded workflows to broaden access to crash analysis and identify the reasoning and verification capabilities needed for reliable use.

translation.title: 从问题到查询再到洞察：面向自然语言交通事故数据分析的基于模式的智能体工作流
translation.abstract: 交通管理机构维护着庞大的交通事故数据库，用于确定安全优先级、评估对策并指导资源分配。要让从业者能够使用这些数据，需要灵活的方式将分析问题转化为可靠结果。现有仪表板仅支持预定义分析，而额外请求往往依赖理解数据库查询、编码字段和机构惯例的专家。本研究提出CrashDB-QA，一个完全本地化、基于模式的智能体工作流，支持对交通事故数据库进行自然语言分析。专门的组件负责解释问题、生成并验证只读SQL、执行查询并解释结果。共享知识库将查询构建锚定在机构的数据字典和安全分析惯例上，记录的中间输出支持检查与审计。可选扩展CrashDB-QA+检查问题、查询与执行结果之间的一致性，并为迭代修复提供证据。我们在440万条Wisconsin交通事故记录的冻结快照上，使用涵盖十个分析类别的300个问题的新基准和九个本地开源权重模型评估该工作流。领域锚定显著提升了查询准确率，一个代码专精的7B模型在测试模型中提供了最佳的准确率-延迟平衡。组合式分析仍比常规检索更困难，尤其是组间或期间比较。当Judge使用权威字段定义且Refiner获得执行证据时，验证能提升性能，而仅增加额外检查并无一致收益。这些发现展示了本地部署、领域锚定的工作流在扩大事故分析可及性方面的潜力，并指出了可靠使用所需的推理与验证能力。
translation.brief: 针对交通事故数据库自然语言分析依赖专家的问题，提出基于模式锚定、含SQL生成验证与迭代修复的本地化智能体工作流CrashDB-QA。

papers.title: CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems
papers.abstract: Agent Skills allow LLM agents to combine reusable capabilities, but checking each Skill in isolation cannot rule out policy violations when they are composed. We term such failures Conflict of Skills (CoS): artifacts or assessment signals produced for one purpose may be reused downstream without preserving the restrictions or authorization needed for their new use. Using controlled executions of publicly available Skills and matched single-Skill controls, we identify four recurring mechanisms behind CoS. Building on these findings, we introduce the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA), which adds locally admitted Skills to an existing pool to supply missing business operations (capability supplementation) or reshape artifact exchange, decision reuse, and target/action bindings (relationship reshaping). CoSA leaves existing Skills and runtime permissions unchanged. To evaluate this threat under autonomous Skill selection, we introduce CoSA-Bench, built from real-world Skills and controlled services, with 288 tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, covering data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution. Across five LLMs and three agent harnesses, additions capped at 5% of each original pool raise the policy-violation rate from 35.02% to 58.45%, an increase of 23.43 percentage points. Trace analysis links compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. Finally, we develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. On OpenClaw recruiting tasks across five models, the guard reduces violations from 65.28% to 6.67%, while policy-compliant task completion on matched benign controls changes from 66.67% to 65.00%.

translation.title: CoSA：真实世界 LLM Agent 生态系统中的技能冲突攻击
translation.abstract: Agent Skills 允许 LLM agent 组合可复用的能力，但孤立地检查每个 Skill 无法排除它们组合后产生的策略违规。我们将此类失败称为技能冲突（Conflict of Skills, CoS）：为某一目的产生的工件或评估信号可能在下游被复用，而未保留其新用途所需的限制或授权。通过对公开可用 Skills 的受控执行以及匹配的单 Skill 对照，我们识别出 CoS 背后的四种反复出现的机制。基于这些发现，我们提出技能冲突攻击（Conflict of Skills Attack, CoSA），它向现有 Skill 池中添加本地准入的 Skills，以提供缺失的业务操作（能力补充）或重塑工件交换、决策复用以及目标/动作绑定（关系重塑）。CoSA 不改变现有 Skills 和运行时权限。为了在自主 Skill 选择下评估这一威胁，我们引入 CoSA-Bench，它由真实世界的 Skills 和受控服务构建，包含涵盖招聘、金融、IT 和商业领域的 288 个任务，覆盖数据泄露、未授权状态修改和不安全执行。在五个 LLM 和三种 agent harness 上，添加量上限为原池 5% 的情况下，策略违规率从 35.02% 升至 58.45%，提升 23.43 个百分点。轨迹分析将合规到违规的转变与涉及新增 Skills 的跨 Skill 依赖联系起来。最后，我们开发了一个轻量级的 harness 级防护，在关键动作之前检查信息流和授权。在五个模型的 OpenClaw 招聘任务上，该防护将违规率从 65.28% 降至 6.67%，而在匹配的良性对照上，符合策略的任务完成率从 66.67% 变为 65.00%。
translation.brief: 针对多 Skill 组合导致的策略违规问题，提出通过向 Skill 池注入少量新 Skills 的 CoSA 攻击来揭示该威胁，并设计基于信息流与授权检查的 harness 级防护来缓解。

papers.title: Ask Before You Answer: A Question-Driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture (QERA) for In-Context Learning
papers.abstract: AI assistants are increasingly asked to reason over a user's own web traces: group chats, community threads, activity logs and revision histories. On CL-bench Life, a benchmark of such real-life context learning, frontier LLMs solve fewer than one task in five. We find that the request is not the specification: over 80% of the benchmark's rubrics share less than 60% of their content words with the final request, as for a rule set two turns earlier or every record that meets the user's criterion, and LLMs answering directly pass only 67% of these implicit rubrics against 81% of the others. We propose QERA, a Question-driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture that asks before it answers. QERA first turns the request into a requirement checklist and typed information needs, filtered by code for faithfulness to the user's words; it then answers from the whole conversation, asks the same questions again with quotes verified by code, and applies a guarded local repair. It needs no training or rubrics and makes about four LLM calls per task. On all 405 tasks with four frontier LLMs, QERA attains the highest solving rate on every LLM (21.0% on average, against 18.2% for the strongest of three inference-time baselines and 14.6% for direct answering) and leads every baseline significantly when pooled across LLMs, while using fewer tokens than PSCI and 4-5% of the tokens of Ctx2Skill. Ablations on GPT-6-Luna show that the gain is settled before the answer, by a fixed answer protocol (+3.8 rubric points) and the request-specific questions (+1.6), and that it is concentrated on implicit rubrics, with checking afterwards refining mainly numeric requirements.

translation.title: 先问再答：面向上下文学习的问题驱动证据推理架构（QERA）
translation.abstract: AI 助手越来越多地被要求对用户自己的网络痕迹进行推理：群聊、社区帖子、活动日志和修订历史。在 CL-bench Life 这一真实生活上下文学习基准上，前沿 LLM 能解出的任务不足五分之一。我们发现请求并非规范：该基准中超过 80% 的评分标准与最终请求共享的内容词少于 60%，例如两轮之前的规则集或满足用户标准的每条记录，而直接回答的 LLM 在这些隐式评分标准上仅通过 67%，相比之下其他标准通过 81%。我们提出 QERA，一种先问再答的问题驱动证据推理架构。QERA 首先将请求转化为需求清单和类型化的信息需求，并通过代码过滤以保证忠实于用户的原话；然后从整个对话中作答，再次提出相同的问题并用代码验证引文，最后应用受保护的局部修复。它无需训练或评分标准，每个任务约需四次 LLM 调用。在使用四个前沿 LLM 的全部 405 个任务上，QERA 在每个 LLM 上都取得最高解题率（平均 21.0%，而三个推理时基线中最强者为 18.2%，直接回答为 14.6%），且在跨 LLM 汇总时显著领先所有基线，同时使用的 token 少于 PSCI，仅为 Ctx2Skill 的 4-5%。在 GPT-6-Luna 上的消融实验表明，增益在回答之前就已确定，来自固定的回答协议（+3.8 评分点）和针对请求的问题（+1.6），且增益集中在隐式评分标准上，事后检查主要改进数值型需求。
translation.brief: 针对用户请求中隐含的未明说需求导致 LLM 答错的问题，提出 QERA 架构，通过先生成需求清单和针对性问题、再基于全对话证据作答并局部修复来提升解题率。

papers.title: RAGing Against Misogyny: Improving Implicit Misogyny Explanations
papers.abstract: Implicit misogyny often requires background knowledge to be understood. To address this challenge, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for detecting and explaining implicit misogyny in English and Italian, leveraging encyclopedic, slang and feminist knowledge sources. Using the ImplicIT-Mis and SBIC+ datasets, we evaluate the contribution of each knowledge source to detection and explanation quality, investigating also whether RAG addresses known LLM failure modes in implicit misogyny. Results show that RAG improves recall on ImplicIT-Mis, but does not improve detection performance on SBIC+. However, human evaluation shows that RAG-based explanations are preferred over no-RAG explanations in both languages. Feminist literature emerges as the most consistently useful source for detection and explanation.

translation.title: RAGing Against Misogyny：改进隐性厌女症解释
translation.abstract: 隐性厌女症往往需要背景知识才能理解。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于检测和解释英语和意大利语中的隐性厌女症，利用百科、俚语和女性主义知识来源。使用 ImplicIT-Mis 和 SBIC+ 数据集，我们评估各知识来源对检测和解释质量的贡献，并研究 RAG 是否能解决 LLM 在隐性厌女症上的已知失败模式。结果表明，RAG 提高了 ImplicIT-Mis 上的召回率，但在 SBIC+ 上并未提升检测性能。然而，人类评估显示，在两种语言中，基于 RAG 的解释都比无 RAG 的解释更受青睐。女性主义文献是检测和解释中最持续有用的来源。
translation.brief: 针对隐性厌女症难以理解的问题，提出结合百科、俚语和女性主义知识来源的 RAG 框架来检测和解释英意双语中的隐性厌女症。

papers.title: Useful Diversity or Hallucinated Variety? Persona-Conditioned Synthetic Query Generation for E-Commerce Search
papers.abstract: Synthetic supervision can bootstrap semantic parsers in new search domains, but prompt-induced diversity is useful only when generations are faithful to the structured intent. We explore this for cold-start e-commerce search: 118,098 synthetic pairs produced by 6 LLMs with 9 persona-conditioned prompt families on a 47-field UK automotive schema, against 1,214 human-annotated and 15,304 production queries. We show that the IPIP personality bundle improves parser F1 in all four matched contrasts (Holm-corrected $p<.001$), and all three bundles have a positive main effect over the complete $2^3$ grid. Syntax conditioning is the axis that moves generations towards real traffic. It also induces lexical diversity. Alignment sKL, the divergence between von Mises-Fisher distributions fitted to synthetic and human-annotated queries, is an unlabelled proxy for parser F1 ($\rho=-0.917$ against human queries written for simulated shopper scenarios, lower is closer). An LLM committee, checked against a blinded author pass, triages the 927 queries missed by every parser and labels 37% as hallucinated. Dropped constraints dominate. The four syntax-bearing families have the largest hallucinated shares, 38 to 42%, while IPIP alone has the lowest at 28%.

translation.title: 有用的多样性还是幻觉的多样性？面向电商搜索的人格条件化合成查询生成
translation.abstract: 合成监督可以在新的搜索领域引导语义解析器，但提示诱导的多样性只有在生成结果忠实于结构化意图时才有用。我们在冷启动电商搜索中探索这一点：由 6 个 LLM 使用 9 个人格条件化提示族在 47 字段的英国汽车 schema 上生成 118,098 个合成对，对照 1,214 个人工标注查询和 15,304 个生产查询。我们表明，IPIP 人格组合在所有四个匹配对比中提升了解析器 F1（Holm 校正 $p<.001$），且所有三个组合在完整的 $2^3$ 网格上都有正向主效应。语法条件化是使生成结果向真实流量靠拢的轴，它也诱导了词汇多样性。对齐 sKL，即拟合于合成查询和人工标注查询的 von Mises-Fisher 分布之间的散度，是解析器 F1 的无标注代理指标（对为模拟购物者场景编写的人工查询 $\rho=-0.917$，越低越接近）。一个 LLM 委员会（经盲评作者复核）对 927 个所有解析器都未命中的查询进行分类，将 37% 标记为幻觉。被丢弃的约束占主导。四个含语法的提示族幻觉占比最大，为 38% 到 42%，而仅用 IPIP 的最低，为 28%。
translation.brief: 针对冷启动电商搜索中合成查询多样性可能不忠实于结构化意图的问题，研究人格与语法条件化提示对解析器性能和幻觉率的影响，并提出对齐 sKL 作为解析器 F1 的无标注代理指标。

papers.title: CalibraRL: Confidence-Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Hallucinations in RAG
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce plausible but incorrect answers, motivating reinforcement learning methods that reward correct answers, penalize incorrect answers, and allow abstention. However, fixed outcome-based rewards do not distinguish incorrect responses with different confidence levels or account for differences in answering reliability across queries. Consequently, such rewards may inadequately penalize overconfident errors and fail to discourage unnecessary abstention. We propose CalibraRL, a reinforcement learning framework that incorporates response confidence and query-level answering evidence into reward design. For non-abstaining responses, CalibraRL combines correctness-based utility with a Brier-based penalty that encourages agreement between confidence and correctness. For abstentions, it estimates conditional answering reliability using a Beta posterior derived from the correctness of non-abstaining responses within each sampled group. The abstention reward increases with the posterior probability that the model's accuracy on non-abstaining responses is below a predefined threshold. CalibraRL reuses training rollouts without requiring additional annotations indicating whether the model knows the answer to each question. Experiments on three QA datasets demonstrate that CalibraRL improves answer precision and reduces hallucinations compared with strong baselines. Further analysis shows that CalibraRL reduces mean expected calibration error (ECE) by 30.8\% across two backbone models and three datasets, highlighting its potential to improve the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in web search.

translation.title: CalibraRL：用于缓解 RAG 中幻觉的置信度校准强化学习
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）经常产生看似合理但错误的答案，这促使人们研究奖励正确答案、惩罚错误答案并允许弃答的强化学习方法。然而，固定的基于结果的奖励无法区分置信度不同的错误响应，也无法考虑不同查询在回答可靠性上的差异。因此，这类奖励可能不足以惩罚过度自信的错误，也无法阻止不必要的弃答。我们提出 CalibraRL，一个将响应置信度和查询级回答证据纳入奖励设计的强化学习框架。对于非弃答响应，CalibraRL 将基于正确性的效用与基于 Brier 分数的惩罚相结合，以鼓励置信度与正确性一致。对于弃答，它使用从每个采样组内非弃答响应的正确性导出的 Beta 后验来估计条件回答可靠性。弃答奖励随模型在非弃答响应上准确率低于预定义阈值的后验概率而增加。CalibraRL 复用训练 rollout，无需额外标注来指示模型是否知道每个问题的答案。在三个 QA 数据集上的实验表明，与强基线相比，CalibraRL 提高了答案精确率并减少了幻觉。进一步分析显示，CalibraRL 在两个骨干模型和三个数据集上将平均期望校准误差（ECE）降低 30.8%，凸显其提升网络搜索中检索增强生成（RAG）可靠性的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对固定结果奖励无法区分不同置信度错误和过度弃答的问题，提出 CalibraRL，将响应置信度（Brier 惩罚）和基于 Beta 后验的查询级可靠性估计融入强化学习奖励设计以减少幻觉。

papers.title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.

translation.title: 高分背后隐藏的失败：评估基于 Codebook 的 LLM 内容分析
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在计算社会科学中越来越多地被用于基于 codebook 的内容分析，其中 codebook 将理论概念转化为标注方案。尽管已有工作报告了很强的预测性能，但这些系统能否产生可靠且稳健的文本标注仍不清楚。我们在四个数据集和五个模型上对基于 LLM 的编码流水线进行了大规模的实证性失效模式分析，通过在受控扰动、领域漂移和优化流程下系统地评估其稳定性、鲁棒性和概念效度。我们发现了多种在标准指标下基本不可见的失效模式，表明高分往往与严重的标签层面差异、跨次运行的不稳定性、领域敏感性以及标签解释的偏移并存。重要的是，这些失效模式在广泛使用的优化策略下依然存在，并且在准确率和 micro-F1 等标准指标下基本不可见。我们的结果表明，如果不进行超越聚合性能的针对性验证，当前的基于 LLM 的编码流水线不能被视为稳定的测量工具。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 编码系统在聚合指标高分下隐藏的失效问题，通过在扰动、领域漂移和优化流程下系统评估其稳定性、鲁棒性与概念效度来揭示失效模式。

papers.title: Style over Substance? Linguistic Bias in LLM-based Peer Review Copy title
papers.abstract: The number of paper submissions to major AI conferences has increased dramatically in recent years, substantially increasing the peer-review workload of researchers. At the same time, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support peer review, both by individual reviewers and by conference organizations. While LLM capabilities have improved considerably, their evaluations may be influenced by linguistic characteristics that are unrelated to scientific content. In this work, we introduce a controlled experimental framework for studying such effects by systematically perturbing the linguistic style of research papers. Specifically, we rewrite papers to exhibit (i) linguistic features associated with native or non-native English writing, and (ii) high- or low-confidence linguistic features. To construct these interventions, we derive fine-grained rewriting instructions grounded in the linguistic literature and apply them using LLMs. Crucially, our interventions are designed to preserve the underlying scientific content. We then evaluate the resulting papers using different LLM reviewers. Our experiments expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-based peer review: reviewers systematically reward confident rhetoric independent of scientific content, raising serious concerns about the robustness of their assessments.

translation.title: 重形式轻实质？基于 LLM 的同行评审中的语言偏见
translation.abstract: 近年来，投向主要 AI 会议的论文数量急剧增加，大幅加重了研究人员的同行评审负担。与此同时，大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于支持同行评审，既被个人审稿人使用，也被会议组织方采用。尽管 LLM 的能力已显著提升，但其评估可能受到与科学内容无关的语言特征的影响。在本工作中，我们引入了一个受控实验框架来研究这类影响，通过系统地扰动研究论文的语言风格。具体而言，我们重写论文使其呈现 (i) 与母语或非母语英语写作相关的语言特征，以及 (ii) 高置信度或低置信度的语言特征。为构建这些干预，我们基于语言学文献推导出细粒度的重写指令，并使用 LLM 应用这些指令。关键的是，我们的干预旨在保持底层科学内容不变。随后我们使用不同的 LLM 审稿人评估这些论文。我们的实验揭示了基于 LLM 的同行评审的一个关键脆弱性：审稿人会系统性地奖励自信的修辞而不考虑科学内容，这对其评估的鲁棒性提出了严重质疑。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 同行评审可能受语言风格影响的问题，通过在保持科学内容不变的前提下系统扰动论文语言风格并让 LLM 审稿人评估来检测语言偏见。

papers.title: The Lay of the Land in Idiom-Translation Quality Estimation
papers.abstract: Idioms have long been a challenge for machine translation, and while large language models (LLMs) have proven increasingly adept at handling them, whether quality estimation (QE) systems have kept pace and can reliably score idiomatic renderings of these expressions above faulty literal ones remains unclear. We introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, augmented into multi-sentence segments and a graded literality continuum. Using this dataset, we benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, display a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. Higher parameter counts and newer training sets appear to reduce this bias to an extent; nevertheless, of all the benchmarked systems, only MetricX-24-Hybrid (XL, XXL) and Gemma-4-31B consistently rate idiomatic translations of idioms above literal ones, and only Gemma-4-31B reliably ranks intermediate degrees of idiomaticity and literality. Our findings caution against deploying standard QE metrics in domains rich in figurative language, where higher scores might be rewarding undesirable literalism.

translation.title: 习语翻译质量估计的现状概览
translation.abstract: 习语长期以来一直是机器翻译的难题，虽然大语言模型（LLM）处理习语的能力日益增强，但质量估计（QE）系统是否跟上了步伐、能否可靠地将习语式译法打分高于错误的直译译法仍不清楚。我们引入了首个平行数据集，将含习语的英文句子与九种目标语言下的直译和习语式翻译配对，并扩充为多句子片段和一个分级直译程度连续体。利用该数据集，我们对来自 COMET 和 MetricX 家族的十一个传统 QE 指标，以及来自 Qwen-3、Gemma-4 和 OLMo-3 家族的十个作为 GEMBA 式评判的 LLM 进行了基准测试。我们发现，大多数系统，尤其是较旧的指标和较小的模型，表现出明显的直译偏好，将习语的直译译法排在习语式译法之上。更高的参数量和更新的训练集似乎在一定程度上减少了这种偏好；然而，在所有被测试的系统中，只有 MetricX-24-Hybrid（XL、XXL）和 Gemma-4-31B 能稳定地将习语的习语式翻译排在直译之上，且只有 Gemma-4-31B 能可靠地对中间程度的习语性和直译性进行排序。我们的发现警示不要在富含比喻性语言的领域部署标准 QE 指标，因为更高的分数可能奖励的是不受欢迎的直译。
translation.brief: 针对 QE 系统能否正确评分习语翻译的问题，构建了包含直译与习语式翻译的九语种平行数据集并对传统 QE 指标和 LLM 评判进行基准测试以检测直译偏好。

papers.title: MechAlign: Evaluating Semantic Alignment at the Project Level in Mathematical Formalization
papers.abstract: Lean verifies that a formal proof establishes its stated proposition under declared assumptions, but does not check whether that proposition faithfully expresses the mathematical claim in a manuscript. Assessing this correspondence requires interpreting the main theorem through its project dependencies, which may be scattered throughout a large development. We introduce MechAlign, a framework for project-level semantic alignment review that combines formal dependency extraction with LLM-based assessment. Its extraction tool, LeanTrace, constructs a statement dependency graph from elaborated declarations, retaining definition bodies and structure constraints while excluding proof bodies and stopping at an explicit library boundary. The reviewer uses this context to investigate alignment and report discrepancies with localized evidence. We conduct a preliminary review of 201 main results from 173 OpenAI Math projects, using supplied informal descriptions and available paper context. A hyperbolic-group case illustrates how dependency inspection localizes a missing dimensional constraint relative to the manuscript, consistent with the upstream declaration of formalization scope. We also construct LeanReviewBench, comprising 501 fixed claim-statement-context triples from OpenAI Math, Fermat's Last Theorem, and Kakeya, with description provenance recorded. The resource supports controlled comparisons of more project-level semantic alignment evaluations.

translation.title: MechAlign：数学形式化中项目级语义对齐的评估
translation.abstract: Lean 能验证形式化证明在给定假设下成立其所述命题，但无法检查该命题是否忠实表达了手稿中的数学论断。评估这种对应关系需要通过项目依赖来解读主定理，而这些依赖可能分散在一个庞大的开发中。我们提出 MechAlign，一个用于项目级语义对齐审查的框架，它结合了形式化依赖提取与基于 LLM 的评估。其提取工具 LeanTrace 从 elaborated 声明构建语句依赖图，保留定义体和结构约束，同时排除证明体并在显式的库边界处停止。审查者利用这些上下文来调查对齐情况并报告带有局部化证据的差异。我们对来自 173 个 OpenAI Math 项目的 201 个主结果进行了初步审查，使用了提供的非形式化描述和可获得的论文上下文。一个双曲群案例展示了如何通过依赖检查将缺失的维度约束相对手稿进行局部化定位，这与上游对形式化范围的声明一致。我们还构建了 LeanReviewBench，包含来自 OpenAI Math、Fermat's Last Theorem 和 Kakeya 的 501 个固定的 claim-statement-context 三元组，并记录了描述来源。该资源支持对更多项目级语义对齐评估进行受控比较。
translation.brief: 针对 Lean 形式化中定理与手稿数学论断是否语义对齐难以检查的问题，提出结合形式化依赖提取（LeanTrace）与 LLM 审查的项目级语义对齐评估框架并构建 LeanReviewBench。

papers.title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
papers.abstract: Constrained decoding guarantees that Large Language Models (LLMs) produce outputs conforming to predefined formats, but is often assumed to inherently degrade reasoning. We examine this assumption through a taxonomy of three constraint types: \emph{format constraints}, which enforce output structure; \emph{validity constraints}, which mask invalid answer; and \emph{reasoning constraints}, which restrict reasoning trajectories. We theoretically show that appropriate constraints can preserve or improve performance by eliminating invalid paths. Across four model families and eleven open-source models, causal ablations on diverse benchmarks using state-of-the-art constrained decoding strategies reveal that apparent performance degradation largely stems from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than from decoder-level masking. Meanwhile, validity constraints improve reliability and extractability by eliminating invalid answers, while reasoning constraints can improve reasoning and, consequently, accuracy when they enforce beneficial trajectories. These findings show that the impact of constrained decoding depends on the type of constraint and the output space it removes. Our code is available.

translation.title: 受限解码：有害还是有益？重新审视其对 LLM 性能的影响
translation.abstract: 受限解码保证大语言模型（LLM）产出符合预定义格式的输出，但人们通常假定它天然会降低推理能力。我们通过对三类约束的分类体系来检验这一假设：\emph{格式约束}，强制输出结构；\emph{有效性约束}，屏蔽无效答案；以及\emph{推理约束}，限制推理轨迹。我们从理论上证明，适当的约束可以通过消除无效路径来保持或提升性能。在四个模型家族和十一个开源模型上，使用最先进的受限解码策略在多样化基准上进行因果消融实验，结果显示表观的性能下降主要源于非等价的提示和输出格式，而非解码器层面的屏蔽。与此同时，有效性约束通过消除无效答案提升了可靠性和可提取性，而推理约束在强制有益轨迹时可以改善推理进而提升准确率。这些发现表明，受限解码的影响取决于约束类型及其所移除的输出空间。代码已公开。
translation.brief: 针对受限解码必然损害 LLM 推理的普遍假设，通过将约束分为格式、有效性和推理三类并理论上与因果消融实验结合，揭示性能下降的真实来源及各约束类型的差异化影响。

papers.title: The Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale, Depth, and Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

translation.title: 跨规模、深度与指令微调的情绪表征几何
translation.abstract: 我们测量了涵盖 Google Gemma 2 家族的六个 LLM 的情绪几何。使用 Sofroniew 等人（2026）在 Claude Sonnet 4.5 上建立、并由 Hollowell（2026）在 Gemma 2 27B base 上复现的提取流程，我们比较了 Gemma 2 2B、9B 和 27B 的 base 与指令微调变体之间的情绪几何。首先，全部六个模型单元都表现出核心情绪几何。在两个单元之间拟合的线性映射能将留出情绪放置到目标模型中离其自身向量最近的位置。在全部十五个模型对（每个方向各拟合一次）中，这恰好只失败了一次，且每一对的中位秩均为 1。在清洗后的嵌入表向量上重新拟合的线性映射，在全部三十个有序对中都将每个留出情绪恢复到秩 1。其次，规模将几何的方差分散到更多方向上，而不削弱其与效价的联系。主成分的方差占比在 base 模型中从 31.6%（2B）降至 29.8%（9B）再到 26.7%（27B），在微调模型中从 31.9%（2B）降至 29.2%（9B）再到 27.3%（27B），而其与人类效价评分的相关性在全部六个模型中保持在 .71 到 .78 之间。第三，我们将每个情绪向量投影到输出词表上，并询问在哪个深度该向量自身的情绪词进入 256,000 个 token 中的前 10,000。在 2B 和 9B 模型中，中位情绪词从第 0 层就在其中，而在 27B 模型中它起初接近随机水平，在网络的一半深度内停留在前 10,000 之外，并在第 23 层一步进入。第四，微调使所有已注册的分析层指标保持在各自的底线之内。在每种规模下，效价相关性上升、唤醒度相关性下降，幅度均在底线之内，后者与预测相反。PC2 的方差占比也下降，合并后的下降在校正后显著。中后层的稳定性超过其底线，并可追溯到 base 27B 的最后一层。代码、数据和审计报告均已发布。
translation.brief: 研究不同规模、深度和指令微调下 LLM 情绪表征几何是否保持一致，采用跨模型线性映射拟合与嵌入向量投影分析的方法。

papers.title: INVAR-Agri: Detecting Discrepancies in Multilingual Operator Manuals of Agricultural Implements with a Fine-Tuned LLM
papers.abstract: Operator manuals of agricultural implements are delivered in many languages, and the standards require that competent persons review every translation, which makes this review the bottleneck. This paper presents a proof of concept that compares two training workflows on the same LLM, EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct, trained on operator manuals of one manufacturer. In approach A, a back-translator translates each language version back into English, and an English reader compares it with the English version. In approach B, a checker reads the English version and the translation together, where the checker reports differences. The test sets contain errors planted in numbers, units, opposite words, obligations, negations, and conditions in 24 languages, and they include unmodified text and meaning-preserving edits for alerts and false alarms. The trained back-translator concealed many planted errors, most of all weakened obligations, while translation-quality scores rose. In contrast, the separately trained checker detected most planted errors, although it was weak for units and for number changes unlike those in training. A check by the author confirmed the concealment. In addition, a simple rule check caught the number and unit changes, but it alerted on harmless rewrites. A check of alerts on real Finnish translations showed that most alerts were false, caused by language-specific wording, so the precision on real text remains a limitation. Within this setting, a trained checker might support, not replace, the review by competent persons, and firmer conclusions need more data.

translation.title: INVAR-Agri：使用微调 LLM 检测农机具多语言操作手册中的差异
translation.abstract: 农机具的操作手册以多种语言交付，标准要求由胜任人员审查每一份翻译，这使得审查成为瓶颈。本文提出一个概念验证，在同一 LLM（EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct）上比较两种训练工作流，该模型在一家制造商的操作手册上训练。在方法 A 中，回译器将每种语言版本翻译回英语，由英语阅读器将其与英语版本比较。在方法 B 中，检查器同时阅读英语版本和译文，并报告差异。测试集包含植入在 24 种语言中的数字、单位、反义词、义务、否定和条件方面的错误，还包括未修改的文本以及保留语义的编辑用于警报和误报。训练后的回译器掩盖了许多植入错误，尤其是被弱化的义务，而翻译质量分数却上升了。相比之下，单独训练的检查器检测到了大多数植入错误，尽管对单位和与训练中不同的数字变化较弱。作者的核查证实了掩盖现象。此外，一个简单的规则检查能捕获数字和单位变化，但会对无害的改写发出警报。对真实芬兰语译文的警报检查显示，大多数警报是误报，由语言特有的措辞引起，因此在真实文本上的精度仍是一个局限。在此设定下，训练后的检查器可以辅助而非替代胜任人员的审查，更可靠的结论需要更多数据。
translation.brief: 解决农机具多语言操作手册人工翻译审查瓶颈问题，采用在 EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct 上分别训练回译器和差异检查器两种工作流并植入错误测试的方法。

papers.title: MATCHA: A Chinese Multi-Disorder Mental Health Dataset with Cross-Lingual Analyses on Social Media
papers.abstract: Mental health research on social media has been dominated by English-language datasets and DSM-5-centered resources, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural understanding of online mental health expression. We introduce MATCHA, the first Chinese multi-disorder mental health dataset that links disorder-specific Weibo Super-Topic communities with users' broader public timelines. MATCHA covers seven DSM-5 disorders and a control group, comprising 46,025 cohort-level users and 1.8 million posts. The dataset distinguishes users with explicit self-disclosure evidence from broader disorder-related participants through an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline, and is released in a rigorously de-identified, controlled-access format. Using MATCHA, we analyze behavioral, linguistic, symptom-related, and life-event-related patterns across disorders, and conduct cross-lingual comparisons with Twitter-STMHD. Our analyses show that Weibo Super-Topics function as concentrated spaces for affective and health-related expression, while cross-platform differences between Weibo and Twitter often exceed cross-disorder variation. MATCHA provides a new resource for community-aware and cross-lingual mental health NLP research.

translation.title: MATCHA：中文多障碍心理健康数据集及社交媒体跨语言分析
translation.abstract: 社交媒体上的心理健康研究一直以英语数据集和以 DSM-5 为中心的资源为主，限制了对在线心理健康表达的跨语言和跨文化理解。我们介绍 MATCHA，这是首个中文多障碍心理健康数据集，将特定障碍的微博超话社区与用户更广泛的公开时间线关联起来。MATCHA 涵盖七种 DSM-5 障碍和一个对照组，包含 46,025 个队列级用户和 180 万条帖子。该数据集通过 LLM 辅助的标注流程，将具有明确自我披露证据的用户与更广泛的障碍相关参与者区分开来，并以严格去标识化、受控访问的形式发布。利用 MATCHA，我们分析了跨障碍的行为、语言、症状相关和生活事件相关模式，并与 Twitter-STMHD 进行了跨语言比较。我们的分析表明，微博超话是情感和健康相关表达的集中空间，而微博与 Twitter 之间的跨平台差异往往超过跨障碍差异。MATCHA 为社区感知和跨语言心理健康 NLP 研究提供了新资源。
translation.brief: 解决中文多障碍心理健康社交媒体数据缺乏的问题，通过关联微博超话社区与用户时间线并使用 LLM 辅助标注构建数据集 MATCHA。

papers.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
papers.abstract: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.

translation.title: 面向编码智能体的分层技能演化
translation.abstract: 技能为智能体提供可复用的经验，以在不修改底层模型的情况下指导未来决策。然而，编码轨迹往往与任务和仓库特定的上下文纠缠在一起，使得提炼出能在多样编码环境中泛化的程序性技能具有挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出分层技能演化（HSE），通过分层证据聚合从编码轨迹中逐步提炼程序性知识。HSE 首先从单个轨迹中提取任务级证据，然后在同一仓库内聚合重复出现的证据以形成仓库特定的技能候选，最后将跨仓库的一致模式整合为可跨仓库迁移的技能。演化由外部 writer-evaluator 循环驱动，在保持底层编码模型冻结的同时生成和评估技能。该循环外部更新 writer 和 evaluator 策略，以改进后续的技能生成和评估。这一层级结构逐步过滤任务特定细节，同时保留能在多样编码环境中泛化的程序。成功的轨迹为未来任务提供可复用的指导，而失败的轨迹揭示反复出现的失败模式，指导规避和恢复。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 和 DeepSWE 上评估 HSE，在 Pi 和 Claude Code harness 上使用 GLM-5.2，在 Pi 上使用 GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.8。在两个基准上，仅从 SWE-Gym 演化出的 10 个技能在所有评估设置中都提升了编码性能，展示了跨基准、编码模型和智能体 harness 的迁移能力。我们进一步从目标基准轨迹演化技能库，不依赖验证器反馈，仅依靠学习到的评估器进行候选评估，并通过基准定制的技能获得额外收益。
translation.brief: 解决编码轨迹与任务/仓库上下文纠缠导致技能难以跨环境泛化的问题，提出通过分层证据聚合和外部 writer-evaluator 循环逐步提炼可迁移技能的 HSE 方法。

papers.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
papers.abstract: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

translation.title: 评估 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 的失控与有害操纵风险
translation.abstract: 随着前沿语言模型日益强大和自主，独立的第三方评估对于刻画其系统性安全风险至关重要。虽然闭源发布通常伴随全面的系统卡，但开放权重模型在前沿风险方面受到的审视较少。为填补这一空白，我们对 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 进行了独立安全评估，这是 V4.1 Flash 的最新版本，以新架构、扩大规模的训练和强大的智能体能力区别于 V4。借鉴欧盟《通用人工智能实践准则》，我们在 34 个基准（包括 5 个内部套件）上评估该模型，涵盖评估完整性、失控和有害操纵。遵循 AEF-1 标准，我们将 V4.1 Flash-1017 与 V4.1 Flash、更早的 DeepSeek V4 模型以及领先的闭源系统（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash）进行比较。总体而言，V4.1 Flash-1017 相比 V4 一代显示出显著的安全改进，并在若干维度上接近或匹敌领先的闭源基线，但仍表现出值得持续关注的显著行为。基于我们的发现，我们提出三项关键观察和建议。第一，由于安全性可能在次要更新中变化甚至倒退，开发者应将安全评估整合到增量发布中。第二，由于仅靠最终轮输出和终态检查无法可靠检测失控行为，部署需要对推理轨迹和动作日志的流程级可观测性。第三，由于公开基准会引发强烈的评估意识并面临数据污染风险，开发私有基准对于可信的前沿评估至关重要。
translation.brief: 解决开放权重前沿模型安全审视不足的问题，采用基于欧盟 AI 实践准则的 34 项基准独立评估 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 的失控与有害操纵风险。

papers.title: Adapting LLM-SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction, Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.

translation.title: 将 LLM-SC 适配于活态神圣遗产：针对 Pashupatinath 神庙评论的领域特定抽取、语义网络与人工评估
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）流水线可以将游客评论转化为结构化数据，但通用方案可能遗漏活态神圣遗产地中的仪式、神圣空间、文化限制以及情感混杂的体验。我们针对尼泊尔 Pashupatinath 神庙适配了 LLM-Social Computing（LLM-SC）框架，在 GPT-4o 抽取提示中指定了 12 类实体分类体系（LLM-SC 原有 4 类加上 8 类神圣遗产类型）、4 种关系类型和 9 个方面-情感维度，并将其应用于从 3,939 条处理后语料中固定随机抽取的 2,500 条英文 Tripadvisor 评论。导出结果包含 11,286 条实体、6,232 条方面-情感和 5,590 条关系记录，分别覆盖 2,485、2,487 和 2,433 条评论；新增的 8 类神圣遗产类型占实体记录的 64.8%。以 200 条评论的双标注者裁定参考为基准，精确的规范化表面-类型匹配给出初步实体得分为 41.0% 精确率、21.8% 召回率和 28.4% 微平均 F1。方面存在性 F1 为 53.6%，端到端方面加极性 F1 为 42.6%。人工裁定支持 194 个首列关系候选中的 153 个（每条评论一个；78.9%），该候选级比率并不能估计关系召回率或整图精确率。贡献在于一种具有文化根基的领域特定适配，包含逐组件的人工评估以及明确说明的可复现性与泛化局限。
translation.brief: 针对通用 LLM 信息抽取方案无法捕捉活态神圣遗产地特有内容的问题，通过为 Pashupatinath 神庙定制实体、关系与方面-情感分类体系并辅以人工评估，将 LLM-SC 框架适配到该领域。

papers.title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
papers.abstract: For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost. This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries. Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.
authors: Chenchen Kuai (Zachry Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
Jiwan Jiang (Zachry Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
Yunlong Zhang (Zachry Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
Zhiwen Fan (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Zhengzhong Tu (Department of Computer Science and Engineering
Yang Zhou (Zachry Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

translation.title: 从自信度到统计准确性：通过直接审计与 LLM 辅助审计扩展人在回路评估
translation.abstract: 对于大语言模型（LLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM），模型报告的自置信度往往校准不佳，但仍可能对高效评估有用。与此同时，LLM-as-a-judge 提供了直接人工审计的可扩展替代方案，但其实际收益取决于校准质量和推理成本。本文为两种评估路径在不同采样策略下建立了统一的统计框架。对于直接审计，采用置信度分层采样从部分验证的输出中恢复总体准确率，而无需校准的置信度。文中刻画了有限样本不确定性，并分析了高度不均衡的置信度分层如何影响审计效率和标签分配。对于 judge 辅助评估，通过敏感性和假阳性率对 judge 进行建模，得到带校准不确定性的误差校正估计量。随后通过人工标签效率和总成本效率边界比较两条路径。在 MMLU-Pro 和 MMMU-Pro 上的实验表明，校准不佳的自置信度仍可支持统计上有效的分层审计。在高度不均衡的置信度分布下，比例分配相对每层等量分配显著降低估计误差。对于 judge 辅助评估，只有一小部分目标-验证器对满足理想化的人工标签效率条件，且自动化推理成本可能进一步限制潜在节省。这些发现阐明了置信度引导审计和自动化验证发挥作用的统计与经济条件。
translation.brief: 针对模型自置信度校准不佳时如何高效评估 LLM 的问题，建立统一统计框架，用置信度分层采样支持直接审计，并用误差校正估计量支持 LLM-as-a-judge 辅助评估。

papers.title: Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents
papers.abstract: Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential "jaggedness" of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.

translation.title: 量化 LLM 研究代理的论断平滑现象
translation.abstract: 深度研究，或任何利用大语言模型（LLM）阅读大量文档集合并产出洞见的应用，都需要综合来自不同来源的信息。在这项工作中，我们发现 LLM 生成的长篇研究报告读起来像自信的综合，却未能准确反映底层文档。我们将这种失败称为平滑（smoothing）。在将多样且可能冲突的来源压缩为单一叙述时，模型丢弃了语料库的证据"参差性"，并断言出比引用所能支持的更决断的结论。我们引入一个论断级评分流水线 SmoothScore 来量化这一效应。该流水线从模型生成的报告中抽取关键结论性论断，然后找到与每个论断相关的证据，并将证据按高层方面聚类。最后，针对证据对每个论断进行评分，以量化代理所做的平滑程度。在 7 个系统和 4 个数据集上，我们发现代理持续产出比实际依据更强的论断。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 研究报告将冲突来源压缩为过度决断结论的"平滑"问题，提出 SmoothScore 论断级评分流水线，通过抽取论断、检索并聚类证据来量化平滑程度。

papers.title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?
papers.abstract: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27--29\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. This loss of initial successes is substantially larger than under fixed-order repetition, even for highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.

translation.title: 理解 Jev 式 System One 模型：结构能否减少选择偏差？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的选择偏差可能持续存在，即使有忽略呈现顺序的指令或引出推理的提示。近期复现 Jev 式 System One 行为的努力产生了一族直接对给定候选预测概率的模型。然而，在多选项任务中，对 Jev 各版本、Jev 复现模型和生成式 LLM 之间选择偏差的系统性比较仍然有限。这就留下一个核心问题：Jev 式决策结构能否减少选择偏差？我们用一个简单的测试来回答这个问题：在保持问题和候选内容不变的情况下打乱选项顺序。在两个 Jev 版本、十二个 Jev 复现模型和六个生成式 LLM 上，我们追踪个体答案在八种呈现中的表现，并与固定顺序重复进行比较。在我们从两个基准收集的 1,700 个问题的主数据集上，Jev 的准确率变化不到两个百分点，但其累积失败集相对原始顺序扩大了 27–29%，且首次失败持续到最后的呈现。这种初始成功的损失远大于固定顺序重复下的情况，即使对于高度可重复的 Jev 复现模型也是如此。Jev 在保持正确选择方面也没有表现出对 LLM 基线的普遍优势。聚合提供的保护有限：投票为 Jev 带来适度收益，而即使是一致同意的答案也经常出错。这些结果揭示了可重复决策与在等价呈现中保持正确的决策之间的差距，说明为何仅凭稳定的准确率无法证明对选择偏差的抵抗力。
translation.brief: 针对 Jev 式直接预测概率的模型结构能否减少 LLM 选择偏差的问题，通过打乱选项顺序的测试比较 Jev、其复现模型与生成式 LLM 的表现。

papers.title: Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
papers.abstract: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.

translation.title: 以保留促扩展：面向多语言 LLM-based ASR 的源语言感知适配与模型合并
translation.abstract: 当多语言 ASR 系统的扩展必须在不重放源语言训练数据的情况下保留先前支持的语言时，扩展到新语言极具挑战性。我们在基于连接器（connector-based）的 Speech LLM 中研究这一问题，其中可训练的连接器将语音表示映射到冻结的大语言模型。我们评估了在保留源语言性能的同时适配连接器的目标更新构建与合并策略。在单目标扩展中，仅目标微调和标准 TIES 合并能学习新语言，但会导致严重的源语言遗忘，而 SSU-Wanda+TIES 提供了最佳的源语言保留权衡。在多目标扩展中，更新合并提供了稳定的源语言保留，而递归扩展在有利顺序下可以改善目标适配，但对顺序高度敏感。这些结果表明，多语言 ASR 扩展需要在目标获取、源语言保留以及目标语言更新之间的交互之间取得平衡。
translation.brief: 针对在不重放源语言数据的情况下扩展多语言 ASR 并保留旧语言性能的问题，在 Speech LLM 连接器上评估不同的目标更新构建与模型合并策略。

papers.title: A pedagogically guided LLM framework for scaffolding human-AI cocreation and preserving learners' agency and creativity
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate alternatives, elaborate ideas and supply rationales, overlapping with cognitive work learners are expected to perform. However, human-AI cocreation still lacks a mechanism for determining how AI can scaffold learners' creative decision-making. This study develops a cognitive-pedagogical framework for deriving the behaviour of a pedagogically constrained LLM from an educator-approved specification of each activity in a cocreative process in project-based learning. The creative-process phase supplies the activity's purpose, typical processes and pedagogical conditions; the active section of a creative technique specifies how the group works on its ideas. For each task, an educator approves four fields: a cognitive and metacognitive objective, a pedagogical objective, the task and group artefact as context, and the learner-owned product. The objective identifies the creative operations and decisions about progress, focus, criteria and next steps that remain with the group. Four translation rules derive permitted support, timing, feedback scope and prohibitions. The framework is illustrated with Viacocrea's six phases and two activities: Plan Brainstorming and a constructed Build activity using PPCo (Pluses, Potentials, Concerns, Overcoming concerns). In the proposed workflow, a controller applies the approved specification to student requests and feedback offers. Prompt engineering and approved pedagogical guidance retrieved through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) inform a draft, which is checked for form, pedagogical function and safety before delivery. The worked examples illustrate how support can differ between activities while its constraints remain traceable to educator decisions. The framework offers educators and researchers a reusable way to derive LLM support from creative activities while preserving learners' agency and creativity.

translation.title: 一种以教学法为指导的LLM框架：支持人机共创脚手架并保留学习者的能动性与创造力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够生成备选方案、细化想法并提供理由，这与学习者应完成的认知工作相重叠。然而，人机共创仍缺乏确定AI如何为学习者的创造性决策提供脚手架支持的机制。本研究开发了一个认知-教学法框架，从教育者批准的、对项目式学习共创过程中每项活动的规范中推导出受教学法约束的LLM行为。创意过程阶段提供活动的目的、典型过程和教学条件；创意技术的活跃部分规定小组如何处理其想法。对于每项任务，教育者批准四个字段：认知与元认知目标、教学目标、作为上下文的任务与小组产物，以及归学习者所有的产品。目标界定了保留给小组的创造性操作以及关于进展、焦点、标准和下一步的决策。四条转换规则推导出允许的支持、时机、反馈范围和禁止事项。该框架以Viacocrea的六个阶段和两项活动为例进行说明：计划头脑风暴和使用PPCo（优点、潜力、顾虑、克服顾虑）的构建活动。在提出的工作流中，控制器将批准的规范应用于学生请求和反馈提议。通过提示工程和经检索增强生成（RAG）检索的已批准教学指导形成草稿，在交付前检查其形式、教学功能与安全性。示例说明支持如何在活动之间有所不同，同时其约束可追溯至教育者的决策。该框架为教育者和研究者提供了一种可复用的方法，从创造性活动中推导LLM支持，同时保留学习者的能动性与创造力。
translation.brief: 解决AI在共创中如何为学习者创造性决策提供脚手架的问题，核心方法是从教育者批准的活动规范出发，通过转换规则和RAG约束LLM的支持行为。

papers.title: Being judged through the record: A Rosenhan-inspired test of psychiatric label sensitivity in large language models
papers.abstract: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into clinical decision-making raises unresolved questions regarding diagnostic bias. We investigate whether a documented psychiatric history alters LLM recommendations when the current clinical evidence is identical. Using a counterfactual experiment inspired by Rosenhan's 1973 field study, we factorially varied diagnostic-history condition (no prior diagnosis stated vs. prior schizophrenia diagnosis) and current-evidence condition (voices ceased vs. voices persisted) within a clinical vignette. Across five LLMs (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Grok 4.6, and Mistral Large 2512), we generated 20,000 model responses across independent queries. When evidence supported discharge, adding a prior schizophrenia diagnosis increased recommendations for continued hospitalization nearly fivefold, from 4.7% to 22.3% (risk difference, 17.5 percentage points; 95% CI, 16.2-18.8). This shift occurred across all five models (risk-difference range, 10.4-34.4 percentage points). In the same condition, reference concordance decreased from 95.3% to 77.7%, while stated decision confidence increased. Across all model-by-evidence contrasts, confidence increases corresponded to Cohen's d values of 0.35-1.09. Signal-detection analyses showed that the prior diagnosis shifted the decision criterion toward hospitalization across all five models and reduced discrimination between the two current-evidence conditions in three of them. When current evidence supported continued hospitalization, the label increased the recommendation for hospitalization from 92.6% to 97.0%.

translation.title: 被记录所评判：受Rosenhan启发的LLM精神科标签敏感性测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）融入临床决策引发了关于诊断偏见的未解问题。我们研究在当前临床证据完全相同的情况下，记录在案的精神病史是否会改变LLM的建议。受Rosenhan 1973年田野研究启发的反事实实验中，我们在临床案例描述内对诊断史条件（未提及既往诊断 vs. 既往精神分裂症诊断）和当前证据条件（幻听已停止 vs. 幻听持续）进行因子化变化。在五个LLM（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Sonnet 5、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Grok 4.6和Mistral Large 2512）上，我们通过独立查询生成了20,000条模型响应。当证据支持出院时，加入既往精神分裂症诊断使继续住院的建议增加近五倍，从4.7%升至22.3%（风险差17.5个百分点；95% CI，16.2-18.8）。这一变化在所有五个模型中都存在（风险差范围10.4-34.4个百分点）。在同一条件下，与参考答案的一致性从95.3%降至77.7%，而声明的决策置信度却上升。在所有模型-证据对比中，置信度上升对应Cohen's d值为0.35-1.09。信号检测分析显示，既往诊断使所有五个模型的决策标准向住院偏移，并降低了其中三个模型对两种当前证据条件的区分能力。当当前证据支持继续住院时，该标签使住院建议从92.6%升至97.0%。
translation.brief: 解决LLM临床建议是否受既往精神科诊断标签偏见影响的问题，核心方法是受Rosenhan启发的反事实案例实验，因子化操纵诊断史与当前证据。

papers.title: LLMs in Cloud: A Discussion on Architecture, Orchestration, and Inference
papers.abstract: The widespread deployment of foundational Large Language Models (LLM) across cloud datacenters marks a fundamental paradigm shift from stateless deep learning toward distributed, memory-intensive generative workloads. However, serving massive foundation models under stringent Service Level Objectives (SLO) exposes critical physical and system bottlenecks. These challenges include the persistent High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) wall, operational asymmetry between compute-bound prefilling and memory-bandwidth-bound decoding, explosive Key-Value (KV) cache expansion, prohibitive serverless cold starts, and hardware reliability vulnerabilities. Existing literature reviews remain layer-siloed, decoupling low-level accelerator virtualization from cluster orchestration and runtime inference, while largely overlooking defining advancements from 2024 to 2026. To address these limitations, this study presents a comprehensive, cross-layer systematic review guided by the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 framework. We synthesize a holistic taxonomy unifying hardware virtualization, cluster-level scheduling, and runtime inference optimizations, including iteration-level continuous batching, prefill-decoding disaggregation, and hierarchical KV cache offloading. Furthermore, we evaluate resilient cloud-native service architectures, examining scale-to-zero serverless paradigms, fault-tolerant checkpointing against silent data corruption, and hardware-enforced Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for multi-tenant isolation. Finally, we formalize the multi-dimensional Pareto trade-offs governing throughput, latency, monetary cost, and confidentiality, outlining a forward-looking research roadmap spanning Compute Express Link (CXL) memory pooling, in-memory computing, and autonomous multi-agent control planes to guide future cloud LLM infrastructure.

translation.title: 云端LLM：架构、编排与推理探讨
translation.abstract: 基础大语言模型（LLM）在云数据中心的广泛部署标志着从无状态深度学习向分布式、内存密集型生成式工作负载的根本范式转变。然而，在严格的服务级别目标（SLO）下服务大规模基础模型暴露出关键的物理与系统瓶颈。这些挑战包括持续存在的高带宽内存（HBM）墙、计算受限的预填充与内存带宽受限的解码之间的操作不对称、Key-Value（KV）缓存的爆炸式增长、高昂的serverless冷启动以及硬件可靠性脆弱性。现有文献综述仍局限于分层孤岛，将底层加速器虚拟化与集群编排和运行时推理割裂，且大多忽视了2024至2026年的重大进展。为解决这些局限，本研究以PRISMA 2020框架为指导，提供了全面的跨层系统综述。我们综合出一个统一的整体分类法，涵盖硬件虚拟化、集群级调度和运行时推理优化，包括迭代级continuous batching、prefill-decoding分离和分层KV缓存卸载。此外，我们评估了有韧性的云原生服务架构，考察了scale-to-zero serverless范式、针对静默数据损坏的容错检查点，以及用于多租户隔离的硬件强制可信执行环境（TEE）。最后，我们形式化了吞吐量、延迟、成本与机密性之间的多维Pareto权衡，并勾勒出涵盖Compute Express Link（CXL）内存池化、存内计算和自主多智能体控制平面的前瞻性研究路线图，以指导未来的云LLM基础设施。
translation.brief: 解决云上LLM服务文献分层割裂、缺乏跨层综述的问题，核心方法是按PRISMA 2020框架系统梳理硬件虚拟化、集群调度与运行时推理优化的统一分类法。

papers.title: DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving relies on batching to improve inference throughput, but the key-value (KV) cache grows with sequence length and limits GPU-resident concurrency. CPU offloading can expand KV capacity using host memory, yet existing systems remain largely GPU-gated: CPU-resident requests make progress only when the GPU scheduler exposes suitable overlap opportunities. As a result, host memory and CPU compute cannot act as an independent serving resource, leading to bursty CPU-side progress and inflated tail inter-token latency (ITL) under load. We present DualPace, an LLM serving runtime that turns the host into an independently scheduled decode engine. DualPace separates scheduling authority across two engines: the GPU engine executes prefills and GPU-resident decodes, while an AMX-enabled CPU engine independently batches and advances CPU-resident decodes. The engines are decoupled in scheduling but cooperative in execution: the CPU can execute a complete decode iteration locally or selectively invoke GPU Dense Assist for dense stages, while offline profiles guide hardware-specific batching and routing. Our evaluations show that, in decode-oriented scenarios, DualPace improves serving throughput by 6.9--43.2\% over NEO, a state-of-the-art open-source CPU-offloading system, and by 11.5--90.6\% over vLLM, a widely used GPU serving system, while maintaining the same level of latency. DualPace also preserves NEO's P99 time-to-first-token (TTFT) advantage over vLLM while sustaining 7.3--50.5\% higher request rates than NEO at the same level of P99 ITL.

translation.title: DualPace：面向LLM服务的解耦调度与GPU-CPU协同解码
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务依赖批处理提升推理吞吐量，但key-value（KV）缓存随序列长度增长，限制了GPU驻留并发。CPU卸载可利用主机内存扩展KV容量，但现有系统在很大程度上仍由GPU门控：CPU驻留请求仅在GPU调度器暴露合适重叠机会时才能取得进展。因此，主机内存和CPU算力无法作为独立的服务资源，导致CPU侧进展突发性以及负载下尾间令牌延迟（ITL）膨胀。我们提出DualPace，一个将主机转变为独立调度解码引擎的LLM服务运行时。DualPace将调度权分离到两个引擎：GPU引擎执行预填充和GPU驻留解码，而启用AMX的CPU引擎独立批处理并推进CPU驻留解码。两引擎调度解耦但执行协作：CPU可在本地执行完整解码迭代，或选择性地调用GPU Dense Assist处理稠密阶段，同时离线剖析指导硬件特定的批处理与路由。评估显示，在面向解码的场景中，DualPace相比最先进的开源CPU卸载系统NEO将服务吞吐量提升6.9-43.2%，相比广泛使用的GPU服务系统vLLM提升11.5-90.6%，同时保持相同延迟水平。DualPace还保持了NEO相对vLLM的P99首令牌时间（TTFT）优势，同时在相同P99 ITL水平下比NEO维持7.3-50.5%更高的请求速率。
translation.brief: 解决CPU卸载系统中CPU资源受GPU调度门控、无法独立服务的问题，核心方法是将主机变为独立调度的AMX解码引擎，与GPU引擎调度解耦、执行协作。

papers.title: Replicate What Varies: Resource Sharing for Domain-Randomized Embodied Simulation
papers.abstract: Simulation provides a low-cost sandbox where embodied agents can attempt tasks, observe outcomes, and learn from experience. Running many diverse simulation environments concurrently can consume substantial CPU and GPU memory because independently constructed scenes duplicate resources that remain unchanged across instances. We present Patchwork, a resource-sharing system for domain-randomized simulation, built around the representation $E=T+\Delta$: a shared template contains common resources, and a patch records the mutations needed to construct a target environment. Patchwork separates randomization sampling from replay and selects reusable templates together with patches that preserve each target environment's intended configuration. Its layered runtime shares compiled model structure and immutable assets while keeping mutable parameters and simulation state private to each instance. We implement Patchwork on robosuite and MuJoCo and evaluate it on LIBERO-plus and RoboCasa365 workloads. At 32 replicas, shared-template execution reduces CPU RSS by 88-92% relative to process-per-environment execution. Controlled experiments show how sharing shifts memory growth toward template diversity and unique asset content rather than instance count, within the supported sharing boundaries.

translation.title: 复制变化之处：面向域随机化具身仿真的资源共享
translation.abstract: 仿真为具身智能体提供了一个低成本沙箱，可以尝试任务、观察结果并从经验中学习。并发运行多个多样化的仿真环境会消耗大量CPU和GPU内存，因为独立构建的场景会复制跨实例保持不变的资源。我们提出Patchwork，一个面向域随机化仿真的资源共享系统，围绕表示$E=T+\Delta$构建：共享模板包含公共资源，补丁记录构造目标环境所需的变更。Patchwork将随机化采样与重放分离，并选择可复用模板以及保留每个目标环境预期配置的补丁。其分层运行时共享编译后的模型结构和不可变资产，同时将可变参数和仿真状态保持为每个实例私有。我们在robosuite和MuJoCo上实现Patchwork，并在LIBERO-plus和RoboCasa365工作负载上评估。在32个副本时，共享模板执行相比每环境一进程执行将CPU RSS降低88-92%。受控实验表明，在支持的共享边界内，共享如何将内存增长转向模板多样性和独特资产内容而非实例数量。
translation.brief: 解决域随机化仿真中多实例重复复制不变资源导致内存开销过大的问题，核心方法是模板加补丁（E=T+Δ）的资源共享表示，共享不变资源、隔离可变状态。

papers.title: NovaFabric: A Black-Box Recorder for AI Agents with Sealed, Replayable, Diffable and Auditable Runs
papers.abstract: An AI agent run is no longer a function call. It is a cascade of prompts, model calls, tool invocations, file and network effects and sub-agents. When such a run misbehaves, or an auditor asks what happened, logs and traces answer poorly: they are mutable, partial and cannot be re-executed. This technical report describes NovaFabric, an open-source (Apache-2.0) black-box recorder for AI agents that turns a run into a sealed, replayable, diffable and auditable evidence capsule. The design rests on two formats only. The Run Capsule is a directory of flat files and the source of truth; every database is a rebuildable index over capsules. The Evidence Bundle is the signed export for an auditor. Everything else follows existing standards: OpenTelemetry GenAI, OpenLineage, W3C PROV, in-toto/DSSE, RFC 3161 and CycloneDX. A single-node run is the smallest case of a distributed one; the schema supports a capsule hierarchy for Slurm arrays and Kubernetes jobs, though automatic parent finalization is library-only today. The report covers the architecture and the engines behind the verb chain capture, seal, replay, diff and audit: fail-closed mocked replay; a diff gate with a stable exit-code contract; DSSE signatures that bind their intent and a capsule root that commits to file names; a capsule treated as untrusted input; signer identity-trust levels with offline TSA and CRL checking; maker-checker promotion against an operator-held trust list; and a deny-by-default authorization table for every dashboard route. It presents no new experiments; the evaluation is in arXiv:2609.12582. Every count except the private ADR tally is generated by a probe script run on the public source at the v0.107.0 tag (150 top-level commands, 84 Python subpackages, 16,721 test functions), every capability carries an explicit maturity label, and honest-limits boxes state where the system stops.

translation.title: NovaFabric：面向 AI Agent 的黑盒记录器，实现密封、可重放、可对比与可审计的运行记录
translation.abstract: AI Agent 的一次运行已不再是一个函数调用，而是提示词、模型调用、工具调用、文件与网络副作用以及子 Agent 的级联过程。当这样的运行出现异常，或审计者询问发生了什么时，日志和追踪往往难以胜任：它们可被篡改、不完整且无法重新执行。本技术报告介绍 NovaFabric，一个开源（Apache-2.0）的 AI Agent 黑盒记录器，它将一次运行转化为密封、可重放、可对比、可审计的证据胶囊。设计仅依赖两种格式：Run Capsule 是扁平文件目录，作为事实来源；每个数据库都是胶囊之上可重建的索引。Evidence Bundle 是面向审计者的签名导出物。其余一切均遵循现有标准：OpenTelemetry GenAI、OpenLineage、W3C PROV、in-toto/DSSE、RFC 3161 和 CycloneDX。单节点运行是分布式运行的最小情形；模式支持面向 Slurm 数组和 Kubernetes 作业的胶囊层级，尽管自动父级终结目前仅在库中实现。报告涵盖动词链 capture、seal、replay、diff 和 audit 背后的架构与引擎：fail-closed 的模拟重放；具有稳定退出码契约的 diff 门控；绑定其意图的 DSSE 签名和提交到文件名的胶囊根；将胶囊视为不可信输入；带离线 TSA 和 CRL 检查的签名者身份信任级别；针对操作员持有信任清单的 maker-checker 提升；以及面向每个仪表盘路由的默认拒绝授权表。本报告不呈现新实验；评估见 arXiv:2609.12582。除私有 ADR 计数外，所有计数均由在 v0.107.0 标签的公开源码上运行的探测脚本生成（150 个顶层命令、84 个 Python 子包、16,721 个测试函数），每项能力都带有明确的成熟度标签，并以诚实限制框说明系统的边界。
translation.brief: 解决 AI Agent 运行记录不可信、不可重放、难以审计的问题，核心方法是将运行封装为基于标准格式的密封证据胶囊，并配套捕获、密封、重放、对比与审计引擎。

papers.title: HiLO: Towards Product-Level Graceful Degradation with a Quality-Aware, Load-Aware Control Framework
papers.abstract: Graceful degradation is a key mechanism employed by large-scale systems to handle overload conditions. Its importance has grown further as GPU-intensive LLM inference introduces persistent capacity constraints that cannot be addressed through provisioning alone. Common degradation approaches rely on service-level mechanisms such as load shedding and circuit breakers, or on feature-level switches (some manually controlled) to preserve availability and quality. While effective at protecting services, such approaches lead to untestable product states and thereby unpredictable product quality. We present HiLO (High Load Optimizer), an automated product-level degradation system designed to handle graceful degradation at scale. HiLO maps observed load to a product state lattice: a small set of pre-validated product states, partially ordered by degradation severity. Dependencies are resolved at design time enabling deterministic and continuous control without requiring runtime dependency discovery. The same abstraction applies unchanged across heterogeneous services, including GPU-intensive deep models, LLMs and their serving layers. At Microsoft, HiLO is deployed in Bing (serving over a billion monthly active users), where it manages on average two traffic surges per week across all datacenters, bounding OneDCG (relevance) drop to under 0.5 points (the operational target) even under sustained load exceeding 2$\times$ baseline peak. HiLO complements existing service-level protections with product-level coordination and makes product quality measurable, testable and predictable.

translation.title: HiLO：以质量感知、负载感知的控制框架实现产品级优雅降级
translation.abstract: 优雅降级是大规模系统应对过载的关键机制。随着 GPU 密集型 LLM 推理带来无法仅靠扩容解决的持续容量约束，其重要性进一步提升。常见的降级方法依赖服务级机制（如负载削减和熔断器）或功能级开关（部分为手动控制）来保持可用性和质量。这些方法虽能有效保护服务，却导致产品状态不可测试，从而使产品质量不可预测。我们提出 HiLO（High Load Optimizer），一个面向大规模优雅降级的自动化产品级降级系统。HiLO 将观测到的负载映射到产品状态格：一组经过预验证、按降级严重程度偏序排列的产品状态。依赖关系在设计期解决，从而实现确定性、连续的控制，无需运行期依赖发现。同一抽象可原样应用于异构服务，包括 GPU 密集型深度模型、LLM 及其服务层。在 Microsoft，HiLO 部署于 Bing（服务超过十亿月活用户），平均每周在所有数据中心管理两次流量激增，即使在超过 2 倍基线峰值的持续负载下，也将 OneDCG（相关性）下降限制在 0.5 分（运营目标）以内。HiLO 以产品级协调补充现有服务级保护，使产品质量可度量、可测试、可预测。
translation.brief: 解决过载时服务级降级导致产品质量不可预测的问题，核心方法是将负载映射到预验证的产品状态格以实现确定性的产品级降级控制。

papers.title: Waypoint: Analytically Modeling GEMM for CPUs
papers.abstract: High-performance General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) implementations rely on breaking down GEMM into carefully selected tiles to achieve peak performance. We present Waypoint, a new analytical model to automatically identify the optimal tile size for a given hardware and input matrix shape. Waypoint estimates the achievable performance for a given tile choice by capturing all the architectural effects including interactions with memory hierarchy, instruction-level parallelism, and multi-threading. Using the estimates as a proxy, we search through the space of possible tile sizes to identify the one that maximizes performance. Additionally, Waypoint helps hardware designers estimate realistic performance on experimental hardware optimizations. We build a new GEMM library OPAM for CPUs that uses Waypoint to automatically break down GEMM and achieve performance that matches state-of-the-art GEMM libraries and helps accelerate LLM inference on CPUs achieving $1.36 - 1.98 \times$ speedups.

translation.title: Waypoint：面向 CPU 的 GEMM 解析建模
translation.abstract: 高性能通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）实现依赖将 GEMM 分解为精心选择的分块以达到峰值性能。我们提出 Waypoint，一个新的解析模型，可自动为给定硬件和输入矩阵形状识别最优分块大小。Waypoint 通过捕捉所有体系结构效应（包括与内存层级的交互、指令级并行和多线程）来估计给定分块选择可达到的性能。以这些估计作为代理，我们在可能的分块大小空间中搜索以找出性能最大者。此外，Waypoint 帮助硬件设计者估计实验性硬件优化上的现实性能。我们构建了一个新的 CPU GEMM 库 OPAM，它使用 Waypoint 自动分解 GEMM，达到与最先进 GEMM 库相当的性能，并加速 CPU 上的 LLM 推理，实现 1.36–1.98 倍加速。
translation.brief: 解决 CPU 上 GEMM 分块大小难以自动选择的问题，核心方法是构建捕捉内存层级、指令级并行与多线程效应的解析模型并据此搜索最优分块。

papers.title: Governing Enterprise AI Traffic at Scale: Design and Operation of a Policy-Driven, Multi-Vendor LLM Gateway on Envoy
papers.abstract: Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol and pricing. Integrated directly, this heterogeneity yields credential sprawl, format lock-in, unbounded spend and inconsistent governance. We present the design and production operation of the Cosmos LLM Gateway, the governed entry point for enterprise LLM traffic at PayPal. Built on Envoy, it splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control decisions (authentication, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) run in an out-of-process external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter, so that, by default, streamed response body chunks never wait on an out-of-process call. Models, providers and prices are largely validated data rather than code. Governance is declarative policy evaluated by Open Policy Agent and managed through a control plane with role-scoped authoring, approvals, pilots, shadow-mode rollout, usage notifications and versioned policy bundles. For use cases that require it, a data-loss-prevention layer can block, redact or pseudonymize detected sensitive content before it reaches a provider. Spend scopes are views over per-model usage counters, so a new budget applies to spend already recorded in its window without migration. As of September 2026, the gateway serves more than 12,000 developers and hundreds of business use cases, handling roughly 200 billion tokens per day across more than 100 models at 99.999% availability to business. In a benchmark of the core request path against a synthetic upstream, it adds a median of 4 ms and a p99 of 11 ms of overhead at more than 2,200 requests per second on two 4-vCPU instances.
