We report the architecture, policy model, evaluation and lessons learned.

translation.title: 大规模治理企业 AI 流量：基于 Envoy 的策略驱动多供应商 LLM 网关的设计与运营
translation.abstract: 大型组织同时消费来自多个供应商的大语言模型（LLM），每个供应商都有各自的 API 方言、凭证模型、流式协议和定价。直接集成时，这种异构性导致凭证蔓延、格式锁定、无限制支出和不一致的治理。我们介绍 Cosmos LLM Gateway 的设计与生产运营，它是 PayPal 企业 LLM 流量的受治理入口。该网关基于 Envoy 构建，按延迟特征划分工作：I/O 密集的控制决策（认证、凭证代理、策略与预算评估）在进程外 external-processing 服务中运行，而线上格式转换、token 计量和提示缓存整形在代理内以 Rust WebAssembly 过滤器运行，因此默认情况下流式响应体分块永远不会等待进程外调用。模型、供应商和价格在很大程度上是经过验证的数据而非代码。治理是由 Open Policy Agent 评估的声明式策略，并通过控制平面管理，包括角色范围化的编写、审批、试点、影子模式发布、使用通知和版本化策略包。对于需要的用例，数据防泄漏层可在敏感内容到达供应商之前进行阻断、脱敏或假名化。支出范围是按模型使用计数器之上的视图，因此新预算无需迁移即可适用于其窗口内已记录的支出。截至 2026 年 9 月，该网关服务超过 12,000 名开发者和数百个业务用例，每天在 100 多个模型上处理约 2000 亿 token，对业务的可用性达 99.999%。在针对合成上游的核心请求路径基准测试中，它在两个 4-vCPU 实例上每秒处理超过 2,200 个请求时，仅增加中位数 4 ms、p99 11 ms 的开销。我们报告其架构、策略模型、评估和经验教训。
translation.brief: 解决企业多供应商 LLM 使用中凭证蔓延、格式锁定与治理不一致的问题，核心方法是在 Envoy 上构建按延迟特征划分进程内外工作的策略驱动 LLM 网关。

papers.title: Interpreting LLM Scores in Peer Review: Alignment and Divergence Across Prompts, Domains, and Manuscript Features
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) scores are being studied as information for scholarly evaluation. Interpreting these scores requires evidence about agreement with human judgments and its variation across evaluation conditions. Guided by an argument-based approach to validation, we compare four LLMs on 7,083 public ICLR 2024 submissions under a standard review condition and examine ten prompt conditions using DeepSeek-V3.2. We distinguish average score divergence, paper-level absolute error, and rank correlation, then examine domain differences and adjusted manuscript-feature associations. For DeepSeek-V3.2, Area Chair guidance reduces mean rating divergence from 1.460 to 0.199 points and mean absolute error from 1.577 to 0.942, while rank correlation changes from 0.377 to 0.387. Historical references combined with downward scoring instructions yield mean divergence of 0.052 and rank correlation of 0.321. Domain differences remain after global calibration. Longer titles have positive adjusted associations with rating divergence, and formula density has negative associations across all four configurations. These findings connect score interpretation to the scoring procedure, evaluation context, and manuscript information represented in the comparison. They show why aggregate alignment, manuscript ordering, and correspondence within manuscript groups require distinct evidence when evaluating LLM-generated scholarly assessment information.

translation.title: 解读同行评审中的 LLM 评分：跨提示、领域与稿件特征的一致与分歧
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）评分正被研究作为学术评估的信息来源。解读这些评分需要关于其与人类判断一致性及其在不同评估条件下变化的证据。在基于论证的效度方法指导下，我们在标准评审条件下比较四个 LLM 对 7,083 篇公开 ICLR 2024 投稿的评分，并使用 DeepSeek-V3.2 检验十种提示条件。我们区分平均分分歧、论文级绝对误差和秩相关，然后考察领域差异和调整后的稿件特征关联。对于 DeepSeek-V3.2，Area Chair 指导将平均评分分歧从 1.460 分降至 0.199 分，平均绝对误差从 1.577 降至 0.942，而秩相关从 0.377 变为 0.387。历史参考文献结合向下评分指令产生 0.052 的平均分歧和 0.321 的秩相关。全局校准后领域差异仍然存在。更长的标题与评分分歧有正向调整关联，公式密度在所有四种配置中均呈负向关联。这些发现将评分解读与评分程序、评估语境以及比较中所代表的稿件信息联系起来。它们说明为何在评估 LLM 生成的学术评估信息时，总体一致性、稿件排序以及稿件组内的对应关系需要不同的证据。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 同行评审评分难以解读的问题，核心方法是在多种提示与评估条件下系统比较 LLM 与人类评分的一致性、绝对误差和秩相关及其与稿件特征的关联。

papers.title: Verse: Semantics and Verification of Hybrid Multi-Agent Scenarios
papers.abstract: Verifying cyber-physical systems with many interacting agents remains difficult because interactions are mediated by sensors, individual decisions are constrained by environment (map) structure, and the resulting mode space scales combinatorially. We present Verse, a framework for writing agents, maps, and sensors in a familiar programming language syntax, with a formal semantics for the resulting scenarios. A compiler translates each scenario to a hybrid automaton whose executions correspond exactly to the runs of the scenario. Reachability analysis on this automaton builds an execution tree from two post operators, one for continuous flow over a time step and one for a single agent's mode change, and checks safety assertions at every vertex. The tree expands only the modes that are reached, without enumerating the global mode space. Experiments highlight expressive modeling across cars and drones, 2D/3D maps (including OpenDRIVE imports), noisy sensors, and multiple simultaneous safety assertions. Verse verifies a scenario with 7 agents and 37 modes in 90 seconds on a standard laptop; it is competitive with CORA and JuliaReach on ARCH benchmarks, and on multi-agent scenarios is an order of magnitude faster than JuliaReach at the cost of looser reachable sets.

translation.title: Verse：混合多智能体场景的语义与验证
translation.abstract: 验证包含大量交互智能体的信息物理系统仍然困难，因为交互由传感器介导、个体决策受环境（地图）结构约束，且由此产生的模式空间呈组合级增长。我们提出 Verse，一个以熟悉的编程语言语法编写智能体、地图和传感器的框架，并为所得场景提供形式化语义。编译器将每个场景翻译为一个混合自动机，其执行与场景的运行精确对应。在该自动机上进行可达性分析，通过两个后继算子（一个用于一个时间步内的连续流，一个用于单个智能体的模式切换）构建执行树，并在每个顶点检查安全性断言。该树只扩展实际到达的模式，无需枚举全局模式空间。实验展示了其在汽车与无人机、2D/3D 地图（包括 OpenDRIVE 导入）、含噪传感器以及多个同时安全性断言方面的丰富建模能力。Verse 在标准笔记本电脑上 90 秒内验证了一个含 7 个智能体、37 个模式的场景；在 ARCH 基准上与 CORA 和 JuliaReach 具有竞争力，在多智能体场景上比 JuliaReach 快一个数量级，代价是可达集较宽松。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体信息物理系统验证中模式空间组合爆炸的问题，提出 Verse 框架，将场景编译为混合自动机并仅扩展实际到达模式的可达性分析来检查安全性。

papers.title: Joint Service Depth and Priority Design in Queueing Systems
papers.abstract: In AI-assisted service systems, the server can choose how much processing effort to spend on each job, which we call the service depth. Deeper reasoning improves output quality but occupies the server longer and increases congestion, and the realized processing time remains random because AI models are probabilistic and tasks vary in complexity. We study the joint design of service depth and priority in a single-server queue whose customers differ in delay sensitivity, with the goal of maximizing social welfare. For each customer type, the decision maker chooses a priority level and a service depth, and service times are exponential with mean equal to the chosen depth. With two customer types and linear service values, we characterize the centralized optimum. Counterintuitively, it prioritizes the patient type and gives it a smaller service depth when patient customers are sufficiently prevalent. When delay sensitivity is private, however, incentive compatibility requires the impatient type to receive a weakly shorter sojourn time, so the optimal price menu never prioritizes the patient type. Consequently, there can be a welfare gap between the centralized decision maker's optimal control policy and the optimal decentralized pricing mechanism. With a continuum of types, the centralized optimum is monotone: more delay-sensitive customers receive weakly smaller depth and higher priority, so the optimum can be implemented by a price menu with no welfare loss. Allowing randomized depths similarly closes the gap in the two-type model. Finally, we calibrate an agentic AI service system using published coding-agent trials from DeepSWE and numerically examine priority inversion, the value of joint design, and the welfare gain from personalization.

translation.title: 排队系统中服务深度与优先级的联合设计
translation.abstract: 在 AI 辅助服务系统中，服务器可以选择对每个任务投入多少处理精力，我们称之为服务深度。更深的推理能提升输出质量，但会占用服务器更长时间并加剧拥堵，且由于 AI 模型的概率性和任务复杂度差异，实际处理时间仍是随机的。我们研究单服务器队列中服务深度与优先级的联合设计，其中顾客的延迟敏感度不同，目标为最大化社会福利。对每类顾客，决策者选择一个优先级和服务深度，服务时间服从以所选深度为均值的指数分布。在两类顾客和线性服务价值下，我们刻画了集中式最优解。反直觉的是，当有耐心的顾客足够多时，最优解会优先服务该类顾客并给予其更小的服务深度。然而当延迟敏感度是私人信息时，激励相容要求不耐烦类型的逗留时间弱更短，因此最优价格菜单永远不会优先服务有耐心的类型。因此，集中式决策者的最优控制策略与最优去中心化定价机制之间可能存在福利差距。在连续类型下，集中式最优解是单调的：延迟敏感度更高的顾客获得弱更小的深度和更高的优先级，因此最优解可通过价格菜单无福利损失地实现。允许随机化深度同样能弥合两类模型中的差距。最后，我们使用 DeepSWE 公布的编码智能体试验校准一个智能体 AI 服务系统，并数值考察优先级反转、联合设计的价值以及个性化带来的福利增益。
translation.brief: 研究单服务器队列中服务深度与优先级的联合设计以最大化社会福利，刻画了集中式最优解结构，并分析了私人信息下定价机制的激励相容约束与福利差距。

papers.title: Strategic Calibration in LLM Multi-Agent Systems: Audited Pivot Scoring for Truthful Elicitation
papers.abstract: In large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, reported confidence increasingly determines the allocation of scarce downstream attention, computation, and decision influence. This makes reporting strategic: an agent may overstate the relevance of its contribution even when its underlying belief is well calibrated. Existing calibration methods largely assume passive reporting and therefore do not address strategic incentives created when confidence determines downstream allocation. We formulate strategic calibration as a reporting-layer incentive problem and propose the Audited Pivot Scoring Mechanism (APSM). APSM offsets platform-controlled allocation benefits, uses inverse-propensity-weighted sparse audits, charges the Clarke pivot externality, and applies a strictly proper score. Under the stated model assumptions, truthful reporting is the unique expected-utility best response. We also characterize approximate execution and the audit-variance trade-off. Calculator-free experiments show that LLM agents inflate confidence under Top-$K$ incentives. With a shared agent-local utility interface, LLM agents reduce distortion under both Compensated Proper Scoring (CPS) and APSM. CPS achieves higher exact allocation match, whereas APSM yields lower Brier loss and numerically fewer cutoff crossings. Experiments further show that APSM enlarges the utility margin against allocation-changing deviations by $1.93\times$ and improves robustness under approximate execution. These results support incentive-aware elicitation as a distinct layer for reliable multi-agent coordination.

translation.title: LLM 多智能体系统中的策略性校准：用于真实引出的审计化枢轴评分
translation.abstract: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统中，报告的置信度日益决定稀缺的下游注意力、计算和决策影响力的分配。这使得报告具有策略性：即使智能体的底层信念校准良好，它也可能夸大其贡献的相关性。现有校准方法大多假设被动报告，因此未解决置信度决定下游分配时产生的策略性激励。我们将策略性校准形式化为报告层的激励问题，并提出审计化枢轴评分机制（APSM）。APSM 抵消平台控制的分配收益，使用逆倾向加权稀疏审计，收取 Clarke 枢轴外部性，并采用严格恰当评分。在所述模型假设下，真实报告是唯一的期望效用最优响应。我们还刻画了近似执行以及审计方差的权衡。无计算器实验表明，LLM 智能体在 Top-$K$ 激励下会夸大置信度。在共享的智能体本地效用接口下，LLM 智能体在补偿恰当评分（CPS）和 APSM 下都减少了失真。CPS 实现更高的精确分配匹配，而 APSM 带来更低的 Brier 损失且数值上更少的截断穿越。实验进一步表明，APSM 将针对改变分配的偏离的效用裕度扩大 $1.93\times$，并提升近似执行下的鲁棒性。这些结果支持将激励感知的引出作为可靠多智能体协调的一个独立层次。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 多智能体系统中置信度决定下游资源分配导致的策略性虚报问题，提出结合稀疏审计、Clarke 枢轴收费与严格恰当评分的 APSM 机制，使真实报告成为唯一最优响应。

papers.title: Pricing Information in Search with Nonobligatory Inspection
papers.abstract: As AI agents reshape Web search and advertising, platforms can monetize information that improves decisions. We study information pricing for sequential search among independent alternatives with nonobligatory inspection: the buyer may select any alternative without buying its report. We show that a common fee maximizes static revenue for identical priors, resolving a uniform-pricing conjecture. Our results also establish that exact optimization is NP-hard for heterogeneous binary priors. Despite this hardness, our polynomial-time static pricing algorithm achieves a $3$-approximation to the information surplus. More generally, a common static fee approximates optimal adaptive revenue within a logarithmic factor in the number of alternatives. This guarantee is asymptotically tight.

translation.title: 非强制检查搜索中的信息定价
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 智能体重塑网络搜索与广告，平台可以将改善决策的信息变现。我们研究在独立备选项间进行序贯搜索且检查非强制时的信息定价：买方可以选择任一备选项而不购买其报告。我们证明，对于相同先验，统一收费可最大化静态收入，从而解决了一个统一定价猜想。我们的结果还表明，对异质二元先验，精确优化是 NP 难的。尽管存在这种困难性，我们的多项式时间静态定价算法可实现信息盈余的 $3$-近似。更一般地，统一静态收费可在备选项数量的对数因子内近似最优自适应收入。该保证在渐近意义上是紧的。
translation.brief: 研究非强制检查的序贯搜索中平台如何为信息定价，证明统一收费对相同先验最优、异质先验下问题 NP 难，并给出多项式时间的常数与对数近似定价算法。

papers.title: Envy-Free Allocations for Random Non-Additive Valuations
papers.abstract: Benade et al. (EC 2024) introduced a semi-random model for non-additive fair division in which each agent starts with an arbitrary base valuation over bundles of items and independently permutes the item names uniformly at random. While they proved that envy-free allocations exist with high probability as the number of items grows for $n = 2$ agents, they left open whether the same holds for $n > 2$ agents. We resolve this open question in the affirmative: for any fixed number of agents $n$ and any number of items $m$ divisible by $n$, an envy-free allocation exists with probability $1 - o(1)$ as $m \to \infty$. Our proof combines the second moment method with a connection to the (small-set) expansion of generalized Johnson graphs, which may be of independent interest.

translation.title: 随机非可加估值下的无嫉妒分配
translation.abstract: Benade 等人（EC 2024）为非可加公平划分引入了一个半随机模型，其中每个智能体从一个对物品束的任意基础估值出发，并独立地均匀随机置换物品名称。他们证明了当物品数量增长时，$n = 2$ 个智能体的情况下无嫉妒分配以高概率存在，但对 $n > 2$ 个智能体是否同样成立留作开放问题。我们肯定地解决了这一开放问题：对任意固定数量的智能体 $n$ 和任意可被 $n$ 整除的物品数 $m$，当 $m \to \infty$ 时，无嫉妒分配以概率 $1 - o(1)$ 存在。我们的证明结合了二阶矩方法与广义 Johnson 图的（小集）扩张之间的联系，后者可能具有独立的研究价值。
translation.brief: 解决了 Benade 等人提出的开放问题，证明在半随机非可加估值模型下任意固定数量智能体的无嫉妒分配以高概率存在，方法结合二阶矩方法与广义 Johnson 图的扩张性质。

papers.title: Online Fair Division with Frequency Predictions
papers.abstract: We study online fair division of indivisible goods among $n$ agents with frequency predictions: before any good arrives, the algorithm learns the multiset of each agent's values for the goods, but neither the arrival order nor which values of different agents belong to the same good. Neoh et al. (ICML 2026) showed that such predictions allow every share-based guarantee that is achievable offline, and left open whether a positive approximation of envy-freeness up to one good (EF1) is possible. We show that deterministic online algorithms can guarantee $1/2$-EF1 for three agents and $(3-\sqrt5)/2$-EF1 for four agents, whereas for five or more agents, no online algorithm can guarantee any positive approximation of EF1, even with $n+1$ goods and identical predictions. Together with the known result for two agents, a positive approximation of EF1 is therefore possible if and only if $n\leq4$. We also rule out any positive approximation of EFX for three or more agents, even when the valuations take only two distinct positive values. Next, we use the meta-algorithm of Neoh et al. (ICML 2026) to compute an epistemic EFX (EEFX) allocation in polynomial time for any $n$, and hence a $1/(n-1)$-EF$(n-2)$ allocation for $n\geq3$, whereas algorithms that fix a picking sequence in advance can guarantee a positive approximation of EF$k$ if and only if $n\leq k+2$. Finally, for noisy predictions, we give algorithms that return EEFX allocations when the predictions are exact, and guarantee $(1-2\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^2))$-EEFX under underestimates and, for $n\geq3$, $(1-2(n-1)\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^2))$-EEFX under overestimates; the linear terms are the best possible, and larger overestimates rule out any positive approximation for such algorithms.

translation.title: 基于频率预测的在线公平分配
translation.abstract: 我们研究在 $n$ 个智能体之间对不可分割物品进行在线公平分配的问题，算法可获得频率预测：在任何物品到达之前，算法得知每个智能体对物品的价值多重集，但既不知道到达顺序，也不知道不同智能体的哪些价值属于同一物品。Neoh et al. (ICML 2026) 证明这类预测使得所有离线可实现的基于份额的保证均可达，但留下了一个开放问题：是否可能对“去除一件物品后无嫉妒”（EF1）取得正近似。我们证明确定性在线算法可为三个智能体保证 $1/2$-EF1，为四个智能体保证 $(3-\sqrt5)/2$-EF1；而对于五个及以上智能体，任何在线算法都无法保证 EF1 的任何正近似，即使只有 $n+1$ 个物品且预测完全相同。结合已知的两个智能体的结果，EF1 存在正近似当且仅当 $n\leq4$。我们还排除了三个及以上智能体情况下 EFX 的任何正近似，即使估值仅取两个不同的正值。接下来，我们利用 Neoh et al. (ICML 2026) 的元算法，对任意 $n$ 在多项式时间内计算出认知 EFX（EEFX）分配，从而对 $n\geq3$ 得到 $1/(n-1)$-EF$(n-2)$ 分配；而预先固定选取序列的算法能保证 EF$k$ 的正近似当且仅当 $n\leq k+2$。最后，针对有噪声的预测，我们给出算法：当预测精确时返回 EEFX 分配，在低估情形下保证 $(1-2\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^2))$-EEFX，对 $n\geq3$ 在高估情形下保证 $(1-2(n-1)\varepsilon+O(\varepsilon^2))$-EEFX；线性项是最优的，且较大的高估会排除此类算法的任何正近似。
translation.brief: 研究带频率预测的在线不可分割物品公平分配中 EF1/EFX 近似保证的可行性，通过设计确定性在线算法并给出不可能性刻画，确定正近似 EF1 当且仅当智能体数不超过 4。

papers.title: Fair Division of Lotteries
papers.abstract: We study fair division of uncertain items, where the utility of each item is a random variable whose realization is observed only after the allocation is determined. This uncertainty creates a distinction between ex-ante fairness, evaluated before utilities are realized, and ex-post fairness, evaluated after realization. We examine to what extent these two notions are compatible. We first identify conditions under which ex-ante envy-free allocations maximize ex-post envy-freeness probability. These include two-agent instances where utilities toward the same item follow the same distribution from a convolution-power family. For an arbitrary number of agents, we establish analogous optimality results when the common generator is non-atomic or log-concave. Beyond convolution-power families, we derive approximation guarantees for ex-ante envy-free allocations relative to the optimal ex-post envy-freeness probability under log-concave or symmetric utilities. We also study the computational complexity of evaluating ex-post envy-freeness probabilities, establishing hardness results as well as pseudo-polynomial-time algorithms.

translation.title: 彩票式公平分配
translation.abstract: 我们研究不确定物品的公平分配，其中每个物品的效用是一个随机变量，其实现值只有在分配确定之后才能观察到。这种不确定性区分了事前公平（在效用实现之前评估）与事后公平（在实现之后评估）。我们考察这两种概念在多大程度上是相容的。我们首先给出事前无嫉妒分配最大化事后无嫉妒概率的条件，其中包括两个智能体且对同一物品的效用服从同一卷积幂族分布的情形。对于任意数量的智能体，当共同的生成分布是非原子的或对数凹的时，我们建立了类似的最优性结果。在卷积幂族之外，我们推导了事前无嫉妒分配相对于最优事后无嫉妒概率的近似保证（在对数凹或对称效用下）。我们还研究了评估事后无嫉妒概率的计算复杂度，建立了困难性结果以及伪多项式时间算法。
translation.brief: 研究效用实现前后的公平分配相容性问题，通过刻画卷积幂族、非原子和对数凹分布等条件，确定事前无嫉妒分配何时能最大化事后无嫉妒概率。

papers.title: BROCADE: Broker-based Contract Design for the Multi-Agency Model
papers.abstract: We study welfare maximization in a contract model with $m$ principals who privately value a public project's success and $n$ agents whose costly effort is unobservable. Contracts induce truthful dominant strategies for principals and equilibrium effort by agents, maximizing the expected total value of eligible principals. We develop three tools: a broker that separates payments from principals and payments to agents, an extension of Myerson's Lemma characterizing dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC), and a black-box reduction to budget-constrained single-principal contract design. When the success probability is a strictly monotone XOS function of agents' actions, these tools yield three results. First, a deterministic DSIC contract achieves a constant approximation against a benchmark that qualifies every principal and maximizes success probability using budget $\sum_j v^j$, but may violate budget balance (BB). Second, against benchmarks with budgets at least the largest principal value, deterministic DSIC and BB contracts admit no finite approximation guarantee, even with two agents. Universally DSIC and universally BB randomized contracts have an $\Omega(n)$ approximation lower bound, even for a fixed number of principals. Third, using one quarter of the optimal fixed-price revenue supported by at least two principals as the benchmark budget, we obtain a universally DSIC and universally BB randomized contract with an $O(\log m)$ approximation ratio independent of $n$.

translation.title: BROCADE：面向多委托方模型的基于经纪人的合同设计
translation.abstract: 我们研究一个合同模型中的福利最大化问题：$m$ 个委托方对一个公共项目的成功有私人估值，$n$ 个智能体的有成本努力不可观测。合同需诱导委托方真实的主导策略和智能体的均衡努力，以最大化合格委托方的期望总价值。我们开发了三个工具：一个将委托方支付与智能体支付分离的经纪人、一个刻画主导策略激励相容性（DSIC）的 Myerson 引理扩展，以及到预算受限单委托方合同设计的黑箱归约。当成功概率是智能体行动的严格单调 XOS 函数时，这些工具带来三个结果。第一，一个确定性 DSIC 合同相对于一个使用预算 $\sum_j v^j$ 让所有委托方合格并最大化成功概率（但可能违反预算平衡 BB）的基准，可达到常数近似。第二，相对于预算至少为最大委托方价值的基准，确定性 DSIC 和 BB 合同不存在有限近似保证，即使只有两个智能体；普遍 DSIC 且普遍 BB 的随机合同存在 $\Omega(n)$ 的近似下界，即使委托方数量固定。第三，以至少两个委托方支持的最优固定价格收入的四分之一作为基准预算，我们得到一个普遍 DSIC 且普遍 BB 的随机合同，其 $O(\log m)$ 近似比与 $n$ 无关。
translation.brief: 研究多委托方不可观测努力合同设计中的福利最大化，通过引入经纪人机制、扩展 Myerson 引理和黑箱归约，构建 DSIC 与预算平衡的合同并给出近似保证与下界。

papers.title: Whale You Go Green? Immediate and Longitudinal Effects of Embodied Conversational AI Avatars on Sustainable Behavioral Tendencies and Pro-Environmental Attitudes
papers.abstract: Embodied conversational AI can be persuasive, but can it motivate people to develop sustainable behavioral tendencies and increase pro-environmental attitudes? We conducted a randomized experiment (N = 576) comparing four embodied avatars--a beluga whale, Greta Thunberg, Emma Watson, and a generic human--with a text chatbot and no-intervention control. All embodied conditions increased immediate sustainable product selection relative to the control (beta = .401-.609, all q <= .0126) and chatbot (beta = .398-.604, all q <= .007), without differing significantly from one another. Only the Beluga condition increased immediate pro-environmental attitudes relative to the control after correction. Among 287 returners assessed two months later, following an intermediate assigned-condition session, Beluga also showed significantly higher pre-booster sustainable product choice compared to the control (beta = .657, q = .0176). Although it did not significantly outperform other embodied agents, these findings establish the immediate potential of nonhuman embodied avatar interfaces as a promising direction for memorable environmental interventions.

translation.title: 鲸鱼带你走向绿色？具身对话式 AI 头像对可持续行为倾向与亲环境态度的即时与纵向效应
translation.abstract: 具身对话式 AI 具有说服力，但它能否激励人们形成可持续行为倾向并增强亲环境态度？我们开展了一项随机实验（N = 576），比较四种具身头像——白鲸、Greta Thunberg、Emma Watson 和一个普通人形象——与文本聊天机器人及无干预对照。所有具身条件相对于对照（beta = .401-.609，所有 q <= .0126）和聊天机器人（beta = .398-.604，所有 q <= .007）均提高了即时的可持续产品选择，且彼此之间无显著差异。只有白鲸条件在校正后相对于对照显著提高了即时的亲环境态度。在两个月后接受评估的 287 名回访者中（其间有一次指定条件的中间会话），白鲸条件在强化前的可持续产品选择上也显著高于对照（beta = .657，q = .0176）。尽管它并未显著优于其他具身智能体，这些发现确立了非人类具身头像界面作为令人难忘的环境干预方向的良好前景。
translation.brief: 通过比较四种具身 AI 头像与聊天机器人及对照的随机实验，检验具身对话式 AI 能否即时和长期地促进可持续行为选择与亲环境态度。

papers.title: The As-If Machine: Personalized counterfactuals make distant policy risks feel close
papers.abstract: Life experiences can shape policy attitudes, but we only live one life. Citizens may therefore fail to support policies addressing risks they have never personally experienced. Narratives can make such risks immediate and personal, but personalized stories remain difficult to produce at scale. Here we ask whether AI can make distant scenarios feel concrete by simulating a participant's life as if that scenario occurred. We present the As-If Machine (AIM), a multi-agent system through which people co-write personalized counterfactual narratives---stories about their own lives under different policy futures. In two pre-registered and quota-matched experiments on science funding (N=1,007) and satellite cybersecurity (N=894), we compared AIM with two controls: reading an expert-written vignette on the same topic and co-writing with AIM about an unrelated topic. AIM increased psychological closeness---how close a risk feels to the self---by nearly identical margins in the two domains (0.36 and 0.38 standard deviations (SDs) against the vignette, 0.80 and 0.90 against unrelated writing). AIM increased psychological closeness even among participants with unfavorable views of AI. For policy attitudes, AIM's effects were 0.16 SDs against the vignette and 0.10 SDs (n.s.) against unrelated writing for science funding; the corresponding effects for satellite cybersecurity were 0.54 and 0.67 SDs. Across 23,496 human-AI autocomplete interactions, participants and the system played distinct roles: AIM supplied concrete detail that grounded the scenario, and participants supplied first-person perspective and emotion. Co-writing with the As-If Machine makes distant policy risks feel close.

translation.title: As-If Machine：个性化反事实叙事让遥远的政策风险变得贴近
translation.abstract: 生活经历可以塑造政策态度，但每个人只能经历一种人生。因此，公民可能不会支持解决他们从未亲身经历过的风险的政策。叙事可以使这类风险变得即时且切身，但个性化故事难以大规模生产。我们在此探讨 AI 能否通过模拟参与者的生活“仿佛”某种情境发生了，使遥远情境变得具体。我们提出 As-If Machine（AIM），这是一个多智能体系统，人们通过它与 AI 共同撰写个性化反事实叙事——关于自己在不同政策未来下的生活故事。在两项预注册且配额匹配的实验中，分别针对科学资助（N=1,007）和卫星网络安全（N=894），我们将 AIM 与两种对照比较：阅读同主题的专家撰写短文，以及用 AIM 共同撰写无关主题。AIM 在两个领域以几乎相同的幅度提高了心理贴近感——风险对自我的贴近程度（相对短文为 0.36 和 0.38 个标准差，相对无关写作为 0.80 和 0.90）。即使对 AI 持负面看法的参与者，AIM 也提高了心理贴近感。在政策态度上，科学资助方面 AIM 相对短文的效应为 0.16 个标准差，相对无关写作为 0.10 个标准差（不显著）；卫星网络安全方面的相应效应为 0.54 和 0.67 个标准差。在 23,496 次人机自动补全交互中，参与者与系统扮演不同角色：AIM 提供使情境落地具体细节，参与者提供第一人称视角和情感。与 As-If Machine 共同撰写使遥远的政策风险变得贴近。
translation.brief: 提出多智能体系统 AIM，通过与用户共同撰写个性化反事实人生叙事，使遥远的政策风险在心理上变得贴近并影响政策态度。

papers.title: FlashScript: Compiling Recurring Agent Workflows into Reusable Neuro-Symbolic Programs
papers.abstract: Many agent tasks recur with new data or small changes, yet agents regenerate their reasoning and actions on each run, producing different results. Distilling a prior run into a skill helps the agent avoid earlier mistakes, but it still re-runs the full process each time, so runs can vary and incur that cost. We compile a successful agent run into a reusable neuro-symbolic program (NSP) with a set of guidelines we call FlashScript. Actions and data transformations become code, instance-specific values become parameters, and decisions that need model judgment become LLM calls. We identify three layers where these calls belong and three techniques that replace most of them with code. The compilation does not remove nondeterminism; it localizes it, so the deterministic program and its neural calls can be reviewed and tested separately. Across 120 WorkBench analytics tasks with Claude Haiku 4.5, the NSPs were correct and made identical tool calls on every run, using about 70 times fewer input tokens and a third of the runtime of a skill-guided agent whose runs were inconsistent. In a composite version of the tasks, the skill-guided agent's accuracy fell to 23%, and its output inconsistency increased, while the NSPs remained correct and identical across all runs. The NSPs successfully generalized to all 108 unseen instances of the same templates. Our findings suggest that NSPs from agent trajectories can be considered cumulative software assets for end-users to test, maintain, and reuse in their recurring workflows.

translation.title: FlashScript：将重复出现的智能体工作流编译为可复用的神经符号程序
translation.abstract: 许多智能体任务会随新数据或微小变化而重复出现，但智能体每次运行都重新生成推理和动作，产生不同结果。将先前一次运行蒸馏为技能有助于智能体避免早先的错误，但仍需每次重新执行完整流程，因此运行结果可能不一致并产生相应成本。我们将一次成功的智能体运行编译为可复用的神经符号程序（NSP），并提出一套称为 FlashScript 的准则。动作和数据变换变为代码，实例相关的值变为参数，需要模型判断的决策变为 LLM 调用。我们识别出这些调用所属的三个层次，以及用代码替换其中大部分调用的三种技术。编译并不消除非确定性，而是将其局部化，使确定性程序及其神经调用可以分别审查和测试。在 120 个 WorkBench 分析任务上使用 Claude Haiku 4.5，NSP 全部正确且每次运行都做出完全相同的工具调用，输入 token 约为技能引导智能体的 1/70，运行时间约为其 1/3，而后者运行结果不一致。在任务的复合版本中，技能引导智能体的准确率降至 23%，输出不一致性加剧，而 NSP 在所有运行中保持正确且一致。NSP 成功泛化到同一模板的全部 108 个未见实例。我们的发现表明，从智能体轨迹得到的 NSP 可以被视为累积性软件资产，供最终用户在重复工作流中测试、维护和复用。
translation.brief: 针对智能体重复任务中每次运行结果不一致且成本高的问题，提出将成功运行轨迹编译为带参数化 LLM 调用的可复用神经符号程序。

papers.title: Human-Aware Agentic Driving: Rethinking Driver State, Trust, and Intervention
papers.abstract: Agentic driving brings goal-directed reasoning, memory, tools, and adaptive interaction into automated vehicles. A vehicle can clarify a request, explain a maneuver, or prepare a driver to take control, then adapt its next action to the response. These capabilities make the vehicle an active participant in shaping the human behavior it observes. We examine how agentic interaction affects driver-state inference, trust and reliance, and human intervention in conditional automation. Established findings on attention, takeover prediction, trust-aware planning, and adaptive warnings provide useful foundations, but their applicability depends on how observations are elicited and how assistance changes the driving task. We distinguish what remains applicable, what changes under flexible interaction, and what remains unresolved across these three areas. The analysis identifies three research priorities: establishing the effects of interventions, jointly designing interaction and driving policies, and maintaining useful adaptation across repeated use and system changes. Progress should be measured through driver comprehension, appropriate reliance, and the ability to perform the required driving action in time.

translation.title: 以人为本的智能体驾驶：重新思考驾驶员状态、信任与干预
translation.abstract: 智能体驾驶将目标导向推理、记忆、工具和自适应交互引入自动驾驶汽车。车辆可以澄清请求、解释操作或提示驾驶员准备接管，然后根据回应调整下一步行动。这些能力使车辆成为塑造其所观察到的人类行为的主动参与者。我们考察智能体交互如何影响条件自动化下的驾驶员状态推断、信任与依赖以及人类干预。关于注意力、接管预测、信任感知规划和自适应警告的既有发现提供了有益基础，但其适用性取决于观察如何被引出以及辅助如何改变驾驶任务。我们区分了在这三个领域中哪些结论仍然适用、哪些在灵活交互下发生变化、哪些仍未解决。分析确定了三个研究优先事项：确立干预的效果、联合设计交互与驾驶策略，以及在重复使用和系统变化中保持有效的自适应。进展应通过驾驶员理解、恰当依赖以及及时完成所需驾驶动作的能力来衡量。
translation.brief: 分析智能体交互如何改变驾驶员状态推断、信任与干预三领域的既有研究适用性，并提出三个研究优先方向。

papers.title: Detecting and Understanding Ambiguity in Visualizations with Role-Playing Vision Language Model Interpretations
papers.abstract: Communicative visualizations can support multiple chart-grounded takeaways, including divergent or conflicting ones; we refer to this variation as interpretive ambiguity. Such ambiguity can undermine a visualization's communicative goal when the supported takeaways diverge from its intended message. Evaluating visualizations with target audiences can surface this variation, but such evaluations can be costly and difficult to scale. In this work, we explore persona-conditioned Vision Language Models (VLMs) as a complementary evaluation tool for interpretive ambiguity. For a given visualization, our pipeline uses topic-relevant personas to elicit candidate contextual takeaways supported by interpretations of perceived visual patterns, such as trends and clusters. We derive a Target--Pattern--Scope framework for comparing these interpretations, use LLM judges to assign Compatible, Disjoint, or Opposing ambiguity labels to statement pairs, and summarize their distribution in an ambiguity profile. To improve chart grounding, we benchmark candidate VLMs on chart comprehension and select the highest-performing model for each chart type. We evaluate statement-pair labeling against human-authored annotations and apply the approach to real-world, public-facing visualizations curated from established datasets. Through case studies, we examine how perceived visual patterns relate to contextual takeaways and how a visualization redesign changes the sampled interpretations. Our findings show how persona-conditioned VLMs can complement human feedback by generating candidate contextual takeaways and surfacing potential ambiguity for further inspection.

translation.title: 基于角色扮演视觉语言模型解读的图表歧义检测与理解
translation.abstract: 沟通型可视化可以支持多个基于图表的结论，包括分歧甚至冲突的结论；我们将这种差异称为解释性歧义。当所支持的结论偏离可视化的预期信息时，这种歧义会损害其沟通目标。用目标受众评估可视化可以揭示这种差异，但此类评估成本高且难以规模化。本文探索以人设为条件的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为解释性歧义的补充评估工具。对于给定可视化，我们的流程使用与主题相关的人设来引出候选的情境化结论，这些结论由对感知到的视觉模式（如趋势和聚类）的解读所支持。我们提出 Target--Pattern--Scope 框架来比较这些解读，使用 LLM 评判者为语句对分配 Compatible、Disjoint 或 Opposing 的歧义标签，并将其分布汇总为歧义画像。为改进图表基础，我们在图表理解上对候选 VLM 进行基准测试，并为每种图表类型选择表现最佳的模型。我们将语句对标注与人工标注进行对比评估，并将该方法应用于从既有数据集中筛选的真实面向公众的可视化。通过案例研究，我们考察感知到的视觉模式如何与情境化结论相关，以及可视化重设计如何改变采样到的解读。研究结果表明，以人设为条件的 VLM 可以通过生成候选情境化结论并揭示潜在歧义来补充人类反馈。
translation.brief: 针对可视化解释性歧义评估难以规模化的问题，提出用多角色 VLM 生成候选解读并结合 LLM 评判者标注歧义的自动化流程。

papers.title: Babysitting AI Agents: A User-Centered Taxonomy and Study of Agentic Delegation Failures
papers.abstract: Users are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, allowing agents to perform long-running, multi-step workflows on their behalf. However, agents may perform these tasks in ways that depart from users' expectations for how they should be carried out, leading to what we call agentic delegation failures. We leverage a large corpus of 163,487 Reddit posts, describing AI agent use, to develop MANDATE: a taxonomy of 23 failure categories organized into seven groups. A follow-up study with 73 AI agent users examined the relationship between prevalence and perceptions of severity and noticeability, finding that failures rated as more severe are considered harder to notice, and that prior experience with a failure is associated with greater noticeability. Finally, we assess the maturity of research on each failure and identify commonly encountered failures that have received little attention (e.g., agents running without making progress). Our findings inform opportunities to make delegation easier for users to oversee and better studied by the research community.

translation.title: 看护 AI 智能体：以用户为中心的智能体委托失败分类与研究
translation.abstract: 用户越来越多地将任务委托给 AI 智能体，让智能体代为执行长时间运行的多步骤工作流。然而，智能体执行任务的方式可能偏离用户对其执行方式的期望，我们将其称为智能体委托失败。我们利用包含 163,487 条描述 AI 智能体使用的 Reddit 帖子的大型语料库，构建了 MANDATE：一个包含 23 个失败类别、组织为七组的分类体系。随后对 73 名 AI 智能体用户开展的研究考察了失败普遍性与严重性、可察觉性感知之间的关系，发现被评为更严重的失败被认为更难察觉，而先前经历过某类失败与更强的可察觉性相关。最后，我们评估了每类失败的研究成熟度，并识别出常见但研究不足的失败（例如智能体持续运行却无进展）。我们的发现为让用户更容易监督委托以及推动研究界更充分研究这些失败提供了方向。
translation.brief: 针对用户委托 AI 智能体时的失败缺乏系统认识的问题，基于大规模 Reddit 语料构建包含 23 类失败的 MANDATE 分类体系并开展用户研究。

papers.title: ECHOES: An Adaptive LLM-Powered AR Glasses Docent for Evidence-Grounded Urban Heritage Interpretation
papers.abstract: Urban heritage tours are often delivered through fixed scripts, leaving limited room for visitors' situated questions, language preferences, or requests for evidence. We present ECHOES, an adaptive LLM-powered AR glasses docent for evidence-grounded interpretation of historical buildings. Specifically, the agent adapts along three dimensions: it modifies response structure according to the type of visitor question (identification, architectural detail, evidence-seeking, or route inquiry); it accumulates session-level interest signals from repeated questions and expressed curiosity to shape later explanations; and it tracks language preference and retrieval context across turns to maintain conversational continuity. The core of ECHOES is an LLM agent initialized as a source-aware urban heritage docent that realizes this adaptation through dialogue and preference context maintained across the session. Around this agent, ECHOES integrates visual site grounding, a self-built historical knowledge base supporting retrieval-augmented generation, and concise multilingual AR output designed for glanceable use. Through a working prototype centered on Shanghai's East Nanjing Road and the Bund, we demonstrate how an adaptive LLM-powered AR docent can transform historical tours from scripted narration into situated, question-responsive, and source-aware conversations.

translation.title: ECHOES：面向有据可依的城市遗产解读的自适应 LLM 驱动 AR 眼镜讲解员
translation.abstract: 城市遗产游览通常通过固定脚本进行，难以回应游客的情境化提问、语言偏好或证据请求。我们提出 ECHOES，一个由 LLM 驱动的自适应 AR 眼镜讲解员，用于对历史建筑进行有据可依的解读。具体而言，该智能体沿三个维度自适应：根据游客问题类型（识别、建筑细节、证据查询或路线询问）调整回复结构；累积会话级的兴趣信号（重复提问和表达的好奇心）以塑造后续讲解；跨轮次跟踪语言偏好和检索上下文以保持对话连续性。ECHOES 的核心是一个初始化为具备来源意识的城市遗产讲解员的 LLM 智能体，通过跨会话维护的对话与偏好上下文实现上述自适应。围绕该智能体，ECHOES 集成了视觉场景定位、支持检索增强生成的自建历史知识库，以及为便于一眼浏览而设计的多语言简洁 AR 输出。通过一个以上海南京东路和外滩为核心的可运行原型，我们展示了自适应 LLM 驱动的 AR 讲解员如何将历史游览从脚本化叙述转变为情境化、响应提问且具备来源意识的对话。
translation.brief: 针对固定脚本讲解无法响应游客情境化提问的问题，提出集成视觉定位、RAG 知识库与多语言 AR 输出的自适应 LLM AR 讲解智能体。

papers.title: SkillQR: Agentic Skill Discovery for Reason-Intensive Query Rewriting
papers.abstract: Dense retrievers provide grounded evidence that mitigates hallucinations in outputs from Large Language Models (LLMs). Real-world queries are often verbose, ambiguously framed, or require multi-step reasoning, introducing irrelevant details that weaken semantic matching for dense retrievers. Query rewriting is a widely adopted pre-retrieval technique that leverages LLMs to reformulate queries and bridge the semantic gap between such queries and the retrieval target. Existing rewriting approaches either rely on expensive proprietary models, substantial training data, or iterative retrieval and rewriting, while largely applying a uniform rewriting strategy regardless of the retrieval corpus. We observe that effective query rewriting instructions are not universal: the optimal strategy depends on the retrieval target, rather than the model alone. We introduce SkillQR, a query rewriting framework that automatically discovers reasoning strategy sets from the retrieval target and dynamically routes a query to the appropriate rewriting strategy at inference time. Without relying on training data, SkillQR achieves competitive performance compared to fine-tuned rewriting models on the BRIGHT and R2MED benchmarks, while also providing lower inference latency than iterative rewriting approaches.

translation.title: SkillQR：面向推理密集型查询改写的智能体式技能发现
translation.abstract: 稠密检索器能够提供有据可依的证据，缓解大语言模型（LLM）输出中的幻觉问题。真实世界的查询往往冗长、表述模糊或需要多步推理，其中引入的无关细节会削弱稠密检索器的语义匹配效果。查询改写是一种被广泛采用的检索前技术，利用 LLM 重新表述查询，弥合此类查询与检索目标之间的语义鸿沟。现有改写方法要么依赖昂贵的专有模型、大量训练数据，要么依赖迭代式的检索与改写，同时在很大程度上无论检索语料如何都采用统一的改写策略。我们观察到，有效的查询改写指令并非普适：最优策略取决于检索目标，而非仅取决于模型。我们提出 SkillQR，一个查询改写框架，它自动从检索目标中发现推理策略集合，并在推理时将查询动态路由到合适的改写策略。在不依赖训练数据的情况下，SkillQR 在 BRIGHT 和 R2MED 基准上取得了与微调改写模型相当的性能，同时推理延迟低于迭代式改写方法。
translation.brief: 针对查询改写策略不随检索目标变化的问题，提出 SkillQR 框架，从检索目标自动发现推理策略集并在推理时动态路由查询到合适策略。

papers.title: Decision-Native Recommendation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) bring world knowledge to user preference modeling in sequential recommendation, but generation-based recommenders express next-item predictions indirectly as text. Generated outputs may fail to identify a unique candidate item, depend on candidate presentation order in the prompt, and lack explicit confidence in the recommendation. Recent studies explore Jev, a model for fast option selection with explicit confidence. Inspired by Jev, we introduce decision-native recommendation, a new paradigm that jointly models item choice and recommendation confidence using LLM representations. It requires valid candidate selection, consistency under candidate reordering, and confidence that reflects recommendation accuracy. We propose Direct Item Choice Estimation (DICE), which learns a personalized next-item distribution over supplied candidates from user interaction history and recommends the highest-scoring item with calibrated confidence. Tree-structured attention shares history computation across isolated candidate branches for order-consistent candidate scoring in a single forward pass. On three recommendation datasets, DICE achieves higher top-one accuracy than all evaluated baselines. Separate evaluations show unchanged item choices under tested candidate reorderings and end-to-end speedups of up to approximately $6\times$ over the evaluated generation-based methods. Its confidence estimates support selective recommendation by identifying more reliable predictions and guide additional computation for low-confidence examples in offline routing.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的决策原生推荐
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为序列推荐中的用户偏好建模带来了世界知识，但基于生成的推荐器以文本形式间接表达下一物品预测。生成的输出可能无法唯一确定候选物品、依赖于提示词中候选的呈现顺序，并且缺乏对推荐的显式置信度。近期研究探索了 Jev，一种具有显式置信度的快速选项选择模型。受 Jev 启发，我们提出决策原生推荐这一新范式，利用 LLM 表示联合建模物品选择与推荐置信度。它要求有效的候选选择、候选重排下的一致性，以及反映推荐准确性的置信度。我们提出直接物品选择估计（DICE），从用户交互历史中学习给定候选上的个性化下一物品分布，并以校准的置信度推荐得分最高的物品。树结构注意力在隔离的候选分支间共享历史计算，实现单次前向传播中顺序一致的候选打分。在三个推荐数据集上，DICE 的 top-one 准确率高于所有评估的基线。独立评估显示，在测试的候选重排下物品选择保持不变，且相比评估的基于生成的方法实现了最高约 6 倍的端到端加速。其置信度估计可通过识别更可靠的预测支持选择性推荐，并在离线路由中为低置信度样本引导额外计算。
translation.brief: 针对生成式 LLM 推荐无法唯一确定物品、受候选顺序影响且缺乏置信度的问题，提出决策原生范式 DICE，联合建模物品选择与校准置信度并用树结构注意力实现顺序一致的高效打分。

papers.title: DPE-Rec: Diversity-Preserving and Efficient Diffusion Language Model Recommendation for Bundle Construction
papers.abstract: Generative bundle construction completes a partially observed bundle by generating its missing items from a large product catalog. Compared to autoregressive LLMs, diffusion LLM emerges as a natural fit for this unordered generation task. Their bidirectional attention provides an inductive bias better aligned with unordered bundle construction. Iterative denoising can reveal multiple tokens per step, potentially reducing inference latency. However, directly applying DLMs to this task presents two key challenges: 1 Despite its flexible reveal order, confidence-guided decoding tends to postpone semantic-fork decisions until refinement tokens constrain their choices, reducing bundle diversity. 2 Revealing more tokens per step can compromise recommendation quality, stifling the potential for faster inference. We introduce DPE-Rec, a diffusion framework for diversity preservation and efficient recommendation. DPE-Rec preserves diversity by introducing semantic-fork-aware GRPO, which prioritizes semantic-fork decisions via autoregressive rollouts. It improves efficiency through pseudo-trajectory distillation, which concentrates learning from the vast random corruption space onto the compact trajectory-induced subspace visited by high-quality decoding, unlocking reliable multi-token decoding. Together, these components enable diverse and accurate bundle construction with substantially fewer denoise steps. Experiments on multiple bundle construction benchmarks show that DPE-Rec improves recommendation performance by 63% on average, and its fast variant achieves 25.6$times$ faster inference on average than existing generative recommendation arts, with minimal loss in recommendation quality.

translation.title: DPE-Rec：面向捆绑包构建的保多样性与高效扩散语言模型推荐
translation.abstract: 生成式捆绑包构建通过从大型商品目录中生成缺失物品来补全部分观察到的捆绑包。与自回归 LLM 相比，扩散语言模型（DLM）天然契合这一无序生成任务。其双向注意力提供了与无序捆绑包构建更契合的归纳偏置；迭代去噪可以每步揭示多个 token，有望降低推理延迟。然而，直接将 DLM 应用于该任务面临两个关键挑战：1）尽管揭示顺序灵活，置信度引导的解码倾向于将语义分叉决策推迟到精炼 token 限制其选择之时，降低了捆绑包多样性；2）每步揭示更多 token 可能损害推荐质量，抑制了更快推理的潜力。我们提出 DPE-Rec，一个兼顾多样性保持与高效推荐的扩散框架。DPE-Rec 通过引入语义分叉感知的 GRPO 来保持多样性，借助自回归 rollout 优先处理语义分叉决策；并通过伪轨迹蒸馏提升效率，将学习从庞大的随机破坏空间集中到高质量解码所访问的紧凑轨迹诱导子空间，实现可靠的多 token 解码。这些组件共同实现了以显著更少去噪步数完成多样且准确的捆绑包构建。在多个捆绑包构建基准上的实验表明，DPE-Rec 平均提升推荐性能 63%，其快速变体平均比现有生成式推荐方法快 25.6 倍，且推荐质量损失极小。
translation.brief: 针对扩散语言模型用于捆绑包构建时多样性下降与多 token 解码损害质量的问题，提出 DPE-Rec，结合语义分叉感知 GRPO 与伪轨迹蒸馏实现多样且高效的推荐。

papers.title: Hallucination-Aware Multi-Agent RAG via Internal Attention Rewards
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in retrieved evidence, but its outputs often contain claims unsupported by that evidence. Recent multi-agent RAG systems decompose the pipeline into cooperative decisions, yet they typically optimize all agents under a shared task reward such as EM or F1, which measures answer overlap rather than faithfulness to evidence. We propose a hallucination-aware multi-agent RAG framework that combines the task reward with an internal hallucination-risk signal computed from the generator's attention-head norms. Three role-specific LoRA adapters, a query planner, an evidence selector, and an answer generator, share a frozen backbone. A lightweight critic is trained once on TruthfulQA truthful/false pairs and then kept frozen, providing a complementary risk score that is added to the shared reward during cooperative PPO training. Across three backbones (Qwen3-8B, Llama3-8B, Llama2-13B) and three benchmarks (RAGTruth, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA), our method improves task performance and reduces hallucination rates over the strongest multi-agent baseline. Ablations and critic diagnostics show that the TruthfulQA-calibrated signal provides useful reward shaping that transfers across RAG tasks.

translation.title: 基于内部注意力奖励的幻觉感知多智能体 RAG
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）将语言模型建立在检索证据之上，但其输出常包含证据不支持的断言。近期的多智能体 RAG 系统将流程分解为协作决策，但它们通常在共享任务奖励（如 EM 或 F1）下优化所有智能体，该奖励衡量答案重叠度而非对证据的忠实度。我们提出一个幻觉感知的多智能体 RAG 框架，将任务奖励与从生成器注意力头范数计算得到的内部幻觉风险信号相结合。三个角色专属的 LoRA 适配器——查询规划器、证据选择器和答案生成器——共享一个冻结的骨干网络。一个轻量级 critic 在 TruthfulQA 真实/虚假样本对上训练一次后保持冻结，提供一个互补的风险分数，在协作式 PPO 训练中加到共享奖励上。在三个骨干模型（Qwen3-8B、Llama3-8B、Llama2-13B）和三个基准（RAGTruth、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA）上，我们的方法相比最强的多智能体基线提升了任务性能并降低了幻觉率。消融实验与 critic 诊断表明，经 TruthfulQA 校准的信号提供了可跨 RAG 任务迁移的有效奖励塑形。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体 RAG 共享任务奖励无法约束幻觉的问题，提出用基于注意力头范数的内部幻觉风险信号与任务奖励结合进行 PPO 协作训练。

papers.title: Learning to Remember: Advances in Memory Mechanisms for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Memory has become a central mechanism for extending large language models (LLMs) beyond fixed context windows, stateless interaction, and static parametric knowledge. This survey organizes the literature around three complementary dimensions: the life cycle of memory, the storage substrate, and the system role that memory plays in LLM-based agents, while using cognitive-science-inspired memory concepts as a lightweight conceptual motivation rather than as a separate technical contribution or implementation family. On this basis, we distinguish three mechanism families: nonparametric memory, where information is stored outside model parameters in text, graph, multimodal, or database-like structures; parametric memory, where information is stored or accessed through activations, key-value caches, learned modules, adapter-based parameterizations, or model weights; and memory for agent evolution, where stored experiences support reinforcement learning, continual learning, procedural reuse, context engineering, and agent harness design. Evaluation is treated as a separate cross-cutting component rather than as a memory mechanism. Unlike surveys that focus primarily on retrieval-augmented generation or long-context modeling, this paper emphasizes the full memory life cycle: construction, maintenance, retrieval, consolidation, forgetting, governance, and evaluation. By aligning conceptual motivations, computational memory mechanisms, benchmarks, and deployment concerns, the survey provides a structured roadmap for designing memory-augmented LLM agents that are persistent, adaptive, auditable, and safe to update over time.

translation.title: 学会记忆：大语言模型记忆机制研究进展
translation.abstract: 记忆已成为将大语言模型（LLM）扩展到固定上下文窗口、无状态交互和静态参数化知识之外的核心机制。本综述围绕三个互补维度组织文献：记忆的生命周期、存储基底，以及记忆在基于 LLM 的智能体中所扮演的系统角色，同时将受认知科学启发的记忆概念作为轻量的概念性动机，而非独立的技术贡献或实现家族。在此基础上，我们区分三个机制家族：非参数记忆，即信息以文本、图、多模态或类数据库结构存储在模型参数之外；参数记忆，即信息通过激活、键值缓存、学习模块、基于适配器的参数化或模型权重进行存储或访问；以及面向智能体进化的记忆，即存储的经验支持强化学习、持续学习、程序复用、上下文工程与智能体框架设计。评估被作为独立的横切组件处理，而非一种记忆机制。与主要聚焦检索增强生成或长上下文建模的综述不同，本文强调完整的记忆生命周期：构建、维护、检索、巩固、遗忘、治理与评估。通过对齐概念动机、计算记忆机制、基准与部署关切，本综述为设计持久、自适应、可审计且可安全随时间更新的记忆增强 LLM 智能体提供了结构化路线图。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 记忆研究缺乏系统梳理的问题，从记忆生命周期、存储基底与系统角色三个维度综述非参数记忆、参数记忆与智能体进化记忆三大机制家族。

papers.title: Octen-WebGR: Scaling Generative Retrieval to 200 Million Web Pages
papers.abstract: Navigational search aims to find a single target page among hundreds of millions of web pages. Click tables work well for queries seen before but cannot generalise to new formulations, while embedding retrievers generalise across content but often rank navigational targets poorly. We introduce Octen-WebGR, a generative retrieval framework that stores web pages in the parameters of a language model: given a query, the model generates a two-token semantic identifier constrained to a table of real URLs. We develop Octen-WebGR-4B, which indexes 201 million web pages, and evaluate it on real navigational traffic from the month after training. Generative retrieval is most effective on new ways of asking for familiar pages: for unseen queries targeting pages with substantial interaction history, it ranks the correct page first 30.9% of the time, against 17.2% for a dense retriever trained on the same clicks (21.4% with a click prior). Embedding retrieval keeps an advantage on rarely visited pages, so the two approaches generalise on complementary sides, the query and the page. Over all navigational traffic, Octen-WebGR reaches 59.6% top-1 accuracy, against 46.5% for a click-enhanced dense retriever and up to 37.5% for frontier LLMs answering from memory, which cost at least 40 times as much per query. The 4B model runs on a single GPU with 10 GB of memory, compared with 412 GB for exact dense retrieval. Scaling experiments with up to 32 million URLs show that, when every query-page pair is seen equally often, the model size needed grows sublinearly with index size, and that retrieval is constrained more by page exposure than by model capacity. We release Octen-WebGR-4B and Octen-WebGR-0.6B with their identifier tables and inference code.

translation.title: Octen-WebGR：将生成式检索扩展到2亿网页
translation.abstract: 导航式搜索旨在从数亿网页中找到唯一目标页面。点击表对见过的查询效果良好，但无法泛化到新的表述方式；而嵌入检索器能跨内容泛化，但对导航目标的排序往往不佳。我们提出Octen-WebGR，一种将网页存储在语言模型参数中的生成式检索框架：给定查询，模型生成一个受真实URL表约束的两token语义标识符。我们开发了索引2.01亿网页的Octen-WebGR-4B，并在训练之后一个月的真实导航流量上评估。生成式检索在用新方式询问熟悉页面时最为有效：对于指向有大量交互历史页面的未见查询，它有30.9%的概率将正确页面排在首位，而基于相同点击训练的稠密检索器仅为17.2%（加入点击先验后为21.4%）。嵌入检索在极少访问的页面上保持优势，因此两种方法在互补的两端——查询端和页面端——各自泛化。在全部导航流量上，Octen-WebGR达到59.6%的top-1准确率，而点击增强的稠密检索器为46.5%，凭记忆回答的前沿LLM最高为37.5%，且后者每查询成本至少高40倍。4B模型可在单张10 GB显存的GPU上运行，而精确稠密检索需要412 GB。多达3200万URL的扩展实验表明，当每个查询-页面对被等频看到时，所需模型规模随索引规模呈亚线性增长，且检索更多受页面曝光而非模型容量的约束。我们发布了Octen-WebGR-4B和Octen-WebGR-0.6B及其标识符表和推理代码。
translation.brief: 解决导航式搜索中新查询表述泛化难的问题，方法是将网页以两token语义标识符形式存入语言模型参数中实现生成式检索。

papers.title: Read the Route: Attention-Steered Hypergraph Retrieval for Multi-hop RAG
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers multi-hop questions by organizing a corpus into a graph and retrieving along its structure. Existing retrieval methods face two limitations. Diffusion- and similarity-based methods expand retrieval along fixed edge weights or by similarity to the question, without resolving its implicit entity references, allowing relevance errors to accumulate across hops. In contrast, exploration-based methods let an LLM reason about the next hop, but require a separate generation at each hop, leading to high inference costs. We observe that an LLM can resolve implicit entity references from retrieved passages and a multi-hop question before generating any tokens. Further analysis identifies a small set of attention heads, termed addressing heads, that capture this capability across multiple hops in a single forward pass. Building on this finding, we propose HyperAddress, which runs Personalized PageRank on a description-labelled hypergraph, using addressing heads to determine the restart distribution and transition weights, thereby guiding multi-hop retrieval without any generation at query time. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and HotpotQA, HyperAddress outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.5 points of Recall@5 and 7.4 points of All@5 on average, with gains that grow with the number of hops. It answers more than twice as fast and builds its index at half the cost.

translation.title: 读路线：注意力引导的超图检索用于多跳RAG
translation.abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过将语料组织成图并沿其结构检索来回答多跳问题。现有检索方法存在两个局限。基于扩散和相似度的方法沿固定边权重或按与问题的相似度扩展检索，不解析问题中的隐式实体指代，导致相关性误差跨跳累积。相比之下，基于探索的方法让LLM推理下一跳，但每跳都需要一次独立生成，推理成本高。我们观察到，LLM可以在生成任何token之前，从检索到的段落和多跳问题中解析隐式实体指代。进一步分析发现一小组注意力头（称为addressing heads）能在单次前向传播中跨多跳捕获这一能力。基于此发现，我们提出HyperAddress，在带描述标签的超图上运行Personalized PageRank，利用addressing heads确定重启分布和转移权重，从而在查询时无需任何生成即可引导多跳检索。在MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA和HotpotQA上，HyperAddress平均比最强基线高出3.5个点的Recall@5和7.4个点的All@5，且增益随跳数增加而扩大。其回答速度快一倍以上，索引构建成本减半。
translation.brief: 解决多跳RAG中隐式实体指代解析与高推理成本问题，方法是用LLM的addressing heads引导超图上的Personalized PageRank实现免生成的多跳检索。

papers.title: Beyond "[at]": A Large-Scale Measurement of Email Address Presentation on Computer Science Scholars' Homepages
papers.abstract: Publishing an email address makes a scholar reachable, but also exposes it to automated collection. Yet how email addresses are presented on the Web has not been measured systematically across their content, form, and location. We measure it across 32,413 homepage records of computer-science scholars listed in CSRankings with MailScope, which preserves raw and rendered HTML, extracts addresses with a three-stage cascade (rules, then large language models, then a crawling agent), and labels each address. Among 19,517 reachable homepages, we find an address for 17,712 scholars (90.8%). Our measurement yields four main findings. (i) Presentation is diverse: only 53.8% publish plain content, the others spread over 23 subtypes of symbol substitution, code, and semantic description, and 5.5% of scholars' addresses appear only after rendering. (ii) Presentation follows hosts rather than individuals: scholars on one host share a content class in 67.9% of pairs, compared with 38.8% across hosts of one institution, whereas research output and institution rank are barely related to presentation. (iii) Content and form are coupled through code-based links, and 6.2% of scholars with non-plain selected presentations have plain-text copies of the same address elsewhere. (iv) Plain addresses are more common behind passed bot challenges, and 36.1% of redirecting homepages no longer lead to scholars. Human assessment yields 94.4% weighted exact-set agreement on 143 judgeable pages, complemented by three 500-page review rounds with human verification. Presentation is diverse but clusters by shared host, and by our label-based estimate plain-string matching misses nearly half of the addresses.

translation.title: 超越"[at]"：计算机科学学者主页上电子邮件地址呈现方式的大规模测量
translation.abstract: 公开电子邮件地址使学者可被联系，但也使其暴露于自动化收集。然而，电子邮件地址在Web上的呈现方式（内容、形式和位置）尚未被系统测量。我们使用MailScope对CSRankings中计算机科学学者的32,413条主页记录进行测量，该工具保留原始和渲染后的HTML，通过三阶段级联（规则、大语言模型、爬取代理）提取地址并为每个地址打标签。在19,517个可访问主页中，我们为17,712位学者（90.8%）找到地址。测量得出四个主要发现：(i) 呈现方式多样：仅53.8%发布纯文本内容，其余分布在23种符号替换、代码和语义描述子类型中，5.5%学者的地址仅在渲染后可见。(ii) 呈现方式跟随主机而非个人：同一主机上的学者在67.9%的配对中共享内容类别，而同一机构不同主机间仅为38.8%，研究成果和机构排名与呈现方式几乎无关。(iii) 内容与形式通过基于代码的链接耦合，6.2%选择非纯文本呈现的学者在其他地方有同一地址的纯文本副本。(iv) 通过机器人挑战的页面后纯文本地址更常见，36.1%的重定向主页已不再指向学者。人工评估在143个可判定页面上达到94.4%的加权精确集合一致率，并辅以三轮各500页的人工验证审查。呈现方式多样但按共享主机聚集，据我们基于标签的估计，纯字符串匹配会漏掉近一半地址。
translation.brief: 解决学者主页邮箱地址呈现方式缺乏系统测量的问题，方法是用三阶段级联提取工具MailScope对3万余条主页记录进行大规模测量分析。

papers.title: ACARE: Agent-Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search
papers.abstract: In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user's original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent's reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker's mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.

translation.title: ACARE：面向迭代搜索的智能体上下文感知重排序器
translation.abstract: 在智能体搜索中，文档可能匹配智能体生成的子查询，却无助于回答用户的原始问题。传统重排序器仅针对子查询对文档打分，忽略了更广泛的任务和智能体的推理过程。我们提出智能体上下文感知重排序器（ACARe），一个紧凑的4B LLM，训练其在上下文可用时利用上下文对文档重排序。在多个基准和智能体家族上，ACARe在降低搜索开销的同时提升了相对其基础重排序器的检索质量。这些收益延伸到答案生成：相比无重排序，ACARe提高了准确率并减少搜索次数，同时以更精确的证据达到或超过基础重排序器的平均准确率。它还帮助较小的智能体缩小与较大智能体之间的检索质量差距，展示了更好的检索工具如何使较小的智能体更有效。模型、训练数据和代码将很快发布。
translation.brief: 解决传统重排序器忽略智能体任务上下文的问题，方法是训练4B LLM利用智能体推理上下文对文档重排序。

papers.title: Cognitively Constrained Partners for Zero-Shot Coordination in Real-Time Partitioned Control
papers.abstract: Effective human-machine teaming requires agents that coordinate with unpredictable human partners. Reinforcement learning from live human feedback or large behavioural datasets is expensive, while purely simulated training overfits to artificial conventions and fails at Zero-Shot Coordination with real people. We propose a framework for training teaming agents against Cognitively Constrained Partners: simulated partners whose diversity emerges from procedural constraints grounded in human physiological literature, specifically reaction delays and perceptual limitations, rather than from reward shaping or historical training checkpoints. In a modified Lunar Lander environment, we report preliminary evidence that these partners play more like real people than unconstrained agents do, and that agents trained against them match the strongest cross-play baselines while being the only ones whose performance does not depend on how their training partners were generated. We also describe a human-participant study designed so that its rankings can be compared directly against cross-play, testing how well that standard evaluation predicts real human-agent teaming.

translation.title: 用于实时分区控制零样本协调的认知受限伙伴
translation.abstract: 有效的人机协作需要能与不可预测的人类伙伴协调的智能体。从实时人类反馈或大型行为数据集进行强化学习成本高昂，而纯模拟训练会过拟合于人工约定，在与真实人类的零样本协调（Zero-Shot Coordination）中失败。我们提出一个针对认知受限伙伴（Cognitively Constrained Partners）训练协作智能体的框架：这类模拟伙伴的多样性来自基于人类生理学文献的程序化约束——具体为反应延迟和感知限制——而非奖励塑形或历史训练检查点。在改进的Lunar Lander环境中，我们报告了初步证据：这些伙伴比无约束智能体更像真人，针对它们训练的智能体达到最强cross-play基线的水平，且是唯一性能不依赖于训练伙伴生成方式的智能体。我们还描述了一项人类被试实验，其设计使排名可与cross-play直接比较，以检验该标准评估对真实人机协作的预测能力。
translation.brief: 解决零样本协调中模拟伙伴过拟合人工约定的问题，方法是用基于人类生理学约束（反应延迟、感知限制）程序化生成认知受限伙伴来训练协作智能体。

papers.title: When and How Does Muon Precondition? The Role of Structured Gradient Noise
papers.abstract: Muon has become a popular optimizer for large language model training, yet its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we study how gradient noise geometry shapes Muon's preconditioning benefits. We first show, theoretically and empirically, that under the classical isotropic noise assumption, Muon offers no acceleration beyond a rescaling of the learning rate. This motivates us to investigate structured noise arising from mini-batch sampling in associative memory with heterogeneous task frequencies. We establish an exact balancing threshold for two tasks and extend the analysis to multiple tasks, revealing how task coverage and gradient reliability jointly shape learning. Our analysis shows that Muon can soften the dependence on task frequency from linear to square-root, helping balance the learning of frequent and rare tasks. We further identify rotation-induced negative transfer in SignSGD that Muon avoids, and explain how momentum reduces sampling noise while tracking changing gradients. Controlled numerical experiments validate these mechanisms, and a preliminary LLM pretraining study illustrates the practical promise of fast-slow momentum.

translation.title: Muon 何时以及如何进行预条件化？结构化梯度噪声的作用
translation.abstract: Muon 已成为大语言模型训练中流行的优化器，但其理论基础仍知之甚少。在本工作中，我们研究梯度噪声的几何结构如何塑造 Muon 预条件化的收益。我们首先从理论和实证上证明，在经典的各向同性噪声假设下，Muon 除了对学习率进行重新缩放之外并不提供任何加速。这促使我们研究在具有异构任务频率的联想记忆中由小批量采样产生的结构化噪声。我们为两个任务建立了精确的平衡阈值，并将分析扩展到多任务情形，揭示了任务覆盖率和梯度可靠性如何共同塑造学习过程。我们的分析表明，Muon 可以将对任务频率的依赖从线性软化到平方根，帮助平衡高频任务与稀有任务的学习。我们进一步识别出 SignSGD 中由旋转引起的负迁移（Muon 可以避免这种负迁移），并解释了动量如何在跟踪变化梯度的同时降低采样噪声。受控数值实验验证了这些机制，一项初步的 LLM 预训练研究展示了快慢动量的实践前景。
translation.brief: 研究 Muon 优化器预条件化收益的理论来源，通过分析小批量采样产生的结构化梯度噪声，揭示其平衡高低频任务学习并避免 SignSGD 负迁移的机制。

papers.title: Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Model Inference via Per-Query Modality Selection
papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) can jointly process a broad range of modalities, such as text, audio, and video, enabling stronger multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, but often at substantial inference cost. We observe that the benefit of additional modalities varies across queries, indicating that a fixed modality configuration can be inefficient. Motivated by this, we study query-wise modality selection, which keeps the underlying Omni-LLM fixed while adaptively selecting which modalities to provide for each query. We formulate the problem as an accuracy-cost optimization problem and develop a cost-sensitive learning approach for modality selection. We evaluate our approach on WorldSense using Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni under three inference-cost measures: input tokens, latency, and monetary cost. Across both models, query-wise modality selection consistently improves the accuracy-cost trade-off and can even outperform the standard setting in which all available modalities are provided to the Omni-LLM. For Qwen2.5-Omni, our cost-sensitive approach matches or exceeds this full-modality accuracy while requiring only approximately 41% of the input tokens, 39% of the latency, and 61% of the monetary cost.

translation.title: 通过逐查询模态选择实现高效的全模态大语言模型推理
translation.abstract: 全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）可以联合处理文本、音频、视频等多种模态，实现更强的多模态理解与推理能力，但往往伴随高昂的推理成本。我们观察到，额外模态带来的收益因查询而异，这表明固定的模态配置可能是低效的。受此启发，我们研究逐查询的模态选择，即在保持底层 Omni-LLM 不变的情况下，自适应地为每个查询选择提供哪些模态。我们将该问题形式化为精度-成本优化问题，并开发了一种用于模态选择的代价敏感学习方法。我们在 WorldSense 上使用 Qwen2.5-Omni 和 Qwen3-Omni，在输入 token 数、延迟和货币成本三种推理成本度量下评估我们的方法。在两个模型上，逐查询模态选择始终改善精度-成本权衡，甚至可以超越向 Omni-LLM 提供所有可用模态的标准设置。对于 Qwen2.5-Omni，我们的代价敏感方法在匹配或超过全模态精度的同时，仅需约 41% 的输入 token、39% 的延迟和 61% 的货币成本。
translation.brief: 针对 Omni-LLM 固定模态配置推理成本高的问题，提出逐查询自适应模态选择的代价敏感学习方法，以在保持精度的同时大幅降低推理成本。

papers.title: CuraLoc: Repository-Level Fault Localization via Planned Code Inspection
papers.abstract: A bug report describes what went wrong, but rarely where the code should change. Existing repository-level localization methods often let language models iteratively decide what code to inspect next, requiring repeated model calls and substantial token usage. We investigate whether these inspection decisions can instead be planned before source retrieval. In this research, we introduce CuraLoc, which first selects candidate files and represents their symbols using compact behavioral and structural descriptions. In a single planning decision, the model jointly selects starting symbols, chooses code relationships to inspect from each, and forms hypotheses about likely edits. Deterministic retrieval collects the requested source for a final ranking informed by those hypotheses, concentrating model reasoning on choosing and comparing code rather than directing each retrieval step. We demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed approach on the SWE-Bench Lite and Verified datasets. On SWE Bench Verified with GPT-5.2, CuraLoc raises Func@1 from LocAgent's 53.8% to 59.3% while using 90.3% fewer recorded tokens, and also outperforms RepoSearcher (56.2%) and Agentless (39.6%) on Func@1. On SWE-bench Lite, CuraLoc achieves a high 83.8% Func@5 accuracy improving on Agentless by more than 15% in relative accuracy. Additionally, CuraLoc supports different model backbones, with strong localization accuracy demonstrated using both GPT-5.2 and GPT-6 Astra. These results provide evidence that repository-level code inspection can be planned effectively without iterative model-controlled navigation.

translation.title: CuraLoc：基于规划式代码检查的仓库级故障定位
translation.abstract: 缺陷报告描述了出了什么问题，但很少指出代码应该在哪里修改。现有的仓库级定位方法通常让语言模型迭代地决定下一步检查什么代码，需要反复调用模型并消耗大量 token。我们研究这些检查决策是否可以在源码检索之前进行规划。在本研究中，我们提出 CuraLoc，它首先选择候选文件，并使用紧凑的行为和结构描述来表示其中的符号。在单次规划决策中，模型联合选择起始符号、选择要从每个符号检查的代码关系，并对可能的修改形成假设。确定性检索收集所需的源码，用于最终由这些假设指导的排序，使模型推理集中于选择和比较代码，而不是指导每一步检索。我们在 SWE-Bench Lite 和 Verified 数据集上展示了所提方法的有效性。在 SWE-Bench Verified 上使用 GPT-5.2，CuraLoc 将 Func@1 从 LocAgent 的 53.8% 提升到 59.3%，同时记录 token 减少 90.3%，并且在 Func@1 上也优于 RepoSearcher（56.2%）和 Agentless（39.6%）。在 SWE-bench Lite 上，CuraLoc 达到 83.8% 的高 Func@5 精度，相对精度比 Agentless 提高超过 15%。此外，CuraLoc 支持不同的模型骨干，在使用 GPT-5.2 和 GPT-6 Astra 时均展现出强大的定位精度。这些结果证明仓库级代码检查可以在无需迭代式模型控制导航的情况下进行有效规划。
translation.brief: 针对仓库级故障定位中迭代式模型导航 token 消耗大的问题，提出 CuraLoc，通过单次规划决策预先制定代码检查计划，再由确定性检索完成定位。

papers.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

translation.title: 将大语言模型与人类反馈对齐：数学基础与算法设计
translation.abstract: 本文介绍了用于将大语言模型（LLM）与人类意图、偏好和价值观对齐的数学基础与算法框架。我们讨论标准的对齐技术，如微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。我们还探索从人类偏好学习的理论基础，将其与逆强化学习（IRL）和离散选择模型建立联系。我们以教程风格呈现最先进的算法，讨论它们的优势与局限，并提供实践实现的见解。我们的阐述旨在为研究人员和从业者提供全面的资源，既提供对齐方法论的基础理解，也提供开发更鲁棒、更可扩展对齐技术的框架。
translation.brief: 以教程形式系统阐述 LLM 人类反馈对齐（SFT、RLHF、DPO）的数学基础与算法设计，并联系 IRL 与离散选择模型的理论。

papers.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
papers.abstract: This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.

translation.title: 推测解码是两种权衡的故事
translation.abstract: 推测解码是一种通过从更快、质量较低的草稿模型采样来加速自回归大语言模型（LLM）推理速度的技术。传统上，推测解码的一个基本特性是相对于验证器分布是无损的，在不牺牲质量的前提下保证速度。这与最近发展的扩散 LLM（dLLM）不同，后者能够通过以更少的扩散努力降低输出质量来实现显著加速。由于扩散模型能够通过并行生成 token 比自回归模型更快地采样，它们被认为是推测扩散中草稿模型的有力候选。虽然人们普遍理解扩散模型可以用质量换速度，但推测解码本身也可以被泛化，通过使用相对于验证器分布更宽松的接受准则来更快地生成有损样本。面对扩散努力和推测解码宽松度这两个参数，本文通过这两个参数的联合变化探索完整可实现的 Pareto 前沿。我们的实验表明，联合调整扩散努力和接受宽松度可以扩展单步扩散草稿的速度-质量 Pareto 前沿。
translation.brief: 研究推测扩散中扩散努力与接受宽松度两个参数的联合调节，探索速度-质量权衡的完整 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: REDAR: Reinforcement-Driven Adaptive Regularisation for Class Incremental Learning
papers.abstract: Regularisation-based class-incremental learning (CIL) methods control the stability-plasticity trade-off through fixed coefficients tuned offline, independently of the continual learning objective and blind to phase-specific variations in data volume, task difficulty, and class similarity. We argue this is a fundamental mismatch and propose REDAR: Reinforcement-Driven Adaptive Regularisation for Class Incremental Learning, which treats regularisation strength selection as a sequential decision problem. At each incremental phase, a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) agent observes a compact state of current performance metrics and incoming data statistics, and outputs the distillation coefficients for that phase. To respect CIL's constraint on historical data access, the policy is trained entirely on pseudo-CIL tasks constructed from the initial phase, then deployed on the incremental sequence without further adaptation. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that REDAR reduces forgetting and improves forward transfer over fixed and heuristic baselines, and that policies trained on short pseudo-task horizons transfer effectively to longer incremental runs.

translation.title: REDAR：面向类增量学习的强化学习驱动自适应正则化
translation.abstract: 基于正则化的类增量学习（CIL）方法通过离线调优的固定系数来控制稳定性-可塑性权衡，该系数与持续学习目标相互独立，且无法感知各阶段数据量、任务难度和类别相似度的变化。我们认为这是一种根本性的失配，并提出 REDAR：面向类增量学习的强化学习驱动自适应正则化，它将正则化强度的选择视为一个序贯决策问题。在每个增量阶段，一个轻量级强化学习（RL）智能体观察由当前性能指标和输入数据统计构成的紧凑状态，并输出该阶段的蒸馏系数。为遵守 CIL 对历史数据访问的限制，策略完全在由初始阶段构建的伪 CIL 任务上训练，然后部署到增量序列上而无需进一步适应。在 CIFAR-100 和 Tiny-ImageNet 上的实验表明，REDAR 相比固定和启发式基线减少了遗忘并提升了前向迁移，且在短伪任务时域上训练的策略能够有效迁移到更长的增量运行中。
translation.brief: 针对类增量学习中固定正则化系数无法适应各阶段差异的问题，提出用强化学习智能体在每个增量阶段自适应选择蒸馏系数，策略仅在初始阶段构建的伪 CIL 任务上训练。

papers.title: PRISM: Promoting Sampling Diversity of Large Language Models with Implicit Stochastic Modulation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes semantic repetition rather than discovery, making rare but stronger solutions unlikely to surface and leaving self-evolution and continual learning difficult to sustain. Most remedies intervene only at inference time, shaping sam- ples without making diversity a model capability. We propose PRISM, a training-time framework that internalizes diversity within the model. PRISM combines (i) submodular curation that pairs each prompt with diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions, and (ii) stochastic embedding modulation, which turns special-token perturbations into implicit signals for sampling distinct outputs. A theoretical analysis establishes the stability of this mechanism. On WritingPrompts and BookMIA, PRISM moves the quality-diversity frontier outward, achieving the best generation quality in all model-benchmark settings while maintaining the strongest or near-strongest semantic diversity across two open-weight model families. It also improves sampling efficiency on math and code benchmarks. Beyond inference, PRISM yields a stronger foundation for reinforcement learning, sustaining diverse rollouts and mitigating the diversity collapse commonly observed during RL training.

translation.title: PRISM：通过隐式随机调制促进大语言模型的采样多样性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）存在模式坍缩现象，即输出分布集中于熟悉的语义模式。当多样性消失时，重复采样变成语义重复而非发现，使得罕见但更优的解难以浮现，自我进化和持续学习也难以维持。大多数补救措施仅在推理时干预，只是塑造样本而没有使多样性成为模型的一种能力。我们提出 PRISM，一个在训练时将多样性内化到模型中的框架。PRISM 结合了：(i) 次模精选，为每个提示配对多样且正确的多教师解；(ii) 随机嵌入调制，将特殊 token 扰动转化为采样不同输出的隐式信号。理论分析证明了该机制的稳定性。在 WritingPrompts 和 BookMIA 上，PRISM 将质量-多样性前沿向外推移，在所有模型-基准设置中取得最佳生成质量，同时在两个开源权重模型家族中保持最强或接近最强的语义多样性。它还提升了数学和代码基准上的采样效率。超越推理层面，PRISM 为强化学习提供了更坚实的基础，维持多样的 rollout 并缓解 RL 训练中常见的多样性坍缩。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 输出模式坍缩导致采样缺乏多样性的问题，提出训练时框架 PRISM，通过次模精选多教师解和随机嵌入调制将多样性内化为模型能力。

papers.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.

translation.title: BiLoCo：用于训练后量化的二值低秩修正
translation.abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）到 FP4 已成为降低大语言模型推理成本的关键技术，尤其是在提供原生 FP4 张量核心支持的 Blackwell GPU 上。然而，直接 PTQ 到 FP4 仍存在明显的精度差距。近期 SVDQuant 的工作通过添加经 SVD 获得的高精度低秩修正来缓解扩散模型中 FP4 量化引入的误差。然而，这种高精度低秩修正每个秩需要消耗大量比特，且与主 FP4 GEMM 运行在相同的张量核心上。我们提出 BiLoCo，一种低秩修正方法，其左右因子以二值 {±1} 符号向量而非 BF16 数值存储。该符号格式使每个秩一分量节省 16 倍存储，且由于修正现在由加法/减法构成，可以在 CUDA 核心上与 FP4 张量核心 GEMM 并发运行。在 4B–72B 的 LLM 上，BiLoCo 在相同内存条件下达到或超越 SVDQuant 的 PTQ 效果。我们在 B300 上将 BiLoCo 实现为融合单内核：FP4 GEMM 运行在张量核心上，位打包修正在同一次启动的 CUDA 核心上运行，两者在 GEMM epilogue 中合并。在 batch size 为 1 时，对于最高 512 的每个秩，融合内核最多比纯 FP4 GEMM 慢 11%。在秩为 128 时，batch size 最高到 8 时最多慢 20%。
translation.brief: 针对 FP4 训后量化精度损失问题，提出 BiLoCo，用二值符号向量存储低秩修正因子以大幅节省存储，并可在 CUDA 核心上与 FP4 张量核心 GEMM 并发执行。

papers.title: Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithms
papers.abstract: Adversarial sharpness penalty per iteration of a base optimizer, known as sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), is an accepted technique to improve generalization in deep learning. Recently, Muon has emerged as a dominant optimization algorithm for training large language models (LLMs). It achieves lower sample complexity for heavy-tailed gradient updates - a phenomenon common in LLM training. However, sharpness penalties with Muon updates are yet largely unexplored in the literature. Moreover, the behavior of SAM under heavy-tailed noise is unknown both theoretically and empirically. A potential reason for this gap is the additional cost of extra gradient computation per iteration for penalty perturbations in SAM, which becomes prohibitive for LLMs. This paper introduces Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA) to combine a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded perturbation scheme with the Muon algorithm. The key idea is to use stale (purely) stochastic gradient noise for adversarial perturbations. Theoretically, we show that SOMA's sample complexity is invariant to the perturbation direction. We provide explorations and insights into SOMA's robustness to heavy-tailed gradient noise. We extensively explore SOMA's efficacy in (a) mitigating quality degradation due to post-training quantization, and (b) catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning of LLMs.

translation.title: 锐度感知正交化动量算法
translation.abstract: 在基础优化器的每次迭代中加入对抗性锐度惩罚，即锐度感知最小化（SAM），是提升深度学习泛化能力的公认技术。近来，Muon 已成为训练大语言模型（LLM）的主导优化算法，它对重尾梯度更新——LLM 训练中的常见现象——实现了更低的样本复杂度。然而，结合 Muon 更新的锐度惩罚在文献中仍基本未被探索。此外，SAM 在重尾噪声下的行为在理论和实证上均属未知。造成这一空白的一个潜在原因是 SAM 中惩罚扰动所需的每次迭代额外梯度计算开销，这对 LLM 而言过于昂贵。本文提出锐度感知正交化动量算法（SOMA），将一种计算高效且有理论依据的扰动方案与 Muon 算法相结合。核心思想是使用陈旧的（纯）随机梯度噪声作为对抗扰动。理论上，我们证明 SOMA 的样本复杂度对扰动方向不变。我们提供了 SOMA 对重尾梯度噪声鲁棒性的探索与洞察，并广泛研究了 SOMA 在以下两方面的有效性：(a) 缓解训练后量化导致的质量退化，(b) LLM 微调中的灾难性遗忘。
translation.brief: 针对 SAM 与 Muon 结合时额外梯度计算开销过大且在重尾噪声下行为未知的问题，提出 SOMA，利用陈旧随机梯度噪声作为对抗扰动，实现计算高效的锐度感知正交化动量优化。

papers.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models often uses separate systems for inference and training. Even with identical weights and BF16 tensors, implementation differences can make an intended on-policy update off-policy and destabilize training. Existing remedies align the entire inference and training stacks, change global precision, or modify the learning algorithm. We ask whether aligning selected parts of the execution stack can stabilize BF16 RL while other implementation differences remain. We align training-side rounding locations with inference in three regions---RoPE, SwiGLU, and residual RMSNorm---by retaining selected intermediates in FP32 until their BF16 outputs. Across four Qwen-family models, aligning all three regions prevents the collapse observed under the default BF16 baseline; RoPE-path alignment alone also suffices in the studied runs, despite remaining numerical discrepancies. The interventions keep the inference engine, matrix-multiplication and attention kernels, and learning objective unchanged.

translation.title: 舍入发生的位置很重要：舍入位置对齐可稳定 LLM 强化学习
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的强化学习通常使用独立的推理和训练系统。即使权重和 BF16 张量完全相同，实现上的差异也可能使预期的 on-policy 更新变为 off-policy，从而破坏训练稳定性。现有补救措施要么对齐整个推理和训练栈，要么改变全局精度，要么修改学习算法。我们探究是否只需对齐执行栈中的选定部分即可在保留其他实现差异的情况下稳定 BF16 RL。我们在三个区域——RoPE、SwiGLU 和残差 RMSNorm——中通过将选定中间量以 FP32 保留直至其 BF16 输出，使训练侧的舍入位置与推理对齐。在四个 Qwen 家族模型上，对齐全部三个区域可防止默认 BF16 基线下观察到的崩溃；在所研究的运行中，仅对齐 RoPE 路径也足以奏效，尽管仍存在数值差异。这些干预保持推理引擎、矩阵乘法和注意力内核以及学习目标不变。
translation.brief: 针对推理与训练系统实现差异导致 BF16 强化学习训练不稳定的问题，提出在 RoPE、SwiGLU 和 RMSNorm 三个区域对齐训练侧与推理侧的舍入位置以稳定训练。

papers.title: LLM-Augmented Agent-Based Simulation of Cyber Social Agents
papers.abstract: Social media bots are often portrayed as malicious automations to be detected and removed, but automation on social media platforms encompasses a wide spectrum of roles, behaviors, and rhetorical strategies that can shape online discourse in both constructive and destructive ways. This work conceptualizes these automated actors as \textbf{Cyber Social Agents} through a taxonomy of archetypes characterized by their operational tactics and rhetorical style. We integrate this taxonomy into an LLM-driven social simulation, where agents communicate and coordinate in a network environment. Using empirically grounded CSA personas, we simulate heterogeneous online societies to study how agent diversity shapes information diffusion and social influence. Our approach bridges the gap between rule-based agent models and LLM-powered simulations with generated agents that are parameterized from empirical data.

translation.title: LLM增强的网络社会智能体仿真
translation.abstract: 社交媒体机器人常被描述为需要检测和清除的恶意自动化程序，但社交媒体平台上的自动化行为涵盖广泛的角色、行为和修辞策略，能以建设性和破坏性两种方式塑造网络话语。本工作通过一个以操作策略和修辞风格为特征的原型分类法，将这些自动化行为者概念化为网络社会智能体（Cyber Social Agents, CSA）。我们将该分类法集成到一个由LLM驱动的社会仿真中，智能体在网络环境中进行交流与协调。基于实证数据的CSA人设，我们仿真异构的在线社会，研究智能体多样性如何塑造信息扩散与社会影响。我们的方法通过从实证数据参数化生成的智能体，弥合了基于规则的智能体模型与LLM驱动仿真之间的鸿沟。
translation.brief: 为研究自动化行为者对网络话语的多样影响，提出基于实证数据分类法并用LLM驱动的网络社会智能体仿真框架。

papers.title: AutoSwarm: Automating Agent Swarms
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate complex tasks, with multi-agent systems seeking further performance gains through specialization and collaboration. However, distributing work across agents does not automatically yield complementary contributions, and inter-agent dependencies can turn local errors into task failure. To address these challenges, we propose AutoSwarm, a multi-agent framework for collaborative problem solving. Collaboration formation jointly defines responsibility boundaries and conditions for acceptance and downstream use, grounding capability allocation in contributions that other agents can assess and integrate toward a shared objective. Execution coordination couples agents' local progress through a shared state, using dependencies and supervisory relationships to govern agent activation, result handoffs, and integration while adapting subsequent actions to review feedback and emerging blockers. Experiments spanning long-horizon programming, interactive planning, and professional financial analysis demonstrate AutoSwarm's advantages over single-agent baselines and existing multi-agent frameworks. Source code is available at https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm.

translation.title: AutoSwarm：智能体集群的自动化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益自动化地完成复杂任务，多智能体系统试图通过专业化与协作获得进一步的性能提升。然而，将工作分配给多个智能体并不自动产生互补贡献，智能体间的依赖也可能将局部错误放大为任务失败。为应对这些挑战，我们提出AutoSwarm，一个用于协作问题求解的多智能体框架。协作形成机制共同定义责任边界以及接受与下游使用的条件，将能力分配建立在其他智能体可评估并整合到共同目标中的贡献之上。执行协调通过共享状态耦合各智能体的局部进展，利用依赖关系和监督关系控制智能体激活、结果移交与整合，并根据评审反馈和出现的阻塞因素调整后续行动。在长程编程、交互式规划和专业金融分析等实验中，AutoSwarm展现了相比单智能体基线和现有多智能体框架的优势。源代码见 https://github.com/HKUDS/AutoSwarm。
translation.brief: 为解决多智能体协作中分工不互补和依赖传播错误的问题，提出通过协作形成与执行协调机制组织LLM智能体集群的AutoSwarm框架。

papers.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
papers.abstract: Large language model agents have enabled software development through natural-language interaction, but extending this paradigm to end-to-end game development remains challenging. Building a playable game requires coordinating code, scenes, assets, animations, physics, and configurations, while allowing developers to validate their integrated behavior through interactive testing. We introduce VibeGame, a framework for creating complete 2D game projects from natural-language prompts and optional reference images. Its AI-native game engine represents project state as schema-validated structured text and provides frame-synchronous runtime control, enabling agents to inspect game states, execute actions, and verify behavior at their own pace. Built upon this interface, we design an Adversarial Agent Team of eight specialized agents to separate implementation from review, so that problems are found and fixed through multi-round loops.
