For each conducted and accepted project, we further introduce a training-free self-evolution mechanism to distill it into reusable skeletons, modules, and collaboration contracts for future development. We evaluate prompt-assets-to-game (PA2G), where agents are given an asset library, and prompt-to-game (P2G), where agents generate their own art. On a GameCraft-Bench subset, VibeGame in P2G consistently outperforms a range of agent harnesses in either P2G or PA2G with the same underlying model, including GPT-6.1-Sol.

translation.title: VibeGame：基于AI原生引擎与自进化对抗智能体团队的提示到游戏开发
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体已能通过自然语言交互进行软件开发，但将该范式扩展到端到端游戏开发仍具挑战性。构建一个可玩的游戏需要协调代码、场景、资产、动画、物理和配置，并让开发者通过交互测试验证其集成行为。我们提出VibeGame，一个从自然语言提示和可选参考图创建完整2D游戏项目的框架。其AI原生游戏引擎将项目状态表示为经模式校验的结构化文本，并提供帧同步的运行时控制，使智能体能够按自己的节奏检查游戏状态、执行动作并验证行为。基于该接口，我们设计了由八个专业化智能体组成的对抗智能体团队（Adversarial Agent Team），将实现与评审分离，通过多轮循环发现并修复问题。对每个已完成并被接受的项目，我们进一步引入免训练的自进化机制，将其提炼为可复用的骨架、模块和协作契约，供未来开发使用。我们在提示-资产到游戏（PA2G，智能体获得资产库）和提示到游戏（P2G，智能体自行生成美术）两种设置下进行评估。在GameCraft-Bench的一个子集上，相同底层模型下，P2G模式的VibeGame在P2G或PA2G模式下均持续优于一系列智能体框架，包括GPT-6.1-Sol。
translation.brief: 为用自然语言提示端到端生成可玩游戏，提出以结构化文本表示状态的AI原生游戏引擎和八智能体对抗团队实现-评审循环框架VibeGame。

papers.title: Coral Discovery: The Division of Cognitive Labor in Autonomous Research
papers.abstract: A research community is only as strong as the way it divides its cognitive labour. The philosopher Philip Kitcher argued that researchers should not all pursue the most promising approach. Credit rules, not a central plan, keep some of them on other lines. We bring this question to autonomous research, where Large Language Model agents improve programs against a deterministic grader. Agents that share only a score follow the leader and converge onto one approach. Coral Discovery gives the community a direction board. A verifier labels every attempt with a direction, the mechanism earning the score, and a method, one change within it. Per direction, the board tracks how much each eval improves the score, adds an exploration bonus for little-tried directions, prices the option of opening a new direction, and suggests how many agents each direction deserves. Credit is earned against a direction's own best, so a lagging direction keeps its agents. Agents finish their lines, then treat the board as advice. We test on nine tasks with the same model and budget, without grader access except for Kernel. Coral Discovery beats the strongest open autonomous multi-agent system on 6 tasks, ties on 1, and loses on 2. Against published numbers, it is best or tied on 4. It improves the reported Kernel result from 1103 to 1095 cycles and passes 1103 at eval 275, under half of the 596 used before. It sets a new Polyominoes state of the art, 91.78 against 87.0. Direction labels show that the leading scores rest on directions a score-only community never entered. Code will be released shortly.

translation.title: Coral Discovery：自主研究中的认知分工
translation.abstract: 一个研究共同体的强弱取决于其分工认知劳动的方式。哲学家Philip Kitcher认为，研究者不应都去追求最有希望的方法，而是由信用规则而非中央计划让部分人留在其他路线上。我们将这一问题带入自主研究领域，即大语言模型智能体在确定性评分器下改进程序。只共享分数的智能体会跟随领先者并收敛到同一方法上。Coral Discovery为共同体提供一个方向看板：验证器为每次尝试标注方向（获得该分数的机制）和方法（其中的一个改动）。看板按方向追踪每次评估对分数的提升，为少有人尝试的方向添加探索奖励，为开辟新方向的机会定价，并建议每个方向应配备多少智能体。信用以该方向自身的最佳成绩为基准计算，因此落后的方向也能留住其智能体。智能体完成自己的路线后，将看板作为建议使用。我们在九个任务上以相同模型和预算进行测试（除Kernel外不访问评分器）。Coral Discovery在6个任务上胜过最强的开源自主多智能体系统，1个打平，2个落后。与已发表结果相比，它在4个任务上最优或打平。它将已报道的Kernel结果从1103个周期改进到1095个周期，并在第275次评估时通过1103，不足此前596次的一半。它还创造了Polyominoes的新最优纪录：91.78对87.0。方向标签显示，领先的分数依赖于纯分数共同体从未进入的方向。代码即将发布。
translation.brief: 为解决LLM智能体研究中只共享分数导致方法趋同的问题，提出用方向看板和按方向计分的信用机制引导认知分工的Coral Discovery。

papers.title: BE-CTDE: Blockchain-Enabled Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Anomaly Detection and Token Economics
papers.abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning supports cooperative decision-making in Internet of Things systems, but strategic deviations can disrupt coordination and undermine confidence in the training process. This paper proposes Blockchain-Enabled Centralized Training and Decentralized Execution (BE-CTDE), which uses blockchain as an active training-management layer. A behavioral verifier compares executed trajectories with shared-policy recommendations; its flags drive a token mechanism combining slashing, burning, rewards, and compensation. Retained balances determine each agent's contribution to the global policy update, connecting auditable behavior to learning influence. We derive a one-round incentive condition that accounts for action-dependent compensation and the payoff from deviation, and a finite expected exclusion-time bound under explicit conditional detection and accounting assumptions, showing perfect detection is unnecessary. An exact finite-population capacity bound characterizes the limits of the population-relative detector. In multi-agent path finding experiments, BE-CTDE outperforms a state-of-the-art learning-based path planner with substantially higher success rates under attack, even when adversaries form the majority. It also outperforms partially defended baselines in all configurations, with collision rates up to 35% lower than under detection without economic consequences and up to 43% lower than under conventional stake slashing. Together, these results characterize how behavioral verification and token feedback can support accountable cooperative learning.

translation.title: BE-CTDE：支持异常检测与代币经济学的区块链多智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 多智能体强化学习支持物联网系统中的协作决策，但策略性偏离会破坏协调并削弱对训练过程的信心。本文提出支持区块链的中心化训练与去中心化执行（BE-CTDE），将区块链用作主动的训练管理层。行为验证器将执行轨迹与共享策略建议进行比较，其标记驱动一个结合罚没、燃烧、奖励和补偿的代币机制。保留的余额决定每个智能体对全局策略更新的贡献，将可审计的行为与学习影响力关联起来。我们推导了考虑动作相关补偿和偏离收益的单轮激励条件，以及在显式的条件化检测与记账假设下的有限期望排除时间上界，表明完美检测并非必要。一个精确的有限种群容量上界刻画了基于种群相对检测器的极限。在多智能体路径规划实验中，BE-CTDE优于最先进的基于学习的路径规划器，在遭受攻击时（即使对手占多数）成功率显著更高。它在所有配置下都优于部分防御的基线，碰撞率比无经济后果的检测方案最多低35%，比传统的权益罚没最多低43%。这些结果共同刻画了行为验证与代币反馈如何支持可问责的协作学习。
translation.brief: 为防止多智能体强化学习中的策略性偏离破坏协作，提出用区块链行为验证器和代币奖惩机制将可审计行为与学习影响力挂钩的BE-CTDE方法。

papers.title: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS) enable large language model agents to interact without centralized control. Agents need to adapt to other agents at test time and reuse accumulated experience to refine their interaction strategies for future interactions across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial settings. However, existing approaches often develop adaptation mechanisms for particular interaction settings. This raises a central question: how can decentralized MAS support test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across interaction settings? We propose EvolveMAS, a unified self-evolution framework that supports experience-driven adaptation within and across episodes. EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, which maintains isolated Structured Memory outside the main agent's reasoning context. EvolveMAS organizes adaptation into two complementary processes: Within-Episode Online Adaptation and Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution. During Within-Episode Online Adaptation, MemoryAgent updates episodic, semantic, and working memory from interaction evidence to inform subsequent actions. During Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution, the main agent uses memory and episode outcomes to distill reusable interaction knowledge comprising partner profiles and interaction strategies for subsequent episodes. Across five benchmarks and six evaluation configurations spanning the three interaction settings, EvolveMAS achieves the highest normalized average score of 77.2 among the compared methods. Ablations show that test-time memory governance and cross-episode knowledge reuse both improve performance. Interaction traces further illustrate how updated memory and distilled knowledge guide subsequent interactions. These results support experience-driven adaptation in decentralized MAS without updating model parameters.

translation.title: EvolveMAS：面向去中心化多智能体系统的统一自进化框架
translation.abstract: 去中心化多智能体系统（MAS）使大语言模型智能体能够在无集中控制的情况下交互。智能体需要在测试时适应其他智能体，并复用积累的经验来改进其在合作、混合动机和对抗等场景中的交互策略。然而，现有方法往往针对特定交互场景设计适应机制。这引出一个核心问题：去中心化 MAS 如何支持跨交互场景的测试时适应与可靠的经验复用？我们提出 EvolveMAS，一个支持回合内与跨回合经验驱动适应的统一自进化框架。EvolveMAS 为每个主智能体配备一个专用的 MemoryAgent 进行测试时记忆治理，该 MemoryAgent 在主智能体的推理上下文之外维护隔离的结构化记忆（Structured Memory）。EvolveMAS 将适应组织为两个互补过程：回合内在线适应与跨回合知识进化。在回合内在线适应中，MemoryAgent 根据交互证据更新情景记忆、语义记忆和工作记忆，以指导后续行动。在跨回合知识进化中，主智能体利用记忆和回合结果蒸馏出可复用的交互知识，包括伙伴画像和交互策略，供后续回合使用。在覆盖三种交互场景的五个基准和六种评估配置上，EvolveMAS 在对比方法中取得最高的归一化平均分 77.2。消融实验表明，测试时记忆治理和跨回合知识复用均能提升性能。交互轨迹进一步展示了更新后的记忆和蒸馏出的知识如何指导后续交互。这些结果支持在不更新模型参数的情况下实现去中心化 MAS 中的经验驱动适应。
translation.brief: 解决去中心化多智能体系统跨交互场景的测试时适应与经验复用问题，核心方法是为每个主智能体配备 MemoryAgent 进行记忆治理，并结合回合内在线适应与跨回合知识蒸馏实现自进化。

papers.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. We introduce DynaFlow, a framework that integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the action space of the main agent. The agent decides when collaboration is needed and generates task-specific programs that coordinate sub-agents through sequential or parallel execution, structured information exchange, and verification. Execution results and traces inform subsequent actions, enabling the agent to adapt collaboration as reasoning progresses. We train only the main agent through supervised fine-tuning on distilled trajectories, followed by refinement on examples filtered for unsupported premises, biased verification, and information-flow defects. All sub-agents remain fixed, separating orchestration learning from executor capability improvement. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, scientific question answering, and multi-hop retrieval, DynaFlow achieves 88.08% overall accuracy in Forced mode, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 10.90 percentage points with the same Qwen3.5-27B backbone. Workflow analysis finds more explicit use, verification, and refinement of upstream outputs after training, highlighting cross-stage information flow as a key dimension of multi-agent orchestration.

translation.title: DynaFlow：学习自由形式的多智能体编排
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统通常依赖预定义的协作结构，限制了其适应多样任务需求的能力。我们提出 DynaFlow，一个将自由形式的可执行工作流合成集成到主智能体动作空间中的框架。智能体自主决定何时需要协作，并生成任务特定的程序，通过顺序或并行执行、结构化信息交换和验证来协调子智能体。执行结果和轨迹会为后续行动提供信息，使智能体能够随着推理的推进调整协作方式。我们仅对主智能体进行训练：先在蒸馏轨迹上进行监督微调，再对经过过滤（剔除无依据前提、有偏验证和信息流缺陷的样本）的示例进行精炼。所有子智能体保持固定，从而将编排学习与执行器能力提升分离。在涵盖数学推理、科学问答和多跳检索的六个基准上，DynaFlow 在 Forced 模式下取得 88.08% 的总体准确率，在相同 Qwen3.5-27B 骨干下比最强基线高出 10.90 个百分点。工作流分析发现，训练后智能体对上游输出的使用、验证和精炼更加显式，凸显跨阶段信息流是多智能体编排的关键维度。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统依赖预定义协作结构、难以适应多样任务的问题，核心方法是将自由形式的工作流合成纳入主智能体动作空间，仅训练主智能体学习编排而保持子智能体固定。

papers.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
papers.abstract: Reusable Web-agent verification requires a rule to follow changing requirements and support subsequent execution. We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings. The resource spans 97 tasks, 79 families, and four Web services. Experiments with DeepSeek Flash/Pro establish two linked measurements. Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs; paired reuse-rebuild BA intervals are [-5.47, 1.57] and [-10.16, 0.00] percentage points. Across 22 execution families, deployment-state panel correctness separates program assignments whose two saved openings are both delivered correctly: 32/33 assignments with error-free panels, versus 1/11 with panel errors. All reference-defined program-gate regressions and withheld deliveries occur in the latter group. Neutral continuation attains the highest correct delivery under the tested generic feedback, providing a concrete baseline for measuring the value added by a gate. Released instructions, states, programs, reference rules, and trajectories connect each test failure to its execution consequences. AgentProofBench makes reusable verification assessable at both the requirement and policy levels.

translation.title: AgentProofBench：面向 Web 智能体可复用验证器的基准测试
translation.abstract: 可复用的 Web 智能体验证需要遵循不断变化的需求规则并支持后续执行。我们提出 AgentProofBench，它将冻结验收规则的成对测试与从相同保存起始状态出发的执行相连接。该资源包含 97 个任务、79 个任务族和四个 Web 服务。使用 DeepSeek Flash/Pro 的实验建立了两个相互关联的测量。在 48 个任务族上，完整面板测试和决策回放测试分别保留了 82/96 个 Flash 和 79/96 个 Pro 源程序；成对的复用-重建 BA 区间分别为 [-5.47, 1.57] 和 [-10.16, 0.00] 个百分点。在 22 个执行任务族上，部署状态面板的正确性可以区分两个保存起始状态均被正确交付的程序分配：面板无错误的 32/33 个分配，对比面板有错误的 1/11 个分配。所有由参考定义的程序门控回归和被扣留的交付都出现在后一组。在所测试的通用反馈下，中性延续取得了最高的正确交付率，为衡量门控的增值提供了具体基线。发布的指令、状态、程序、参考规则和轨迹将每个测试失败与其执行后果相连接。AgentProofBench 使可复用验证能够在需求层面和策略层面进行评估。
translation.brief: 解决 Web 智能体可复用验证器难以评估的问题，核心方法是构建将冻结验收规则的成对测试与相同起始状态的执行结果相连接的基准，从需求和策略两个层面衡量验证器价值。

papers.title: Guarded Agent-in-the-Loop Residual Adaptation for Evolving Wind Power Regimes
papers.abstract: Wind power forecasting models are often deployed as fixed temporal backbones, but the errors they make can vary across meteorological regimes such as cold waves, heat-and-calm periods, productive typhoon, and destructive storms. We present a guarded Agent-in-the-loop residual adaptation framework that leaves the temporal backbone unchanged and adapts only a small set of scene-conditioned residual experts. An Agent layer interprets external scene information, identifies the current regime, selects residual experts, and applies a correction only when recent observed errors support it. New experts enter the pool after they outperform their initializations on a validation set, keeping model growth under explicit control. Backbone-only and Agent-enhanced forecasts are compared at lead times of 4, 8, 12, 24, and 48 across nine time-series backbones. Across these runs, the guarded framework lowers both MAE and RMSE for all 45 backbone-horizon combinations, with average MAE reductions ranging from 11.21% to 20.26% across backbones. Online-selection baselines, component ablations, and routing analyses identify the roles of residual experts, scene-aware routing, and the online acceptance rule. Candidate-scene runs evaluate the promotion path under controlled conditions; long-term unattended deployment was not evaluated.

translation.title: 面向演化风电场景的受保护智能体在环残差适应
translation.abstract: 风电预测模型通常以固定的时间骨干部署，但其误差会随寒潮、热浪静风期、生产性台风和破坏性风暴等气象场景而变化。我们提出一个受保护的智能体在环残差适应框架，保持时间骨干不变，仅适应一小组基于场景条件的残差专家。Agent 层解释外部场景信息，识别当前场景，选择残差专家，并仅在近期观测误差支持时才应用修正。新专家只有在验证集上超越其初始化后才进入专家池，使模型增长处于显式控制之下。在九个时间序列骨干上，比较了仅骨干与 Agent 增强预测在 4、8、12、24 和 48 预测时距上的表现。在这些运行中，受保护框架在全部 45 个骨干-时距组合上均降低了 MAE 和 RMSE，各骨干的平均 MAE 降幅在 11.21% 到 20.26% 之间。在线选择基线、组件消融和路由分析确定了残差专家、场景感知路由和在线接受规则的作用。候选场景运行在受控条件下评估了晋升路径；未评估长期无人值守部署。
translation.brief: 解决风电预测模型在不同气象场景下误差差异大的问题，核心方法是保持时间骨干固定，由 Agent 层进行场景识别与残差专家路由，并采用受保护的在线接受规则控制模型增长。

papers.title: Knowing When to Escalate: Disagreement Patterns for Uncertainty-Aware Content Moderation
papers.abstract: Agentic content-moderation systems increasingly rely on collective judgments from LLM agents, while aggregation methods commonly treat inter-agent disagreement as a reliability problem to be removed through consensus or voting. This framing is inappropriate for value-laden tasks, where disagreement may reflect irreducible value pluralism - a distinction standard uncertainty decompositions cannot recover, since they operate on output distributions and discard the reasoning behind each judgment. We propose Reasoning Trace Divergence Analysis (RTDA), which embeds model-generated justifications from perspective-differentiated agents and classifies each case by justification similarity and conclusion agreement. The resulting four-state taxonomy isolates convergent disagreement, where agents reasoning similarly but concluding differently, as a candidate signature of value-laden conflict. On 1,000 items from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, this structural signal predicts human annotator disagreement better than magnitude-only and output-only baselines. We contribute a design principle: condition human escalation on the structure of disagreement, not its magnitude alone, with RTDA serving as a post-processing layer for systems that already generate reasoning traces.

translation.title: 知道何时升级：用于不确定性感知内容审核的分歧模式
translation.abstract: 智能体内容审核系统日益依赖 LLM 智能体的集体判断，而常用的聚合方法将智能体间分歧视为需要通过共识或投票消除的可靠性问题。这一框架不适用于涉及价值判断的任务，因为分歧可能反映不可还原的价值多元主义——标准的不确定性分解无法区分这一点，因为它们只作用于输出分布而丢弃了每个判断背后的推理。我们提出推理轨迹分歧分析（RTDA），它对来自视角差异化智能体的模型生成理由进行嵌入，并根据理由相似性和结论一致性对每个案例进行分类。由此得到的四状态分类法将收敛性分歧——即智能体推理相似但结论不同——隔离为价值冲突的候选特征信号。在 Measuring Hate Speech 语料库的 1000 个条目上，这一结构性信号比仅基于幅度和仅基于输出的基线更能预测人类标注者的分歧。我们贡献了一条设计原则：基于分歧的结构而非仅其幅度来决定是否升级给人类处理，RTDA 可作为已生成推理轨迹的系统的后处理层。
translation.brief: 解决内容审核中智能体间分歧被简单视为噪声而无法区分价值多元冲突的问题，核心方法是提出 RTDA，通过嵌入并分类智能体推理轨迹的理由相似性与结论一致性来决定何时升级给人类。

papers.title: Simulation-Efficient Double-Flow Neural Posterior Estimation for Agent-Based Models
papers.abstract: Neural posterior estimation (NPE) enables Bayesian inference of the posterior parameter in agent-based models (ABMs) with intractable likelihoods, but simulating training data can be computationally expensive. We propose Double-Flow Neural Posterior Estimation (DF-NPE), which combines learned time-series summaries with two conditional normalizing flows for synthetic-data generation and posterior estimation. The framework supplements direct simulations with synthetic training pairs and supports both pooled and ordered training strategies. Experiments in two settings of the Brock-Hommes asset-pricing model show that DF-NPE can reduce direct simulations by 90 percent while achieving lower mean posterior discrepancies and runtime than standard NPE. Performance varies with the allocation of directly simulated and synthetic data and the training strategy. These results establish learned summary augmentation as a practical approach to reducing simulation costs for Bayesian posterior inference of parameters in ABMs.

translation.title: 面向基于智能体模型的仿真高效双流神经后验估计
translation.abstract: 神经后验估计（NPE）能够对似然不可解的基于智能体模型（ABM）中的后验参数进行贝叶斯推断，但模拟训练数据的计算代价可能很高。我们提出双流神经后验估计（DF-NPE），它将学习到的时间序列摘要与两个条件归一化流相结合，用于合成数据生成和后验估计。该框架在直接模拟的基础上补充合成训练对，并支持池化和有序两种训练策略。在Brock-Hommes资产定价模型的两种设置下的实验表明，DF-NPE可以将直接模拟减少90%，同时比标准NPE获得更低的后验平均差异和运行时间。性能随直接模拟数据与合成数据的分配比例以及训练策略而变化。这些结果表明，学习式摘要增强是降低ABM参数贝叶斯后验推断仿真成本的一种实用方法。
translation.brief: 针对ABM贝叶斯推断中直接模拟成本过高的问题，提出DF-NPE，用学习的时间序列摘要结合双条件归一化流生成合成训练数据并估计后验，大幅减少直接模拟次数。

papers.title: GEAR: Feature-Based Configuration and Code Generation for Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: Engineering multi-agent systems (MAS) requires choosing agents, orchestration strategies, communication mechanisms, reasoning approaches, and memory configurations. These choices depend on framework-specific capabilities and abstractions, requiring developers to learn different APIs when exploring alternative implementations. We present GEAR, an open-source tool for configuring MAS and generating framework-specific implementations from a common specification. GEAR uses a feature-based representation to make configuration options and their constraints explicit, enabling users to validate specifications before code generation. Through connectors for ten agentic frameworks, users generate projects from the same specification and can then inspect reports describing framework-specific adaptations. A preliminary assessment of mapping feasibility identifies translation strategies for 271 of 320 evaluated feature-framework pairs (84.69%). GEAR supports developers prototyping agentic systems and researchers exploring MAS configurations across frameworks. GEAR is available as open-source software at https://github.com/brellsanwouo/gear-framework and a video demo is available at https://youtu.be/iwNi-oC2tCw.

translation.title: GEAR：面向智能体系统的基于特征的配置与代码生成
translation.abstract: 构建多智能体系统（MAS）需要选择智能体、编排策略、通信机制、推理方式和记忆配置。这些选择依赖于特定框架的能力和抽象，导致开发者在探索不同实现方案时需要学习不同的API。我们提出GEAR，一个开源工具，用于配置MAS并从统一规范生成框架特定的实现。GEAR采用基于特征的表示使配置选项及其约束显式化，使用户能够在代码生成前验证规范。通过为十个智能体框架提供的连接器，用户可以从同一规范生成项目，并查看描述框架特定适配的报告。对映射可行性的初步评估表明，在320个特征-框架对中，271个（84.69%）可以确定翻译策略。GEAR支持开发者对智能体系统进行原型设计，也支持研究者跨框架探索MAS配置。GEAR已作为开源软件发布于 https://github.com/brellsanwouo/gear-framework，视频演示见 https://youtu.be/iwNi-oC2tCw。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统开发需学习各框架不同API的问题，提出GEAR，用基于特征的统一规范描述配置并通过连接器自动生成各框架特定的实现代码。

papers.title: Preference-Guided Cooperation in Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. We propose Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), with static (MIRL-S) and dynamic (MIRL-D) variants. By incorporating meta-gradient information, MIRL enables agents to learn how to prioritise objectives individually while collectively optimising the system-level objective, allowing the multi-objective structure to directly guide cooperation. Experiments on a multi-objective multiple particle environment show that our methods improve Pareto-front quality over baselines, with the dynamic variant achieving the strongest performance.

translation.title: 多目标多智能体强化学习中的偏好引导合作
translation.abstract: 多目标多智能体强化学习（MOMARL）在优化整体系统性能的同时，需要同时处理智能体协调与目标权衡。现有工作倾向于将多智能体合作与多目标优化视为学习问题中基本独立的组成部分，这在除简单情形外会带来过高的复杂度。本文研究是否可以利用多目标本身提供的结构来促进合作，而不是将其视为额外的优化挑战。我们在团队和个体两个层面形式化MOMARL，并引入逐目标反事实信用分配来评估每个智能体对各团队目标的贡献。我们提出元梯度信息驱动的多目标多智能体强化学习（MIRL），包含静态（MIRL-S）和动态（MIRL-D）两种变体。通过融入元梯度信息，MIRL使智能体能够学习如何个体化地排列目标优先级，同时共同优化系统级目标，从而让多目标结构直接引导合作。在多目标多粒子环境上的实验表明，我们的方法相比基线提升了帕累托前沿质量，其中动态变体表现最佳。
translation.brief: 针对MOMARL中合作与多目标权衡被割裂处理导致复杂度过高的问题，提出MIRL，通过元梯度信息和逐目标反事实信用分配让多目标结构直接引导智能体合作。

papers.title: Organon : From Evolutionary Search to Recursive Self-Improving Agents for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery does not follow a single fixed methodology: research methods vary across domains and evolve through experimentation as investigations unfold. Although LLM-guided evolutionary search has advanced automated discovery, existing frameworks typically rely on fixed search procedures or restrict adaptation to predefined components, limiting their ability to address diverse research problems and adapt to challenges that emerge at runtime. We introduce Organon, a recursively self-improving agent for scientific discovery. During execution, a single persistent agent analyzes its accumulated experience and autonomously revises its own search strategies, population management, diagnostic tools, memory, and worker coordination. These revisions take effect at runtime, allowing the agent to continuously adapt its approach as research progresses. Importantly, the agent can also diagnose and correct flaws in its own adaptation procedures, enabling recursive improvement of the mechanisms that guide its future self-improvement. We evaluate Organon across 21 computational discovery tasks spanning algorithm design, GPU kernel optimization, mathematical construction, and systems optimization. On ALE-Bench Lite, Organon achieves the best performance among competing search frameworks on all 10 tasks, improving mean held-out performance by 20.5% over EvoX. On KernelBench, it achieves the best results on three of four workloads, with speedups of up to 1.67x over the strongest competing method. Analysis of the search trajectories further reveals how the agent develops task-specific search strategies, builds new diagnostic capabilities, and corrects or reverses its own earlier revisions. We implement Organon using DeepSeek Harness and Cordis's spatiotemporal composability. Code is available at https://github.com/cheikh025/Organon.

translation.title: Organon：从进化搜索到面向科学发现的递归自改进智能体
translation.abstract: 科学发现并不遵循单一固定的方法论：研究方法因领域而异，并随着研究的展开通过实验不断演进。尽管LLM引导的进化搜索推动了自动化发现，现有框架通常依赖固定的搜索过程，或仅允许对预定义组件进行适配，限制了其应对多样化研究问题和适应运行时出现挑战的能力。我们提出Organon，一个面向科学发现的递归自改进智能体。在执行过程中，单个持久智能体分析其积累的经验，自主修订自身的搜索策略、种群管理、诊断工具、记忆和工作者协调机制。这些修订在运行时生效，使智能体能够随研究进展持续调整其方法。重要的是，该智能体还能诊断并纠正自身适配过程中的缺陷，实现对引导其未来自我改进机制的递归改进。我们在涵盖算法设计、GPU内核优化、数学构造和系统优化的21个计算发现任务上评估Organon。在ALE-Bench Lite上，Organon在全部10个任务上均取得竞争搜索框架中的最佳性能，比EvoX的平均留出性能提升20.5%。在KernelBench上，它在四个工作负载中的三个上取得最佳结果，相对最强竞争方法的加速比高达1.67倍。对搜索轨迹的进一步分析揭示了该智能体如何发展出任务特定的搜索策略、构建新的诊断能力，并纠正或撤销自己先前的修订。我们基于DeepSeek Harness和Cordis的时空可组合性实现了Organon。代码见 https://github.com/cheikh025/Organon。
translation.brief: 针对现有LLM进化搜索框架依赖固定搜索过程、难以适应运行时挑战的问题，提出递归自改进智能体Organon，在执行中自主修订自身搜索策略、工具和协调机制并递归改进其自我改进机制。

papers.title: Satellite Intelligence: Distributed Training, Collaborative Inference,and LLM Adaptation in LEO Constellation
papers.abstract: The proliferation of orbital sensing data and the real-time demands of emerging global services are pushing low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks from bent-pipe relays toward intelligent onboard processing. This shift confronts a fundamental tension, where modern artificial intelligence (AI) training paradigms require intensive computation, abundant memory, and stable connectivity, all of which are scarce under the dynamic topologies, intermittent links, and severe size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints of satellite networks. Addressing this tension demands rethinking AI workflows, from training and inference to the emerging deployment of large language models (LLMs), under a constraint-aware design philosophy. To the best of our knowledge, this paper provides the first survey that jointly covers all three, whereas prior surveys examine these aspects in isolation. We begin by identifying the deployment challenge of satellite intelligence (SI) and deriving design principles for SI. We then examine three advancing paradigms: i) distributed training, where federated learning (FL) and split learning (SL) enable satellite-ground co-training under resource limitations; ii) collaborative inference, which exploits single-satellite, multi-satellite, and satellite-ground architectures to meet real-time service demands; and iii) on-orbit LLM adaptation and serving, which tackles the frontier challenge of deploying LLMs under severe orbital constraints and resource-aware serving. Finally, we identify open challenges and future directions. By bridging the AI and satellite networks, this paper provides a research roadmap for the implementation of space-native AI technologies.

translation.title: 卫星智能：低轨星座中的分布式训练、协同推理与LLM适配
translation.abstract: 轨道传感数据的激增和新兴全球服务的实时需求，正推动低轨（LEO）卫星网络从弯管中继走向智能星上处理。这一转变面临一个根本性矛盾：现代人工智能（AI）训练范式需要密集计算、充足内存和稳定连接，而这些在卫星网络的动态拓扑、间歇链路以及严格的尺寸、重量和功耗（SWaP）约束下都极为稀缺。应对这一矛盾需要在约束感知的设计理念下重新思考AI工作流——从训练、推理到新兴的大语言模型（LLM）部署。据我们所知，本文是首个同时涵盖上述三方面的综述，而此前综述均只孤立地考察其中某一方面。我们首先指出卫星智能（SI）的部署挑战并推导其设计原则，然后考察三种演进范式：i) 分布式训练，其中联邦学习（FL）和拆分学习（SL）在资源受限下实现星地协同训练；ii) 协同推理，利用单星、多星和星地架构满足实时服务需求；iii) 在轨LLM适配与服务，应对在严苛轨道约束下部署LLM及资源感知服务的前沿挑战。最后，我们指出开放挑战和未来方向。通过连接AI与卫星网络，本文为空间原生AI技术的实现提供了研究路线图。
translation.brief: 针对LEO卫星网络资源受限与AI计算密集需求之间的矛盾，本文首次联合综述分布式训练、协同推理和在轨LLM适配三种范式并提出设计原则与未来方向。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Guided Counterfactual Sensor Selection and Safety-Gated Recognition for Autonomous Sensing Agents in IoT Systems
papers.abstract: Autonomous IoT systems rely on distributed sensing, but sensor faults and communication loss can leave multichannel evidence incomplete or unreliable. Their agents must therefore classify measurements, assess evidence sufficiency, select a sensor to reacquire, and hand off unsafe decisions. We formulate counterfactual sensing: a degraded window defines the factual state, each candidate restoration defines a controlled alternative, and a pre-request utility model estimates loss reduction. Physics-Guided Invariant-Kinematic Fusion (PGIK-Fusion) constructs class evidence, while calibrated risk and cost-sensitive utility select acceptance, sensor request, or handoff from factual information. On the Logistic Activity Recognition Challenge dataset, PGIK-Fusion achieves 0.768 accuracy and a macro-averaged F1 score (Macro-F1) of 0.696, exceeding extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost)--one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) fusion by 2.49 and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. Across seven predefined degradation conditions on held-out subjects, the policy reduces unsafe acceptance from 33.0% to 13.8%; relative to an action-rate-matched random policy, it raises automation accuracy by 18.5 percentage points and lowers expected cost by 24.7%. In the auxiliary within-event wind-turbine study, PGIK-Fusion reaches 0.975 Macro-F1, improves on XGBoost--1D-CNN by 1.17 percentage points, and reduces unsafe acceptance from 20.1% to 8.0%. The evaluation characterizes the controlled responses of a frozen recognition model to specified sensor restorations under predefined fault families and severities. Within this scope, the results demonstrate that calibrated recognition, targeted evidence acquisition, and conservative deferral can form a unified perception--action loop that reduces unsafe automation under sensor degradation.

translation.title: 面向物联网系统中自主感知代理的不确定性引导反事实传感器选择与安全门控识别
translation.abstract: 自主物联网系统依赖分布式感知，但传感器故障和通信中断会使多通道证据不完整或不可靠。因此其代理必须对测量进行分类、评估证据充分性、选择传感器进行重新采集，并移交不安全的决策。我们提出反事实感知的表述：退化窗口定义事实状态，每个候选恢复定义一个受控替代方案，预请求效用模型估计损失降低。物理引导不变运动学融合（PGIK-Fusion）构建类别证据，而经校准的风险和代价敏感效用基于事实信息选择接受、传感器请求或移交。在Logistic Activity Recognition Challenge数据集上，PGIK-Fusion达到0.768准确率和0.696宏平均F1分数（Macro-F1），分别超过极端梯度提升（XGBoost）与一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）融合方法2.49和2.00个百分点。在留出受试者的七种预定义退化条件下，该策略将不安全接受率从33.0%降至13.8%；相对于动作速率匹配的随机策略，它将自动化准确率提高18.5个百分点，并将期望代价降低24.7%。在辅助的事件内风力涡轮机研究中，PGIK-Fusion达到0.975 Macro-F1，比XGBoost-1D-CNN提高1.17个百分点，并将不安全接受率从20.1%降至8.0%。该评估刻画了冻结识别模型在预定义故障族和严重程度下对指定传感器恢复的受控响应。在此范围内，结果表明经校准的识别、有针对性的证据获取和保守移交可以形成一个统一的感知-动作回路，减少传感器退化下的不安全自动化。
translation.brief: 解决传感器退化导致物联网代理不安全决策的问题，核心方法是结合PGIK-Fusion证据构建与基于校准风险和代价敏感效用的反事实传感器选择及安全移交策略。

papers.title: ToolContractGate: Versioned Trusted Contracts for Drift-Safe Agent Tool Invocation
papers.abstract: Agent tool approval and input validation do not, by themselves, bind a request to an approved source artifact. ToolContractGate provides a deterministic runtime contract evaluator for OpenAPI-derived agent tools. Each versioned ToolContract combines a stored OpenAPI fingerprint with access, schema, and behavioral declarations. The full evaluator applies ten checks, including a cached boot-time provenance result; four execution modes and five evaluation configurations support baseline, ablation, and non-blocking shadow analysis. On a synthetic benchmark of 45 cases (35 unsafe cases across 12 drift classes and 10 safe cases), the full pipeline detects all 35 faults: 29 BLOCK, 3 REVIEW, and 3 WARN decisions, with no false blocks on the safe cases. The archived run reports a mean gate latency of 0.18 ms and a 95th percentile (p95) of 2 ms using integer-millisecond measurements. The open-source artifact includes seven OpenAPI specifications, twelve enterprise contracts, 29 unit tests, and a 900-record evaluation. Results characterize contract-decision coverage; downstream enforcement requires a host that honors the returned decision. Production traffic, semantic backend drift, and dynamic provenance refresh remain evaluation and integration opportunities.

translation.title: ToolContractGate：面向漂移安全代理工具调用的版本化可信契约
translation.abstract: 代理工具审批和输入验证本身并不能将请求绑定到已批准的源工件。ToolContractGate为基于OpenAPI派生的代理工具提供确定性的运行时契约评估器。每个版本化的ToolContract将存储的OpenAPI指纹与访问、模式和行为声明相结合。完整评估器应用十项检查，包括缓存的启动时来源验证结果；四种执行模式和五种评估配置支持基线、消融和非阻塞影子分析。在一个包含45个案例（12个漂移类别中的35个不安全案例和10个安全案例）的合成基准上，完整流水线检测出全部35个故障：29个BLOCK、3个REVIEW和3个WARN决策，且对安全案例无误拦截。归档运行报告平均门控延迟为0.18毫秒，95百分位（p95）为2毫秒（基于整数毫秒测量）。开源工件包括七个OpenAPI规范、十二个企业契约、29个单元测试和900条记录的评估。结果刻画了契约决策覆盖范围；下游执行需要遵循返回决策的主机支持。生产流量、语义后端漂移和动态来源刷新仍是评估与集成的机会。
translation.brief: 解决代理工具调用无法绑定到已批准源工件的问题，核心方法是为OpenAPI派生工具构建版本化契约及确定性运行时评估器。

papers.title: Navigating Epistemic Parity in LLM Agents: A Benchmark for Cross-Source Conflict Resolution Between Memory and Procedural Skills
papers.abstract: Production LLM agents increasingly run episodic memory pipelines and procedural skill modules (e.g., SKILL.md files) in tandem. Both are injected into the same context region with no defined precedence, so they can issue contradictory instructions that no instruction hierarchy resolves, a condition we term epistemic parity. We introduce a benchmark for measuring how LLM agents adjudicate such cross-source conflicts. We (i) develop a four-way taxonomy of memory-skill contradictions (factual, format, procedural, permission); (ii) instantiate 52 scenarios under a tripartite test-case anatomy (memory injection, skill injection, ambiguous user task), scored almost entirely by deterministic checkers over tool-call payloads and output structure; and (iii) run each scenario under three context conditions to isolate positional bias, measure the efficacy of an explicit precedence directive, and classify disclosure behavior, quantifying silent adjudication: resolving a conflict without telling the user. Across 1,383 runs on three open-weight models, neither source wins uniformly: resolution depends jointly on conflict type, model, and injection order. Moving the skill block nearer the task raises its win rate in all six factual and procedural cells (sign test, p = 0.031) but reverses for format conflicts, indicating that adjudication tracks token placement rather than source semantics. An explicit "skill takes absolute precedence" directive raises skill compliance on the two stronger models yet leaves 3-10% residual non-compliance, and moves the smallest model's factual and procedural resolution in the wrong direction. Most consequentially, in 98.8% of runs where the agent acted through a tool call it emitted no accompanying text at all, and 89% of all runs disclosed nothing about the contradiction: silent adjudication is the default. Code, scenarios, and raw outputs are public.

translation.title: 导航LLM代理中的认知对等：记忆与程序化技能跨源冲突解决的基准
translation.abstract: 生产环境的LLM代理日益同时运行情景记忆流水线和程序化技能模块（如SKILL.md文件）。两者被注入同一上下文区域且无定义的优先级，因此可能发出任何指令层级都无法解决的矛盾指令，我们将这种情况称为认知对等。我们引入一个基准来衡量LLM代理如何裁决此类跨源冲突。我们（i）开发了记忆-技能矛盾的四分类法（事实、格式、程序、权限）；（ii）在三元测试用例结构（记忆注入、技能注入、模糊用户任务）下实例化52个场景，几乎完全通过对工具调用载荷和输出结构的确定性检查器进行评分；（iii）在三种上下文条件下运行每个场景，以隔离位置偏差、衡量显式优先级指令的效果并分类披露行为，量化静默裁决：在不告知用户的情况下解决冲突。在三个开源权重模型的1,383次运行中，没有任何来源一致获胜：裁决结果共同取决于冲突类型、模型和注入顺序。将技能块移近任务会在所有六个事实和程序单元格中提高其胜率（符号检验，p = 0.031），但在格式冲突中相反，表明裁决跟随token位置而非来源语义。显式的"技能具有绝对优先级"指令在两个较强模型上提高了技能合规性，但仍留下3-10%的残余不合规，并使最小模型的事实和程序裁决向错误方向发展。最重要的是，在代理通过工具调用行动的运行中，98.8%没有发出任何伴随文本，且所有运行的89%未披露任何关于矛盾的信息：静默裁决是默认行为。代码、场景和原始输出均已公开。
translation.brief: 解决LLM代理中记忆与技能模块指令冲突无优先级裁决依据的问题，核心方法是构建包含四类矛盾、52个场景和确定性评分的跨源冲突解决基准。

papers.title: WebUniverse: Scaling Verified Training Data for Agentic Web Development
papers.abstract: Training agents for front-end web development requires demonstrations of code editing, execution, browser inspection and revision, yet public trajectories and reusable task environments remain limited. We introduce WebUniverse, a pipeline that constructs verifiable tasks with verified development trajectories from open-source repositories and real web pages. The tasks cover text-grounded application development in standalone and iterative settings and vision-grounded reproduction across pages and viewports. We collect agent trajectories for these tasks and verify the resulting applications against task-specific functional or visual requirements. We release WebUniverse-Env, containing 15K executable task environments, and WebUniverse-Mix, containing the corresponding 15K development trajectories with verification records and scores. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on WebUniverse-Mix raises the Vision2Web average score from 51.7 to 68.3, WebGen-Bench accuracy from 34.5% to 63.9%, and Web-Bench pass@2 from 12.2% to 23.1%. The resulting model also outperforms a public-data baseline trained with the same configuration and sample budget across all reported metrics. Ablations show complementary benefits from text and visual trajectories and continued gains as training data scales from 5K to 15K trajectories.

translation.title: WebUniverse：为代理式Web开发扩展经验证的训练数据
translation.abstract: 训练前端Web开发代理需要代码编辑、执行、浏览器检查和修订的演示，然而公开轨迹和可复用的任务环境仍然有限。我们提出WebUniverse，一个从开源仓库和真实网页构建可验证任务及经验证开发轨迹的流水线。任务涵盖独立和迭代设置下的文本接地应用开发，以及跨页面和视口的视觉接地复现。我们为这些任务收集代理轨迹，并根据任务特定的功能或视觉要求验证生成的应用。我们发布包含15K可执行任务环境的WebUniverse-Env，以及包含相应15K开发轨迹及验证记录和分数的WebUniverse-Mix。在WebUniverse-Mix上微调Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，将Vision2Web平均分从51.7提升至68.3，WebGen-Bench准确率从34.5%提升至63.9%，Web-Bench pass@2从12.2%提升至23.1%。所得模型在所有报告指标上也优于使用相同配置和样本预算训练的公开数据基线。消融实验显示文本和视觉轨迹的互补收益，以及训练数据从5K扩展到15K轨迹时的持续增益。
translation.brief: 解决前端Web开发代理训练数据稀缺的问题，核心方法是从开源仓库和真实网页自动构建可验证任务环境及经验证的开发轨迹数据集。

papers.title: Cross-Platform Application Migration to HarmonyOS: An Agentic Pipeline with Artifact-Derived Verification
papers.abstract: The migration of applications written for a different platforms like Android or iOS to HarmonyOS NEXT requires a complete rewrite in ArkTS. Although LLMs automate the translation of source constructs into ArkTS, syntactic compilation is not enough and functional assurance is a critical open challenge in HarmonyOS NEXT migration. We present HMOS~Migrator, an agentic pipeline that reads an application's source code, generates an ArkTS project, and validates the result by replaying recorded interactions on a real device. We cast the scoring problem as quality estimation without a reference implementation; we score a migration using only the source application's recorded behaviour and the artifacts produced by the pipeline. We define seven weighted metrics, each constructed so that reduced measurement cannot artificially raise the score. Over twelve runs across six open-source applications, the pipeline's structural reproduction is high (completeness \pct{83.3}--\pct{100.0}), while on-device behaviour (\pct{4.3}--\pct{63.1}) and UI fidelity (\pct{21.1}--\pct{63.2}) remain the primary limits. Scores improve steadily over time: $+0.45$~points per day overall ($R^2=0.44$, $p=0.019$) and $+0.47$ over the model-free subset ($R^2=0.39$, $p=0.029$), with corresponding to fit angles of $+8.4^{\circ}$ and $+11.7^{\circ}$ respectively.

translation.title: 跨平台应用迁移至HarmonyOS：基于工件派生验证的代理式流水线
translation.abstract: 将为Android或iOS等其他平台编写的应用迁移到HarmonyOS NEXT需要用ArkTS完全重写。尽管LLM可以自动化将源代码结构翻译为ArkTS，但仅语法编译是不够的，功能保障是HarmonyOS NEXT迁移中的关键开放挑战。我们提出HMOS~Migrator，一个代理式流水线，它读取应用的源代码，生成ArkTS项目，并通过在真实设备上重放录制的交互来验证结果。我们将评分问题转化为无参考实现的质量估计；我们仅使用源应用录制的行为和流水线产生的工件对迁移进行评分。我们定义了七个加权指标，每个指标的构建方式确保减少测量不会人为提高分数。在六个开源应用的十二次运行中，流水线的结构复现度很高（完整性83.3%–100.0%），而设备上的行为（4.3%–63.1%）和UI保真度（21.1%–63.2%）仍是主要限制。分数随时间稳步提升：总体每天+0.45分（R²=0.44，p=0.019），无模型子集+0.47（R²=0.39，p=0.029），分别对应+8.4°和+11.7°的拟合角度。
translation.brief: 解决跨平台应用迁移到HarmonyOS NEXT时缺乏功能保障的问题，核心方法是代理式流水线生成ArkTS项目并通过真实设备重放录制交互进行无参考的质量评分。

papers.title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
papers.abstract: Regulated industries such as finance and healthcare face critical governance challenges that hamper the adoption of AI-assisted software development and hinder the transition from experimental pilots to production work. This paper presents Zafin AIOS, an end-to-end orchestration platform and control plane designed to deploy AI within regulated industries such as finance. We provide the architectural principles and an empirical comparison between AI-assisted and human-led workloads. To validate this framework empirically, we conduct a case study analysis of Zafin's internal enterprise workflows, which we refer to as Customer Zero. This paper contributes a production case study of AI-assisted software engineering in regulated industries. We evaluate the results of using Zafin AIOS with two different production codebases, one for the pricing execution platform and the other for the client deal negotiation platform. Our contribution is a customer case study for regulated industries with production codebases and governance, which includes proof of work. The results demonstrate that strictly governed agentic orchestration increases enterprise capacity without compromising control. In the pricing execution platform workflows, the platform provided complete observability and reduced effort by 38\%. In the client deal negotiation platform, it reduced reporting work by 76\% while maintaining all predefined data privacy, role-based access, and audit guardrails. This paper bridges the gap between AI-assisted software engineering theory and the operational reality of compliance. Closing this gap is important to help enterprises take advantage of AI technologies. These results are descriptive of the benefits of using governed workflows in regulated industries.

translation.title: 在受监管金融行业中落地受治理的 Agentic 工作流：基于 Zafin AIOS 的 Customer Zero 案例研究
translation.abstract: 金融和医疗等受监管行业面临严峻的治理挑战，这阻碍了 AI 辅助软件开发的采用，也妨碍了从实验性试点向生产环境工作的过渡。本文提出 Zafin AIOS，一个端到端编排平台和控制平面，旨在金融等受监管行业中部署 AI。我们提供了架构原则以及 AI 辅助工作负载与人工主导工作负载的实证比较。为对该框架进行实证验证，我们对 Zafin 的内部企业工作流进行了案例研究分析，我们称之为 Customer Zero。本文贡献了一个受监管行业中 AI 辅助软件工程的生产案例研究。我们在两个不同的生产代码库上评估了使用 Zafin AIOS 的结果，一个是定价执行平台，另一个是客户交易谈判平台。我们的贡献是一个面向受监管行业的客户案例研究，包含生产代码库和治理，并附有工作证明。结果表明，严格治理的 agentic 编排在不损害控制的前提下提升了企业能力。在定价执行平台工作流中，该平台提供了完整的可观测性，并将工作量降低了 38%。在客户交易谈判平台中，它将报告工作减少了 76%，同时保持了所有预定义的数据隐私、基于角色的访问和审计防护栏。本文弥合了 AI 辅助软件工程理论与合规运营现实之间的差距。弥合这一差距对企业利用 AI 技术非常重要。这些结果描述性地展示了在受监管行业使用受治理工作流的收益。
translation.brief: 针对受监管行业 AI 辅助开发落地难的问题，提出端到端治理编排平台 Zafin AIOS 并以内部生产工作流案例验证其可行性。

papers.title: From Cosmetic to Structural: A Paired Experiment on Metric-Guided Agentic Refactoring
papers.abstract: The role of coding agents is expanding beyond writing new code toward maintaining existing systems as AI teammates. Yet recent studies show that agent refactorings favor superficial, consistency-oriented edits over structural transformations needed to resolve Technical Debt (TD). We investigate if explicit static-analysis feedback closes this gap. Through the CodeScene MCP server, we give an open-source agent (gptme) access to code smell reports and CodeHealth (CH) scores (1--10, higher is better), and compare guided against unguided refactorings in a paired experiment covering $24{,}620$ single-file competitive programming solutions in C++, Java, and Python. We find that guidance shifts the agent from performing cosmetic edits toward structural operations, raising the rate of effective refactorings by $21$--$26$ percentage points. The benefit depends on initial code quality, with language-dependent break-even points at CH $4.9$--$7.1$, below where the structural transformations pushed by guidance increasingly risk regression, indicating where the agent needs more support to refactor. Guided runs also shift the failure profile toward logical test failures, introduce new coupling smells, and consume $\sim$$3$--$5\times$ more tokens over $\sim$$2\times$ as many interaction turns. Our results indicate that AI teammates can benefit from similar static-analysis feedback that human developers already use, enabling structural transformations toward more effective TD remediation, at a higher token cost and more interaction turns.

translation.title: 从表面性到结构性：度量引导的 Agentic 重构配对实验
translation.abstract: 编码智能体的角色正在从编写新代码扩展到作为 AI 队友维护现有系统。然而近期研究表明，智能体的重构倾向于表面性、一致性导向的编辑，而非解决技术债务（Technical Debt, TD）所需的结构性变换。我们研究显式的静态分析反馈能否弥合这一差距。通过 CodeScene MCP 服务器，我们让开源智能体 gptme 访问代码坏味报告和 CodeHealth（CH）评分（1–10，越高越好），并在一项覆盖 24,620 个 C++、Java 和 Python 单文件竞赛编程解答的配对实验中比较引导与未引导的重构。我们发现，引导使智能体从表面性编辑转向结构性操作，将有效重构率提升 21–26 个百分点。收益取决于初始代码质量，语言相关的盈亏平衡点在 CH 4.9–7.1 之间，低于该点时引导所推动的结构性变换日益面临回归风险，表明智能体在这些场景下需要更多支持才能进行重构。引导运行还将失败模式转向逻辑性测试失败，引入新的耦合坏味，并在约 2 倍的交互轮次中消耗约 3–5 倍的 token。我们的结果表明，AI 队友可以从人类开发者已使用的类似静态分析反馈中受益，实现结构性变换以更有效地治理技术债务，代价是更高的 token 成本和更多交互轮次。
translation.brief: 针对智能体重构偏重表面性编辑的问题，通过 CodeScene MCP 提供静态分析度量反馈，以配对实验验证其对结构性重构的引导作用。

papers.title: Developers as Managers of AI Agents: A Workplace Shadowing Study
papers.abstract: As AI coding agents become more autonomous, developers increasingly direct, coordinate, and check their work. Yet little is known about these practices in everyday professional development. We shadowed 11 professional developers across approximately 15 hours of work, coded their activities and task transitions, analyzed 255 submitted prompts, and conducted 4.6 hours of follow-up interviews. Developers spent an average of 33.4% of observed time formulating prompts or checking AI responses, with task-switching rates ranging from 0 to 101.6 switches per hour. Beyond producing artifacts, prompts supported understanding, requirements clarification, agent configuration, and coordination. We identified three recurring patterns: \textit{Supervisor}, involving direct artifact inspection; \textit{Delegator}, involving dialogue-based coordination and delegated implementation and checking; and \textit{Learner}, involving agents primarily to build understanding. Developers sought technical information from agents and organizational context, authority, and alignment from colleagues. Our findings suggest future studies of how developers manage attention across concurrent agent tasks and tools that support verification, coordination, and learning.

translation.title: 开发者作为 AI 智能体的管理者：一项职场跟随研究
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 编码智能体日益自主，开发者越来越多地指导、协调和检查它们的工作。然而关于这些实践在日常专业开发中的情况知之甚少。我们对 11 名专业开发者进行了约 15 小时工作的跟随观察，对其活动和任务切换进行了编码，分析了 255 条提交的提示词，并进行了 4.6 小时的后续访谈。开发者平均将 33.4% 的观察时间用于撰写提示词或检查 AI 回复，任务切换率从每小时 0 次到 101.6 次不等。除了产出工件之外，提示词还支持理解、需求澄清、智能体配置和协调。我们识别出三种反复出现的模式：Supervisor（监督者），涉及直接检查工件；Delegator（委托者），涉及基于对话的协调以及委托实现和检查；Learner（学习者），主要使用智能体来建立理解。开发者从智能体处寻求技术信息，而从同事处寻求组织背景、权威和一致性。我们的发现为未来研究开发者如何管理跨并发智能体任务的注意力，以及支持验证、协调和学习的工具提供了方向。
translation.brief: 针对开发者日常如何管理 AI 编码智能体缺乏了解的问题，通过跟随观察与访谈提炼出 Supervisor、Delegator、Learner 三种工作模式。

papers.title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
papers.abstract: As general-purpose LLM agent harnesses mature, organizations must decide whether to continue developing in-house systems or adopt existing alternatives. We study this decision at Volvo Group for GUI testing of Android-based in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems. We compare a production, custom-built harness with two general-purpose harnesses, Claude Code and OpenCode, keeping the tools, accessed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the models the same. We evaluate the harnesses with up to four models on Volvo's IVI test cases and on open-ended tasks in public apps (Google Maps, Booking.com), and interview ten practitioners: developers, the product owner, and testers. On Volvo's stepwise IVI tests, general-purpose harnesses match the custom-built harness in success but vary more across runs. Their inference cost per task is 2.6-10.7 times higher, yet the engineering effort they save outweighs this: for a nightly IVI regression suite, total monthly cost, including engineering effort and inference, is 3-66% lower. On open-ended public-app tasks, they succeed more often, mainly because they recover better from incorrect actions. Interviews suggest that external advances can turn an in-house harness into technical debt even without deterioration. Adopting a general-purpose harness shifts maintenance from the agent loop to tools and instructions, but gives teams less control over what the model receives. Regardless of the harness, testers want to inspect the agent's actions and ensure that it follows the prescribed test scenario.

translation.title: 自建还是采用？定制与通用 LLM 智能体框架在汽车 GUI 测试中的对比
translation.abstract: 随着通用 LLM 智能体框架的成熟，组织必须决定是继续开发内部系统还是采用现有替代方案。我们在 Volvo Group 研究这一决策，场景是基于 Android 的车载信息娱乐（IVI）系统的 GUI 测试。我们将一个生产环境定制框架与两个通用框架 Claude Code 和 OpenCode 进行比较，保持通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）访问的工具和所用模型相同。我们在 Volvo 的 IVI 测试用例以及公开应用（Google Maps、Booking.com）的开放式任务上，用最多四种模型评估这些框架，并访谈了十位从业者：开发者、产品负责人和测试人员。在 Volvo 的分步 IVI 测试中，通用框架的成功率与定制框架相当，但跨运行的波动更大。它们的每任务推理成本高 2.6–10.7 倍，但节省的工程投入足以抵消：对于一个夜间 IVI 回归测试套件，包含工程投入和推理的总月度成本降低 3–66%。在开放式公开应用任务上，通用框架成功率更高，主要因为它们能更好地从错误操作中恢复。访谈表明，外部技术的进步即使在没有退化的情况下也可能使内部框架沦为技术债务。采用通用框架将维护工作从智能体循环转移到工具和指令上，但团队对模型接收内容的控制力更弱。无论使用何种框架，测试人员都希望检查智能体的操作并确保其遵循规定的测试场景。
translation.brief: 针对组织应自建还是采用通用 LLM 智能体测试框架的决策问题，在 Volvo 的车载 GUI 测试场景中对定制与通用框架进行实证对比分析。

papers.title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
papers.abstract: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture's tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE's role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.

translation.title: 软件工程 LLM：为什么需要它们以及软件工程如何助力构建它们
translation.abstract: 软件工程（SE）专业知识可以塑造编码大语言模型（LLM）的训练方式及其获得的工程能力。我们通过对一个服务超过 10 万名开发者的 92B 参数编码 LLM 进行能力聚焦训练的工业案例研究来考察这一角色。我们展示了成熟的 SE 知识如何指导工程能力的选择、可验证训练数据的构建以及模型改进的评估。为针对仓库级重构，我们开发了 RefactorForge，一个结合重构知识、成熟 SE 工具和验证技术来构建训练数据的流水线。在 306 个 Python 仓库中，RefactorForge 生成了 5,704 个可执行任务，并保留了 4,572 条经验证的教师轨迹，共计 7,251 万 token。在这些轨迹上进行增量监督微调（占先前编码混合数据 token 的 0.46%），将 RefactorBench 性能提升 18.00 个百分点，SWE-Bench ProMax 提升 7.06 分。在 OpenCode 下，这些改进延伸到 SWE 问题解决，SWE-Bench Verified 提升 4.97 分，SWE-Bench Pro 提升 1.23 分。改进在其他编码智能体框架中也得以保持，而全新仓库生成则结果不一。我们报告了构建能力聚焦训练数据并评估其在工程工作负载中效果的经验。基于这一工业实践，我们提出了一个研究议程，以扩展 SE 在将编码 LLM 转变为 SE LLM 中的作用：将 SE 知识纳入模型训练、将工程方法应用于模型开发与维护，并系统性地定义这些模型应获得的工程能力。
translation.brief: 针对编码 LLM 缺乏软件工程能力的问题，提出 RefactorForge 流水线构建可验证的仓库级重构训练数据并进行增量微调，同时提出 SE LLM 的研究议程。

papers.title: ArchGuard-APR: Architecture-Constraint-Aware Multi-Agent Program Repair Using Repository Graphs and Execution Feedback
papers.abstract: Repository-level automated program repair must reason about more than a localized failing statement. A candidate change can satisfy a narrow test while violating dependency boundaries, modifying an unsafe path, or relying on context that omits relevant repository structure. ArchGuard-APR is an architecture-aware repair prototype that integrates deterministic repository analysis, immutable repository graphs, explicit architecture profiles, graph-guided context retrieval, role-based repair orchestration, patch-policy enforcement, isolated execution feedback, provider cost controls, and canonical source-free evidence. We evaluate the implemented pipeline through an exploratory paired feasibility study, not a confirmatory effectiveness experiment. Six executions were planned; four completed, and two black-4 conditions ended in pre-provider infrastructure attrition. Across two valid paired tasks, baseline and ArchGuard conditions each produced 0/2 successful repairs, and all four completed outputs were classified as invalid patches. The completed executions consumed 35,431 input tokens and 2,737 output tokens, for a total of 38,168 tokens, at a total cost of USD 0.1296325. No effectiveness advantage was observed, and the sample provides no useful inferential basis. The study instead establishes the engineering feasibility of composing architecture constraints with a reproducible repair pipeline and identifies patch validity and infrastructure robustness as the principal targets for future work.

translation.title: ArchGuard-APR：基于仓库图与执行反馈的架构约束感知多智能体程序修复
translation.abstract: 仓库级自动程序修复所需推理的不应只是局部失败语句。一个候选修改可能在满足狭窄测试的同时违反依赖边界、修改不安全路径，或依赖遗漏相关仓库结构的上下文。ArchGuard-APR 是一个架构感知的修复原型，集成了确定性的仓库分析、不可变仓库图、显式架构配置文件、图引导的上下文检索、基于角色的修复编排、补丁策略强制、隔离执行反馈、提供商成本控制以及规范的免源码证据。我们通过一项探索性配对可行性研究而非验证性有效性实验来评估已实现的流水线。原计划执行六次；四次完成，两次 black-4 条件在进入提供商阶段前因基础设施损耗而终止。在两个有效的配对任务中，基线与 ArchGuard 条件各自取得 0/2 的成功修复，四次已完成的输出均被判定为无效补丁。已完成的执行消耗 35,431 个输入 token 和 2,737 个输出 token，共 38,168 个 token，总成本为 0.1296325 美元。未观察到有效性优势，且样本未提供有用的推断依据。该研究反而确立了将架构约束与可复现修复流水线组合的工程可行性，并将补丁有效性与基础设施健壮性确定为未来工作的主要目标。
translation.brief: 解决仓库级程序修复中候选补丁可能违反架构约束的问题，采用仓库图、架构配置与多智能体编排相结合的架构感知修复流水线。

papers.title: DRILS: Dependency-based Requirement Change Impact Analysis Using LLMs
papers.abstract: Change is inevitable in software systems, where requirements must continuously adapt to evolving stakeholder needs, regulations, and project scopes. Managing such changes is a fundamental software engineering challenge, as manually identifying the impact of a change request, given high requirements volume, Natural Language (NL) complexity, and intricate interdependencies, is error-prone and time-consuming. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising solutions for requirements change impact analysis (CIA), yet their effectiveness when enhanced with advanced techniques remains underexplored. We present DRILS, an LLM-based agentic framework for requirements Change Impact Analysis, employing a multi-agent architecture to generate candidate impact sets, with an LLM-as-a-judge promoting diversity during selection. DRILS features two key components: RE-RAG, a carefully engineered RAG technique providing focused domain context, and a requirement dependency graph (RDG) as an additional knowledge source. Evaluation across three manually curated datasets demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average recall of 87.1%, precision of 76.3%, and F1 score of 81% at a lower cost. Precision gains are particularly significant, 41.1%, 83.4%, and 149.8% over the closest baseline per dataset, as higher precision directly reduces false positives and manual validation effort. We also contribute three annotated CIA datasets to support future research.

translation.title: DRILS：基于 LLM 的依赖驱动需求变更影响分析
translation.abstract: 变更在软件系统中不可避免，需求必须持续适应不断演化的利益相关者需求、法规和项目范围。管理此类变更是软件工程的一项基本挑战，因为在需求量大、自然语言（NL）复杂且相互依赖关系错综复杂的情况下，人工识别变更请求的影响既容易出错又耗时。大语言模型（LLM）为需求变更影响分析（CIA）提供了有前景的解决方案，但其在先进技术增强下的有效性仍未被充分探索。我们提出 DRILS，一个基于 LLM 的智能体式需求变更影响分析框架，采用多智能体架构生成候选影响集，并通过 LLM-as-a-judge 在选择过程中促进多样性。DRILS 具有两个关键组件：RE-RAG，一种精心设计的 RAG 技术，可提供聚焦的领域上下文；以及需求依赖图（RDG）作为额外的知识来源。在三个人工整理的数据集上的评估表明其性能优于最先进的基线，以更低的成本实现了平均 87.1% 的召回率、76.3% 的精确率和 81% 的 F1 分数。精确率提升尤为显著，在每个数据集上相对最接近的基线分别提升 41.1%、83.4% 和 149.8%，因为更高的精确率直接减少了误报和人工验证工作量。我们还贡献了三个标注的 CIA 数据集以支持未来研究。
translation.brief: 解决需求变更影响分析中人工识别耗时易错的问题，采用多智能体 LLM 框架结合 RE-RAG 与需求依赖图生成候选影响集。

papers.title: Securing Agent-Generated Code with Its Own Development History
papers.abstract: Pull requests written by coding agents can pass a project's test suite while omitting a guard or a validation step. To find the missing condition, a reviewer currently relies on static analysis of the final code. An agent-generated change, however, is accompanied by a development history that a human commit does not provide. The agent's trajectory records each edit together with the agent's stated assumptions, and structural differencing shows how each changed function evolved. We present TRACER, a workflow that uses this development history as evidence for security review. TRACER tracks changes at the symbol level, treats the agent's recorded rationale as claims to be verified against the current code, accepts a repair only after assessment and functional validation, and attaches to each accepted repair an executable check that later changes must satisfy. On the SusVibes benchmark, symbol-level tracking places the vulnerable symbol in the review scope for 94.6% of agent patches, compared with 13.4% for the primary scanner warning. With two investigator models, the configuration that includes the agent's rationale yields the largest number of verified security repairs while preserving functionality, and adding AST history to it does not increase that number. A funnel analysis identifies where the remaining candidates are lost. In a study of structural-biology software, the combination of repair memory and a boundary check allows a subsequent feature request to succeed in nine of ten tasks without reintroducing the repaired vulnerability, whereas functional feedback alone succeeds in four and reintroduces the vulnerability in three.

translation.title: 利用智能体自身的开发历史保障其生成代码的安全
translation.abstract: 由编码智能体编写的 pull request 可能通过项目的测试套件，却遗漏了某个防护或验证步骤。要找到缺失的条件，审查者目前只能依赖对最终代码的静态分析。然而，智能体生成的变更伴随有人工提交所不具备的开发历史。智能体的轨迹记录了每次编辑及其声明的假设，结构化差异对比则展示了每个被修改函数的演化过程。我们提出 TRACER，一种将这些开发历史用作安全审查证据的工作流。TRACER 在符号级别跟踪变更，将智能体记录的理由视为需对照当前代码验证的声明，仅在评估与功能验证之后才接受修复，并为每个被接受的修复附加一个后续变更必须满足的可执行检查。在 SusVibes 基准上，符号级跟踪将 94.6% 的智能体补丁中的易受攻击符号纳入审查范围，而主要扫描器警告仅为 13.4%。使用两个调查者模型时，包含智能体理由的配置产生了最多的经验证且保留功能性的安全修复，而在此基础上加入 AST 历史并未增加该数量。漏斗分析指出了剩余候选在何处流失。在一项针对结构生物学软件的研究中，修复记忆与边界检查的组合使后续的十个功能请求任务中有九个成功且未重新引入已修复的漏洞，而仅靠功能反馈只成功了四个，并在三个任务中重新引入了该漏洞。
translation.brief: 解决审查智能体生成代码时遗漏安全防护条件的问题，利用智能体开发历史（编辑轨迹与声明理由）作为证据进行安全审查与修复验证。

papers.title: Bug Severity Classification with Fine-Tuned Open LLMs: A Paired Comparison with TF-IDF and CodeBERT Baselines on Eclipse Reports
papers.abstract: Open large language models (LLMs) small enough to run on a laptop are an obvious candidate for automatic bug severity prediction. We measure what they add over cheaper classifiers on one task: assigning one of four Bugzilla severity levels (Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial) to Eclipse bug reports. From a public dump of 361,006 unique Eclipse reports we draw a class-balanced sample of 20,000 rows and compare eleven configurations of nine model types: six TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder, and Llama 3 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B, each run zero-shot and after QLoRA fine-tuning. All eleven are scored on the same 2,000 held-out reports, with bootstrap intervals and McNemar tests. The zero-shot runs reach macro-F1 0.305 and 0.321, below every TF-IDF model (0.430-0.489). The fine-tuned runs reach 0.526 and 0.485, but the zero-shot and fine-tuned setups also differ in checkpoint, serving runtime and decoding, so this gap cannot be credited to fine-tuning alone. Fine-tuned Llama 3 shows no detectable difference from CodeBERT (0.518; difference +0.007, 95% CI -0.017 to +0.032), and fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 is below it on macro-F1. The models differ more by class than in aggregate: fine-tuned Llama 3 finds 36% of Critical reports, Qwen 2.5 finds 69% but only 21% of Minor ones. The dump repeats 60,000 rows, and 8% of the test reports duplicate a training report; removing them lowers TF-IDF scores by up to 0.031 and leaves the LLMs almost unchanged. We release split identifiers, per-report predictions and the analysis script at https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts, together with CyberTriage, a tool that serves the fine-tuned classifier locally.

translation.title: 使用微调开源 LLM 进行缺陷严重性分类：在 Eclipse 报告上与 TF-IDF 和 CodeBERT 基线的配对比较
translation.abstract: 小到可在笔记本电脑上运行的开源大语言模型（LLM）是自动缺陷严重性预测的明显候选。我们在一项任务上衡量它们相对于更廉价分类器所带来的增益：为 Eclipse 缺陷报告分配四个 Bugzilla 严重性级别之一（Critical、Major、Minor、Trivial）。我们从包含 361,006 条唯一 Eclipse 报告的公开转储中抽取了 20,000 行类平衡样本，并比较九种模型类型的十一种配置：六个 TF-IDF 分类器、一个微调的 CodeBERT 编码器，以及 Llama 3 8B 和 Qwen 2.5 7B，各自分别以零样本和 QLoRA 微调方式运行。所有十一种配置都在相同的 2,000 条保留报告上评分，使用 bootstrap 区间和 McNemar 检验。零样本运行达到 0.305 和 0.321 的 macro-F1，低于所有 TF-IDF 模型（0.430-0.489）。微调运行达到 0.526 和 0.485，但零样本与微调设置在检查点、服务运行时和解码方面也存在差异，因此这一差距不能仅归因于微调。微调的 Llama 3 与 CodeBERT（0.518）无可检测的差异（差值 +0.007，95% CI -0.017 至 +0.032），微调的 Qwen 2.5 在 macro-F1 上低于 CodeBERT。各模型在类别层面的差异大于总体差异：微调的 Llama 3 找出 36% 的 Critical 报告，Qwen 2.5 找出 69% 但仅找出 21% 的 Minor 报告。该转储重复了 60,000 行，且 8% 的测试报告与训练报告重复；去除它们使 TF-IDF 分数最多下降 0.031，而 LLM 几乎不受影响。我们在 https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts 发布了切分标识、每份报告的预测和分析脚本，以及 CyberTriage——一个在本地服务微调分类器的工具。
translation.brief: 解决缺陷严重性自动分类中微调开源 LLM 相对廉价分类器增益不明的问题，通过在 Eclipse 报告上与 TF-IDF 和 CodeBERT 基线进行配对对比实验来衡量。

papers.title: SpeC2Rust: Specification-Driven Repository-Level C-to-Rust Translation
papers.abstract: Legacy C codebases remain central to system software and performance-critical infrastructure, but their weak memory safety imposes security and maintenance risks. Recent C-to-Rust translation systems, including LLM-based translators, make automated migration increasingly feasible, yet they still struggle to recover repository-level intent, avoid raw pointers and unsafe constructs, maintain cross-file interfaces, and repair compilation and validation failures efficiently. We propose SpeC2Rust, a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation. It has three stages: (1) Project-Intent Structuring, which decomposes a C repository into semantically coherent modules and generates persistent repository- and module-level specifications; (2) Spec-Guided Generation, which translates each Rust module against these specifications with a live symbol registry to preserve cross-file consistency; and (3) Layered-Feedback Repair, which batches repairs and injects only failure-relevant diagnostics, specification context, and source evidence for efficient compilation and test-driven correction. We evaluate SpeC2Rust on eight repository-level C projects. It generates Rust projects that compile and pass the original end-to-end tests, with no raw-pointer declarations, raw-pointer dereferences, or unsafe lines. On projects shared with an LLM-based baseline, SpeC2Rust reduces cost by 66.1% and input-token usage by 84.7%.

translation.title: SpeC2Rust：规格驱动的仓库级 C 到 Rust 翻译
translation.abstract: 遗留 C 代码库仍是系统软件和性能关键基础设施的核心，但其薄弱的内存安全性带来安全与维护风险。近期的 C 到 Rust 翻译系统（包括基于 LLM 的翻译器）使自动化迁移日益可行，但它们在恢复仓库级意图、避免裸指针和不安全构造、维护跨文件接口以及高效修复编译和验证失败方面仍有困难。我们提出 SpeC2Rust，一个规格驱动的仓库级 C 到 Rust 翻译流水线。它包含三个阶段：(1) 项目意图结构化，将 C 仓库分解为语义连贯的模块，并生成持久的仓库级和模块级规格；(2) 规格引导生成，依据这些规格翻译每个 Rust 模块，并通过实时符号注册表保持跨文件一致性；(3) 分层反馈修复，批量执行修复并仅注入与失败相关的诊断信息、规格上下文和源码证据，以实现高效的编译和测试驱动修正。我们在八个仓库级 C 项目上评估 SpeC2Rust。它生成的 Rust 项目能够编译并通过原始的端到端测试，且不含裸指针声明、裸指针解引用或不安全行。在与基于 LLM 的基线共享的项目上，SpeC2Rust 将成本降低 66.1%，输入 token 用量降低 84.7%。
translation.brief: 解决 C 到 Rust 自动迁移中难以恢复仓库级意图并避免不安全构造的问题，采用规格驱动的三阶段流水线（意图结构化、规格引导生成、分层反馈修复）。

papers.title: Honesty Testing of LLMs and AI Agents: A Vision for Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Human oversight of large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents increasingly depends on their reports. Claims that conflict with a system's own judgments can conceal failures, prevent timely intervention, and contribute to severe harm. Greater autonomy makes faithful reporting increasingly important for maintaining human control. In this vision paper, we propose honesty testing of LLMs and AI agents as a new research area in software engineering. Building on existing honesty evaluations, our goal is to make faithful reporting a software quality requirement that developers can specify, test, and maintain. We define honesty bugs as behavioural defects in which an LLM or AI agent, when required to communicate faithfully, makes an explicit claim that conflicts with its own judgment at the time of reporting. We present an initial framework covering LLM-level testing under controlled inputs and agent-level testing of complete systems. The framework connects these levels to testing workflows and oracle evidence. We identify research directions in benchmarks, model and harness analysis, oracle construction, and lifecycle testing to support effective oversight alongside task correctness.

translation.title: LLM与AI智能体的诚实性测试：面向软件工程的愿景
translation.abstract: 人类对大语言模型（LLM）和人工智能（AI）智能体的监督越来越依赖于系统的报告。与系统自身判断相冲突的声明可能掩盖失败、阻碍及时干预并导致严重危害。更高的自主性使得忠实报告对维持人类控制愈发重要。在这篇愿景论文中，我们提出将LLM和AI智能体的诚实性测试作为软件工程的一个新研究方向。基于现有的诚实性评估，我们的目标是使忠实报告成为开发者可以指定、测试和维护的软件质量需求。我们将诚实性缺陷定义为一种行为缺陷：LLM或AI智能体在被要求忠实沟通时，做出了与自身在报告时判断相冲突的明确声明。我们提出了一个初步框架，涵盖受控输入下的LLM级测试和完整系统的智能体级测试，并将这两个层次与测试工作流和oracle证据相连接。我们指出了在基准测试、模型与测试工具分析、oracle构建和生命周期测试方面的研究方向，以在任务正确性之外支持有效监督。
translation.brief: 提出将LLM与AI智能体的“诚实性缺陷”（报告与自身判断冲突）作为软件质量需求，并给出覆盖LLM级与智能体级的诚实性测试框架。

papers.title: Beyond Benchmarks: Can Small Open-Weight Models Get Real Coding Work Done?
papers.abstract: Making an open-weight language model generate text is not the same as making it finish coding work. This retrospective empirical systems experience report follows my engineering work from July to October 2026 across coding clients, model-specific serving recipes, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and MLX. Models behind a nominally compatible endpoint still differed in tool-call formatting, turn control, context behavior, cache reuse, and reliability. A served model, coherent text, executed tool calls, and code that passes independent behavioral checks proved to be distinct levels of progress. The evidence includes 4,165 coding-agent gateway turns from my own sessions, 623 debug jobs, and three separate delegation studies with hidden behavioral checks and a fixed Claude Opus 5.5 parent. Saved cold-prefix requests had a median time to first token of about 69.4 s, versus 2.8 s for high-reuse requests (observational). In a 45-trial study, direct coding passed 15/15 and delegation to a quantized Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B worker passed 12/15 and 14/15. On a second 15-task suite under a fixed artifact contract, the completed replacement cohort had 45/45 for direct coding and 12/45 for a Nemotron Cascade 2 worker (11 worker substitutions). Sixteen sessions stopped by a subscription limit before any model call were replaced; counting them as failures gives 37/45 and 8/45. A Qwen3-Coder worker passed 0/45. In both studies with a direct arm, direct coding had lower API list-price-equivalent frontier cost per verified success. A post-hoc diagnostic found that 19 of 36 artifacts rejected only for renamed parameters passed the hidden checks unchanged; they are not counted as successes. The contribution is an evidence-qualified account of serving, agent protocol, session continuity, artifact validation, and verification in practice. The studies are not pooled and do not rank models or runtimes.

translation.title: 超越基准测试：小型开放权重模型能真正完成编码工作吗？
translation.abstract: 让开放权重语言模型生成文本并不等于让它完成编码工作。这份回溯性的实证系统经验报告记录了我2026年7月至10月间在编码客户端、模型专用服务方案、vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp和MLX上的工程工作。名义上兼容的端点背后的模型在工具调用格式、轮次控制、上下文行为、缓存复用和可靠性方面仍存在差异。被服务的模型、连贯的文本、可执行的工具调用以及通过独立行为检查的代码被证明是不同层次的进展。证据包括我自己会话中的4,165个编码智能体网关轮次、623个调试任务，以及三项包含隐藏行为检查和固定Claude Opus 5.5父代理的委托研究。保存的冷前缀请求的首token时间中位数约为69.4秒，而高复用请求为2.8秒（观察性数据）。在一项45次试验的研究中，直接编码通过了15/15，而委托给量化Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B工作模型通过了12/15和14/15。在固定工件契约下的第二个15任务套件上，已完成的替换组直接编码为45/45，而Nemotron Cascade 2工作模型为12/45（11次工作模型替换）。十六个会话在任何模型调用前因订阅限制而停止并被替换；若将其计为失败，则为37/45和8/45。Qwen3-Coder工作模型通过了0/45。在两项含直接编码组的研究中，直接编码的每个已验证成功的API标价等价前沿成本更低。事后诊断发现，36个仅因参数重命名而被拒绝的工件中有19个原样通过了隐藏检查；它们未被计为成功。本文的贡献是对服务、智能体协议、会话连续性、工件验证和实践中的验证的有证据限定的描述。这些研究未进行合并，也不对模型或运行时进行排名。
translation.brief: 通过长期工程实践中的编码智能体会话与委托实验，实证考察小型开放权重模型在真实编码工作（服务、协议、验证等）中相对直接编码的实际可用性。

papers.title: ComBeautify: Leveraging Code Change Summaries for Conventional Commit Generation
papers.abstract: Modern software development relies on version control systems such as Git to track changes and facilitate collaboration. While commit messages are crucial for conveying developer intent, they do not affect program functionality; as a result, developers often lack motivation to write meaningful ones. The Conventional Commits Specification (CCS) addresses this with a structured format and guidelines that help developers express the intent of a change, improving clarity and enabling automation. Yet, developers frequently struggle to express intent while adhering to the format. In particular, they may misclassify commits due to the large number of possible categories or the lack of project-specific guidance. We introduce ComBeautify, an approach that automatically generates CCS-compliant commit messages. Our hybrid approach leverages context-preserving summarization of Git diffs with large language models (LLMs) to improve commit classification accuracy under CCS. Rather than relying on manually curated category definitions, we learn them from historical commits. We also propose a method for automatically generating the CCS description component. Our empirical evaluation across 13 languages, 6,500 open-source repositories, and over 20 million commits provides long-term insights into CCS adoption, revealing increasing compliance. Our evaluation on twenty popular repositories reveals the limitations of approaches guided by generic category definitions, and shows that ComBeautify, when trained on project-specific data, outperforms baselines by up to 3x. Additionally, using a dataset of 2,000 manually curated commits, we validate our summarization approach, achieving up to 95.25% accuracy and surpassing baselines. These findings emphasize the need for adaptable, context-aware AI methods for commit classification and CCS-compliant commit message generation.

translation.title: ComBeautify：利用代码变更摘要生成符合规范的Conventional Commit
translation.abstract: 现代软件开发依赖Git等版本控制系统来跟踪变更并促进协作。虽然提交信息对传达开发者意图至关重要，但它们不影响程序功能；因此开发者往往缺乏编写有意义提交信息的动力。Conventional Commits规范（CCS）通过结构化格式和指南解决这一问题，帮助开发者表达变更意图，提高清晰度并支持自动化。然而，开发者在遵循格式的同时表达意图时常常遇到困难，尤其是由于类别繁多或缺乏项目特定指导而可能错误分类提交。我们提出ComBeautify，一种自动生成符合CCS的提交信息的方法。我们的混合方法利用大语言模型（LLM）对Git diff进行保留上下文的摘要，以提高CCS下的提交分类准确率。我们不依赖人工整理的类别定义，而是从历史提交中学习它们。我们还提出一种自动生成CCS描述组件的方法。我们在13种语言、6,500个开源仓库和超过2,000万次提交上的实证评估提供了对CCS采纳的长期洞察，显示合规性在不断提升。我们在20个流行仓库上的评估揭示了由通用类别定义引导的方法的局限性，并表明ComBeautify在项目特定数据上训练后，性能最高可达基线的3倍。此外，使用包含2,000个人工整理提交的数据集，我们验证了摘要方法，达到最高95.25%的准确率并超越基线。这些发现强调了对提交分类和符合CCS的提交信息生成而言，可适应、上下文感知的AI方法的必要性。
translation.brief: 提出ComBeautify，利用LLM对Git diff做上下文保留摘要并从历史提交中学习类别定义，自动生成符合CCS规范的提交信息。

papers.title: MulFCoder: Framework-conditioned Multi-agent for MLLM-based Multi-framework Front-end Code Generation
papers.abstract: Generating runnable front-end code from UI screenshots is a long-standing goal in automated software engineering. Existing MLLM-based methods predominantly focused on HTML/CSS, leaving multi-framework generation for React/Vue/Angular underexplored. Naively modifying prompts leads to substantial performance gaps across multi-framework and highly framework-specific error modes. To address this, we propose MulFCoder, a framework-conditioned multi-agent method that explicitly encodes framework constraints to bring multi-framework differences into a decidable rule space. MulFCoder orchestrates four agents: Grounder constructs an ElementTable, ContentTable, and macro-layout regions from detected UI elements; Planner builds a DOM-like hierarchical layout tree, produces a task schedule, and derives a framework-specific file Contract; Writer generates structured file writes or patches within a restricted edit window; Judger enforces lightweight, framework-conditioned constraints to accept or reject updates and trigger bounded repairs, preventing drift and deadlocks without expensive builds. Experiments demonstrate that MulFCoder substantially improves compilation success rate and reduces framework-specific errors, with particularly pronounced gains on Angular.

translation.title: MulFCoder：面向MLLM多框架前端代码生成的框架条件化多智能体方法
translation.abstract: 从UI截图生成可运行的前端代码是自动化软件工程的长期目标。现有的基于MLLM的方法主要聚焦于HTML/CSS，而对React/Vue/Angular等多框架生成的探索不足。简单地修改提示词会在多框架之间产生显著的性能差距，并出现高度框架特有的错误模式。为解决这一问题，我们提出MulFCoder，一种框架条件化的多智能体方法，显式编码框架约束，将多框架差异纳入可判定的规则空间。MulFCoder编排四个智能体：Grounder从检测到的UI元素构建ElementTable、ContentTable和宏观布局区域；Planner构建类DOM的层次布局树、生成任务调度，并推导框架特定的文件Contract；Writer在受限编辑窗口内生成结构化文件写入或补丁；Judger执行轻量级的框架条件化约束以接受或拒绝更新并触发有界修复，防止漂移和死锁而无需昂贵的构建。实验表明，MulFCoder显著提高了编译成功率并减少了框架特有错误，在Angular上的提升尤为明显。
translation.brief: 提出框架条件化的四智能体方法MulFCoder，显式编码框架约束，使MLLM能从UI截图生成React/Vue/Angular等多框架的可运行前端代码。

papers.title: A Multi-Domain Study on the Effectiveness of LLMs at Writing Property-Based Tests
papers.abstract: A property-based test (PBT) checks a property of a program on many generated inputs, but writing one takes a property, a generator of valid inputs, and an oracle. LLM-based PBT writers produce all three, yet they have been evaluated only on Python libraries. We study how two of them, Proptest-AI and Agentic-PBT, generalize to ten programs in five domains: deep learning libraries, databases, system software, compilers, and LLM serving engines. Most of these programs take text in their own language, such as queries, configurations, and programs. Agentic-PBT covers more branches than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten programs with Opus 5 and on all ten with GLM-5.3-Flash. Domain-specific fuzzers cover more of the compilers and of PostgreSQL and less of PyTorch than Agentic-PBT. We filed 180 bug reports, 44 of which duplicate reports that others filed after the models' knowledge cutoffs; maintainers have confirmed 65 of the others, in all five domains, and fixed 23. We draw lessons for building and evaluating such writers: low observability hurts them, and mature fuzzers paired with LLM-written properties could check that each feature behaves as documented.

translation.title: LLM编写基于性质的测试有效性的多领域研究
translation.abstract: 基于性质的测试（PBT）在大量生成的输入上检查程序的一个性质，但编写一个PBT需要性质定义、有效输入生成器和oracle。基于LLM的PBT编写器可生成这三者，但此前仅在Python库上被评估过。我们研究其中两个——Proptest-AI和Agentic-PBT——在五个领域的十个程序上的泛化能力：深度学习库、数据库、系统软件、编译器和LLM服务引擎。这些程序大多接受自有语言的文本输入，如查询、配置和程序。使用Opus 5时，Agentic-PBT在十个程序中的七个上覆盖的分支多于Proptest-AI；使用GLM-5.3-Flash时则在全部十个上更多。领域特定模糊测试工具在编译器、PostgreSQL上覆盖更多，而在PyTorch上少于Agentic-PBT。我们提交了180份bug报告，其中44份与模型知识截止日期后他人提交的报告重复；维护者已确认其余报告中的65份（覆盖全部五个领域），并修复了23份。我们为构建和评估此类编写器总结了经验：低可观测性会损害其表现，而成熟的模糊测试工具与LLM编写的性质结合可以检查每个功能是否按文档描述运行。
translation.brief: 在五个领域的十个程序上评估两种LLM的PBT编写器的泛化能力，并总结构建此类编写器的经验教训。

papers.title: Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science
papers.abstract: AI has made significant contributions to scientific discovery. Autonomous agents can now independently analyse complex problems, design experiments, write and execute code, analyse findings, and derive scientific conclusions. Nevertheless, errors in AI-generated code, experimental procedures, or evidence interpretation can lead to invalid research conclusions, undermining the reliability and reproducibility of automated scientific discovery. In this vision paper, we propose Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science (SE4AI4Sci) as an emerging research area for addressing this challenge. As an organising framework, we introduce the Scientific Assurance Chain, connecting intent, experimental design, implementation, execution, evidence, and claim. Through six documented failures in recent AI-for-science systems, we show where this chain can break, where existing assurance mechanisms fall short, and what new research challenges follow. We also outline a research agenda for adapting and extending software engineering techniques across the chain.

translation.title: 面向AI驱动科学的软件工程
translation.abstract: AI已为科学发现做出重要贡献。自主智能体现在可以独立分析复杂问题、设计实验、编写并执行代码、分析结果并得出科学结论。然而，AI生成的代码、实验流程或证据解释中的错误可能导致无效的研究结论，损害自动化科学发现的可靠性与可复现性。在这篇愿景论文中，我们提出将面向AI驱动科学的软件工程（SE4AI4Sci）作为一个应对该挑战的新兴研究领域。作为组织框架，我们引入了科学保证链（Scientific Assurance Chain），连接意图、实验设计、实现、执行、证据与结论。通过近期AI-for-Science系统中六个有记录的失败案例，我们展示了该链条可能在何处断裂、现有保证机制在何处不足，以及由此产生的新研究挑战。我们还概述了在整个链条上适配和扩展软件工程技术的研究议程。
translation.brief: 针对AI自动科学发现中代码与实验错误导致结论不可靠的问题，提出SE4AI4Sci研究领域及贯穿意图到结论的科学保证链框架。

papers.title: Do AI Coding Agents Write Infrastructure as Code Like Humans? An Empirical Study of GitHub Pull Requests
papers.abstract: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) configurations define cloud resources, networking, and access control, and AI coding agents increasingly write them. Little is known about how agent contributions differ from those of humans and automation bots, how maintainers evaluate them, and whether they introduce different sustainability concerns. We study 349,156 IaC pull requests (PRs) from 49,241 GitHub repositories, distinguishing humans, automation bots, silent agents, and disclosed agents. Bots account for 32.9% of ostensibly human PRs, and 12.3% of the remaining PRs contain agent traces, a share that grows over the study period. Agent PRs are about four times larger than human PRs and more often modify core infrastructure modules, whereas bots mainly maintain dependencies. Silent-agent PRs have higher overall merge rates than human PRs (87.4% vs. 78.9%) but are merged 4.0 percentage points less often within the same repositories. Disclosed agents create new infrastructure more often than humans (34.0% vs. 21.4%), and even for the same change type within the same repository, their PRs are 8.4 points less likely to be merged; silent-agent PRs show comparable acceptance for most change types. Finally, in 2,645 matched agent-human Terraform PR pairs, agent and human PRs introduce sustainability smells at similar rates (10.4% vs. 10.3%; paired odds ratio 1.02, 95% CI 0.83-1.25), most commonly missing remote state and monolithic configurations.

translation.title: AI编程智能体像人类一样编写基础设施即代码吗？基于GitHub Pull Request的实证研究
translation.abstract: 基础设施即代码（IaC）配置定义了云资源、网络和访问控制，而AI编程智能体正越来越多地编写这些配置。目前对智能体贡献与人类及自动化机器人贡献的差异、维护者如何评估它们，以及它们是否引入不同的可持续性问题知之甚少。我们研究了来自49,241个GitHub仓库的349,156个IaC pull request（PR），区分人类、自动化机器人、未披露的智能体和已披露的智能体。机器人占表面上是人类的PR的32.9%，其余PR中有12.3%包含智能体痕迹，且这一比例在研究期间持续增长。智能体PR的规模约是人类PR的四倍，更常修改核心基础设施模块，而机器人主要维护依赖。未披露智能体的PR总体合并率高于人类PR（87.4% vs. 78.9%），但在同一仓库内合并率低4.0个百分点。已披露智能体比人类更常创建新基础设施（34.0% vs. 21.4%），即使在同一仓库中进行相同类型的更改，其PR被合并的可能性也低8.4个百分点；未披露智能体的PR在大多数更改类型上接受度相当。最后，在2,645对匹配的智能体-人类Terraform PR中，智能体与人类PR以相近的比率引入可持续性坏味道（10.4% vs. 10.3%；配对比值比1.02，95% CI 0.83-1.25），最常见的是缺少远程状态和单体式配置。
translation.brief: 通过分析34.9万个GitHub IaC PR，实证比较AI智能体、人类与机器人在编写基础设施即代码时的规模、合并率与可持续性坏味道差异。

papers.title: Built to Remember, Shipped to Forget: Operational Contracts, Failures, and Repairs in Containerized LLM Agent Deployments
papers.abstract: LLM agent systems reach production as container images run by platforms such as Docker, Compose, and Kubernetes. Framework and platform document opposite expectations: to the platform a container is disposable, while the framework persists conversations, pauses runs for human input, and resumes interrupted work from saved state; each side specifies only its own behavior, so the obligations their composition creates are stated nowhere. We present the first empirical study of this boundary, stating these obligations as operational contracts: guarantees a deployment must provide to preserve an agent system's required behavior when a deployment-platform event occurs. From the first-party documentation of LangGraph and the three platforms we derive 14 contracts and evaluate them with three independent sources of evidence: 433 deployed open-source agent systems, seven events induced on 12 of them, and 122 developer repairs mined from 39,261 commits, pull requests, and issues.
