At least one contract applies to 75.5% of the systems, yet its guarantee is routinely missing: of systems that must keep state beyond the process, 37.4% lose it to a restart and 41.5% to a container replacement, and every assessable deployment stops the framework's production server mid-drain. Induced events turn 14 of 16 predicted violations into runtime failures and all seven predicted holds pass. The failures are born in deployment but repaired in code: developer repairs independently cover twelve of the fourteen contracts, 78% change application code, and only two in three fully restore the violated guarantee. The 14-contract catalogue, detection rules, fault-injection harness, and 35-pattern repair taxonomy provide a basis for checking and strengthening agent deployments.

translation.title: 为记忆而构建，为遗忘而部署：容器化LLM智能体部署中的运行契约、故障与修复
translation.abstract: LLM智能体系统以容器镜像的形式到达生产环境，由Docker、Compose和Kubernetes等平台运行。框架与平台的文档表达了相反的期望：对平台而言容器是一次性的，而框架会持久化对话、暂停运行以等待人类输入，并从保存的状态恢复被中断的工作；双方各自只规定自己的行为，因此其组合所产生的义务无处声明。我们首次对这一边界进行实证研究，将这些义务表述为运行契约（operational contracts）：即当部署平台事件发生时，部署必须提供的保证，以维持智能体系统所需的行为。从LangGraph及三个平台的第一方文档中，我们推导出14条契约，并用三个独立证据来源进行评估：433个已部署的开源智能体系统、在其中12个系统上诱导的七类事件，以及从39,261个commit、pull request和issue中挖掘出的122个开发者修复。至少有一条契约适用于75.5%的系统，但其保证经常缺失：在需要跨进程保留状态的系统中，37.4%因重启丢失状态，41.5%因容器替换丢失状态，且每个可评估的部署都会在排空过程中中途停止框架的生产服务器。诱导事件将16个预测违规中的14个转化为运行时故障，而所有七个预测保持的用例均通过。这些故障诞生于部署环节，却在代码中被修复：开发者修复独立覆盖了14条契约中的12条，78%的修复更改了应用代码，且只有三分之二的修复完全恢复了被违反的保证。14条契约目录、检测规则、故障注入工具和35种模式的修复分类法为检查和加强智能体部署提供了基础。
translation.brief: 首次实证研究容器化LLM智能体部署中框架与平台之间的运行契约，推导14条契约并揭示状态丢失等故障及开发者的修复模式。

papers.title: CodeMeepo: A Multi-Agent Workflow for Repository-Level Code Migration and Optimization
papers.abstract: Repository-level code migration rewrites an entire project in a new programming language while preserving its observable behavior. It is challenging because behavior spans interdependent modules, dependencies and build infrastructure must be adapted to the target ecosystem, and the source code is often the only specification. Large language model agents can now attempt these migrations end to end, but three challenges remain. First, an agent that writes both the translation and its acceptance tests may overlook the same requirements in both, leaving missing or incorrect behavior undetected. Second, large repositories can exceed a model's context window, and dividing the work into smaller tasks does not ensure that all required behavior is migrated. Third, even behaviorally correct translations may be slower than the original implementation. We present CodeMeepo, a multi-agent pipeline for complete and efficient migration of large repositories. Each milestone is evaluated against a fixed external oracle that the agents neither author nor modify. A separate parity assessment compares source and target components in scope and adds identified gaps back into the plan as required work. Ordered milestones limit the scope of each task, while cumulative regression checks guard against breaking already-migrated behavior. A benchmark-guided optimization phase addresses performance, followed by full-suite conformance testing and repair. Eight specialized agent roles communicate through file artifacts, and a deterministic state machine governs repair, deferral, scope changes, and termination. On nine subjects in three language pairs, CodeMeepo achieves the best pass rate on every subject and passes 18% more tests than a state-of-the-art multi-agent baseline using the same model. On a production daemon, its optimization phase improves half of the benchmarks, by 25% on average.

translation.title: CodeMeepo：面向仓库级代码迁移与优化的多智能体工作流
translation.abstract: 仓库级代码迁移是在保持可观察行为的前提下，用新的编程语言重写整个项目。这具有挑战性，因为行为跨越相互依赖的模块，依赖和构建基础设施必须适配目标生态系统，且源代码往往是唯一的规范。大语言模型智能体现在可以端到端地尝试这些迁移，但仍存在三个挑战。第一，同时编写翻译及其验收测试的智能体可能在两者中忽略相同的需求，使缺失或错误的行为无法被检测。第二，大型仓库可能超出模型的上下文窗口，而将工作划分为更小的任务并不能确保所有必需的行为都被迁移。第三，即使行为正确的翻译也可能比原实现更慢。我们提出CodeMeepo，一个用于完整且高效迁移大型仓库的多智能体流水线。每个里程碑都由智能体既不编写也不修改的固定外部oracle进行评估。独立的对等评估比较源与目标组件的范围，并将发现的差距作为必需工作加回计划。有序的里程碑限制每个任务的范围，而累积回归检查防止破坏已迁移的行为。基准引导的优化阶段解决性能问题，随后进行全套一致性测试与修复。八个专门的智能体角色通过文件工件通信，由确定性状态机管理修复、推迟、范围变更和终止。在三个语言对的九个对象上，CodeMeepo在每个对象上都取得最佳通过率，使用相同模型时比最先进的多智能体基线多通过18%的测试。在一个生产守护进程上，其优化阶段改进了一半的基准，平均提升25%。
translation.brief: 提出多智能体流水线CodeMeepo，通过外部oracle评估、里程碑划分与基准引导优化，实现大型仓库的完整高效跨语言迁移。

papers.title: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Language model agents often abandon correct work when a user challenges it, yet simply telling them to stand firm makes them ignore real mistakes. Once an agent reads a complaint, it tends to discount its own earlier checks in order to agree with the user. We introduce Thinking-in-Bets, a training-free method in which an agent writes a short private record of its main claims, the checks supporting them, and its confidence before reading user feedback. When challenged, the agent consults this Claim Checklist to keep verified work intact while investigating uncertain or newly challenged parts. We evaluate five Gemini models (3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.5 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.8 Flash, and 4.0 Argon) across eight benchmarks: SWE-Together, SWE-Interact, and DeepSWE for software engineering, Agents' Last Exam for professional reports, Humanity's Last Exam and SycEval for academic reasoning, Vals Finance for financial analysis, and Terminal-Bench for command-line tasks. Recording claims before criticism nearly eliminates false reversals in patch review and protects passing report drafts under mistaken pushback, whereas writing the same record after reading the complaint recovers very little of the gain. In multi-turn coding, pre-reply claim records substantially reduce unnecessary file edits after mistaken complaints, and gating the record so it is written only when the agent is uncertain lowers token overhead while fixing more real bugs than the baseline. Even in non-interactive tasks without user feedback, listing the key claims in a draft and re-checking the weakest one before submission improves both answer accuracy and confidence estimates across all tested models.

translation.title: 测试时的赌注式思考减少LLM智能体的谄媚性修改
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体在用户质疑其工作时常常放弃正确的结果，但简单地要求它们坚持立场又会使其忽视真实的错误。一旦智能体读到抱怨，它倾向于贬低自己先前的检查以迎合用户。我们提出Thinking-in-Bets，一种无需训练的方法：智能体在阅读用户反馈之前，先写下其核心主张、支持这些主张的检查以及置信度的简短私人记录。当受到质疑时，智能体查阅这份主张清单（Claim Checklist），保持已验证工作的完整，同时调查不确定或新受到质疑的部分。我们在八个基准上评估五个Gemini模型（3.5 Flash-Lite、3.5 Flash、3.6 Flash、3.8 Flash和4.0 Argon）：软件工程的SWE-Together、SWE-Interact和DeepSWE，专业报告的Agents' Last Exam，学术推理的Humanity's Last Exam和SycEval，金融分析的Vals Finance，以及命令行任务的Terminal-Bench。在批评之前记录主张几乎消除了补丁评审中的错误反转，并在错误的反对下保护通过的报告草稿，而在阅读抱怨之后写同样的记录几乎无法恢复收益。在多轮编程中，回复前的主张记录大幅减少了错误抱怨后不必要的文件编辑，且通过门控使记录仅在智能体不确定时才写入，可降低token开销，同时比基线修复更多真实bug。即使在无用户反馈的非交互任务中，在草稿中列出关键主张并在提交前复查最弱的一项，也能在所有测试模型上提升答案准确性和置信度估计。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体被用户质疑时放弃正确工作的问题，提出无需训练的Thinking-in-Bets方法，在读取反馈前记录主张与置信度以抵御谄媚性修改。

papers.title: The Physical Cost of Context: Quality-Constrained Resource Accounting for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents resend a growing context on every model call, and context policies are usually judged by the prompt tokens they save. Executed work also depends on call count and prefix reuse: a caching runtime prefills only the tokens after the longest cached prefix. A shorter prompt can therefore cost more if it rewrites cached history. Our quality-gated protocol splits executed prefill into logical prompt minus reused prefix and measures KV residency, time, and energy. On 450 localization cases derived from SWE-rebench V2, preloading ten retrieved blocks (Eager) and adding anchored history compaction (Compact) both pass a five-point non-inferiority gate. In a separate 900-cell study, Eager cuts model calls by 35.7% and the GPU-energy proxy by 33.2% against on-demand search (Grep); Compact saves nothing further. Enabling prefix caching leaves Eager's prompt volume similar (+8.3%; its 95% CI spans zero) but cuts its uncached prefill by 67.7%. Deleting history can turn a token saving into extra work. With mini-SWE-agent on 100 SWE-bench Verified instances, keeping only the last five observations (Mask-5) cuts Eager's prompt volume by 33.3% but loses 135.9k reusable tokens per task. Uncached prefill rises by 608.5%, the energy proxy by 125.6%, and the policy misses the quality gate. Policies thus save physical work by shortening the trajectory and can multiply it by editing reusable history.

translation.title: 上下文的物理代价：面向编码代理的质量约束资源核算
translation.abstract: 编码代理在每次模型调用时都会重发不断增长的上下文，而上下文策略通常仅以节省的 prompt token 数来评判。实际执行的工作还取决于调用次数和前缀复用：缓存运行时只预填充最长缓存前缀之后的 token。因此，如果较短的 prompt 重写了已缓存的历史，其代价可能反而更高。我们的质量门控协议将实际执行的预填充拆分为逻辑 prompt 减去复用前缀，并测量 KV 驻留、时间和能耗。在基于 SWE-rebench V2 的 450 个定位案例上，预加载十个检索块（Eager）和添加锚定式历史压缩（Compact）均通过了五点非劣性门控。在另一项 900 单元的研究中，Eager 相比按需搜索（Grep）将模型调用减少 35.7%，GPU 能耗代理减少 33.2%；Compact 未带来额外节省。启用前缀缓存后，Eager 的 prompt 体量基本不变（+8.3%；其 95% 置信区间包含零），但未缓存预填充减少 67.7%。删除历史可能把 token 节省变成额外工作。在 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 实例上使用 mini-SWE-agent 时，仅保留最后五条观察（Mask-5）使 Eager 的 prompt 体量减少 33.3%，但每个任务丢失 135.9k 可复用 token，未缓存预填充上升 608.5%，能耗代理上升 125.6%，且该策略未通过质量门控。因此，上下文策略通过缩短轨迹来节省物理工作，而编辑可复用历史则可能成倍增加物理工作。
translation.brief: 针对上下文策略只按节省 token 评判而忽视实际执行代价的问题，提出质量门控协议，将预填充拆分为逻辑 prompt 减去复用前缀并核算 KV 驻留、时间与能耗。

papers.title: Silent and Costly: Characterizing and Detecting Prompt-Caching Mis-Integration in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) services process massive volumes of user requests, resulting in substantial inference costs. To reduce both cost and latency, providers have introduced prompt caching. However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial due to heterogeneous provider-specific APIs and continuously evolving caching semantics. To understand prompt-caching mis-integration in downstream applications, we conduct the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests from 10 popular open-source agent systems. Our findings show that prompt-caching mis-integrations arise in both request-side misconfiguration and read-side usage miscount. More importantly, most mis-integrations fail silently without causing observable runtime failures. Motivated by these findings, we design CACHELINT, which models a prompt-caching mis-integration as an invocation site together with the preconditions required for correct cache integration. CACHELINT locates caching invocation sites with CodeQL and discharges each precondition either against a dated provider capability oracle or with an LLM guard check. CACHELINT achieves 0.71 precision and 0.78 recall in identifying the 120 labeled mis-integrations across the 10 studied agent systems. Our evaluation further demonstrates the effectiveness of CACHELINT in real-world settings, identifying 32 mis-integrations across 571 agent projects with 0.86 precision. These findings have received 21 developer confirmations and led to 18 upstream fixes, including one in Anthropic's official SDK.

translation.title: 无声而昂贵：LLM 代理中 prompt 缓存错误集成的刻画与检测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务处理海量用户请求，产生巨大的推理成本。为降低成本和延迟，服务商引入了 prompt 缓存。然而，由于各服务商 API 异构且缓存语义不断演进，正确集成 prompt 缓存并非易事。为理解下游应用中的 prompt 缓存错误集成，我们对来自 10 个流行开源代理系统的 120 个与 prompt 缓存相关的 pull request 进行了首次实证研究。研究结果表明，prompt 缓存错误集成既源于请求侧的错误配置，也源于读取侧的使用计数错误。更重要的是，大多数错误集成会静默失败，不产生可观察的运行时故障。基于这些发现，我们设计了 CACHELINT，它将 prompt 缓存错误集成建模为一个调用点加上正确缓存集成所需的前置条件。CACHELINT 使用 CodeQL 定位缓存调用点，并依据带日期的服务商能力 oracle 或 LLM 守卫检查来逐一验证前置条件。在识别 10 个代理系统中的 120 个标注错误集成时，CACHELINT 达到 0.71 的精确率和 0.78 的召回率。评估进一步证明了 CACHELINT 在真实环境中的有效性：在 571 个代理项目中识别出 32 个错误集成，精确率为 0.86。这些发现获得了 21 次开发者确认，并促成 18 个上游修复，其中包括 Anthropic 官方 SDK 中的一处。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 代理中 prompt 缓存错误集成难以发现的问题，通过实证研究刻画其模式，并设计 CACHELINT，用 CodeQL 定位调用点并以能力 oracle 或 LLM 守卫检查验证前置条件。

papers.title: Large Language Models for Quantum Code Translation: An Exploratory Study
papers.abstract: Quantum software development is challenged by quantum-mechanical semantics and fragmented software development kits (SDKs), which complicate cross-SDK code translation and execution. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based approach for translating executable programs between high-level quantum SDKs. We develop a quantum-aware translation workflow whose prompt design and validation reflect quantum semantics and accommodate the version evolution of quantum ecosystems. We conduct a preliminary evaluation of 4 LLM configurations on 43 tasks, translating Qiskit programs to PennyLane and Q#. LLMs achieve a zero-shot Pass@1 of up to 72.33%, while one-shot prompting further improves the translation effectiveness. These results suggest potential for quantum code translation by LLMs.

translation.title: 用于量子代码翻译的大语言模型：一项探索性研究
translation.abstract: 量子软件开发面临量子力学语义和碎片化软件开发工具包（SDK）的挑战，这使得跨 SDK 的代码翻译和执行变得复杂。本文提出一种基于 LLM 的方法，用于在高层量子 SDK 之间翻译可执行程序。我们开发了量子感知的翻译工作流，其 prompt 设计和验证反映量子语义，并适应量子生态系统的版本演进。我们在 43 个任务上对 4 种 LLM 配置进行了初步评估，将 Qiskit 程序翻译为 PennyLane 和 Q#。LLM 的零样本 Pass@1 最高达到 72.33%，而单样本提示进一步提升了翻译效果。这些结果表明 LLM 在量子代码翻译方面具有潜力。
translation.brief: 针对跨量子 SDK 代码翻译困难的问题，提出量子感知的 LLM 翻译工作流，在 Qiskit 到 PennyLane 和 Q# 的翻译任务上进行评估。

papers.title: Ethics by Configuration: AI Ethics Principles in Coding Agent Instructions
papers.abstract: As AI coding agents become integral to software development, projects increasingly utilise configuration files, such as context files and skills, to govern agent behaviour. While AI ethics principles are widely used in research and policy, little is known about whether and how they are reflected when developers configure coding agents. We studied ethics principles in 40,079 configuration files across 8,893 GitHub repositories. Using a validated large language model (LLM) classification, we measured the prevalence of ethics-related statements, and qualitatively analysed 702 stratified samples across 679 files to uncover the ethical considerations reflected in these files and the parties they concern. Ethics-related statements appeared in 39.4% of files and 61.5% of repositories; concentrated on accountability, transparency, privacy protection, and reliability; and occurred more often in task-specific files such as skills than in project-wide context files. Our qualitative analysis identified 30 categories of ethical considerations, which take the form of concrete rules for the agent. Accountability appeared mainly as requirements for human approval, transparency as explain and honestly report the agent's work, and fairness as accessibility and localisation. These considerations reveal a difference in focus. Whereas public ethics frameworks aim to protect society and end users, configuration files mainly concern developers, maintainers, and community members in the development workflow. Ethics-related content appeared mainly in prose-based files, and whether agents follow these instructions remains untested. We discuss the implications for practitioners, researchers, and policymakers.

translation.title: 通过配置实现伦理：编码代理指令中的 AI 伦理原则
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 编码代理成为软件开发不可或缺的一部分，项目越来越多地使用配置文件（如上下文文件和技能）来约束代理行为。虽然 AI 伦理原则在研究和政策中被广泛使用，但关于开发者在配置编码代理时是否以及如何体现这些原则，我们知之甚少。我们研究了来自 8,893 个 GitHub 仓库的 40,079 个配置文件中的伦理原则。使用经过验证的大语言模型（LLM）分类，我们测量了伦理相关陈述的普遍程度，并对 679 个文件中的 702 个分层样本进行定性分析，以揭示这些文件中体现的伦理考量及其涉及的相关方。伦理相关陈述出现在 39.4% 的文件和 61.5% 的仓库中；集中于问责、透明度、隐私保护和可靠性；并且更多出现在技能等任务特定文件中，而非项目级上下文文件中。我们的定性分析识别出 30 类伦理考量，它们以针对代理的具体规则形式存在。问责主要表现为要求人工批准，透明度表现为解释并诚实报告代理的工作，公平则表现为可访问性和本地化。这些考量揭示了一种关注点的差异：公共伦理框架旨在保护社会和最终用户，而配置文件主要关注开发工作流中的开发者、维护者和社区成员。伦理相关内容主要出现在基于散文的文件中，而代理是否遵循这些指令仍有待检验。我们讨论了对从业者、研究者和政策制定者的启示。
translation.brief: 针对开发者配置编码代理时如何体现 AI 伦理原则缺乏了解的问题，对近 4 万个配置文件进行 LLM 分类与定性分析，刻画伦理考量的类别与关注对象。

papers.title: AIPC: Evidence-Guided Agent Workflows for PyTorch Project Deployment
papers.abstract: Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, requires more than using a framework device API as with CUDA. The project must be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Differences in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces create cross-layer problems spanning PyTorch/ONNX models, toolchains, runtimes, and device execution. LLM Agents can invoke tools to address such problems, but may drift because of insufficient domain knowledge, large configuration and repair spaces, or poor path selection. We propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, organizing model adaptation, artifact building, on-target execution, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into one deployment flow. We evaluate AIPC on the on-device NPU path of Qualcomm QAIRT across vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion models. In two optimization cases, 6/7 Skill-arm Whisper-Small runs meet predefined accuracy and latency criteria versus 0/6 control runs, while YOLO-Worldv2 achieves a 2.791x end-to-end speedup versus 1.599x for the control. Under a pre-fixed deployment contract, Skill, tool permissions, and check conditions, some runs achieve zero in-run human intervention (0-HITL). We also examine Qwen3.8-27B as a locally deployable model for driving an Agent workflow.

translation.title: AIPC：面向 PyTorch 项目部署的证据引导代理工作流
translation.abstract: 在专用加速器（尤其是端侧 NPU）上部署和优化 PyTorch 推理项目，不仅仅是像使用 CUDA 那样调用框架设备 API。项目必须被转换为硬件运行时工件，并适配目标工具链和应用接口。模型格式、量化流程、算子支持和工具链接口的差异会产生跨越 PyTorch/ONNX 模型、工具链、运行时和设备执行的跨层问题。LLM 代理可以调用工具来解决此类问题，但可能因领域知识不足、配置与修复空间过大或路径选择不佳而漂移。我们提出 AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion），一种用于部署 PyTorch 推理项目的代理方法。AIPC 将结构化 Skills 与工具链、运行时和性能剖析证据相结合，驱动跨层诊断与修复，将模型适配、工件构建、目标端执行、精度修复和性能优化组织为统一的部署流程。我们在 Qualcomm QAIRT 的端侧 NPU 路径上，对视觉、语音、LLM 和扩散模型评估了 AIPC。在两个优化案例中，6/7 个 Skill-arm 的 Whisper-Small 运行满足预定义的精度和延迟标准，而对照组为 0/6；YOLO-Worldv2 实现了 2.791 倍的端到端加速，对照组为 1.599 倍。在预先固定的部署契约、Skill、工具权限和检查条件下，部分运行实现了零人工干预（0-HITL）。我们还考察了 Qwen3.8-27B 作为驱动代理工作流的本地可部署模型。
translation.brief: 针对 PyTorch 项目部署到端侧 NPU 时跨层问题导致 LLM 代理漂移的问题，提出 AIPC，将结构化 Skills 与工具链、运行时和剖析证据结合以驱动跨层诊断与修复。

papers.title: SemWeaver: Refining LLM-Generated Static Vulnerability Checkers with Analyzer-Internal Evidence
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that LLMs can synthesize static-analysis checkers from security patches, but a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. A patch reveals what changed, not why the change is safe, so generated checkers often match only the surface edit and miss the deeper semantic condition. Existing refinement loops feed back compilation errors and validation reports, yet these signals describe symptoms without explaining what the checker misunderstands about the code. We observe that the analysis framework itself already computes the information needed to close this gap. Control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks are available inside the analyzer but unused by current refinement strategies. SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts patch-relevant analyzer evidence and assembles it with source context and validation feedback into a structured, provenance-labelled bundle. An iterative editing loop refines the checker on both the vulnerable and fixed revisions, guarded by a retention gate that accepts warning recovery or false-positive reduction while preventing over-pruning. We evaluate SemWeaver on 39 KNighter-derived CSA checkers from Linux kernel fixes. With analyzer evidence, refinement reaches 23 warning-positive vulnerable revisions (vs. 15 for KNighter's loop) and raises version-level $F_1$ from 0.448 to 0.575. An ablation removing internal evidence recovers fewer silent cases and produces different checker edits, indicating that the two evidence configurations address complementary recognition gaps. Additional experiments cover three editor models on a 12-subject subset, a CodeQL query refinement, and controlled source-form variations. A qualitative follow-up on all 11 non-tied comparisons traces each warning-count change to a specific checker repair, such as recognizing a lowered callback or unwrapping an expression cast.

translation.title: SemWeaver：利用分析器内部证据精炼 LLM 生成的静态漏洞检查器
translation.abstract: 近期研究表明，LLM 能够从安全补丁中合成静态分析检查器，但可编译的检查器并不一定是正确的。补丁只揭示了改动了什么，而非改动为何安全，因此生成的检查器往往只匹配表面编辑而遗漏更深层的语义条件。现有的精炼循环只反馈编译错误和验证报告，这些信号仅描述症状，却不解释检查器对代码的误解所在。我们观察到，分析框架本身已经计算了弥合这一差距所需的信息。控制流图、符号值、内存区域和检查器回调在分析器内部可用，却被现有精炼策略忽视。SemWeaver 是一个插件式精炼层，它提取与补丁相关的分析器证据，并将其与源码上下文和验证反馈组装成结构化、带来源标注的证据包。迭代编辑循环在漏洞版本和修复版本上同时精炼检查器，并由保留门控保护，在接受警告恢复或误报减少的同时防止过度剪枝。我们在来自 Linux 内核修复的 39 个 KNighter 衍生的 CSA 检查器上评估了 SemWeaver。借助分析器证据，精炼达到 23 个警告阳性的漏洞版本（KNighter 循环为 15 个），并将版本级 $F_1$ 从 0.448 提升至 0.575。移除内部证据的消融实验恢复了更少的静默案例并产生不同的检查器编辑，表明两种证据配置解决的是互补的识别差距。附加实验包括在 12 个主题子集上测试三个编辑模型、一次 CodeQL 查询精炼以及受控的源码形式变体。对全部 11 组非平局比较的定性后续分析将每次警告数量变化追溯到具体的检查器修复，例如识别降级后的回调或解包表达式类型转换。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 从补丁生成的静态检查器只匹配表面编辑、遗漏深层语义条件的问题，核心方法是提取分析器内部的 CFG、符号值、内存区域等证据并与验证反馈结合进行迭代精炼。

papers.title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
papers.abstract: Coding agents can adapt their harnesses, the software, configuration, and instructions used to run them, based on experience from earlier tasks, but whether these adaptations improve their behavior on later tasks remains unclear. We study \retro, a skill that asks an agent to review a completed session and propose harness changes, and ask what changes it proposes and whether implemented changes reduce repeated work on later tasks. We ran Claude Code on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues, qualitatively coded the 125 proposals from \retro, implemented 24, and evaluated 12 harness changes on later issues from the same repositories in fresh sessions with and without each change. Most proposals referred to an event in the session, but 18 of 43 lint-related proposals recommended a practice regardless of what had happened. Among the seven evaluations in which sessions without the change encountered the targeted problem, two changes eliminated the targeted action, one reduced its occurrence, four showed no reduction, and some changes added work on unrelated issues. Harness self-evolution requires more than generating and implementing changes: it needs ways to establish whether a change helps on later tasks and to revise or remove changes that do not.

translation.title: 编码智能体 Harness 如何自我进化？一项回顾性适应的实证研究
translation.abstract: 编码智能体可以基于早期任务的经验调整其 harness（运行它们所用的软件、配置和指令），但这些调整是否能改善其在后续任务上的行为仍不清楚。我们研究了 \retro——一种让智能体回顾已完成的会话并提出 harness 修改建议的技能——并探究它会提出哪些修改，以及已实施的修改能否减少后续任务中的重复工作。我们在 30 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上运行 Claude Code，对 \retro 提出的 125 条建议进行定性编码，实施了 24 条，并在相同仓库的后续问题上以全新会话评估了 12 项 harness 修改（分别在有和无该修改的情况下）。大多数建议都引用了会话中的某个事件，但 43 条与 lint 相关的建议中有 18 条无论发生了什么都推荐某种实践。在无该修改的会话遇到目标问题的七次评估中，两项修改消除了目标行为，一项减少了其发生，四项没有减少，且某些修改在不相关的问题上增加了工作量。Harness 自我进化需要的不仅是生成和实施修改：还需要建立修改是否对后续任务有帮助的验证方法，以及修订或移除无效修改的机制。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体基于会话回顾自我修改 harness 是否有效，核心方法是在 SWE-bench Verified 问题上对回顾性建议进行定性编码并在后续任务上对照评估其实际效果。

papers.title: Reasoning Patterns for Efficient AI Coding: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate long reasoning traces that expose intermediate inference behavior, offering opportunities to study and control reasoning in AI coding. However, the underlying patterns in these traces and their potential for analyzing and guiding coding models remain poorly understood, limiting systematic characterization and inference-time control of LRM reasoning. We conduct an empirical study of reasoning patterns across four representative coding tasks. We transform reasoning traces into structured action sequences and mine recurring fragments using within-task support, cross-task contrasts, and valid--invalid support contrasts. We characterize four general reasoning patterns by coding agents: design-to-implementation for code generation, state tracing for execution reasoning, evidence--fix--recheck for debugging, and semantic mapping for translation. We further identify positive and negative patterns associated with valid and invalid reasoning traces, respectively. Positive patterns reflect verification-driven convergence, whereas negative patterns reflect repeated design revision, reflection, and knowledge recall without closure. To demonstrate their practical utility, we evaluate three pattern-based applications: task identification, pattern-guided prompting, and pattern-aware early stopping. Features capturing general reasoning patterns enable accurate task identification from reasoning traces without accessing task descriptions or final answers. Prompting guided by positive and negative patterns improves the overall accuracy of downstream tasks, while negative pattern-aware early stopping substantially reduces API-reported token usage with only a modest decrease in pass@1. All three applications also generalize to previously unseen models, showing that reasoning patterns can support both the analysis and control of LRM behavior in AI coding.

translation.title: 面向高效 AI 编码的推理模式：一项实证研究
translation.abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）生成暴露中间推理行为的长推理轨迹，为研究和控制 AI 编码中的推理提供了机会。然而，这些轨迹中的底层模式及其在分析和引导编码模型方面的潜力仍鲜为人知，限制了对 LRM 推理的系统性刻画和推理时控制。我们对四个代表性编码任务中的推理模式进行了实证研究。我们将推理轨迹转化为结构化动作序列，并利用任务内支持度、跨任务对比以及有效-无效支持度对比挖掘反复出现的片段。我们刻画了编码智能体的四种通用推理模式：面向代码生成的设计到实现、面向执行推理的状态追踪、面向调试的证据-修复-复检，以及面向翻译的语义映射。我们进一步识别了分别与有效和无效推理轨迹相关的正负模式。正模式体现验证驱动的收敛，而负模式体现无闭环的重复设计修订、反思和知识回忆。为展示其应用价值，我们评估了三种基于模式的应用：任务识别、模式引导提示和模式感知早停。捕获通用推理模式的特征无需访问任务描述或最终答案即可从推理轨迹中准确识别任务。正负模式引导的提示提升了下游任务的整体准确率，而负模式感知的早停大幅减少了 API 报告的 token 用量，仅带来 pass@1 的轻微下降。三种应用均可泛化到未见过的模型，表明推理模式可以同时支持 AI 编码中 LRM 行为的分析与控制。
translation.brief: 解决 LRM 推理轨迹模式不明、难以用于分析与控制的问题，核心方法是将轨迹转化为结构化动作序列并挖掘通用与正负推理模式，进而支持任务识别、模式引导提示和早停。

papers.title: Rivet: Utility-Preserving Context Control for Repository-Level Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Repository-level code generation asks an agent to implement a task requirement inside an existing repository. To produce code that works in the repository, the agent needs repository evidence, such as target locations, helper definitions, caller usages, and configuration constraints, which determine how the code should be located, integrated, and executed. Because the context budget cannot hold the entire repository, existing retrieval, compression, and structure-aware methods select context by task similarity, context length, or structural proximity, but these criteria do not directly measure whether the selected context contains this evidence. As a result, the selected context can appear relevant to the task yet miss the evidence that the implementation depends on. We call this failure mode context utility dilution. In this paper, we propose Rivet, a context control framework that preserves repository evidence for coding agents under a fixed context budget. Rivet, first uses Signal Grounding to select task-related code anchors by fusing lexical, semantic, and structural signals. Utility Linking then expands these anchors through dependency, usage, and configuration relations to collect repository evidence. Finally, Budget Shaping packs the evidence by priority and, when the budget is tight, reduces snippets to signatures or summaries before dropping them. We evaluate Rivet, on two executable repository-level benchmarks, DevEval and RepoExec, with four backbone models, two context budgets (4K and 8K tokens), and eight baselines. Rivet, achieves the highest Pass@1 in all 16 settings and improves over the strongest baseline by 3.73--5.15 percentage points on average. Moreover, GPT-5-mini with Rivet, outperforms GPT-5 without Rivet,on both benchmarks while reducing inference cost by 73.3%--84.5%.

translation.title: Rivet：面向仓库级编码智能体的保效用上下文控制
translation.abstract: 仓库级代码生成要求智能体在现有仓库中实现任务需求。为生成能在仓库中正常工作的代码，智能体需要仓库证据，如目标位置、辅助函数定义、调用方用法和配置约束，它们决定代码应如何定位、集成和执行。由于上下文预算无法容纳整个仓库，现有的检索、压缩和结构感知方法按任务相似度、上下文长度或结构邻近度选择上下文，但这些标准并未直接衡量所选上下文是否包含此类证据。结果是所选上下文看似与任务相关，却遗漏了实现所依赖的证据。我们将这种失败模式称为上下文效用稀释。本文提出 Rivet，一个在固定上下文预算下为编码智能体保留仓库证据的上下文控制框架。Rivet 首先通过融合词汇、语义和结构信号的信号锚定（Signal Grounding）选择与任务相关的代码锚点；然后通过效用链接（Utility Linking）沿依赖、用法和配置关系扩展这些锚点以收集仓库证据；最后通过预算塑形（Budget Shaping）按优先级打包证据，当预算紧张时，先将代码片段缩减为签名或摘要再丢弃。我们在两个可执行的仓库级基准 DevEval 和 RepoExec 上，使用四个骨干模型、两种上下文预算（4K 和 8K token）和八个基线评估 Rivet。Rivet 在全部 16 种设置中取得最高 Pass@1，相比最强基线平均提升 3.73--5.15 个百分点。此外，使用 Rivet 的 GPT-5-mini 在两个基准上均优于不使用 Rivet 的 GPT-5，同时将推理成本降低 73.3%--84.5%。
translation.brief: 解决上下文选择看似相关却遗漏实现所需仓库证据的“上下文效用稀释”问题，核心方法是通过信号锚定、效用链接和预算塑形在固定预算下保留并按优先级打包仓库证据。

papers.title: V$^3$AST-Bench: Verifiable, Valid, and Versatile Safety Evaluation for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly act through code, modifying repositories, executing programs, and interacting with services in agent form. Their actions introduce risks that cannot be assessed from generated responses alone. Safety evaluation must verify actual consequences, distinguish harm avoidance from task incapability, and cover realistic workflows. We introduce V$^3$AST-Bench, a benchmark for Verifiable results, Valid interpretation, and Versatile risk coverage of Agent Safety. It comprises 212 risk tasks spanning 18 categories. Dedicated runtime environments verify harm and task outcomes through executable checks over states, records, and artifact behavior, while paired capability twin tasks verify workflow competence. Our experiments span 51 combinations of 11 models and five harnesses, spanning 86,496 trials and over 9 billion tokens of model interaction. Results show that V$^3$AST-Bench remains challenging even for frontier coding agents, as Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code still causes verified harm on 20.9% of tasks. Across model-harness combinations, agents with comparable competence exhibit markedly different safety outcomes, showing that task capability alone does not guarantee safe execution. More importantly, even explicit recognition of risks does not reliably prevent harmful actions, revealing a critical gap between risk awareness and safe execution. These findings highlight the need to move beyond risk recognition toward enforcing safety throughout execution.

translation.title: V$^3$AST-Bench：面向编码智能体的可验证、有效且多样的安全评估
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地通过代码行事，以智能体形式修改仓库、执行程序并与服务交互。其行为带来的风险无法仅从生成的回复中评估。安全评估必须验证实际后果，区分避免伤害与任务能力不足，并覆盖真实工作流。我们提出 V$^3$AST-Bench，一个面向智能体安全的可验证结果（Verifiable）、有效解读（Valid）和多样风险覆盖（Versatile）的基准。它包含 212 个横跨 18 个类别的风险任务。专用运行时环境通过对状态、记录和工件行为的可执行检查来验证危害和任务结果，同时配对的能力孪生任务用于验证工作流能力。我们的实验涵盖 11 个模型与五种 harness 的 51 种组合，共 86,496 次试验和超过 90 亿 token 的模型交互。结果表明，即使对前沿编码智能体而言，V$^3$AST-Bench 仍然具有挑战性：使用 Claude Code 的 Claude Opus 4.8 仍在 20.9% 的任务上造成已验证的危害。跨模型-harness 组合来看，能力相当的智能体表现出显著不同的安全结果，说明仅凭任务能力并不能保证安全执行。更重要的是，即使明确识别了风险，也不能可靠地阻止有害行为，揭示了风险意识与安全执行之间的关键差距。这些发现凸显了超越风险识别、在执行全程强制安全的必要性。
translation.brief: 解决仅凭模型回复无法评估智能体实际安全后果的问题，核心方法是构建带可执行运行时验证和配对能力孪生任务的多类别风险基准，以区分危害避免与能力不足。

papers.title: Behavioral Regression Detection for Pull Requests via Structured Oracles
papers.abstract: Software regressions are unintended behavioral changes introduced by code modifications and are hard to detect at pull-request (PR) level. Existing methods rely on incomplete tests or directly analyze PRs via LLMs, lacking structured behavioral reasoning and explicit oracles. We present ORION, a staged framework for PR-level regression detection. ORION extracts PR intent and identifies impacted functions via AST-based impact analysis, then synthesizes function-level structured behavioral oracles encoding preserved/changed behaviors, setup constraints and control-flow hints from PR intent, static risk signals and code changes. Guided by these oracles, ORION generates executable tests, conducts oracle-coverage-guided augmentation and static repair, and differentially runs tests on pre- and post-change code. It classifies PRs with deterministic rules and constrained LLM reasoning. We build RegBench-Py, the first Python PR regression benchmark with 154 verified real-world PRs. ORION achieves F1-scores of 0.6125 (DeepSeek-Chat-V3.2) and 0.5578 (Claude-4.5-haiku), outperforming baselines including Testora, Codex and Claude Code. Compared with PatchGuru, ORION supports broader multi-function PRs while remaining competitive on single-function cases. On 1,459 merged PRs, ORION finds 9 reproducible regression candidates, 8 confirmed by maintainers. It takes ~15 minutes per PR, showing practicality for CI/CD screening.

translation.title: 基于结构化 Oracle 的 Pull Request 行为回归检测
translation.abstract: 软件回归是代码修改引入的非预期行为变化，在 pull request（PR）层面难以检测。现有方法依赖不完整的测试或直接用 LLM 分析 PR，缺乏结构化的行为推理和显式 oracle。我们提出 ORION，一个用于 PR 级回归检测的分阶段框架。ORION 提取 PR 意图并通过基于 AST 的影响分析识别受影响的函数，然后从 PR 意图、静态风险信号和代码变更中合成函数级结构化行为 oracle，编码保留/变更的行为、setup 约束和控制流提示。在这些 oracle 的引导下，ORION 生成可执行测试，进行 oracle 覆盖引导的增强和静态修复，并在变更前后代码上差分运行测试。它通过确定性规则和受约束的 LLM 推理对 PR 进行分类。我们构建了 RegBench-Py，首个包含 154 个经验证真实世界 PR 的 Python PR 回归基准。ORION 取得 F1 分数 0.6125（DeepSeek-Chat-V3.2）和 0.5578（Claude-4.5-haiku），优于 Testora、Codex 和 Claude Code 等基线。与 PatchGuru 相比，ORION 支持更广泛的多函数 PR，同时在单函数场景下保持竞争力。在 1,459 个已合并 PR 上，ORION 发现 9 个可复现的回归候选，其中 8 个得到维护者确认。每个 PR 约需 15 分钟，显示出在 CI/CD 筛查中的实用性。
translation.brief: 针对 PR 级软件回归检测缺乏结构化行为推理的问题，提出 ORION 框架，通过合成函数级结构化行为 oracle 引导测试生成与差分执行来检测回归。

papers.title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. To this end, we trained the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception on a manually collected dataset of 667 UI screens, called Hagasu. By correctly identifying 78.5% of scrollable regions, experiments across nine GUI agents show that integrating Hagasu improves the mean end-to-end completion rate from 64.8% to 82.7% on explore-dependent tasks. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the swipe dataset and the source code of Hagasu.

translation.title: 探索不可见之物：GUI Agent 中隐藏目标探索的交互式感知
translation.abstract: 尽管在命令行界面（CLI）任务上进展迅速，近期基于 LLM 的 agent 在通过图形用户界面（GUI）可靠执行任务方面仍然吃力。一个关键挑战是有限视口内可见内容受限，尤其在移动设备上，许多任务相关目标处于隐藏状态，只能通过滑动交互才能显现。因此，尽管大多数 GUI agent 支持将滑动作为动作原语，但目标不可见性使它们难以决定何时、何地以及如何滑动以显示隐藏内容。我们的定量研究进一步表明，在需要滑动探索的情形中，GUI agent 有 47.8% 的情况下错误地选择了点击动作。为弥合这一差距，本文提出为 GUI agent 装备可滚动区域感知能力，以在动作选择前支持隐藏区域探索。为此，我们在手工收集的 667 个 UI 屏幕数据集上训练了首个用于可滚动区域感知的多模态模型，称为 Hagasu。通过正确识别 78.5% 的可滚动区域，跨九个 GUI agent 的实验表明，集成 Hagasu 将探索依赖型任务的平均端到端完成率从 64.8% 提升至 82.7%。为促进后续研究，我们发布了滑动数据集和 Hagasu 的源代码。
translation.brief: 针对 GUI agent 无法感知视口外隐藏目标而难以决定滑动操作的问题，训练首个可滚动区域感知多模态模型 Hagasu，在动作选择前识别可滚动区域以支持隐藏区域探索。

papers.title: Testing with Coding Agents: A Large-Scale Comparison of Agent-Supported and Human-Authored Pull Requests
papers.abstract: Context. Coding agents increasingly contribute tests through pull requests that developers then maintain, so how testing work is divided affects long-term maintainability. Objective. We compare pull requests in which developers and coding agents collaborate (agent-supported) with pull requests without detectable agent involvement (human-authored) along five dimensions: the frequency and extent of test changes, their type and context, test structure, test smells, and code coverage. Method. We analyze 114,134 pull requests merged between January 2025 and April 2026 in 391 Java repositories, identifying five coding agents through pull-request-level and commit-level signals. Since agent adoption varies across projects, we compare the two groups within repositories with mixed-effects models that control for change size. Results. Pooled across repositories, both groups change test code almost equally often; within repositories, the odds that an agent-supported pull request does so are 1.65 times higher. Agent-supported pull requests add tests more often (odds ratios 1.50-1.58) and modify (0.70-0.76) and delete (0.51-0.77) them less often. We detect no difference in most structural characteristics of the tests they add, which more often have an oracle, nor, in the 95 repositories we could build, in the coverage of their production changes; in test-only pull requests, however, their tests cover less of the code they exercise. Differences in test smells are borderline and not reproduced for individual test methods. Conclusions. Agent participation is associated with a different mix of testing work, which pooled comparisons across projects can hide or reverse; its relationship with test quality remains uncertain.

translation.title: 使用编码 Agent 进行测试：Agent 辅助与人工编写的 Pull Request 的大规模比较
translation.abstract: 背景：编码 agent 越来越多地通过 pull request 贡献测试，开发者随后需要维护这些测试，因此测试工作的分工方式影响长期可维护性。目标：我们从五个维度比较开发者与编码 agent 协作的 pull request（agent 辅助）与无可检测 agent 参与的 pull request（人工编写）：测试变更的频率和范围、类型和上下文、测试结构、测试坏味以及代码覆盖率。方法：我们分析了 2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月间 391 个 Java 仓库中合并的 114,134 个 pull request，通过 PR 级和 commit 级信号识别五种编码 agent。由于 agent 采用程度因项目而异，我们在仓库内部使用控制变更规模的混合效应模型对两组进行比较。结果：跨仓库汇总时，两组变更测试代码的频率几乎相同；在仓库内部，agent 辅助的 pull request 这样做的几率高 1.65 倍。agent 辅助的 pull request 更常添加测试（几率比 1.50-1.58），更少修改（0.70-0.76）和删除（0.51-0.77）测试。我们未发现两者添加的测试在大多数结构特征上有差异，前者更常带有 oracle；在可构建的 95 个仓库中，生产变更的覆盖率也无差异；然而在仅含测试的 pull request 中，其测试对所执行代码的覆盖更少。测试坏味的差异处于临界水平，且在单个测试方法层面未能复现。结论：agent 参与与不同的测试工作组合相关，跨项目的汇总比较可能掩盖或逆转这种差异；其与测试质量的关系仍不确定。
translation.brief: 针对编码 agent 贡献测试对可维护性影响不明的问题，通过混合效应模型在仓库内部大规模比较 agent 辅助与人工编写的 PR 的测试变更特征。

papers.title: RepoTrace: Improving Requirement Tracing in Multi-Round Agent Interactions
papers.abstract: Code agents have become increasingly capable of performing software engineering tasks through interaction with software environments. However, agents tend to degrade as the number of interaction rounds increases, making it difficult to maintain existing software during iterative modification. We analyze 2,656 agent trajectories in EvoCode-Bench and identify requirement focus misalignment as a recurring failure pattern, where agents struggle to distinguish the primary modification targets of a requirement from unrelated code. We propose Repotrace a requirement-driven repository understanding harness that combines repository structure with requirement semantics to construct a requirement-code correspondence and injects it into the agent context. This correspondence enables code agents to follow the repository architecture, trace requirements across multi-round interactions, and identify the core code elements corresponding to the current requirement. Experiments show that Repotrace improves the mean per-round reward (MPR) across different models (e.g., +19.99 on GLM-5.2) and agent harnesses (e.g., +10.22 on Claude Code). Across rounds, Repotrace increases the average per-round reward from 0.163 to 0.371 on Terminus-2 with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, while reducing average regression errors by 56.78%. We release the source code and agents' trajectories to support future research.

translation.title: RepoTrace：改进多轮 Agent 交互中的需求追踪
translation.abstract: 代码 agent 通过与软件环境交互执行软件工程任务的能力日益增强。然而，随着交互轮数增加，agent 的表现往往退化，使得在迭代修改中维护现有软件变得困难。我们分析了 EvoCode-Bench 中的 2,656 条 agent 轨迹，发现需求焦点错位是一种反复出现的失败模式，即 agent 难以区分需求的主要修改目标与无关代码。我们提出 Repotrace，一个需求驱动的仓库理解 harness，它将仓库结构与需求语义相结合以构建需求-代码对应关系，并将其注入 agent 上下文。这种对应关系使代码 agent 能够遵循仓库架构、在多轮交互中追踪需求，并识别与当前需求对应的核心代码元素。实验表明，Repotrace 在不同模型（如 GLM-5.2 上 +19.99）和 agent harness（如 Claude Code 上 +10.22）上提升了平均每轮奖励（MPR）。跨轮次来看，Repotrace 在 Terminus-2 配 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上将平均每轮奖励从 0.163 提升至 0.371，同时将平均回归错误减少 56.78%。我们发布源代码和 agent 轨迹以支持未来研究。
translation.brief: 针对代码 agent 在多轮交互中因需求焦点错位而退化的问题，提出 Repotrace，通过构建需求-代码对应关系并注入 agent 上下文来引导需求追踪。

papers.title: Toward Evidence-Based Agentic Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Task success rates and execution costs of agentic coding tools depend on both model and harness. The harness manages context, provides tools, and runs the agent loop. In empirical software engineering (SE) studies, comparisons that change model and harness together cannot isolate their effects. We qualitatively annotated 325 experiments reported in 146 peer-reviewed full papers published between 2025 and 2026. We examined the reported configurations and whether comparisons isolated harness effects, including harness configuration and version, model, tasks, and user interaction. The exact version of every harness used was reported for only 15 experiments. For five, the paper reported when the experiments were run, and for 31, authors shared execution traces for every session. Of the 226 experiments comparing harnesses, 35 never varied the harness in isolation. Based on this analysis, we derive requirements for a reference harness that the SE community can use for experiments. We call on the community to report all degrees of freedom of experiments with agentic coding tools and on SE venues to pilot dedicated tracks or special issues around a specified reference harness release. In these tracks, papers would hold the harness version fixed and vary features through separately versioned extensions to isolate feature effects and test their interactions.

translation.title: 迈向基于证据的 Agentic 软件工程
translation.abstract: agentic 编码工具的任务成功率和执行成本同时取决于模型和 harness。harness 管理上下文、提供工具并运行 agent 循环。在实证软件工程（SE）研究中，同时改变模型和 harness 的比较无法分离二者的效应。我们对 2025 至 2026 年间发表的 146 篇同行评审完整论文中报告的 325 个实验进行了定性标注。我们考察了报告的配置以及比较是否分离了 harness 效应，包括 harness 配置和版本、模型、任务和用户交互。仅 15 个实验报告了所用 harness 的确切版本；5 个论文报告了实验运行时间；31 个作者分享了每个会话的执行轨迹。在比较 harness 的 226 个实验中，35 个从未单独变化 harness。基于此分析，我们推导出 SE 社区可用于实验的参考 harness 的需求。我们呼吁社区报告 agentic 编码工具实验的所有自由度，并呼吁 SE 会议围绕指定的参考 harness 发布试点专门赛道或特刊。在这些赛道中，论文应固定 harness 版本，并通过单独版本化的扩展来变化特性，以分离特性效应并检验其交互。
translation.brief: 针对实证研究中模型与 harness 同时变化而无法分离 harness 效应的问题，通过标注 325 个实验分析报告规范缺陷，并提出基于参考 harness 的实验规范与出版机制建议。

papers.title: Making Small Code LLMs More Efficient for Secure Code Review with Neuro-Symbolic Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: As AI coding assistants generate more code, the need to review it for security flaws grows. Existing approaches leave a gap: static analyzers identify program sites but offer little explanation, while language-model explanations can be difficult to verify. Small open-weight code models could make security review available without sending proprietary code to a hosted service. We study whether fine-tuning helps these models turn security evidence into explanations that developers and tools can check. We present secSemScan, which pairs a static analyzer with a locally deployable model that writes a schema-constrained security monologue naming program sites, assigning a CWE, and giving a machine-parseable verdict. We also introduce OGSM (Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue), a dataset of 1,993 C/C\texttt{++} functions covering 22 CWEs in the taint and lifetime families. Each record pairs a function with analyzer-derived or fix-diff-derived evidence and a monologue. We fine-tune three open-weight code models in two stages, first on the output format and then on the monologue content. Because evaluation prompts supply the verdict and evidence, our results measure how well models use that information, not whether they detect vulnerabilities independently. On 355 test records, fine-tuning raised Qwen2.5-Coder-7B's verdict accuracy from 4.8\% to 96.6\%; DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B reached 78.9\%, and StarCoder2-7B reached 43.7\%. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B cited 87.5\% of Tier~1 oracle sites, and every line it cited belonged to the oracle evidence. The results suggest that fine-tuning helps small models produce more structured, evidence-linked security reasoning.

translation.title: 通过神经符号微调让小型代码 LLM 更高效地进行安全代码审查
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 编程助手生成越来越多的代码，对其安全缺陷进行审查的需求也随之增长。现有方法存在缺口：静态分析器能定位程序位置但缺乏解释，而语言模型的解释又难以验证。小型开源权重代码模型可以在不将专有代码发送到托管服务的情况下实现安全审查。我们研究微调是否能帮助这些模型将安全证据转化为开发者和工具可核查的解释。我们提出 secSemScan，它将静态分析器与一个可本地部署的模型配对，该模型生成受 schema 约束的安全独白，指明程序位置、分配 CWE 并给出机器可解析的判定。我们还引入了 OGSM（Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue）数据集，包含 1,993 个 C/C\texttt{++} 函数，覆盖污点和生命周期两类共 22 种 CWE。每条记录将一个函数与分析器推导或修复 diff 推导的证据及一段独白配对。我们分两个阶段微调三个开源权重代码模型：先学习输出格式，再学习独白内容。由于评估提示中提供了判定和证据，我们的结果衡量的是模型利用这些信息的能力，而非其独立检测漏洞的能力。在 355 条测试记录上，微调将 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 的判定准确率从 4.8% 提升至 96.6%；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 达到 78.9%，StarCoder2-7B 达到 43.7%。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 引用了 87.5% 的 Tier 1 oracle 位置，且其引用的每一行都属于 oracle 证据。结果表明，微调有助于小型模型产生更结构化、与证据关联的安全推理。
translation.brief: 针对小型代码模型难以生成可核查的安全审查解释的问题，提出将静态分析器与微调后的本地模型结合的 secSemScan 框架及 OGSM 数据集，通过两阶段微调让模型输出结构化、证据关联的安全独白。

papers.title: FeatureLoop: Benchmarking Coding Agents under Evolving Requirements
papers.abstract: Software development with coding agents often begins with a rough request that users refine after trying the implementation. Final correctness alone does not capture the repeated guidance this process requires. We introduce FeatureLoop, a benchmark of 61 human-reviewed tasks from 34 repositories across five primary programming languages and seven software forms. Each task follows one development goal in a persistent workspace through evolution feedback, which adds or clarifies requirements, and completion feedback, which reports failures of stated requirements. Cumulative executable checks track new behavior, repair, and preservation of earlier functionality. We evaluate 12 frontier models and find that the strongest completes 72.1% of tasks with both feedback types. Across models, however, only 15.4% of observed failed stages recover within two corrective revisions. Further analysis reveals incomplete repairs, regressions, and model-specific differences in feedback use and token efficiency, identifying obstacles to reliable, low-intervention development.

translation.title: FeatureLoop：在需求演化下对编程智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 使用编程智能体进行软件开发时，往往始于一个粗略的请求，用户在试用实现后再进行细化。仅凭最终正确性无法刻画这一过程所需的反复引导。我们提出 FeatureLoop，这是一个包含来自 34 个仓库、五种主要编程语言和七种软件形态的 61 个人工审核任务的基准。每个任务在持久化工作区中围绕一个开发目标，经历演化反馈（新增或澄清需求）和完成反馈（报告已声明需求的失败）。累积的可执行检查用于追踪新行为、修复以及对既有功能的保留。我们评估了 12 个前沿模型，发现最强的模型在两种反馈类型下完成 72.1% 的任务。然而，跨模型来看，观察到的失败阶段中仅有 15.4% 能在两次纠正性修订内恢复。进一步分析揭示了不完整的修复、回归，以及模型在反馈利用和 token 效率上的差异，指出了实现可靠、低干预开发的障碍。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法刻画编程智能体在需求反复演化下的表现的问题，构建了带演化反馈与完成反馈的 FeatureLoop 基准来评估智能体在持续需求变更下的开发能力。

papers.title: The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: A Study of Trajectory Deletion in Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract: Software engineering agents resend their entire trajectory to an LLM at every turn, motivating online trajectory reduction. Prior work shows that randomly deleting 75% of tokens in old turns may preserve agent effectiveness, but it remains unclear why, how agents compensate for missing content, and whether it actually reduces costs. This paper presents an empirical study of 42 trajectory-reduction configurations, focusing on effectiveness, agent behavior, and cost. We systematically explore deleting content from old turns by varying the scope, granularity, amount, and timing of deletion across 9,400 runs with two state-of-the-art agents on SWE-bench Verified. We find deleting large amounts of trajectory content (e.g., up to 100% of reasoning text) can preserve overall effectiveness. Importantly, such deletion must be applied with a delay, as immediate deletion tends to significantly degrade effectiveness. Agents often compensate for deleted content by re-fetching it, increasing both the number of turns taken and the input/output tokens. Whether trajectory reduction reduces costs depends on the pricing model: Under a flat pricing model, estimated costs fall in 26 of 42 evaluations. Surprisingly, under a caching-aware pricing model, zero evaluations yield lower costs, since reducing the trajectory breaks the cached prefix billed at a lower rate. Our findings have three implications: First, token counts alone are misleading; trajectory reduction techniques must consider overall costs under a realistic pricing model. Second, analyzing trajectories is crucial to understand agent behavior, as end-to-end effectiveness hides differences such as excessive re-fetching. Finally, these results highlight the need for future work on memory management to reduce costs without sacrificing effectiveness.

translation.title: 遗忘的隐性代价：软件工程智能体中轨迹删除的研究
translation.abstract: 软件工程智能体在每一轮都会将完整轨迹重新发送给 LLM，这促使了在线轨迹缩减的研究。先前工作表明，随机删除旧轮次中 75% 的 token 可能保持智能体的有效性，但原因何在、智能体如何补偿缺失内容、以及是否真正降低了成本，仍不清楚。本文对 42 种轨迹缩减配置进行了实证研究，聚焦有效性、智能体行为和成本。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用两个最先进的智能体进行了 9,400 次运行，系统地探索了从旧轮次删除内容的方式，改变删除的范围、粒度、数量和时机。我们发现删除大量轨迹内容（例如高达 100% 的推理文本）可以保持整体有效性。重要的是，这种删除必须延迟应用，因为立即删除往往会显著降低有效性。智能体常常通过重新获取被删除的内容来补偿，这增加了轮数和输入/输出 token 数。轨迹缩减是否降低成本取决于定价模型：在平价定价模型下，42 次评估中有 26 次估计成本下降。令人惊讶的是，在缓存感知定价模型下，没有任何评估产生更低成本，因为缩减轨迹破坏了以较低费率计费的缓存前缀。我们的发现有三点启示：第一，仅看 token 数量具有误导性；轨迹缩减技术必须考虑现实定价模型下的总体成本。第二，分析轨迹对理解智能体行为至关重要，因为端到端有效性掩盖了诸如过度重新获取之类的差异。最后，这些结果凸显了未来在内存管理方面开展工作的必要性，以便在不牺牲有效性的前提下降低成本。
translation.brief: 针对智能体轨迹缩减为何有效及是否真正省成本不明的问题，通过大规模实证研究揭示删除旧轮次内容需延迟应用，且在缓存感知定价下反而增加成本。

papers.title: FLOWSTEP: A Framework for Learning to Predict GitHub Actions Workflow STEPs
papers.abstract: Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD) are fundamental to modern software development, yet configuring pipelines such as GitHub Actions (GHA) workflows remains complex and error-prone. Recent work has explored Transformer-based models for GHA workflow recommendation, but existing approaches typically model workflow steps as a single homogeneous generation task. This formulation overlooks a key distinction: reusable Actions are structured, ecosystem-level components, whereas project-specific Scripts encode local build, test, and deployment semantics. Consequently, current models struggle to capture the different forms of knowledge required for accurate workflow completion. In this work, we present FLOWSTEP, a framework for GHA workflow step completion that explicitly distinguishes between Action and Script generation. FLOWSTEP combines large language models (LLMs) with contrastive learning to better capture semantic relationships among workflow contexts, Actions, and Scripts. Evaluated on established benchmarks, FLOWSTEP improves end-to-end workflow step prediction accuracy from 38.23% to 51.09%. Beyond prediction accuracy, we further study whether LLM-as-a-judge can provide a more semantic evaluation of generated workflow steps. By comparing LLM-based assessments with human annotations, we find that the best-performing model configuration reaches substantial agreement with human ground truth (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701), suggesting that LLM-as-a-judge can serve as a scalable complement to manual evaluation.

translation.title: FLOWSTEP：学习预测 GitHub Actions 工作流步骤的框架
translation.abstract: 持续集成与交付（CI/CD）是现代软件开发的基础，然而配置 GitHub Actions（GHA）工作流等流水线仍然复杂且容易出错。近期工作探索了基于 Transformer 的 GHA 工作流推荐模型，但现有方法通常将工作流步骤建模为单一的同质生成任务。这种表述忽视了一个关键区别：可复用的 Action 是结构化的、生态系统级的组件，而项目特定的 Script 则编码了本地的构建、测试和部署语义。因此，当前模型难以捕捉准确完成工作流所需的不同形式的知识。在本工作中，我们提出 FLOWSTEP，一个显式区分 Action 生成与 Script 生成的 GHA 工作流步骤补全框架。FLOWSTEP 将大语言模型（LLM）与对比学习相结合，以更好地捕捉工作流上下文、Action 和 Script 之间的语义关系。在既有基准上的评估显示，FLOWSTEP 将端到端工作流步骤预测准确率从 38.23% 提升至 51.09%。除预测准确率外，我们进一步研究 LLM-as-a-judge 能否为生成的工作流步骤提供更语义化的评估。通过将基于 LLM 的评估与人工标注进行比较，我们发现表现最佳的模型配置与人工真值达到较高一致性（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.701），表明 LLM-as-a-judge 可以作为人工评估的可扩展补充。
translation.brief: 针对现有模型将 GHA 工作流步骤视为同质生成任务而忽略 Action 与 Script 差异的问题，提出结合 LLM 与对比学习、显式区分两类生成的 FLOWSTEP 框架。

papers.title: Investigating Forecasting Capabilities of Narrative Networks on Emerging Stories
papers.abstract: Networks have been used to model the interactions among the elements that underlie a narrative. In this paper, we investigate whether the structure of these networks can predict which links will emerge as a storyline evolves. We construct these networks from news articles using a Semantic Edge Parser (SEP) built on a Large Language Model (LLM), and evaluate the networks on three disparate real-world storylines, the 2022 Canadian Freedom Convoy, Hurricane Melissa (2025), and the 2025-26 Iranian protests. To test the narrative network's predictive capability, we construct a rolling window of the narrative and predict the emergent links between existing narrative elements on the day following the rolling window period. We identify candidate links with seven standard link predictors, including the Adamic-Adar index, Common Neighbors, and Preferential Attachment. Forecasting next-day links across the three storylines, we find Preferential Attachment to be the strongest standard link predictor, achieving a mean ROC-AUC of 0.76-0.79. It exceeds EdgeBank, a memorization baseline, by 11.3-14.5 points on every event. To summarize, narrative-network structure ranks next-day emergent relations above chance, though this advantage is concentrated among the most frequently mentioned, highly connected entities.

translation.title: 研究叙事网络对新兴故事的预测能力
translation.abstract: 网络已被用于建模叙事底层元素之间的交互。本文研究这些网络的结构能否预测随着故事线演化将出现哪些链接。我们使用基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的语义边解析器（Semantic Edge Parser, SEP）从新闻文章中构建这些网络，并在三条不同的真实故事线上评估这些网络：2022 年加拿大自由车队、飓风 Melissa（2025）以及 2025-26 年伊朗抗议活动。为检验叙事网络的预测能力，我们构建叙事的滚动窗口，并预测滚动窗口期后一天现有叙事元素之间新出现的链接。我们使用七种标准链接预测器识别候选链接，包括 Adamic-Adar 指数、共同邻居和优先连接。在对三条故事线的次日链接预测中，我们发现优先连接是最强的标准链接预测器，平均 ROC-AUC 达到 0.76-0.79。它在每个事件上都比记忆基线 EdgeBank 高出 11.3-14.5 分。总之，叙事网络结构对次日新出现关系的排序优于随机水平，尽管这一优势集中在被最频繁提及、高度连接的实体上。
translation.brief: 针对叙事网络结构能否预测故事演化中新出现链接的问题，用基于 LLM 的语义边解析器构建叙事网络并测试七种标准链接预测器的预测能力。

papers.title: On the Discernibility of Topology Changes in Networked LTI Systems
papers.abstract: This article investigates the discernibility of topology changes in networked linear time-invariant systems, with particular focus on edge disconnection. We introduce a new notion of discernibility motivated by a limitation of the definition commonly adopted in the literature. In consensus networks, topology changes are inherently indiscernible for all initial conditions belonging to the synchronization subspace. To overcome this issue, we first introduce the notion of dynamical discernibility of a topology change for elementary consensus networks. This notion explicitly disregards the intrinsic indiscernibility associated with states in the consensus subspace. We characterize this property for directed communication graphs and then specialize the resulting conditions to topology changes arising from either the disconnection of an edge or a variation in its weight. We then extend the analysis to networks of homogeneous agents by introducing discernibility modulo synchronization, which factors out the unavoidable indiscernibility associated with synchronized trajectories. We derive a general characterization showing how discernibility depends jointly on the topology change and on the dynamics of the individual agents. Finally, we specialize the analysis to undirected communication graphs and show that, under mild additional assumptions, discernibility modulo synchronization is equivalent to the dynamical discernibility of the corresponding topology change. This establishes a direct connection between the two notions and extends existing results on the discernibility of topology variations in dynamical networks. The resulting characterizations are then further specialized to the case of edge disconnection.

papers.title: Recursive Neighbor Pruning: Decentralized Community Detection with Certified Behavior from Saturated Opinion Dynamics
papers.abstract: Detecting communities, i.e., groups of densely connected nodes, usually requires a central entity that knows the whole network. We study Recursive Neighbor Pruning (RNP), a fully decentralized alternative inspired by social learning. Each agent holds a private opinion but only shows its neighbors a coarse public action, namely its opinion amplified and clipped to a fixed range. Agents repeatedly move their opinion toward the actions of their neighbors and, once opinions settle, drop the links with neighbors whose action has the opposite sign. Repeating this procedure on the remaining network splits it into communities, without any agent knowing the network or the number of communities. We use tools from nonlinear control to characterize this behavior. We show that splitting requires the amplification to exceed a threshold set by how strongly the network is bottlenecked. We also show that a group in which every member has enough of its links inside the group can no longer be split once its members agree, and that a single run separates such groups exactly when started from suitable opinions. Finally, we bound the number of runs and messages. On two standard families of synthetic networks, RNP is as accurate as the best centralized method as long as each node has fewer than about forty percent of its links outside its community, and it fails close to the value predicted by our analysis. It is more accurate than two decentralized competitors below this level, but exchanges many more messages.

papers.title: Accelerated Push-Pull with Local Updates for Decentralized Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract: We consider decentralized stochastic nonconvex optimization over directed networks. Push--Pull provides an efficient decentralized optimization framework for such networks, but in the stochastic setting, gradient variance can slow its convergence and complicate the analysis of linear speedup. Motivated by this observation, we incorporate recursive momentum into stochastic Push--Pull for variance reduction, yielding the accelerated stochastic Push--Pull (ASPP) algorithm. Under mean-squared smoothness, we prove that ASPP improves the convergence rate of stochastic Push--Pull and achieves asymptotic linear speedup with respect to the number of agents. To further reduce communication, we develop LASPP, a local-update variant of ASPP that allows each agent to perform multiple local updates between communication rounds. We show that LASPP achieves an additional asymptotic linear speedup with respect to the number of local steps. With a suitable number of local steps, LASPP reduces communication complexity while maintaining the same stochastic gradient complexity as ASPP. Numerical experiments on real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.
